``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLDetailsElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean open;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a disclosure widget from which the user can obtain additional information or controls&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

As with all HTML elements&#44; it is not conforming to use the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element when attempting to represent another type of control&#46; For example&#44; tab widgets and menu widgets are not disclosure widgets&#44; so abusing the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element to implement these patterns is incorrect&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element is not appropriate for footnotes&#46; Please see [the section on footnotes](#footnotes) for details on how to mark up footnotes&#46;

The first <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element child of the element&#44; if any&#44; <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the summary or legend of the details&#46; If there is no child <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent should provide its own legend &#40;e&#46;g&#46; &#34;Details&#34;&#41;&#46;

The rest of the element&#39;s contents <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the additional information or controls&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;details&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> content attribute gives the name of the group of related <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements that the element is a member of&#46; Opening one member of this group causes other members of the group to close&#46; If the attribute is specified&#44; its value must not be the empty string&#46;

Before using this feature&#44; authors should consider whether this grouping of related <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements into an exclusive accordion is helpful or harmful to users&#46; While using an exclusive accordion can reduce the maximum amount of space that a set of content can occupy&#44; it can also frustrate users who have to open many items to find what they want or users who want to look at the contents of multiple items at the same time&#46;

A document must not contain more than one <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element in the same <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;name&#45;group"></a>[details name group](#details-name-group) that has the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;2"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute present&#46; Authors must not use script to add <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements to a document in a way that would cause a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;name&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[details name group](#details-name-group) to have more than one <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element with the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;3"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute present&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The group of elements that is created by a common <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute is exclusive&#44; meaning that at most one of the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements can be open at once&#46; While this exclusivity is enforced by user agents&#44; the resulting enforcement immediately changes the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;4"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attributes in the markup&#46; This requirement on authors forbids such misleading markup&#46;

A document must not contain a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element that is a descendant of another <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element in the same <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;name&#45;group&#45;3"></a>[details name group](#details-name-group)&#46;

Documents that use the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute to group multiple related <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements should keep those related elements together in a containing element &#40;such as a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;section&#45;element"></a><code>[section](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-section-element)</code> element or <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;article&#45;element"></a><code>[article](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-article-element)</code> element&#41;&#46; When it makes sense for the group to be introduced with a heading&#44; authors should put that heading in a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;heading"></a>[heading](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#concept-heading) element at the start of the containing element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Visually and programmatically grouping related elements together can be important for accessible user experiences&#46; This can help users understand the relationship between such elements&#46; When related elements are in disparate sections of a web page rather than being grouped&#44; the elements&#39; relationships to each other can be less discoverable or understandable&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;details&#45;open"></a><strong><code>open</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; it indicates that both the summary and the additional information is to be shown to the user&#46; If the attribute is absent&#44; only the summary is to be shown&#46;

When the element is created&#44; if the attribute is absent&#44; the additional information should be hidden&#59; if the attribute is present&#44; that information should be shown&#46; Subsequently&#44; if the attribute is removed&#44; then the information should be hidden&#59; if the attribute is added&#44; the information should be shown&#46;

The user agent should allow the user to request that the additional information be shown or hidden&#46; To honor a request for the details to be shown&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[set](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;5"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute on the element to the empty string&#46; To honor a request for the information to be hidden&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove) the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;6"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute from the element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This ability to request that additional information be shown or hidden may simply be the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) of the appropriate <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#44; in the case such an element exists&#46; However&#44; if no such element exists&#44; user agents can still provide this ability through some other user interface affordance&#46;

The <a id="details&#45;name&#45;group"></a><strong>details name group</strong> that contains a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element <var>a</var> also contains all the other <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements <var>b</var> that fulfill all of the following conditions&#58;

- Both <var>a</var> and <var>b</var> are in the same <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#46;
- They both have a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute&#44; their <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;5"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attributes are not the empty string&#44; and the value of <var>a</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;6"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute equals the value of <var>b</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;7"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute&#46;

Every <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element has a <a id="details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a><strong>details toggle task tracker</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a>[toggle task tracker](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-tracker) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

The following <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change&#45;ext"></a>[attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>oldValue</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; and <var>namespace</var>&#44; are used for all <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements&#58;

1.  If <var>namespace</var> is not null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>localName</var> is <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;8"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;ensure&#45;details&#45;exclusivity&#45;by&#45;closing&#45;the&#45;given&#45;element&#45;if&#45;needed"></a>[ensure details exclusivity by closing the given element if needed](#ensure-details-exclusivity-by-closing-the-given-element-if-needed) given <var>element</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>localName</var> is <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;7"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code>&#58;

    1.  If one of <var>oldValue</var> or <var>value</var> is null and the other is not null&#44; run the following steps&#44; which are known as the <a id="details&#45;notification&#45;task&#45;steps"></a><strong>details notification task steps</strong>&#44; for this <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#58;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        When the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;8"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is toggled several times in succession&#44; the resulting tasks essentially get coalesced so that only one event is fired&#46;

        1.  If <var>oldValue</var> is null&#44; <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;details&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task"></a>[queue a details toggle event task](#queue-a-details-toggle-event-task) given the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#44; &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#46;

        2.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;details&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a details toggle event task](#queue-a-details-toggle-event-task) given the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#44; &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  If <var>oldValue</var> is null and <var>value</var> is not null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;ensure&#45;details&#45;exclusivity&#45;by&#45;closing&#45;other&#45;elements&#45;if&#45;needed"></a>[ensure details exclusivity by closing other elements if needed](#ensure-details-exclusivity-by-closing-other-elements-if-needed) given <var>element</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;ensure&#45;details&#45;exclusivity&#45;by&#45;closing&#45;the&#45;given&#45;element&#45;if&#45;needed&#45;2"></a>[Ensure details exclusivity by closing the given element if needed](#ensure-details-exclusivity-by-closing-the-given-element-if-needed) given <var>insertedNode</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

To be clear&#44; these attribute change and insertion steps also run when an attribute or element is inserted via the parser&#46;

To <a id="queue&#45;a&#45;details&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task"></a><strong>queue a details toggle event task</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#44; a string <var>oldState</var>&#44; and a string <var>newState</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker) is not null&#58;

    1.  Set <var>oldState</var> to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;2"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;old&#45;state"></a>[old state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-old-state)&#46;

    2.  Remove <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;3"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-task) from its <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;task&#45;queue"></a>[task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-queue)&#46;

    3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;4"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker) to null&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) given the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) and <var>element</var> to run the following steps&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;event&#45;toggle"></a><code>[toggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-toggle)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggleevent"></a><code>[ToggleEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggleevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;oldstate"></a><code>[oldState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-oldstate)</code> attribute initialized to <var>oldState</var> and the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;newstate"></a><code>[newState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-newstate)</code> attribute initialized to <var>newState</var>&#46;

    2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;5"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker) to null&#46;

3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;6"></a>[details toggle task tracker](#details-toggle-task-tracker) to a struct with <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-task) set to the just&#45;queued <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) and <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;old&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[old state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-old-state) set to <var>oldState</var>&#46;

To <a id="ensure&#45;details&#45;exclusivity&#45;by&#45;closing&#45;other&#45;elements&#45;if&#45;needed"></a><strong>ensure details exclusivity by closing other elements if needed</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var> has an <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;9"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> does not have a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;9"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute&#44; or its <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;10"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute is the empty string&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Let <var>groupMembers</var> be a list of elements&#44; containing all elements in <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;name&#45;group&#45;4"></a>[details name group](#details-name-group) except for <var>element</var>&#44; in <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) element <var>otherElement</var> of <var>groupMembers</var>&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;10"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is set on <var>otherElement</var>&#58;

        1.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>otherElement</var> is the only element in <var>groupMembers</var> that has the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;11"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute set&#46;

        2.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[Remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove) the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;12"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute on <var>otherElement</var>&#46;

        3.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;break"></a>[Break](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break)&#46;

To <a id="ensure&#45;details&#45;exclusivity&#45;by&#45;closing&#45;the&#45;given&#45;element&#45;if&#45;needed"></a><strong>ensure details exclusivity by closing the given element if needed</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> does not have an <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;13"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> does not have a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;11"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute&#44; or its <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;12"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute is the empty string&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Let <var>groupMembers</var> be a list of elements&#44; containing all elements in <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;details&#45;name&#45;group&#45;5"></a>[details name group](#details-name-group) except for <var>element</var>&#44; in <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;2"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) element <var>otherElement</var> of <var>groupMembers</var>&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;14"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is set on <var>otherElement</var>&#58;

        1.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove&#45;3"></a>[Remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove) the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;15"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute on <var>element</var>&#46;

        2.  <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;break&#45;2"></a>[Break](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example shows the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element being used to hide technical details in a progress report&#46;

``` text
<section class="progress window">
 <h1>Copying "Really Achieving Your Childhood Dreams"</h1>
 <details>
  <summary>Copying... <progress max="375505392" value="97543282"></progress> 25%</summary>
  <dl>
   <dt>Transfer rate:</dt> <dd>452KB/s</dd>
   <dt>Local filename:</dt> <dd>/home/rpausch/raycd.m4v</dd>
   <dt>Remote filename:</dt> <dd>/var/www/lectures/raycd.m4v</dd>
   <dt>Duration:</dt> <dd>01:16:27</dd>
   <dt>Color profile:</dt> <dd>SD (6-1-6)</dd>
   <dt>Dimensions:</dt> <dd>320×240</dd>
  </dl>
 </details>
</section>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following shows how a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element can be used to hide some controls by default&#58;

``` text
<details>
 <summary><label for=fn>Name & Extension:</label></summary>
 <p><input type=text id=fn name=fn value="Pillar Magazine.pdf">
 <p><label><input type=checkbox name=ext checked> Hide extension</label>
</details>
```

One could use this in conjunction with other <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> in a list to allow the user to collapse a set of fields down to a small set of headings&#44; with the ability to open each one&#46;

![](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-details-1.png)![](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-details-2.png)

In these examples&#44; the summary really just summarizes what the controls can change&#44; and not the actual values&#44; which is less than ideal&#46;

<a id="example&#45;details&#45;exclusive&#45;accordion"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-details-exclusive-accordion)

The following example shows the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;13"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute of the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element being used to create an exclusive accordion&#44; a set of <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> elements where a user action to open one <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element causes any open <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> to close&#46;

``` text
<section class="characteristics">
 <details name="frame-characteristics">
  <summary>Material</summary>
  The picture frame is made of solid oak wood.
 </details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics">
  <summary>Size</summary>
  The picture frame fits a photo 40cm tall and 30cm wide.
  The frame is 45cm tall, 35cm wide, and 2cm thick.
 </details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics">
  <summary>Color</summary>
  The picture frame is available in its natural wood
  color, or with black stain.
 </details>
</section>
```

<a id="example&#45;details&#45;exclusive&#45;accordion&#45;setting&#45;open"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-details-exclusive-accordion-setting-open)

The following example shows what happens when the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;16"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is set on a <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element that is part of a set of elements using the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;name&#45;14"></a><code>[name](#attr-details-name)</code> attribute to create an exclusive accordion&#46;

Given the initial markup&#58;

``` text
<section class="characteristics">
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d1" open>...</details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d2">...</details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d3">...</details>
</section>
```

and the script&#58;

``` text
document.getElementById("d2").setAttribute("open", "");
```

then the resulting tree after the script executes will be equivalent to the markup&#58;

``` text
<section class="characteristics">
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d1">...</details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d2" open>...</details>
 <details name="frame-characteristics" id="d3">...</details>
</section>
```

because setting the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;17"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute on <code>d2</code> removes it from <code>d1</code>&#46;

The same happens when the user activates the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element inside of <code>d2</code>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Because the <a id="the&#45;details&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;18"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is added and removed automatically as the user interacts with the control&#44; it can be used in CSS to style the element differently based on its state&#46; Here&#44; a style sheet is used to animate the color of the summary when the element is opened or closed&#58;

``` text
<style>
 details > summary { transition: color 1s; color: black; }
 details[open] > summary { color: red; }
</style>
<details>
 <summary>Automated Status: Operational</summary>
 <p>Velocity: 12m/s</p>
 <p>Direction: North</p>
</details>
```

#### <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element"></a>4&#46;11&#46;2 The <strong><code>summary</code></strong> element[](#the-summary-element)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;summary](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/summary)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox49&#43;Safari6&#43;Chrome12&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android4&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As the <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;first&#45;child"></a>[first child](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-first-child) of a <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; optionally intermixed with <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;heading&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[heading content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#heading-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-summary)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-summary)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

Uses <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><code>[HTMLElement](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlelement)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a summary&#44; caption&#44; or legend for the rest of the contents of the <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#39;s parent <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#44; if any&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element is a <a id="summary&#45;for&#45;its&#45;parent&#45;details"></a><strong>summary for its parent details</strong> if the following algorithm returns true&#58;

1.  If this <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element has no parent&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  Let <var>parent</var> be this <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#39;s parent&#46;

3.  If <var>parent</var> is not a <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element&#44; then return false&#46;

4.  If <var>parent</var>&#39;s first <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element child is not this <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#44; then return false&#46;

5.  Return true&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) of <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> elements is to run the following steps&#58;

1.  If this <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element is not the <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;summary&#45;for&#45;its&#45;parent&#45;details"></a>[summary for its parent details](#summary-for-its-parent-details)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>parent</var> be this <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;the&#45;summary&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[summary](#the-summary-element)</code> element&#39;s parent&#46;

3.  If the <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute is present on <var>parent</var>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove) it&#46; Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[set](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) <var>parent</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;details&#45;open&#45;2"></a><code>[open](#attr-details-open)</code> attribute to the empty string&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This will then run the <a id="the&#45;summary&#45;element&#58;details&#45;notification&#45;task&#45;steps"></a>[details notification task steps](#details-notification-task-steps)&#46;

#### <a id="commands"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3 Commands[](#commands)

##### <a id="facets&#45;2"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;1 Facets[](#facets-2)

A <a id="concept&#45;command"></a><strong>command</strong> is the abstraction behind menu items&#44; buttons&#44; and links&#46; Once a command is defined&#44; other parts of the interface can refer to the same command&#44; allowing many access points to a single feature to share facets such as the <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate)&#46;

<a id="facets"></a>Commands are defined to have the following <a id="concept&#45;facet"></a><strong>facets</strong>&#58;

<strong><a id="command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a><strong>Label</strong></strong>

The name of the command as seen by the user&#46;

<strong><a id="command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a><strong>Access Key</strong></strong>

A key combination selected by the user agent that triggers the command&#46; A command might not have an Access Key&#46;

<strong><a id="command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a><strong>Hidden State</strong></strong>

Whether the command is hidden or not &#40;basically&#44; whether it should be shown in menus&#41;&#46;

<strong><a id="command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a><strong>Disabled State</strong></strong>

Whether the command is relevant and can be triggered or not&#46;

<strong><a id="command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a><strong>Action</strong></strong>

The actual effect that triggering the command will have&#46; This could be a scripted event handler&#44; a <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) to which to <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;navigate"></a>[navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate)&#44; or a form submission&#46;

<a id="expose&#45;commands&#45;in&#45;ui"></a>User agents may expose the <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[commands](#concept-command) that match the following criteria&#58;

- The <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate) facet is false &#40;visible&#41;&#46;

- The element is <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document) with a non&#45;null <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc)&#46;

- Neither the element nor any of its ancestors has a <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute specified&#46;

User agents are encouraged to do this especially for commands that have <a id="facets&#45;2&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Keys](#command-facet-accesskey)&#44; as a way to advertise those keys to the user&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; such commands could be listed in the user agent&#39;s menu bar&#46;

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;2 <strong>Using the <code>a</code> element to define a command</strong>[](#using-the-a-element-to-define-a-command)

An <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element with an <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#44; if any&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate) of the command is true &#40;hidden&#41; if the element has a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate) facet of the command is true if the element or one of its ancestors is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) of the command is to <a id="using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event"></a>[fire a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at the element&#46;

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;3 <strong>Using the <code>button</code> element to define a command</strong>[](#using-the-button-element-to-define-a-command)

A <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code> element always <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label)&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey)&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate)&#44; and <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) facets of the command are determined <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;using&#45;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>[as for <code>a</code> elements](#using-the-a-element-to-define-a-command) &#40;see the previous section&#41;&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate) of the command is true if the element or one of its ancestors is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#44; or if the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-disabled) state is set&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;4 <strong>Using the <code>input</code> element to define a command</strong>[](#using-the-input-element-to-define-a-command)

An <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in one of the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;"></a>[Submit Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#submit-button-state-(type=submit))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;"></a>[Reset Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#reset-button-state-(type=reset))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image-button-state-(type=image))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;button&#41;"></a>[Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#button-state-(type=button))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>[Radio Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#radio-button-state-(type=radio))&#44; or <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>[Checkbox](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) states <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) of the command is determined as follows&#58;

1.  If the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in one of the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Submit Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#submit-button-state-(type=submit))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Reset Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#reset-button-state-(type=reset))&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Image Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image-button-state-(type=image))&#44; or <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;button&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#button-state-(type=button)) states&#44; then the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) is the string given by the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if any&#44; and a UA&#45;dependent&#44; locale&#45;dependent value that the UA uses to label the button itself if the attribute is absent&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; if the element is a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;labeled&#45;control"></a>[labeled control](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#labeled-control)&#44; then the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;3"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) is the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content) of the first <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-label-element)</code> element in <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) whose <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;2"></a>[labeled control](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#labeled-control) is the element in question&#46; &#40;In JavaScript terms&#44; this is given by <code>element&#46;labels&#91;0&#93;&#46;textContent</code>&#46;&#41;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute is present&#44; then the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;4"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) is the value of that attribute&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;5"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) is the empty string&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Even though the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute on <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> elements in the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Image Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image-button-state-(type=image)) state is non&#45;conformant&#44; the attribute can still contribute to the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;6"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) determination&#44; if it is present and the Image Button&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-alt)</code> attribute is missing&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#44; if any&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate) of the command is true &#40;hidden&#41; if the element has a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate) of the command is true if the element or one of its ancestors is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#44; or if the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-disabled) state is set&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) of the command is to <a id="using&#45;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event"></a>[fire a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at the element&#46;

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;5 <strong>Using the <code>option</code> element to define a command</strong>[](#using-the-option-element-to-define-a-command)

An <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element with an ancestor <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element and either no <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-option-value)</code> attribute or a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-option-value)</code> attribute that is not the empty string <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) of the command is the value of the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-option-label)</code> attribute&#44; if there is one&#44; or else the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#44; with <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;strip&#45;and&#45;collapse&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[ASCII whitespace stripped and collapsed](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-and-collapse-ascii-whitespace)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#44; if any&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate) of the command is true &#40;hidden&#41; if the element has a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate) of the command is true if the element is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-option-disabled)&#44; or if its nearest ancestor <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; or if it or one of its ancestors is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

If the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code>&#39;s nearest ancestor <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element has a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) of the command is to <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;toggle"></a>[toggle](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-select-toggle) the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#46; Otherwise&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action&#45;2"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) is to <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;pick"></a>[pick](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-select-pick) the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#46;

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;6 <strong>Using the <code>accesskey</code> attribute on a <code>legend</code> element to define a command</strong>[](#using-the-accesskey-attribute-on-a-legend-element-to-define-a-command)

A <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element"></a><code>[legend](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-legend-element)</code> element <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command) if all of the following are true&#58;

- It has an <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#46;

- It is a child of a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;fieldset&#45;element"></a><code>[fieldset](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-fieldset-element)</code> element&#46;

- Its parent has a descendant that <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;concept&#45;command&#45;2"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command) that is neither a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-label-element)</code> element nor a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[legend](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-legend-element)</code> element&#46; This element&#44; if it exists&#44; is <a id="the&#45;legend&#45;element&#39;s&#45;accesskey&#45;delegatee"></a><strong>the <code>legend</code> element&#39;s <code>accesskey</code> delegatee</strong>&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key&#45;2"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate)&#44; <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate)&#44; and <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) facets of the command are the same as the respective facets of <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#39;s&#45;accesskey&#45;delegatee"></a>[the <code>legend</code> element&#39;s <code>accesskey</code> delegatee](#the-legend-element's-accesskey-delegatee)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[legend](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-legend-element)</code> element specifies an <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute"></a><code>[accesskey](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#the-accesskey-attribute)</code>&#44; which&#44; when activated&#44; will delegate to the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element inside the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;on&#45;a&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[legend](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-legend-element)</code> element&#46;

``` text
<fieldset>
 <legend accesskey=p>
  <label>I want <input name=pizza type=number step=1 value=1 min=0>
   pizza(s) with these toppings</label>
 </legend>
 <label><input name=pizza-cheese type=checkbox checked> Cheese</label>
 <label><input name=pizza-ham type=checkbox checked> Ham</label>
 <label><input name=pizza-pineapple type=checkbox> Pineapple</label>
</fieldset>
```

##### <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;11&#46;3&#46;7 <strong>Using the <code>accesskey</code> attribute to define a command on other elements</strong>[](#using-the-accesskey-attribute-to-define-a-command-on-other-elements)

An element that has an <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key) <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;command"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#46;

If one of the earlier sections that define elements that <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;command&#45;2"></a>[define commands](#concept-command) define that this element <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;command&#45;3"></a>[defines a command](#concept-command)&#44; then that section applies to this element&#44; and this section does not&#46; Otherwise&#44; this section applies to that element&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) of the command depends on the element&#46; If the element is a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;labeled&#45;control"></a>[labeled control](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#labeled-control)&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content) of the first <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-label-element)</code> element in <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) whose <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;2"></a>[labeled control](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#labeled-control) is the element in question is the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) &#40;in JavaScript terms&#44; this is given by <code>element&#46;labels&#91;0&#93;&#46;textContent</code>&#41;&#46; Otherwise&#44; the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;label&#45;3"></a>[Label](#command-facet-label) is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;accesskey"></a>[Access Key](#command-facet-accesskey) of the command is the element&#39;s <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;assigned&#45;access&#45;key&#45;2"></a>[assigned access key](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#assigned-access-key)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;hiddenstate"></a>[Hidden State](#command-facet-hiddenstate) of the command is true &#40;hidden&#41; if the element has a <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;disabledstate"></a>[Disabled State](#command-facet-disabledstate) of the command is true if the element or one of its ancestors is <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;command&#45;facet&#45;action"></a>[Action](#command-facet-action) of the command is to run the following steps&#58;

1.  Run the <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;focusing&#45;steps"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) for the element&#46;
2.  <a id="using&#45;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;on&#45;other&#45;elements&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event"></a>[Fire a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at the element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

Where <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2) is expected&#46;

<a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;
