Returns the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code>&#39;s return value&#46;

Can be set&#44; to update the return value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;show"></a><strong><code>show&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;5"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute and <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is false&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;6"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If the result of <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;beforetoggle"></a><code>[beforetoggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-beforetoggle)</code>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggleevent"></a><code>[ToggleEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggleevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;oldstate"></a><code>[oldState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-oldstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;newstate"></a><code>[newState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-newstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>open</code>&#34; at <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is false&#44; then return&#46;

4.  If <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;7"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task"></a>[Queue a dialog toggle event task](#queue-a-dialog-toggle-event-task) given <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; and null&#46;

6.  Add an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;8"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute to <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; whose value is the empty string&#46;

7.  Set <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;previously&#45;focused&#45;element"></a>[previously focused element](#previously-focused-element) to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) element&#46;

8.  Let <var>document</var> be <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

9.  Let <var>hideUntil</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;topmost&#45;popover&#45;ancestor"></a>[topmost popover ancestor](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#topmost-popover-ancestor) given <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; null&#44; and false&#46;

10. Run <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;hide&#45;popovers&#45;until"></a>[hide popovers until](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hide-popovers-until) given <var>document</var>&#44; <var>hideUntil</var>&#44; false&#44; and true&#46;

11. Run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;focusing&#45;steps&#45;4"></a>[dialog focusing steps](#dialog-focusing-steps) given <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;showmodal"></a><strong><code>showModal&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;show&#45;a&#45;modal&#45;dialog"></a>[show a modal dialog](#show-a-modal-dialog) given <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and null&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;close"></a><strong><code>close&#40;<var>returnValue</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>returnValue</var> is not given&#44; then set it to null&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;the&#45;dialog"></a>[Close the dialog](#close-the-dialog) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;13"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) with <var>returnValue</var> and null&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;requestclose"></a><strong><code>requestClose&#40;<var>returnValue</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>returnValue</var> is not given&#44; then set it to null&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;request&#45;close"></a>[Request to close the dialog](#dialog-request-close) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;14"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) with <var>returnValue</var> and null&#46;

<a id="note&#45;dialog&#45;method&#45;names"></a>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

[](#note-dialog-method-names)

We use show&#47;close as the verbs for <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> elements&#44; as opposed to verb pairs that are more commonly thought of as antonyms such as show&#47;hide or open&#47;close&#44; due to the following constraints&#58;

- Hiding a dialog is different from closing one&#46; Closing a dialog gives it a return value&#44; fires an event&#44; unblocks the page for other dialogs&#44; and so on&#46; Whereas hiding a dialog is a purely visual property&#44; and is something you can already do with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hidden&#45;2"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute or by removing the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;9"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#46; &#40;See also the [note above](#note-dialog-remove-open-attribute) about removing the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;10"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; and how hiding the dialog in that way is generally not desired&#46;&#41;

- Showing a dialog is different from opening one&#46; Opening a dialog consists of creating and showing that dialog &#40;similar to how <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;open"></a><code>[window&#46;open&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-open)</code> both creates and shows a new window&#41;&#46; Whereas showing the dialog is the process of taking a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element that is already in the DOM&#44; and making it interactive and visible to the user&#46;

- If we were to have a <code>dialog&#46;open&#40;&#41;</code> method despite the above&#44; it would conflict with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;dialog&#45;open"></a><code>[dialog&#46;open](#dom-dialog-open)</code> property&#46;

Furthermore&#44; a [survey](https://lists.whatwg.org/pipermail/whatwg-whatwg.org/2013-December/041799.html) of many other UI frameworks contemporary to the original design of the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element made it clear that the show&#47;close verb pair was reasonably common&#46;

In summary&#44; it turns out that the implications of certain verbs&#44; and how they are used in technology contexts&#44; mean that paired actions such as showing and closing a dialog are not always expressible as antonyms&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;returnvalue"></a><strong><code>returnValue</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the last value to which it was set&#46; On setting&#44; it must be set to the new value&#46; When the element is created&#44; it must be set to the empty string&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dialog&#45;closedby"></a><strong><code>closedBy</code></strong> getter steps are to return the keyword corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;computed&#45;closed&#45;by&#45;state"></a>[computed closed&#45;by state](#computed-closed-by-state) given <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;this&#45;15"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="dialog&#45;pointerdown&#45;target"></a><strong>dialog pointerdown target</strong>&#44; which is an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;htmldialogelement"></a>[HTML dialog element](#htmldialogelement) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) has a <a id="previously&#45;focused&#45;element"></a><strong>previously focused element</strong> which is null or an element&#44; and it is initially null&#46; When <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;dialog&#45;showmodal&#45;4"></a><code>[showModal&#40;&#41;](#dom-dialog-showmodal)</code> and <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;dialog&#45;show&#45;2"></a><code>[show&#40;&#41;](#dom-dialog-show)</code> are called&#44; this element is set to the currently <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;2"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) element before running the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;focusing&#45;steps&#45;5"></a>[dialog focusing steps](#dialog-focusing-steps)&#46; Elements with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;popover"></a><code>[popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover)</code> attribute set this element to the currently <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;3"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) element during the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;show&#45;popover"></a>[show popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#show-popover)&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has a <a id="dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a><strong>dialog toggle task tracker</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a>[toggle task tracker](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-tracker) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has a <a id="dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a><strong>close watcher</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;watcher"></a>[close watcher](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-watcher) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has a <a id="request&#45;close&#45;return&#45;value"></a><strong>request close return value</strong>&#44; which is a string or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has a <a id="request&#45;close&#45;source&#45;element"></a><strong>request close source element</strong>&#44; which is an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has an <a id="enable&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;for&#45;requestclose&#40;&#41;"></a><strong>enable close watcher for request close</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;enable&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;for&#45;requestclose&#40;&#41;"></a>[enable close watcher for request close](#enable-close-watcher-for-requestclose()) is used to force enable the dialog&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) while <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;request&#45;close&#45;2"></a>[requesting to close](#dialog-request-close) it&#46; A dialog whose <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;computed&#45;closed&#45;by&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[computed closed&#45;by state](#computed-closed-by-state) is the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;none&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[None](#attr-dialog-closedby-none-state) state would otherwise have a disabled <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;2"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher)&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element has an <a id="is&#45;modal"></a><strong>is modal</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>insertedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>insertedNode</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;11"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute and is <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;setup&#45;steps"></a>[dialog setup steps](#dialog-setup-steps) given <var>insertedNode</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; given <var>removedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>removedNode</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;12"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;cleanup&#45;steps"></a>[dialog cleanup steps](#dialog-cleanup-steps) given <var>removedNode</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;top&#45;layer"></a>[top layer](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#document-top-layer) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;list&#45;contains"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) <var>removedNode</var>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;remove&#45;an&#45;element&#45;from&#45;the&#45;top&#45;layer&#45;immediately"></a>[remove an element from the top layer immediately](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#remove-an-element-from-the-top-layer-immediately) given <var>removedNode</var>&#46;

3.  Set <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;2"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <var>removedNode</var> to false&#46;

The following <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change&#45;ext"></a>[attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>oldValue</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; and <var>namespace</var> are used for <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> elements&#58;

1.  If <var>namespace</var> is not null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>localName</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;13"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code>&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If <var>value</var> is null and <var>oldValue</var> is not null&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;cleanup&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[dialog cleanup steps](#dialog-cleanup-steps) given <var>element</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected&#45;2"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This ensures that the dialog setup steps are not run on nodes that are disconnected&#44; which would result in a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;watcher&#45;2"></a>[close watcher](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-watcher) being established&#46; The <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;cleanup&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[dialog cleanup steps](#dialog-cleanup-steps) need no such guard&#46;

6.  If <var>value</var> is not null and <var>oldValue</var> is null&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;setup&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[dialog setup steps](#dialog-setup-steps) given <var>element</var>&#46;

To <a id="show&#45;a&#45;modal&#45;dialog"></a><strong>show a modal dialog</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var> and an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or null <var>source</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>subject</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;14"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute and <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;3"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <var>subject</var> is true&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>subject</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;15"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;3"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  If <var>subject</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected&#45;3"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  If <var>subject</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;popover&#45;showing&#45;state"></a>[popover showing state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#popover-showing-state)&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

6.  If the result of <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;beforetoggle&#45;2"></a><code>[beforetoggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-beforetoggle)</code>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggleevent&#45;2"></a><code>[ToggleEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggleevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable&#45;2"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;oldstate&#45;2"></a><code>[oldState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-oldstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;newstate&#45;2"></a><code>[newState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-newstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;source"></a><code>[source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-source)</code> attribute initialized to <var>source</var> at <var>subject</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

7.  If <var>subject</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;16"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

8.  If <var>subject</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected&#45;4"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

9.  If <var>subject</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;popover&#45;showing&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[popover showing state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#popover-showing-state)&#44; then return&#46;

10. <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a dialog toggle event task](#queue-a-dialog-toggle-event-task) given <var>subject</var>&#44; &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>source</var>&#46;

11. Add an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;17"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute to <var>subject</var>&#44; whose value is the empty string&#46;

12. <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;3"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) is not null&#46;

13. Set <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;4"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <var>subject</var> to true&#46;

14. Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) to be <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;blocked&#45;by&#45;a&#45;modal&#45;dialog&#45;2"></a>[blocked by the modal dialog](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#blocked-by-a-modal-dialog) <var>subject</var>&#46;

    <a id="note&#45;dialog&#45;plus&#45;focus&#45;fixup"></a>

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    [](#note-dialog-plus-focus-fixup)This will cause the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;area&#45;of&#45;the&#45;document"></a>[focused area of the document](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused-area-of-the-document) to become <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert) &#40;unless that currently focused area is a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;descendant"></a>[shadow&#45;including descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-descendant) of <var>subject</var>&#41;&#46; In such cases&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;area&#45;of&#45;the&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[focused area of the document](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused-area-of-the-document) will soon be [reset](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#focus-fixup-rule) to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;viewport"></a>[viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport)&#46; In a couple steps we will attempt to find a better candidate to focus&#46;

15. If <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;top&#45;layer&#45;2"></a>[top layer](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#document-top-layer) does not already <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;2"></a>[contain](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) <var>subject</var>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;add&#45;an&#45;element&#45;to&#45;the&#45;top&#45;layer"></a>[add an element to the top layer](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#add-an-element-to-the-top-layer) given <var>subject</var>&#46;

16. Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;previously&#45;focused&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[previously focused element](#previously-focused-element) to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;4"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) element&#46;

17. Let <var>document</var> be <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;8"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

18. Let <var>hideUntil</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;topmost&#45;popover&#45;ancestor&#45;2"></a>[topmost popover ancestor](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#topmost-popover-ancestor) given <var>subject</var>&#44; null&#44; and false&#46;

19. Run <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;hide&#45;popovers&#45;until&#45;2"></a>[hide popovers until](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hide-popovers-until) given <var>document</var>&#44; <var>hideUntil</var>&#44; false&#44; and true&#46;

20. Run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;focusing&#45;steps&#45;6"></a>[dialog focusing steps](#dialog-focusing-steps) given <var>subject</var>&#46;

<a id="canceling&#45;dialogs"></a>To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a><strong>set the dialog close watcher</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>dialog</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;4"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) is null&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;3"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>dialog</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;18"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute and <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;9"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;4"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#46;

3.  Set <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;5"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) to the result of <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;establish&#45;a&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a>[establishing a close watcher](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#establish-a-close-watcher) given <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; with&#58;

    - <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;create&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;cancelaction"></a><em>[cancelAction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-close-watcher-cancelaction)</em> given <var>canPreventClose</var> being to return the result of <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;cancel&#45;3"></a><code>[cancel](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-cancel)</code> at <var>dialog</var>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable&#45;3"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to <var>canPreventClose</var>&#46;

    - <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;create&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;closeaction"></a><em>[closeAction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-close-watcher-closeaction)</em> being to <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;the&#45;dialog&#45;2"></a>[close the dialog](#close-the-dialog) given <var>dialog</var>&#44; <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;return&#45;value"></a>[request close return value](#request-close-return-value)&#44; and <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;source&#45;element"></a>[request close source element](#request-close-source-element)&#46;

    - <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;create&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;getenabledstate"></a><em>[getEnabledState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-close-watcher-getenabledstate)</em> being to return true if <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;enable&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;for&#45;requestclose&#40;&#41;&#45;2"></a>[enable close watcher for request close](#enable-close-watcher-for-requestclose()) is true or <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;computed&#45;closed&#45;by&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[computed closed&#45;by state](#computed-closed-by-state) is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;none&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[None](#attr-dialog-closedby-none-state)&#59; otherwise false&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;valid&#45;command&#45;steps"></a>[is valid command steps](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#is-valid-command-steps) for <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> elements&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command"></a><code>[command](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command)</code> attribute <var>command</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;close&#45;state"></a>[Close](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-close-state) state&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;request&#45;close&#45;state"></a>[Request Close](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-request-close-state) state&#44; or the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;show&#45;modal&#45;state"></a>[Show Modal](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-show-modal-state) state&#44; then return true&#46;

2.  Return false&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;command&#45;steps"></a>[command steps](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#command-steps) for <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> elements&#44; given an element <var>element</var>&#44; an element <var>source</var>&#44; and a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;2"></a><code>[command](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command)</code> attribute <var>command</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;popover&#45;showing&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[popover showing](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#popover-showing-state) state&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;close&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Close](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-close-state) state and <var>element</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;19"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;the&#45;dialog&#45;3"></a>[close the dialog](#close-the-dialog) <var>element</var> with <var>source</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;optional&#45;value"></a>[optional value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-optional-value) and <var>source</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;request&#45;close&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Request Close](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-request-close-state) state and <var>element</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;20"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;request&#45;close&#45;3"></a>[request to close the dialog](#dialog-request-close) <var>element</var> with <var>source</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;optional&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[optional value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-optional-value) and <var>source</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>command</var> is the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;show&#45;modal&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Show Modal](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-command-show-modal-state) state and <var>element</var> does not have an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;21"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;show&#45;a&#45;modal&#45;dialog&#45;2"></a>[show a modal dialog](#show-a-modal-dialog) given <var>element</var> and <var>source</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following buttons use <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor"></a><code>[commandfor](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-button-commandfor)</code> to open and close a &#34;confirm&#34; <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> as modal when activated&#58;

``` text
<button type=button
        commandfor="the-dialog"
        command="show-modal">
 Delete
</button>
<dialog id="the-dialog">
 <form action="/delete" method="POST">
  <button type="submit">
   Delete
  </button>
  <button commandfor="the-dialog"
          command="close">
   Cancel
  </button>
 </form>
</dialog>
    
```

When a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var> is to be <a id="close&#45;the&#45;dialog"></a><strong>closed</strong>&#44; with null or a string <var>result</var> and an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;element&#45;3"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or null <var>source</var>&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>subject</var> does not have an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;22"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;beforetoggle&#45;3"></a><code>[beforetoggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-beforetoggle)</code>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggleevent&#45;3"></a><code>[ToggleEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggleevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;oldstate&#45;3"></a><code>[oldState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-oldstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;newstate&#45;3"></a><code>[newState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-newstate)</code> attribute initialized to &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;source&#45;2"></a><code>[source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-source)</code> attribute initialized to <var>source</var> at <var>subject</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>subject</var> does not have an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;23"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[Queue a dialog toggle event task](#queue-a-dialog-toggle-event-task) given <var>subject</var>&#44; &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>source</var>&#46;

5.  Remove <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;24"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#46;

6.  If <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;5"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <var>subject</var> is true&#44; then <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;an&#45;element&#45;to&#45;be&#45;removed&#45;from&#45;the&#45;top&#45;layer"></a>[request an element to be removed from the top layer](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#request-an-element-to-be-removed-from-the-top-layer) given <var>subject</var>&#46;

7.  Let <var>wasModal</var> be the value of <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;6"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) flag&#46;

8.  Set <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;7"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) of <var>subject</var> to false&#46;

9.  If <var>result</var> is not null&#44; then set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;dialog&#45;returnvalue&#45;2"></a><code>[returnValue](#dom-dialog-returnvalue)</code> attribute to <var>result</var>&#46;

10. Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;return&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[request close return value](#request-close-return-value) to null&#46;

11. Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[request close source element](#request-close-source-element) to null&#46;

12. If <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;previously&#45;focused&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[previously focused element](#previously-focused-element) is not null&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;previously&#45;focused&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[previously focused element](#previously-focused-element)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;previously&#45;focused&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[previously focused element](#previously-focused-element) to null&#46;

    3.  If <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;10"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;area&#45;of&#45;the&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[focused area of the document](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused-area-of-the-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;anchor"></a>[DOM anchor](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#dom-anchor) is a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;inclusive&#45;descendant"></a>[shadow&#45;including inclusive descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) of <var>subject</var>&#44; or <var>wasModal</var> is true&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focusing&#45;steps"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) for <var>element</var>&#59; the viewport should not be scrolled by doing this step&#46;

13. <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <var>subject</var> element to <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;close&#45;4"></a><code>[close](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-close)</code> at <var>subject</var>&#46;

To <a id="dialog&#45;request&#45;close"></a><strong>request to close</strong> <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var>&#44; given null or a string <var>returnValue</var> and null or an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;element&#45;4"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> <var>source</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>subject</var> does not have an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;25"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>subject</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected&#45;5"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected) or <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;11"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;5"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;4"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;6"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) is not null&#46;

4.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;enable&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;for&#45;requestclose&#40;&#41;&#45;3"></a>[enable close watcher for request close](#enable-close-watcher-for-requestclose()) to true&#46;

5.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;return&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[request close return value](#request-close-return-value) to <var>returnValue</var>&#46;

6.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;request&#45;close&#45;source&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[request close source element](#request-close-source-element) to <var>source</var>&#46;

7.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;watcher&#45;request&#45;close"></a>[Request to close](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-watcher-request-close) <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;7"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) with false&#46;

8.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;enable&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;for&#45;requestclose&#40;&#41;&#45;4"></a>[enable close watcher for request close](#enable-close-watcher-for-requestclose()) to false&#46;

To <a id="queue&#45;a&#45;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;event&#45;task"></a><strong>queue a dialog toggle event task</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#44; a string <var>oldState</var>&#44; a string <var>newState</var>&#44; and an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;element&#45;5"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or null <var>source</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker) is not null&#58;

    1.  Set <var>oldState</var> to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;2"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;old&#45;state"></a>[old state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-old-state)&#46;

    2.  Remove <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;3"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-task) from its <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;task&#45;queue"></a>[task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-queue)&#46;

    3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;4"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker) to null&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) given the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) and <var>element</var> to run the following steps&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;event&#45;toggle"></a><code>[toggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-toggle)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggleevent&#45;4"></a><code>[ToggleEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggleevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;oldstate&#45;4"></a><code>[oldState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-oldstate)</code> attribute initialized to <var>oldState</var>&#44; the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;newstate&#45;4"></a><code>[newState](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-newstate)</code> attribute initialized to <var>newState</var>&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;toggleevent&#45;source&#45;3"></a><code>[source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-toggleevent-source)</code> attribute initialized to <var>source</var>&#46;

    2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;5"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker) to null&#46;

3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;toggle&#45;task&#45;tracker&#45;6"></a>[dialog toggle task tracker](#dialog-toggle-task-tracker) to a struct with <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-task) set to the just&#45;queued <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) and <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;toggle&#45;task&#45;old&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[old state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#toggle-task-old-state) set to <var>oldState</var>&#46;

To retrieve a dialog&#39;s <a id="computed&#45;closed&#45;by&#45;state"></a><strong>computed closed&#45;by state</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;35"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> <var>dialog</var>&#58;

1.  If the state of <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;5"></a><code>[closedby](#attr-dialog-closedby)</code> attribute is <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;auto&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Auto](#attr-dialog-closedby-auto-state)&#58;

    1.  If <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;is&#45;modal&#45;8"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) is true&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;closerequest&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Close Request](#attr-dialog-closedby-closerequest-state)&#46;

    2.  Return <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;none&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[None](#attr-dialog-closedby-none-state)&#46;

2.  Return the state of <var>dialog</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;6"></a><code>[closedby](#attr-dialog-closedby)</code> attribute&#46;

The <a id="dialog&#45;focusing&#45;steps"></a><strong>dialog focusing steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;36"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  If the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;allow&#45;focus&#45;steps"></a>[allow focus steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#allow-focus-steps) given <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;12"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) return false&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>control</var> be null&#46;

3.  If <var>subject</var> has the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autofocus&#45;7"></a><code>[autofocus](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-fe-autofocus)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>control</var> to <var>subject</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>control</var> is null&#44; then set <var>control</var> to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focus&#45;delegate"></a>[focus delegate](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focus-delegate) of <var>subject</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>control</var> is null&#44; then set <var>control</var> to <var>subject</var>&#46;

6.  Run the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focusing&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) for <var>control</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If <var>control</var> is not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focusable"></a>[focusable](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusable)&#44; this will do nothing&#46; This would only happen if subject had no focus delegate&#44; and the user agent decided that <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> elements were not generally focusable&#46; In that case&#44; any [earlier modifications](#note-dialog-plus-focus-fixup) to the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;area&#45;of&#45;the&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[focused area of the document](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused-area-of-the-document) will apply&#46;

7.  Let <var>topDocument</var> be <var>control</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;navigable"></a>[node navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#node-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;top"></a>[top&#45;level traversable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-top)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#46;

8.  If <var>control</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;13"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is not the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) as the <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) of <var>topDocument</var>&#44; then return&#46;

9.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;list&#45;empty"></a>[Empty](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-empty) <var>topDocument</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;autofocus&#45;candidates"></a>[autofocus candidates](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#autofocus-candidates)&#46;

10. Set <var>topDocument</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;autofocus&#45;processed&#45;flag"></a>[autofocus processed flag](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#autofocus-processed-flag) to true&#46;

The <a id="dialog&#45;setup&#45;steps"></a><strong>dialog setup steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;5"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>subject</var> has an <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;26"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;6"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>subject</var> is <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;connected&#45;6"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;7"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;14"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;open&#45;dialogs&#45;list"></a>[open dialogs list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#open-dialogs-list) does not <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;3"></a>[contain](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) <var>subject</var>&#46;

4.  Add <var>subject</var> to <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;15"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;open&#45;dialogs&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[open dialogs list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#open-dialogs-list)&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a>[Set the dialog close watcher](#set-the-dialog-close-watcher) with <var>subject</var>&#46;

The <a id="dialog&#45;cleanup&#45;steps"></a><strong>dialog cleanup steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element <var>subject</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;list&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) <var>subject</var> from <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;16"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;open&#45;dialogs&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[open dialogs list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#open-dialogs-list)&#46;

2.  If <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;8"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) is not null&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;close&#45;watcher&#45;destroy"></a>[Destroy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-watcher-destroy) <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;9"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>subject</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;10"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) to null&#46;

#### <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss"></a>4&#46;11&#46;5 <strong>Dialog light dismiss</strong>[](#dialog-light-dismiss)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

&#34;Light dismiss&#34; means that clicking outside of a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element whose <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby"></a><code>[closedby](#attr-dialog-closedby)</code> attribute is in the <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;any&#45;state"></a>[Any](#attr-dialog-closedby-any-state) state will close the <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element&#46; This is in addition to how such <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code>s respond to <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;close&#45;request"></a>[close requests](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-request)&#46;

To <a id="light&#45;dismiss&#45;open&#45;dialogs"></a><strong>light dismiss open dialogs</strong>&#44; given a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;pointerevent"></a><code>[PointerEvent](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface)</code> <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;istrusted"></a><code>[isTrusted](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted)</code> attribute is true&#46;

2.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;target"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event-target)&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

3.  If <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;open&#45;dialogs&#45;list"></a>[open dialogs list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#open-dialogs-list) is <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;list&#45;is&#45;empty"></a>[empty](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty)&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Let <var>ancestor</var> be the result of running <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;nearest&#45;clicked&#45;dialog"></a>[nearest clicked dialog](#nearest-clicked-dialog) given <var>event</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;type"></a><code>[type](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type)</code> is &#34;<a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;event&#45;pointerdown"></a><code>[pointerdown](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#the-pointerdown-event)</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dialog&#45;pointerdown&#45;target"></a>[dialog pointerdown target](#dialog-pointerdown-target) to <var>ancestor</var>&#46;

6.  If <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type)</code> is &#34;<a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;event&#45;pointerup"></a><code>[pointerup](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#the-pointerup-event)</code>&#34;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>sameTarget</var> be true if <var>ancestor</var> is <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dialog&#45;pointerdown&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[dialog pointerdown target](#dialog-pointerdown-target)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dialog&#45;pointerdown&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[dialog pointerdown target](#dialog-pointerdown-target) to null&#46;

    3.  If <var>sameTarget</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

    4.  Let <var>topmostDialog</var> be the last element of <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;open&#45;dialogs&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[open dialogs list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#open-dialogs-list)&#46;

    5.  If <var>ancestor</var> is <var>topmostDialog</var>&#44; then return&#46;

    6.  If <var>topmostDialog</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;computed&#45;closed&#45;by&#45;state"></a>[computed closed&#45;by state](#computed-closed-by-state) is not <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;closedby&#45;any&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Any](#attr-dialog-closedby-any-state)&#44; then return&#46;

    7.  <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>topmostDialog</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) is not null&#46;

    8.  <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;close&#45;watcher&#45;request&#45;close"></a>[Request to close](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#close-watcher-request-close) <var>topmostDialog</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;dialog&#45;close&#45;watcher&#45;2"></a>[close watcher](#dialog-close-watcher) with false&#46;

To <a id="run&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#45;activities"></a><strong>run light dismiss activities</strong>&#44; given a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;pointerevent&#45;2"></a><code>[PointerEvent](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface)</code> <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  Run <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;light&#45;dismiss&#45;open&#45;popovers"></a>[light dismiss open popovers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#light-dismiss-open-popovers) with <var>event</var>&#46;

2.  Run <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;light&#45;dismiss&#45;open&#45;dialogs"></a>[light dismiss open dialogs](#light-dismiss-open-dialogs) with <var>event</var>&#46;

<a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;run&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#45;activities"></a>[Run light dismiss activities](#run-light-dismiss-activities) will be called by the [Pointer Events spec](https://github.com/w3c/pointerevents/pull/460) when the user clicks or touches anywhere on the page&#46;

To find the <a id="nearest&#45;clicked&#45;dialog"></a><strong>nearest clicked dialog</strong>&#44; given a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;pointerevent&#45;3"></a><code>[PointerEvent](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface)</code> <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>target</var> be <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event-target)&#46;

2.  If <var>target</var> is a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element&#44; <var>target</var> has an <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;is&#45;modal"></a>[is modal](#is-modal) is true&#44; and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;mouseevent&#45;clientx"></a><code>[clientX](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mouseevent-clientx)</code> and <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;mouseevent&#45;clienty"></a><code>[clientY](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mouseevent-clienty)</code> are outside the bounds of <var>target</var>&#44; then return null&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The check for <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;mouseevent&#45;clientx&#45;2"></a><code>[clientX](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mouseevent-clientx)</code> and <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;mouseevent&#45;clienty&#45;2"></a><code>[clientY](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#dom-mouseevent-clienty)</code> is because a pointer event that hits the <code>&#58;&#58;backdrop</code> pseudo element of a dialog will result in <var>event</var> having a target of the dialog element itself&#46;

3.  Let <var>currentNode</var> be <var>target</var>&#46;

4.  While <var>currentNode</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  If <var>currentNode</var> is a <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[dialog](#the-dialog-element)</code> element and <var>currentNode</var> has an <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;attr&#45;dialog&#45;open&#45;2"></a><code>[open](#attr-dialog-open)</code> attribute&#44; then return <var>currentNode</var>&#46;

    2.  Set <var>currentNode</var> to <var>currentNode</var>&#39;s parent in the <a id="dialog&#45;light&#45;dismiss&#58;flat&#45;tree"></a>[flat tree](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping/#flat-tree)&#46;

5.  Return null&#46;

### <a id="scripting&#45;3"></a>4&#46;12 Scripting[](#scripting-3)

Scripts allow authors to add interactivity to their documents&#46;

Authors are encouraged to use declarative alternatives to scripting where possible&#44; as declarative mechanisms are often more maintainable&#44; and many users disable scripting&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; instead of using a script to show or hide a section to show more details&#44; the <a id="scripting&#45;3&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element"></a><code>[details](#the-details-element)</code> element could be used&#46;

Authors are also encouraged to make their applications degrade gracefully in the absence of scripting support&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; if an author provides a link in a table header to dynamically resort the table&#44; the link could also be made to function without scripts by requesting the sorted table from the server&#46;

id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;supports"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLScriptElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions] attribute (TrustedScriptURL or USVString) src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean noModule;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean async;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean defer;
  [SameObject, PutForwards=value, Reflect] readonly attribute DOMTokenList blocking;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString? crossOrigin;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString referrerPolicy;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString integrity;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString fetchPriority;

  // innerText and textContent shadow HTMLElement's and Node's, to add Trusted Types checks
  [CEReactions] attribute (TrustedScript or [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString) innerText;
  [CEReactions] attribute (TrustedScript or DOMString)? textContent;
  [CEReactions] attribute (TrustedScript or DOMString) text;

  static boolean supports(DOMString type);

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element allows authors to include dynamic script&#44; instructions to the user agent&#44; and data blocks in their documents&#46; The element does not <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) content for the user&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;script&#35;attr&#45;type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/script#attr-type)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
