Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The script element has two core attributes&#46; The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> attribute allows customization of the type of script represented&#58;

- Omitting the attribute&#44; setting it to the empty string&#44; or setting it to a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;essence&#45;match"></a>[JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match) means that the script is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#44; to be interpreted according to the JavaScript <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;js&#45;prod&#45;script"></a><em>[Script](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#prod-Script)</em> top&#45;level production&#46; Authors should omit the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute instead of redundantly setting it&#46;

- Setting the attribute to an <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>module</code>&#34; means that the script is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#44; to be interpreted according to the JavaScript <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;js&#45;prod&#45;module"></a><em>[Module](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#prod-Module)</em> top&#45;level production&#46;

- Setting the attribute to an <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34; means that the script is an <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;import&#45;map"></a>[import map](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#import-map)&#44; containing JSON that will be used to control the behavior of <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;resolve&#45;a&#45;module&#45;specifier"></a>[module specifier resolution](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#resolve-a-module-specifier)&#46;

- Setting the attribute to an <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34; means that the script defines a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;speculation&#45;rule&#45;set"></a>[speculation rule set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rule-set)&#44; containing JSON that will be used to describe [speculative loads](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculative-loading)&#46;

- Setting the attribute to any other value means that the script is a <a id="data&#45;block"></a><strong>data block</strong>&#44; which is not processed by the user agent&#44; but instead by author script or other tools&#46; Authors must use a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string"></a>[valid MIME type string](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type) that is not a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;essence&#45;match&#45;2"></a>[JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match) to denote data blocks&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  The requirement that <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;data&#45;block"></a>[data blocks](#data-block) must be denoted using a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid MIME type string](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type) is in place to avoid potential future collisions&#46; Values for the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute that are not MIME types&#44; like &#34;<code>module</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#44; are used by the standard to denote types of scripts which have special behavior in user agents&#46; By using a valid MIME type string now&#44; you ensure that your data block will not ever be reinterpreted as a different script type&#44; even in future user agents&#46;

The second core attribute is the <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute&#46; It must only be specified for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[JavaScript module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#44; and denotes that instead of using the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) as the script content&#44; the script will be fetched from the specified <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46; If <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> is specified&#44; it must be a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

Which other attributes may be specified on a given <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element is determined by the following table&#58;

href="#attr-script-crossorigin">crossorigin</a></code>      </th><th><code id="the-script-element:attr-script-referrerpolicy-2"><a href="#attr-script-referrerpolicy">referrerpolicy</a></code> &#42; Although inline scripts have no initial fetches&#44; the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;3"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;3"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-script-referrerpolicy)</code> attribute on inline scripts affects the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;2"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) used by module imports&#44; including dynamic <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;import&#40;&#41;"></a><code>[import&#40;&#41;](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-import-calls)</code>&#46;

† Unlike <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;4"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;4"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-script-referrerpolicy)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;fetchpriority&#45;3"></a><code>[fetchpriority](#attr-script-fetchpriority)</code> does not affect module imports&#46; See some discussion in [issue &#35;10276](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10276)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The contents of inline <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#44; or the external script resource&#44; must conform with the requirements of the JavaScript specification&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;js&#45;prod&#45;script&#45;2"></a><em>[Script](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#prod-Script)</em> or <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;js&#45;prod&#45;module&#45;2"></a><em>[Module](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#prod-Module)</em> productions&#44; for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[JavaScript module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script) respectively&#46; [&#91;JAVASCRIPT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsJAVASCRIPT)

The contents of inline <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;import&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[import maps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#import-map) must conform with the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;import&#45;map&#45;authoring&#45;requirements"></a>[import map authoring requirements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#import-map-authoring-requirements)&#46;

The contents of inline <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;speculation&#45;rule&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[speculation rule sets](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rule-set) must conform with the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;speculation&#45;rule&#45;set&#45;authoring&#45;requirements"></a>[speculation rule set authoring requirements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rule-set-authoring-requirements)&#46;

When used to include <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;data&#45;block&#45;2"></a>[data blocks](#data-block)&#44; the data must be embedded inline&#44; the format of the data must be given using the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute&#44; and the contents of the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element must conform to the requirements defined for the format used&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;nomodule"></a><strong><code>nomodule</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) that prevents a script from being executed in user agents that support <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script)&#46; This allows selective execution of <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script) in modern user agents and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;4"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) in older user agents&#44; [as shown below](#script-nomodule-example)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;async"></a><strong><code>async</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;defer"></a><strong><code>defer</code></strong> attributes are <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) that indicate how the script should be evaluated&#46; There are several possible modes that can be selected using these attributes&#44; depending on the script&#39;s type&#46;

For external <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;5"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;3"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute is present&#44; then the classic script will be fetched <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel) to parsing and evaluated as soon as it is available &#40;potentially before parsing completes&#41;&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;4"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute is not present but the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;3"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> attribute is present&#44; then the classic script will be fetched <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;2"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel) and evaluated when the page has finished parsing&#46; If neither attribute is present&#44; then the script is fetched and evaluated immediately&#44; blocking parsing until these are both complete&#46;

For <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;4"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script)&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;5"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute is present&#44; then the module script and all its dependencies will be fetched <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;3"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel) to parsing&#44; and the module script will be evaluated as soon as it is available &#40;potentially before parsing completes&#41;&#46; Otherwise&#44; the module script and its dependencies will be fetched <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;4"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel) to parsing and evaluated when the page has finished parsing&#46; &#40;The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;4"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> attribute has no effect on module scripts&#46;&#41;

This is all summarized in the following schematic diagram&#58;

![With &#60;script&#62;&#44; parsing is interrupted by fetching and execution&#46; With &#60;script defer&#62;&#44; fetching is parallel to parsing and execution takes place after all parsing has finished&#46; And with &#60;script async&#62;&#44; fetching is parallel to parsing but once it finishes parsing is interrupted to execute the script&#46; The story for &#60;script type&#61;&#34;module&#34;&#62; is similar to &#60;script defer&#62;&#44; but the dependencies will be fetched as well&#44; and the story for &#60;script type&#61;&#34;module&#34; async&#62; is similar to &#60;script async&#62; with the extra dependency fetching&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/asyncdefer.svg)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The exact processing details for these attributes are&#44; for mostly historical reasons&#44; somewhat non&#45;trivial&#44; involving a number of aspects of HTML&#46; The implementation requirements are therefore by necessity scattered throughout the specification&#46; The algorithms [below](#script-processing-model) describe the core of this processing&#44; but these algorithms reference and are referenced by the parsing rules for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> [start](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#scriptTag) and [end](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#scriptEndTag) tags in HTML&#44; [in foreign content](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#scriptForeignEndTag)&#44; and [in XML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#scriptTagXML)&#44; the rules for the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> method&#44; the handling of [scripting](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#scripting)&#44; etc&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

When inserted using the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write&#45;2"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> method&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements [usually](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#document-written-scripts-intervention) execute &#40;typically blocking further script execution or HTML parsing&#41;&#46; When inserted using the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;innerhtml"></a><code>[innerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-innerhtml)</code> and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;outerhtml"></a><code>[outerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-outerhtml)</code> attributes&#44; or the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;insertadjacenthtml"></a><code>[insertAdjacentHTML&#40;&#41;](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-insertadjacenthtml)</code> method&#44; they do not execute at all&#44; unless a Trusted Types default policy&#39;s <code>createParserOptions</code> callback enables script execution&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;5"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> attribute may be specified even if the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;6"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute is specified&#44; to cause legacy web browsers that only support <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;6"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> &#40;and not <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;7"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code>&#41; to fall back to the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;7"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> behavior instead of the blocking behavior that is the default&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;blocking"></a><strong><code>blocking</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;blocking&#45;attribute"></a>[blocking attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#blocking-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin"></a><strong><code>crossorigin</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;cors&#45;settings&#45;attribute"></a>[CORS settings attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-settings-attribute)&#46; For external <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;6"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#44; it controls whether error information will be exposed&#44; when the script is obtained from other <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[origins](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin)&#46; For external <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;5"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script)&#44; it controls the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) used for the initial fetch of the module source&#44; if cross&#45;origin&#46; For both <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;7"></a>[classic](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;6"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script)&#44; it controls the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) used for cross&#45;origin module imports&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Unlike <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;8"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;module&#45;script&#45;7"></a>[module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script) require the use of the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;cors&#45;protocol"></a>[CORS protocol](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cors-protocol) for cross&#45;origin fetching&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><strong><code>referrerpolicy</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;attribute"></a>[referrer policy attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#referrer-policy-attribute)&#46; Its sets the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;3"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) used for the initial fetch of an external script&#44; as well as the fetching of any imported module scripts&#46; [&#91;REFERRERPOLICY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsREFERRERPOLICY)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

An example of a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s referrer policy being used when fetching imported scripts but not other subresources&#58;

``` text
<script referrerpolicy="origin">
  fetch('/api/data');    // not fetched with <script>'s referrer policy
  import('./utils.mjs'); // is fetched with <script>'s referrer policy ("origin" in this case)
</script>
```

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;integrity"></a><strong><code>integrity</code></strong> attribute sets the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;integrity&#45;metadata"></a>[integrity metadata](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-integrity-metadata) used for the initial fetch of an external script&#46; The value must match <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;requirements&#45;of&#45;the&#45;integrity&#45;attribute"></a>[the requirements of the integrity attribute](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#the-integrity-attribute)&#46; [&#91;SRI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSRI)

The <a id="attr&#45;script&#45;fetchpriority"></a><strong><code>fetchpriority</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;priority&#45;attribute"></a>[fetch priority attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fetch-priority-attribute)&#46; Its sets the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;priority&#45;2"></a>[priority](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority) used for the initial fetch of an external script&#46;

Changing any of these attributes dynamically has no direct effect&#59; these attributes are only used at specific times described in the [processing model](#script-processing-model)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Trusted Types processing for the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element is still largely defined in Trusted Types&#44; and does not cover everything implementations are expected to do&#46; See [w3c&#47;trusted&#45;types&#35;507](https://github.com/w3c/trusted-types/issues/507)&#46; [&#91;TRUSTED&#45;TYPES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsTRUSTED-TYPES)

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;get&#45;by&#45;namespace"></a>[getting an attribute by namespace and local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-get-by-namespace) given null&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-local-name)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

3.  Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; relative to <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  If <var>urlString</var> is not failure&#44; then return <var>urlString</var>&#46;

5.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;convert"></a>[converted to a scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#dom-script-src)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>compliantScriptURL</var> be the result of invoking the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;getcompliantstring"></a>[get trusted type compliant string](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string) algorithm with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;trustedscripturl&#45;2"></a><code>[TrustedScriptURL](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedscripturl)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; the given value&#44; &#34;<code>HTMLScriptElement src</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[Set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) given <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-local-name)&#44; and <var>compliantScriptURL</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;crossorigin"></a><strong><code>crossOrigin</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;5"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLScriptElement&#47;referrerPolicy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLScriptElement/referrerPolicy)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox65&#43;Safari14&#43;Chrome70&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><strong><code>referrerPolicy</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;reflect&#45;2"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;5"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-script-referrerpolicy)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;fetchpriority"></a><strong><code>fetchPriority</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;reflect&#45;3"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;fetchpriority&#45;4"></a><code>[fetchpriority](#attr-script-fetchpriority)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;3"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;async"></a><strong><code>async</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) is true&#44; then return true&#46;

2.  If <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;8"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> content attribute is present&#44; then return true&#46;

3.  Return false&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;async&#45;2"></a><code>[async](#dom-script-async)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Set <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async&#45;2"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) to false&#46;

2.  If the given value is true&#44; then set <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;9"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> content attribute to the empty string&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; remove <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;10"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> content attribute&#46;

<strong><code><var>script</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;script&#45;text&#45;dev"></a>[text](#dom-script-text) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) of the element&#46;

<strong><code><var>script</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;text&#45;2"></a>[text](#dom-script-text) &#61; <var>value</var></code></strong>

Replaces the element&#39;s children with the text given by <var>value</var>&#46;

<strong><code><a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;htmlscriptelement"></a><code>[HTMLScriptElement](#htmlscriptelement)</code>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;script&#45;supports&#45;dev"></a>[supports](#dom-script-supports)&#40;<var>type</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns true if the given <var>type</var> is a script type supported by the user agent&#46; The possible script types in this specification are &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#44; but others might be added in the future&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;text&#45;3"></a><code>[text](#dom-script-text)</code> and <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;textcontent&#45;2"></a><code>[textContent](#dom-script-textcontent)</code> IDL attributes are the encouraged way of dynamically setting the text of a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#44; as their setters check the given value against Trusted Types&#46; [&#91;TRUSTED&#45;TYPES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsTRUSTED-TYPES) Manipulating text nodes directly will instead invoke the default policy on the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) when the script is prepared&#46; &#40;The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;innertext&#45;2"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-script-innertext)</code> setter also checks the given value&#44; but replaces line breaks with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> elements&#44; which are not part of the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;4"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;&#41;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;innertext"></a><strong><code>innerText</code></strong> getter steps are to return the result of running <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;get&#45;the&#45;text&#45;steps"></a>[get the text steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#get-the-text-steps) with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;innertext&#45;3"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-script-innertext)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>compliantScript</var> be the result of invoking the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;getcompliantstring&#45;2"></a>[get trusted type compliant string](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string) algorithm with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;trustedscript&#45;4"></a><code>[TrustedScript](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedscript)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; the given value&#44; &#34;<code>HTMLScriptElement innerText</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;update&#45;script&#45;trustedness"></a>[Update script trustedness](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#update-script-trustedness) for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given <var>compliantScript</var>&#46;

3.  Run <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;inner&#45;text&#45;steps"></a>[set the inner text steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#set-the-inner-text-steps) with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;13"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and <var>compliantScript</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;innertext&#45;4"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-script-innertext)</code> setter stores the compliant string as the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s Trusted Types script text&#44; but then replaces any line breaks in it with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> elements&#44; so the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;5"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) no longer matches&#46; See [w3c&#47;trusted&#45;types&#35;517](https://github.com/w3c/trusted-types/issues/517)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;textcontent"></a><strong><code>textContent</code></strong> getter steps are to return the result of running <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;get&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[get text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#get-text-content) with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;14"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;textcontent&#45;3"></a><code>[textContent](#dom-script-textcontent)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>value</var> be the given value&#46;

2.  If <var>value</var> is null&#44; then set <var>value</var> to the empty string&#46;

3.  Let <var>compliantScript</var> be the result of invoking the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;getcompliantstring&#45;3"></a>[get trusted type compliant string](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string) algorithm with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;trustedscript&#45;5"></a><code>[TrustedScript](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedscript)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;15"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;3"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; &#34;<code>HTMLScriptElement textContent</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;update&#45;script&#45;trustedness&#45;2"></a>[Update script trustedness](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#update-script-trustedness) for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;16"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given <var>compliantScript</var>&#46;

5.  Run <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;set&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[set text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#set-text-content) with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;17"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and <var>compliantScript</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;text"></a><strong><code>text</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;18"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;6"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;text&#45;4"></a><code>[text](#dom-script-text)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>compliantScript</var> be the result of invoking the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;getcompliantstring&#45;4"></a>[get trusted type compliant string](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string) algorithm with <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;trustedscript&#45;6"></a><code>[TrustedScript](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedscript)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;19"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;4"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; the given value&#44; &#34;<code>HTMLScriptElement text</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;update&#45;script&#45;trustedness&#45;3"></a>[Update script trustedness](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#update-script-trustedness) for <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;20"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given <var>compliantScript</var>&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[String replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with <var>compliantScript</var> within <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;this&#45;21"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLScriptElement&#47;supports&#95;static](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLScriptElement/supports_static)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox94&#43;Safari16&#43;Chrome96&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge96&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The static <a id="dom&#45;script&#45;supports"></a><strong><code>supports&#40;<var>type</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>type</var> <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;is"></a>[is](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

2.  If <var>type</var> <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;is&#45;2"></a>[is](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

3.  If <var>type</var> <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;is&#45;3"></a>[is](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

4.  If <var>type</var> <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;is&#45;4"></a>[is](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

5.  Return false&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <var>type</var> argument has to exactly match these values&#59; we do not perform an <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;4"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match&#46; This is different from how <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> content attribute values are treated&#44; and how <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;domtokenlist&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMTokenList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;domtokenlist&#45;supports"></a><code>[supports&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domtokenlist-supports)</code> method works&#44; but it aligns with the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;workertype"></a><code>[WorkerType](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#workertype)</code> enumeration used in the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;worker"></a><code>[Worker&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-worker)</code> constructor&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; two <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements are used&#46; One embeds an external <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;9"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#44; and the other includes some data as a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;data&#45;block&#45;3"></a>[data block](#data-block)&#46;

``` text
<script src="game-engine.js"></script>
<script type="text/x-game-map">
........U.........e
o............A....e
.....A.....AAA....e
.A..AAA...AAAAA...e
</script>
```

The data in this case might be used by the script to generate the map of a video game&#46; The data doesn&#39;t have to be used that way&#44; though&#59; maybe the map data is actually embedded in other parts of the page&#39;s markup&#44; and the data block here is just used by the site&#39;s search engine to help users who are looking for particular features in their game maps&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following sample shows how a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element can be used to define a function that is then used by other parts of the document&#44; as part of a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;10"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#46; It also shows how a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element can be used to invoke script while the document is being parsed&#44; in this case to initialize the form&#39;s output&#46;

``` text
<script>
 function calculate(form) {
   var price = 52000;
   if (form.elements.brakes.checked)
     price += 1000;
   if (form.elements.radio.checked)
     price += 2500;
   if (form.elements.turbo.checked)
     price += 5000;
   if (form.elements.sticker.checked)
     price += 250;
   form.elements.result.value = price;
 }
</script>
<form name="pricecalc" onsubmit="return false" onchange="calculate(this)">
 <fieldset>
  <legend>Work out the price of your car</legend>
  <p>Base cost: £52000.</p>
  <p>Select additional options:</p>
  <ul>
   <li><label><input type=checkbox name=brakes> Ceramic brakes (£1000)</label></li>
   <li><label><input type=checkbox name=radio> Satellite radio (£2500)</label></li>
   <li><label><input type=checkbox name=turbo> Turbo charger (£5000)</label></li>
   <li><label><input type=checkbox name=sticker> "XZ" sticker (£250)</label></li>
  </ul>
  <p>Total: £<output name=result></output></p>
 </fieldset>
 <script>
  calculate(document.forms.pricecalc);
 </script>
</form>
```

<a id="script&#45;type&#45;module&#45;example&#45;1"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#script-type-module-example-1)

The following sample shows how a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element can be used to include an external <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;4"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#46;

``` text
<script type="module" src="app.mjs"></script>
```

This module&#44; and all its dependencies &#40;expressed through JavaScript <code>import</code> statements in the source file&#41;&#44; will be fetched&#46; Once the entire resulting module graph has been imported&#44; and the document has finished parsing&#44; the contents of <code>app&#46;mjs</code> will be evaluated&#46;

Additionally&#44; if code from another <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element in the same <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> imports the module from <code>app&#46;mjs</code> &#40;e&#46;g&#46; via <code>import &#34;&#46;&#47;app&#46;mjs&#34;&#59;</code>&#41;&#44; then the same <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;5"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script) created by the former <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element will be imported&#46;

<a id="script&#45;nomodule&#45;example"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#script-nomodule-example)

This example shows how to include a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;6"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script) for modern user agents&#44; and a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;11"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) for older user agents&#58;

``` text
<script type="module" src="app.mjs"></script>
<script nomodule defer src="classic-app-bundle.js"></script>
```

In modern user agents that support <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;7"></a>[JavaScript module scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element with the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;nomodule&#45;3"></a><code>[nomodule](#attr-script-nomodule)</code> attribute will be ignored&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> of &#34;<code>module</code>&#34; will be fetched and evaluated &#40;as a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;8"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#41;&#46; Conversely&#44; older user agents will ignore the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;8"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> of &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; as that is an unknown script type for them — but they will have no problem fetching and evaluating the other <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element &#40;as a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;classic&#45;script&#45;12"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#41;&#44; since they do not implement the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;nomodule&#45;4"></a><code>[nomodule](#attr-script-nomodule)</code> attribute&#46;

<a id="script&#45;type&#45;module&#45;example&#45;2"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#script-type-module-example-2)

The following sample shows how a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element can be used to write an inline <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;9"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script) that performs a number of substitutions on the document&#39;s text&#44; in order to make for a more interesting reading experience &#40;e&#46;g&#46; on a news site&#41;&#58; [&#91;XKCD1288&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXKCD1288)

``` text
<script type="module">
 import { walkAllTextNodeDescendants } from "./dom-utils.mjs";

 const substitutions = new Map([
   ["witnesses", "these dudes I know"]
   ["allegedly", "kinda probably"]
   ["new study", "Tumblr post"]
   ["rebuild", "avenge"]
   ["space", "spaaace"]
   ["Google glass", "Virtual Boy"]
   ["smartphone", "Pokédex"]
   ["electric", "atomic"]
   ["Senator", "Elf-Lord"]
   ["car", "cat"]
   ["election", "eating contest"]
   ["Congressional leaders", "river spirits"]
   ["homeland security", "Homestar Runner"]
   ["could not be reached for comment", "is guilty and everyone knows it"]
 ]);

 function substitute(textNode) {
   for (const [before, after] of substitutions.entries()) {
     textNode.data = textNode.data.replace(new RegExp(`\\b${before}\\b`, "ig"), after);
   }
 }

 walkAllTextNodeDescendants(document.body, substitute);
</script>
```

Some notable features gained by using a JavaScript module script include the ability to import functions from other JavaScript modules&#44; strict mode by default&#44; and how top&#45;level declarations do not introduce new properties onto the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;global&#45;object"></a>[global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#global-object)&#46; Also note that no matter where this <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element appears in the document&#44; it will not be evaluated until both document parsing has complete and its dependency &#40;<code>dom&#45;utils&#46;mjs</code>&#41; has been fetched and evaluated&#46;

<a id="json&#45;module&#45;script&#45;example"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#json-module-script-example)

The following sample shows how a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;json&#45;module&#45;script"></a>[JSON module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#json-module-script) can be imported from inside a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;10"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#58;

``` text
<script type="module">
 import peopleInSpace from "http://api.open-notify.org/astros.json" with { type: "json" };

 const list = document.querySelector("#people-in-space");
 for (const { craft, name } of peopleInSpace.people) {
   const li = document.createElement("li");
   li.textContent = `${name} / ${craft}`;
   list.append(li);
 }
</script>
```

MIME type checking for module scripts is strict&#46; In order for the fetch of the <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;json&#45;module&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[JSON module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#json-module-script) to succeed&#44; the HTTP response must have a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;json&#45;mime&#45;type"></a>[JSON MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type)&#44; for example <code>Content&#45;Type&#58; text&#47;json</code>&#46; On the other hand&#44; if the <code>with &#123; type&#58; &#34;json&#34; &#125;</code> part of the statement is omitted&#44; it is assumed that the intent is to import a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;module&#45;script&#45;11"></a>[JavaScript module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#javascript-module-script)&#44; and the fetch will fail if the HTTP response has a MIME type that is not a <a id="the&#45;script&#45;element&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type"></a>[JavaScript MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model"></a>4&#46;12&#46;1&#46;1 Processing model[](#script-processing-model)

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has several associated pieces of state&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="parser&#45;document"></a><strong>parser document</strong>&#44; which is either null or a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; initially null&#46; It is set by the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) and the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser) on <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements they insert&#44; and affects the processing of those elements&#46; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements with non&#45;null <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document"></a>[parser documents](#parser-document) are known as <a id="parser&#45;inserted"></a><strong>parser&#45;inserted</strong>&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="preparation&#45;time&#45;document"></a><strong>preparation&#45;time document</strong>&#44; which is either null or a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; initially null&#46; It is used to prevent scripts that move between documents during <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[preparation](#prepare-the-script-element) from <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[executing](#execute-the-script-element)&#46;

<a id="non&#45;blocking"></a>A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="script&#45;force&#45;async"></a><strong>force async</strong> boolean&#44; initially true&#46; It is set to false by the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) and the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser) on <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements they insert&#44; and when the element gets an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> content attribute added&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="concept&#45;script&#45;external"></a><strong>from an external file</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46; It is determined when the script is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[prepared](#prepare-the-script-element)&#44; based on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute of the element at that time&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed"></a><strong>ready to be parser&#45;executed</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46; This is used only used for elements that are also <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#44; to let the parser know when to execute the script&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has an <a id="already&#45;started"></a><strong>already started</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="concept&#45;script&#45;delay&#45;load"></a><strong>delaying the load event</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="concept&#45;script&#45;type"></a><strong>type</strong>&#44; which is either null&#44; &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#44; or &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#44; initially null&#46; It is determined when the element is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[prepared](#prepare-the-script-element)&#44; based on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute of the element at that time&#46;

<a id="concept&#45;script&#45;script"></a>A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has a <a id="concept&#45;script&#45;result"></a><strong>result</strong>&#44; which is either &#34;<code>uninitialized</code>&#34;&#44; null &#40;representing an error&#41;&#44; a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script"></a>[script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script)&#44; an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;import&#45;map&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[import map parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#import-map-parse-result)&#44; or a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;speculation&#45;rules&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[speculation rules parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rules-parse-result)&#46; It is initially &#34;<code>uninitialized</code>&#34;&#46;

<a id="the&#45;script&#45;is&#45;ready"></a>A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element has <a id="steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready"></a><strong>steps to run when the result is ready</strong>&#44; which are a series of steps or null&#44; initially null&#46; To <a id="mark&#45;as&#45;ready"></a><strong>mark as ready</strong> a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var> given a <var>result</var>&#58;

1.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) to <var>result</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) are not null&#44; then run them&#46;

3.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready&#45;2"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) to null&#46;

4.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;delay&#45;load"></a>[delaying the load event](#concept-script-delay-load) to false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;implicitly&#45;potentially&#45;render&#45;blocking"></a>[implicitly potentially render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#implicitly-potentially-render-blocking) if <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#44; <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;2"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#44; and <var>el</var> does not have an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;2"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> or <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> attribute&#46;

The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;ext"></a>[cloning steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone-ext) for <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements given <var>node</var>&#44; <var>copy</var>&#44; and <var>subtree</var> are to set <var>copy</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started"></a>[already started](#already-started) to <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started&#45;2"></a>[already started](#already-started)&#46;

When an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;3"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute is added to a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#44; the user agent must set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) to false&#46;

Whenever a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;delay&#45;load&#45;2"></a>[delaying the load event](#concept-script-delay-load) is true&#44; the user agent must <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>insertedNode</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;3"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[Prepare the script element](#prepare-the-script-element) given <var>insertedNode</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps) only run when the inserted element is still <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; which protects against cases where an earlier&#45;inserted <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> removes a later&#45;inserted <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code>&#46; For instance&#58;

``` text
<script>
const script1 = document.createElement('script');
script1.innerText = `
  document.querySelector('#script2').remove();
`;

const script2 = document.createElement('script');
script2.id = 'script2';
script2.textContent = `console.log('script#2 running')`;

document.body.append(script1, script2);
</script>
```

Nothing is printed to the console in this example&#46; By the time the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps) run for the first <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> that was atomically inserted by <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;node&#45;append"></a><code>[append&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-append)</code>&#44; it can observe that the second <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> is already <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected&#45;2"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected) to the DOM&#44; and it removes it from the DOM&#46; Because the second <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> is no longer <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected&#45;3"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; its <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;4"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps) do not run&#44; and it does not get <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[prepared](#prepare-the-script-element)&#46;

The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps) given <var>removedNode</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;2"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;speculation&#45;rules&#45;parse&#45;result&#45;2"></a>[speculation rules parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rules-parse-result)&#58;

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;unregister&#45;speculation&#45;rules"></a>[Unregister speculation rules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#unregister-speculation-rules) given <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) and <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;3"></a>[result](#concept-script-result)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started&#45;3"></a>[already started](#already-started) to false&#46;

    3.  Set <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;4"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) to null&#46;

The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;children&#45;changed&#45;steps"></a>[children changed steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-children-changed-ext) given <var>changedNode</var> are&#58;

1.  If the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element is not <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected&#45;4"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Run the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;5"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; given <var>changedNode</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This has an interesting implication on the execution order of a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element and any newly&#45;inserted child <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#46; Consider the following snippet&#58;

``` text
<script id=outer-script></script>

<script>
  const outerScript = document.querySelector('#outer-script');

  const start = new Text('console.log(1);');
  const innerScript = document.createElement('script');
  innerScript.textContent = `console.log('inner script executing')`;
  const end = new Text('console.log(2);');

  outerScript.append(start, innerScript, end);

  // Logs:
  // 1
  // 2
  // inner script executing
</script>
```

By the time the second script block executes&#44; the <code>outer&#45;script</code> has already been <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[prepared](#prepare-the-script-element)&#44; but because it is empty&#44; it did not execute and therefore is not marked as <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started&#45;4"></a>[already started](#already-started)&#46; The atomic insertion of the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes and nested <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element have the following effects&#58;

1.  All three child nodes get atomically inserted as children of <code>outer&#45;script</code>&#59; all of their <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;ext"></a>[insertion steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert-ext) run&#44; which have no observable consequences in this case&#46;

2.  The <code>outer&#45;script</code>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;children&#45;changed&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[children changed steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-children-changed-ext) run&#44; which <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[prepares](#prepare-the-script-element) that script&#59; because its body is now non&#45;empty&#44; this executes the contents of the two <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes&#44; in order&#46;

3.  The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;6"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps) finally run for <code>innerScript</code>&#44; causing its body to execute&#46;

The following <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change&#45;ext"></a>[attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>oldValue</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; and <var>namespace</var>&#44; are used for all <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#58;

1.  If <var>namespace</var> is not null&#44; then return&#46;

2.
