If <var>localName</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code>&#44; <var>value</var> is not null&#44; and <var>element</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected&#45;5"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then run the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;35"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;7"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#46;

<a id="prepare&#45;a&#45;script"></a>To <a id="prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><strong>prepare the script element</strong> given a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;36"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started&#45;5"></a>[already started](#already-started) is true&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>parser document</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[parser document](#parser-document)&#46;

3.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) to null&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is done so that if parser&#45;inserted <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements fail to run when the parser tries to run them&#44; e&#46;g&#46; because they are empty or specify an unsupported scripting language&#44; another script can later mutate them and cause them to run again&#46;

4.  If <var>parser document</var> is non&#45;null and <var>el</var> does not have an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;4"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async&#45;2"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) to true&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is done so that if a parser&#45;inserted <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element fails to run when the parser tries to run it&#44; but it is later executed after a script dynamically updates it&#44; it will execute in an async fashion even if the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;5"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute isn&#39;t set&#46;

5.  Let <var>source text</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;

6.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;empty"></a>

    If <var>el</var> has no <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute&#44; and <var>source text</var> is the empty string&#44; then return&#46;

7.  If <var>el</var> is not <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;connected&#45;6"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

8.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;prepare"></a>

    If any of the following are true&#58;

    - <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute whose value is the empty string&#59;

    - <var>el</var> has no <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute but it has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;language"></a><code>[language](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-language)</code> attribute and <em>that</em> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#59; or

    - <var>el</var> has neither a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute nor a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;language&#45;2"></a><code>[language](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-language)</code> attribute&#44;

    then let <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> for this <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element be &#34;<code>text&#47;javascript</code>&#34;&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute&#44; then let <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> be the value of that attribute&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; <var>el</var> has a non&#45;empty <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;language&#45;3"></a><code>[language](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-language)</code> attribute&#59; let <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> be the concatenation of &#34;<code>text&#47;</code>&#34; and the value of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;language&#45;4"></a><code>[language](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-language)</code> attribute&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;language&#45;5"></a><code>[language](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-language)</code> attribute is never conforming&#44; and is always ignored if there is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute present&#46;

9.  If <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;essence&#45;match"></a>[JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match)&#44; or <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute whose value with <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[leading and trailing ASCII whitespace stripped](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;essence&#45;match&#45;2"></a>[JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match)&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) to &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#46;

10. Otherwise&#44; if <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> is an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) to &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#46;

11. Otherwise&#44; if <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> is an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;4"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) to &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;&#46;

12. Otherwise&#44; if <var>the script block&#39;s type string</var> is an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;5"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) to &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#46;

13. Otherwise&#44; return&#46; &#40;No script is executed&#44; and <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;6"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is left as null&#46;&#41;

14. If <var>parser document</var> is non&#45;null&#44; then set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) back to <var>parser document</var> and set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async&#45;3"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) to false&#46;

15. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;start"></a>

    Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;already&#45;started&#45;6"></a>[already started](#already-started) to true&#46;

16. Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document) to its <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

17. If <var>parser document</var> is non&#45;null&#44; and <var>parser document</var> is not equal to <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document)&#44; then return&#46;

18. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;noscript"></a>

    If <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for <var>el</var>&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The definition of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;2"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) means that&#44; amongst others&#44; the following scripts will not execute&#58; scripts in <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;xmlhttprequest"></a><code>[XMLHttpRequest](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlhttprequest)</code>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;xmlhttprequest&#45;responsexml"></a><code>[responseXML](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-xmlhttprequest-responsexml)</code> documents&#44; scripts in <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;domparser"></a><code>[DOMParser](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#domparser)</code>&#45;created documents&#44; scripts in documents created by <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;xsltprocessor"></a><code>[XSLTProcessor](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#xsltprocessor)</code>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;xsltprocessor&#45;transformtodocument"></a><code>[transformToDocument](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-xsltprocessor-transformtodocument)</code> feature&#44; and scripts that are first inserted by a script into a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> that was created using the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;domimplementation&#45;createdocument"></a><code>[createDocument&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domimplementation-createdocument)</code> API&#46; [&#91;XHR&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXHR) [&#91;DOMPARSING&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOMPARSING) [&#91;XSLTP&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXSLTP) [&#91;DOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOM)

19. If <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;nomodule"></a><code>[nomodule](#attr-script-nomodule)</code> content attribute and its <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;7"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This means specifying <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;nomodule&#45;2"></a><code>[nomodule](#attr-script-nomodule)</code> on a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;module&#45;script"></a>[module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-script) has no effect&#59; the algorithm continues onward&#46;

20. Let <var>cspType</var> be &#34;<code>script speculationrules</code>&#34; if <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;8"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#59; otherwise&#44; &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

21. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;csp"></a>

    If <var>el</var> does not have a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> content attribute&#44; and the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;should&#45;element&#39;s&#45;inline&#45;behavior&#45;be&#45;blocked&#45;by&#45;content&#45;security&#45;policy"></a>[Should element&#39;s inline behavior be blocked by Content Security Policy&#63;](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-inline) algorithm returns &#34;<code>Blocked</code>&#34; when given <var>el</var>&#44; <var>cspType</var>&#44; and <var>source text</var>&#44; then return&#46; [&#91;CSP&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSP)

22. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;for"></a>

    If <var>el</var> has an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;event"></a><code>[event](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-event)</code> attribute and a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;for"></a><code>[for](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-for)</code> attribute&#44; and <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;9"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>for</var> be the value of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;for&#45;2"></a><code>[for](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-for)</code> attribute&#46;

    2.  Let <var>event</var> be the value of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;event&#45;2"></a><code>[event](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-event)</code> attribute&#46;

    3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from <var>event</var> and <var>for</var>&#46;

    4.  If <var>for</var> is not an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;4"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>window</code>&#34;&#44; then return&#46;

    5.  If <var>event</var> is not an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;5"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for either the string &#34;<code>onload</code>&#34; or the string &#34;<code>onload&#40;&#41;</code>&#34;&#44; then return&#46;

23. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;encoding"></a>

    If <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;charset"></a><code>[charset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-charset)</code> attribute&#44; then let <var>encoding</var> be the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding"></a>[getting an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) from the value of the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;charset&#45;2"></a><code>[charset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-charset)</code> attribute&#46;

    If <var>el</var> does not have a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;charset&#45;3"></a><code>[charset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-script-charset)</code> attribute&#44; or if <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[getting an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) failed&#44; then let <var>encoding</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding"></a>[the encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;10"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; this encoding will be ignored&#46;

24. Let <var>classic script CORS setting</var> be the current state of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#46;

25. Let <var>module script credentials mode</var> be the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;cors&#45;settings&#45;attribute&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[CORS settings attribute credentials mode](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-settings-attribute-credentials-mode) for <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;2"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#46;

26. Let <var>cryptographic nonce</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;cryptographicnonce"></a>[&#91;&#91;CryptographicNonce&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cryptographicnonce) internal slot&#39;s value&#46;

27. If <var>el</var> has an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;integrity"></a><code>[integrity](#attr-script-integrity)</code> attribute&#44; then let <var>integrity metadata</var> be that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; let <var>integrity metadata</var> be the empty string&#46;

28. Let <var>referrer policy</var> be the current state of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-script-referrerpolicy)</code> content attribute&#46;

29. Let <var>fetch priority</var> be the current state of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;fetchpriority"></a><code>[fetchpriority](#attr-script-fetchpriority)</code> content attribute&#46;

30. Let <var>parser metadata</var> be &#34;<code>parser&#45;inserted</code>&#34; if <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;4"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#44; and &#34;<code>not&#45;parser&#45;inserted</code>&#34; otherwise&#46;

31. Let <var>options</var> be a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;fetch&#45;options"></a>[script fetch options](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#script-fetch-options) whose <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;nonce"></a>[cryptographic nonce](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-nonce) is <var>cryptographic nonce</var>&#44; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;integrity"></a>[integrity metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity) is <var>integrity metadata</var>&#44; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;parser"></a>[parser metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-parser) is <var>parser metadata</var>&#44; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;credentials"></a>[credentials mode](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials) is <var>module script credentials mode</var>&#44; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;referrer&#45;policy"></a>[referrer policy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy) is <var>referrer policy</var>&#44; and <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;fetch&#45;priority"></a>[fetch priority](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority) is <var>fetch priority</var>&#46;

32. Let <var>settings object</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

33. <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;src&#45;prepare"></a>

    If <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> content attribute&#58;

    1.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;11"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>el</var> to <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;event&#45;error"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>el</var>&#44; and return&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        External import maps and speculation rules are not currently supported&#46; See [WICG&#47;import&#45;maps issue &#35;235](https://github.com/WICG/import-maps/issues/235) and [WICG&#47;nav&#45;speculation issue &#35;348](https://github.com/WICG/nav-speculation/issues/348) for discussions on adding support&#46;

    2.  Let <var>src</var> be the value of <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute&#46;

    3.  If <var>src</var> is the empty string&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>el</var> to <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;event&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>el</var>&#44; and return&#46;

    4.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;external"></a>[from an external file](#concept-script-external) to true&#46;

    5.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given <var>src</var>&#44; relative to <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

    6.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>el</var> to <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;event&#45;error&#45;3"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>el</var>&#44; and return&#46;

    7.  If <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;potentially&#45;render&#45;blocking"></a>[potentially render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#potentially-render-blocking)&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;block&#45;rendering"></a>[block rendering](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#block-rendering) on <var>el</var>&#46;

    8.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;delay&#45;load&#45;3"></a>[delaying the load event](#concept-script-delay-load) to true&#46;

    9.  If <var>el</var> is currently <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;render&#45;blocking"></a>[render&#45;blocking](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#render-blocking)&#44; then set <var>options</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;render&#45;blocking"></a>[render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking) to true&#46;

    10. Let <var>onComplete</var> given <var>result</var> be the following steps&#58;

        1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;mark&#45;as&#45;ready"></a>[Mark as ready](#mark-as-ready) <var>el</var> given <var>result</var>&#46;

    11. Switch on <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;12"></a>[type](#concept-script-type)&#58;

        <strong>&#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;</strong>

        <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;fetch&#45;a&#45;classic&#45;script"></a>[Fetch a classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fetch-a-classic-script) given <var>url</var>&#44; <var>settings object</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#44; <var>classic script CORS setting</var>&#44; <var>encoding</var>&#44; and <var>onComplete</var>&#46;

        <strong>&#34;<code>module</code>&#34;</strong>

        If <var>el</var> does not have an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;integrity&#45;2"></a><code>[integrity](#attr-script-integrity)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>options</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;integrity&#45;2"></a>[integrity metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity) to the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;resolving&#45;a&#45;module&#45;integrity&#45;metadata"></a>[resolving a module integrity metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#resolving-a-module-integrity-metadata) with <var>url</var> and <var>settings object</var>&#46;

        <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;fetch&#45;a&#45;module&#45;script&#45;tree"></a>[Fetch an external module script graph](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fetch-a-module-script-tree) given <var>url</var>&#44; <var>settings object</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#44; and <var>onComplete</var>&#46;

        For performance reasons&#44; user agents may start fetching the classic script or module graph &#40;as defined above&#41; as soon as the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;7"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute is set&#44; instead&#44; in the hope that <var>el</var> will become connected &#40;and that the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;3"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> attribute won&#39;t change value in the meantime&#41;&#46; Either way&#44; once <var>el</var> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;becomes&#45;connected"></a>[becomes connected](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#becomes-connected)&#44; the load must have started as described in this step&#46; If the UA performs such prefetching&#44; but <var>el</var> never becomes connected&#44; or the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;8"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute is dynamically changed&#44; or the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin&#45;4"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> attribute is dynamically changed&#44; then the user agent will not execute the script so obtained&#44; and the fetching process will have been effectively wasted&#46;

34. <a id="establish&#45;script&#45;block&#45;source"></a>

    If <var>el</var> does not have a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;9"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> content attribute&#58;

    1.  Let <var>base URL</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[document base URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document-base-url)&#46;

    2.  Switch on <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;13"></a>[type](#concept-script-type)&#58;

        <strong>&#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;</strong>

        1.  Let <var>script</var> be the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;creating&#45;a&#45;classic&#45;script"></a>[creating a classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#creating-a-classic-script) using <var>source text</var>&#44; <var>settings object</var>&#44; <var>base URL</var>&#44; and <var>options</var>&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;mark&#45;as&#45;ready&#45;2"></a>[Mark as ready](#mark-as-ready) <var>el</var> given <var>script</var>&#46;

        <strong>&#34;<code>module</code>&#34;</strong>

        1.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;delay&#45;load&#45;4"></a>[delaying the load event](#concept-script-delay-load) to true&#46;

        2.  If <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;potentially&#45;render&#45;blocking&#45;2"></a>[potentially render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#potentially-render-blocking)&#58;

            1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;block&#45;rendering&#45;2"></a>[Block rendering](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#block-rendering) on <var>el</var>&#46;

            2.  Set <var>options</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;fetch&#45;options&#45;render&#45;blocking&#45;2"></a>[render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking) to true&#46;

        3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;fetch&#45;an&#45;inline&#45;module&#45;script&#45;graph"></a>[Fetch an inline module script graph](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fetch-an-inline-module-script-graph)&#44; given <var>source text</var>&#44; <var>base URL</var>&#44; <var>settings object</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#44; and with the following steps given <var>result</var>&#58;

            1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) given <var>el</var> to perform the following steps&#58;

                1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;mark&#45;as&#45;ready&#45;3"></a>[Mark as ready](#mark-as-ready) <var>el</var> given <var>result</var>&#46;

                <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

                Queueing a task here means that&#44; even if the inline module script has no dependencies or synchronously results in a parse error&#44; we won&#39;t proceed to <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[execute the script element](#execute-the-script-element) synchronously&#46;

        <strong>&#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;</strong>

        1.  Let <var>result</var> be the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;create&#45;an&#45;import&#45;map&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[creating an import map parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-an-import-map-parse-result) given <var>source text</var> and <var>base URL</var>&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;mark&#45;as&#45;ready&#45;4"></a>[Mark as ready](#mark-as-ready) <var>el</var> given <var>result</var>&#46;

        <strong>&#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;</strong>

        1.  Let <var>result</var> be the result of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;create&#45;a&#45;speculation&#45;rules&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[creating a speculation rules parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-speculation-rules-parse-result) given <var>source text</var> and <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;mark&#45;as&#45;ready&#45;5"></a>[Mark as ready](#mark-as-ready) <var>el</var> given <var>result</var>&#46;

35. If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;14"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34; and <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;10"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute&#44; or <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;15"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#58;

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;5"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) is &#34;<code>uninitialized</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;src"></a>

        <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;module&#45;async"></a>If <var>el</var> has an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;6"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> attribute or <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async&#45;4"></a>[force async](#script-force-async) is true&#58;

        1.  Let <var>scripts</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;set&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a>[set of scripts that will execute as soon as possible](#set-of-scripts-that-will-execute-as-soon-as-possible)&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;set&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append) <var>el</var> to <var>scripts</var>&#46;

        3.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready&#45;3"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) to the following&#58;

            1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Execute the script element](#execute-the-script-element) <var>el</var>&#46;

            2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) <var>el</var> from <var>scripts</var>&#46;

    3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;src&#45;sync"></a>

        <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;module&#45;noasync"></a>Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> is not <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;5"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#58;

        1.  Let <var>scripts</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;in&#45;order&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a>[list of scripts that will execute in order as soon as possible](#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-in-order-as-soon-as-possible)&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>el</var> to <var>scripts</var>&#46;

        3.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready&#45;4"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) to the following&#58;

            1.  If <var>scripts</var>&#91;0&#93; is not <var>el</var>&#44; then abort these steps&#46;

            2.  While <var>scripts</var> is not empty&#44; and <var>scripts</var>&#91;0&#93;&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;6"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) is not &#34;<code>uninitialized</code>&#34;&#58;

                1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[Execute the script element](#execute-the-script-element) <var>scripts</var>&#91;0&#93;&#46;

                2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) <var>scripts</var>&#91;0&#93;&#46;

    4.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;defer"></a>

        <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;module&#45;noasync&#45;parser&#45;inserted"></a>Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> has a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;2"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> attribute or <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;16"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#58;

        1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>el</var> to its <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[parser document](#parser-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing"></a>[list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing](#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-when-the-document-has-finished-parsing)&#46;

        2.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready&#45;5"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) to the following&#58; set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](#ready-to-be-parser-executed) to true&#46; &#40;The parser will handle executing the script&#46;&#41;

    5.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;parser&#45;inserted"></a>

        Otherwise&#58;

        1.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[parser document](#parser-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](#pending-parsing-blocking-script) to <var>el</var>&#46;

        2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;block&#45;rendering&#45;3"></a>[Block rendering](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#block-rendering) on <var>el</var>&#46;

        3.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;run&#45;when&#45;the&#45;result&#45;is&#45;ready&#45;6"></a>[steps to run when the result is ready](#steps-to-run-when-the-result-is-ready) to the following&#58; set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed&#45;2"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](#ready-to-be-parser-executed) to true&#46; &#40;The parser will handle executing the script&#46;&#41;

36. Otherwise&#58;

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;7"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) is <em>not</em> &#34;<code>uninitialized</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;style&#45;delayed"></a>

        If all of the following are true&#58;

        - <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;17"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;&#59;
        - <var>el</var> is <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;6"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](#parser-inserted)&#59;
        - <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;has&#45;a&#45;style&#45;sheet&#45;that&#45;is&#45;blocking&#45;scripts"></a>[has a style sheet that is blocking scripts](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#has-a-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts)&#59; and
        - either the parser that created <var>el</var> is an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; or it&#39;s an <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) whose <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level"></a>[script nesting level](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#script-nesting-level) is not greater than one&#44;

        then&#58;

        1.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;8"></a>[parser document](#parser-document)&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](#pending-parsing-blocking-script) to <var>el</var>&#46;

        2.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed&#45;3"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](#ready-to-be-parser-executed) to true&#46; &#40;The parser will handle executing the script&#46;&#41;

    3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;inline"></a>

        Otherwise&#44; <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;immediately"></a>[immediately](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#immediately) <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[execute the script element](#execute-the-script-element) <var>el</var>&#44; even if other scripts are already executing&#46;

Each <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script"></a><strong>pending parsing&#45;blocking script</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;40"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Each <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="set&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a><strong>set of scripts that will execute as soon as possible</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;set"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;41"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#44; initially empty&#46;

Each <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;in&#45;order&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a><strong>list of scripts that will execute in order as soon as possible</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;42"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#44; initially empty&#46;

Each <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing"></a><strong>list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;2"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;43"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#44; initially empty&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;44"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element that blocks a parser gets moved to another <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> before it would normally have stopped blocking that parser&#44; it nonetheless continues blocking that parser until the condition that causes it to be blocking the parser no longer applies &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if the script is a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](#pending-parsing-blocking-script) because the original <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;has&#45;a&#45;style&#45;sheet&#45;that&#45;is&#45;blocking&#45;scripts&#45;2"></a>[has a style sheet that is blocking scripts](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#has-a-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts) when it was parsed&#44; but then the script is moved to another <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> before the blocking style sheet&#40;s&#41; loaded&#44; the script still blocks the parser until the style sheets are all loaded&#44; at which time the script executes and the parser is unblocked&#41;&#46;

<a id="execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;block"></a>To <a id="execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><strong>execute the script element</strong> given a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;45"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;node&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;preparation&#45;time&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[preparation&#45;time document](#preparation-time-document) is not equal to <var>document</var>&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;unblock&#45;rendering"></a>[Unblock rendering](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#unblock-rendering) on <var>el</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;8"></a>[result](#concept-script-result) is null&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;event&#45;error&#45;4"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>el</var>&#44; and return&#46;

5.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;external&#45;2"></a>[from an external file](#concept-script-external) is true&#44; or <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;18"></a>[type](#concept-script-type) is &#34;<code>module</code>&#34;&#44; then increment <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ignore&#45;destructive&#45;writes&#45;counter"></a>[ignore&#45;destructive&#45;writes counter](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#ignore-destructive-writes-counter)&#46;

6.  Switch on <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;type&#45;19"></a>[type](#concept-script-type)&#58;

    <strong>&#34;<code>classic</code>&#34;</strong>

    1.  Let <var>oldCurrentScript</var> be the value to which <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;currentscript"></a><code>[currentScript](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-document-currentscript)</code> object was most recently set&#46;

    2.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;root"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root) is <em>not</em> a <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root)&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;currentscript&#45;2"></a><code>[currentScript](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-document-currentscript)</code> attribute to <var>el</var>&#46; Otherwise&#44; set it to null&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This does not use the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document&#45;tree"></a>[in a document tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree) check&#44; as <var>el</var> could have been removed from the document prior to execution&#44; and in that scenario <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;currentscript&#45;3"></a><code>[currentScript](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-document-currentscript)</code> still needs to point to it&#46;

    3.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;run&#45;a&#45;classic&#45;script"></a>[Run the classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#run-a-classic-script) given by <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;9"></a>[result](#concept-script-result)&#46;

    4.  Set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;currentscript&#45;4"></a><code>[currentScript](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-document-currentscript)</code> attribute to <var>oldCurrentScript</var>&#46;

    <strong>&#34;<code>module</code>&#34;</strong>

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;assert&#45;3"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;currentscript&#45;5"></a><code>[currentScript](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-document-currentscript)</code> attribute is null&#46;

    2.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;run&#45;a&#45;module&#45;script"></a>[Run the module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#run-a-module-script) given by <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;10"></a>[result](#concept-script-result)&#46;

    <strong>&#34;<code>importmap</code>&#34;</strong>

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;register&#45;an&#45;import&#45;map"></a>[Register an import map](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#register-an-import-map) given <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) and <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;11"></a>[result](#concept-script-result)&#46;

    <strong>&#34;<code>speculationrules</code>&#34;</strong>

    1.  <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;register&#45;speculation&#45;rules"></a>[Register speculation rules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#register-speculation-rules) given <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;3"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) and <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;12"></a>[result](#concept-script-result)&#46;

7.  Decrement the <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ignore&#45;destructive&#45;writes&#45;counter&#45;2"></a>[ignore&#45;destructive&#45;writes counter](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#ignore-destructive-writes-counter) of <var>document</var>&#44; if it was incremented in the earlier step&#46;

8.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;external&#45;3"></a>[from an external file](#concept-script-external) is true&#44; then <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="script&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>el</var>&#46;

##### <a id="scriptingLanguages"></a>4&#46;12&#46;1&#46;2 Scripting languages[](#scriptingLanguages)

User agents are not required to support JavaScript&#46; This standard needs to be updated if a language other than JavaScript comes along and gets similar wide adoption by web browsers&#46; Until such a time&#44; implementing other languages is in conflict with this standard&#44; given the processing model defined for the <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#46;

Servers should use <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;text&#47;javascript"></a><code>[text&#47;javascript](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/javascript)</code> for JavaScript resources&#44; in accordance with Updates to ECMAScript Media Types&#46; Servers should not use other <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type"></a>[JavaScript MIME types](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type) for JavaScript resources&#44; and must not use non&#45;<a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[JavaScript MIME types](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type)&#46; [&#91;RFC9239&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC9239)

For external JavaScript resources&#44; MIME type parameters in &#96;<a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;content&#45;type"></a><code>[Content&#45;Type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)</code>&#96; headers are generally ignored&#46; &#40;In some cases the &#96;<code>charset</code>&#96; parameter has an effect&#46;&#41; However&#44; for the <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute they are significant&#59; it uses the <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;essence&#45;match"></a>[JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match) concept&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; scripts with their <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-script-type)</code> attribute set to &#34;<code>text&#47;javascript&#59; charset&#61;utf&#45;8</code>&#34; will not be evaluated&#44; even though that is a valid <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;javascript&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[JavaScript MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type) when parsed&#46;

Furthermore&#44; again for external JavaScript resources&#44; special considerations apply around &#96;<a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;content&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[Content&#45;Type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)</code>&#96; header processing as detailed in the <a id="scriptingLanguages&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[prepare the script element](#prepare-the-script-element) algorithm and Fetch&#46; [&#91;FETCH&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsFETCH)

##### <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;12&#46;1&#46;3 <strong>Restrictions for contents of <code>script</code> elements</strong>[](#restrictions-for-contents-of-script-elements)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The easiest and safest way to avoid the rather strange restrictions described in this section is to always escape an ASCII case&#45;insensitive match for &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;</code>&#34; as &#34;<code>&#92;x3C&#33;&#45;&#45;</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>&#60;script</code>&#34; as &#34;<code>&#92;x3Cscript</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;script</code>&#34; as &#34;<code>&#92;x3C&#47;script</code>&#34; when these sequences appear in literals in scripts &#40;e&#46;g&#46; in strings&#44; regular expressions&#44; or comments&#41;&#44; and to avoid writing code that uses such constructs in expressions&#46; Doing so avoids the pitfalls that the restrictions in this section are prone to triggering&#58; namely&#44; that&#44; for historical reasons&#44; parsing of <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> blocks in HTML is a strange and exotic practice that acts unintuitively in the face of these sequences&#46;

The <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content) must match the <code>script</code> production in the following ABNF&#44; the character set for which is Unicode&#46; [&#91;ABNF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABNF)

``` text
script        = outer *( comment-open inner comment-close outer )

outer         = < any string that doesn't contain a substring that matches not-in-outer >
not-in-outer  = comment-open
inner         = < any string that doesn't contain a substring that matches not-in-inner >
not-in-inner  = comment-close / script-open

comment-open  = "<!--"
comment-close = "-->"
script-open   = "<" s c r i p t tag-end

s             =  %x0053 ; U+0053 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S
s             =/ %x0073 ; U+0073 LATIN SMALL LETTER S
c             =  %x0043 ; U+0043 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER C
c             =/ %x0063 ; U+0063 LATIN SMALL LETTER C
r             =  %x0052 ; U+0052 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER R
r             =/ %x0072 ; U+0072 LATIN SMALL LETTER R
i             =  %x0049 ; U+0049 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER I
i             =/ %x0069 ; U+0069 LATIN SMALL LETTER I
p             =  %x0050 ; U+0050 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER P
p             =/ %x0070 ; U+0070 LATIN SMALL LETTER P
t             =  %x0054 ; U+0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T
t             =/ %x0074 ; U+0074 LATIN SMALL LETTER T

tag-end       =  %x0009 ; U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)
tag-end       =/ %x000A ; U+000A LINE FEED (LF)
tag-end       =/ %x000C ; U+000C FORM FEED (FF)
tag-end       =/ %x0020 ; U+0020 SPACE
tag-end       =/ %x002F ; U+002F SOLIDUS (/)
tag-end       =/ %x003E ; U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)
```

When a <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element contains <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts"></a>[script documentation](#inline-documentation-for-external-scripts)&#44; there are further restrictions on the contents of the element&#44; as described in the section below&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following script illustrates this issue&#46; Suppose you have a script that contains a string&#44; as in&#58;

``` text
const example = 'Consider this string: <!-- <script>';
console.log(example);
```

If one were to put this string directly in a <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> block&#44; it would violate the restrictions above&#58;

``` text
<script>
  const example = 'Consider this string: <!-- <script>';
  console.log(example);
</script>
```

The bigger problem&#44; though&#44; and the reason why it would violate those restrictions&#44; is that actually the script would get parsed weirdly&#58; <em>the script block above is not terminated</em>&#46; That is&#44; what looks like a &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;script&#62;</code>&#34; end tag in this snippet is actually still part of the <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> block&#46; The script doesn&#39;t execute &#40;since it&#39;s not terminated&#41;&#59; if it somehow were to execute&#44; as it might if the markup looked as follows&#44; it would fail because the script &#40;highlighted here&#41; is not valid JavaScript&#58;

``` text
<script>
  const example = 'Consider this string: <!-- <script>';
  console.log(example);
</script>
<!-- despite appearances, this is actually part of the script still! -->
<script>
 ... // this is the same script block still...
</script>
```

What is going on here is that for legacy reasons&#44; &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;</code>&#34; and &#34;<code>&#60;script</code>&#34; strings in <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements in HTML need to be balanced in order for the parser to consider closing the block&#46;

By escaping the problematic strings as mentioned at the top of this section&#44; the problem is avoided entirely&#58;

``` text
<script>
  // Note: `\x3C` is an escape sequence for `<`.
  const example = 'Consider this string: \x3C!-- \x3Cscript>';
  console.log(example);
</script>
<!-- this is just a comment between script blocks -->
<script>
 ... // this is a new script block
</script>
```

It is possible for these sequences to naturally occur in script expressions&#44; as in the following examples&#58;

``` text
if (x<!--y) { ... }
if ( player<script ) { ... }
```

In such cases the characters cannot be escaped&#44; but the expressions can be rewritten so that the sequences don&#39;t occur&#44; as in&#58;

``` text
if (x < !--y) { ... }
if (!--y > x) { ... }
if (!(--y) > x) { ... }
if (player < script) { ... }
if (script > player) { ... }
```

Doing this also avoids a different pitfall as well&#58; for related historical reasons&#44; the string &#34;&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;&#34; in <a id="restrictions&#45;for&#45;contents&#45;of&#45;script&#45;elements&#58;classic&#45;script"></a>[classic scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script) is actually treated as a line comment start&#44; just like &#34;&#47;&#47;&#34;&#46;

##### <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts"></a>4&#46;12&#46;1&#46;4 <strong>Inline documentation for external scripts</strong>[](#inline-documentation-for-external-scripts)

If a <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute is specified&#44; then the contents of the <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#44; if any&#44; must be such that the value of the <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;text"></a><code>[text](#dom-script-text)</code> IDL attribute&#44; which is derived from the element&#39;s contents&#44; matches the <code>documentation</code> production in the following ABNF&#44; the character set for which is Unicode&#46; [&#91;ABNF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABNF)

<a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;scalar&#45;value"></a><a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;2"></a><a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;3"></a>

``` text
documentation = *( *( space / tab / comment ) [ line-comment ] newline )
comment       = slash star *( not-star / star not-slash ) 1*star slash
line-comment  = slash slash *not-newline

; characters
tab           = %x0009 ; U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)
newline       = %x000A ; U+000A LINE FEED (LF)
space         = %x0020 ; U+0020 SPACE
star          = %x002A ; U+002A ASTERISK (*)
slash         = %x002F ; U+002F SOLIDUS (/)
not-newline   = %x0000-0009 / %x000B-10FFFF
                ; a scalar value other than U+000A LINE FEED (LF)
not-star      = %x0000-0029 / %x002B-10FFFF
                ; a scalar value other than U+002A ASTERISK (*)
not-slash     = %x0000-002E / %x0030-10FFFF
                ; a scalar value other than U+002F SOLIDUS (/)
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This corresponds to putting the contents of the element in JavaScript comments&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This requirement is in addition to the earlier restrictions on the syntax of contents of <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This allows authors to include documentation&#44; such as license information or API information&#44; inside their documents while still referring to external script files&#46; The syntax is constrained so that authors don&#39;t accidentally include what looks like valid script while also providing a <a id="inline&#45;documentation&#45;for&#45;external&#45;scripts&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-script-src)</code> attribute&#46;

``` text
<script src="cool-effects.js">
 // create new instances using:
 //    var e = new Effect();
 // start the effect using .play, stop using .stop:
 //    e.play();
 //    e.stop();
</script>
```

##### <a id="scriptTagXSLT"></a>4&#46;12&#46;1&#46;5 Interaction of <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements and XSLT[](#scriptTagXSLT)

Avoid using client&#45;side XSLT in browsers&#46; The browser implementations of XSLT are highly susceptible to memory safety vulnerabilities&#44; and the web platform has evolved toward JavaScript as the safe replacement&#46; For these reasons&#44; this feature is in the process of being removed from the web platform&#46; &#40;This is a long process that takes many years&#46;&#41;

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

This specification does not define how XSLT interacts with the <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element&#46; However&#44; in the absence of another specification actually defining this&#44; here are some guidelines for implementers&#44; based on existing implementations&#58;

- When an XSLT transformation program is triggered by an <code>&#60;&#63;xml&#45;stylesheet&#63;&#62;</code> processing instruction and the browser implements a direct&#45;to&#45;DOM transformation&#44; <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements created by the XSLT processor need to have its <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;parser&#45;document"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) set correctly&#44; and run in document order &#40;modulo scripts marked <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer"></a><code>[defer](#attr-script-defer)</code> or <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code>&#41;&#44; <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;immediately"></a>[immediately](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#immediately)&#44; as the transformation is occurring&#46;

- The <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;xsltprocessor"></a><code>[XSLTProcessor](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#xsltprocessor)</code> <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;dom&#45;xsltprocessor&#45;transformtodocument"></a><code>[transformToDocument&#40;&#41;](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-xsltprocessor-transformtodocument)</code> method adds elements to a <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object with a null <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc)&#44; and&#44; accordingly&#44; any <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements they create need to have their <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;already&#45;started"></a>[already started](#already-started) set to true in the <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[prepare the script element](#prepare-the-script-element) algorithm and never get executed &#40;<a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;concept&#45;environment&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-environment-noscript)&#41;&#46; Such <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements still need to have their <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) set&#44; though&#44; such that their <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;dom&#45;script&#45;async"></a><code>[async](#dom-script-async)</code> IDL attribute will return false in the absence of an <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;2"></a><code>[async](#attr-script-async)</code> content attribute&#46;

- The <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;xsltprocessor&#45;2"></a><code>[XSLTProcessor](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#xsltprocessor)</code> <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;dom&#45;xsltprocessor&#45;transformtofragment"></a><code>[transformToFragment&#40;&#41;](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-xsltprocessor-transformtofragment)</code> method needs to create a fragment that is equivalent to one built manually by creating the elements using <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;createelementns"></a><code>[document&#46;createElementNS&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createelementns)</code>&#46; For instance&#44; it needs to create <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements with null <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;parser&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[parser document](#parser-document) and with their <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;already&#45;started&#45;2"></a>[already started](#already-started) set to false&#44; so that they will execute when the fragment is inserted into a document&#46;

The main distinction between the first two cases and the last case is that the first two operate on <a id="scriptTagXSLT&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>s and the last operates on a fragment&#46;
