<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;metadata&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Metadata content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#metadata-content-2)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

In a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element of an <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; if there are no ancestor <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> elements&#46;

Where <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2) is expected in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;documents&#45;2"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; if there are no ancestor <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> elements&#46;

As a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element or an <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; if there are no ancestor <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

When <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript)&#44; in a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#58; in any order&#44; zero or more <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> elements&#44; zero or more <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code> elements&#44; and zero or more <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> elements&#46;

When <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;2"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript)&#44; not in a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#58; <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;transparent"></a>[transparent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#transparent)&#44; but there must be no <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element descendants&#46;

Otherwise&#58; text that conforms to the requirements given in the prose&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-noscript)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-noscript)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

Uses <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><code>[HTMLElement](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlelement)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its children if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;3"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript)&#46; It is used to present different markup to user agents that support scripting and those that don&#39;t support scripting&#44; by affecting how the document is parsed&#46;

When used in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;documents&#45;3"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; the allowed content model is as follows&#58;

<strong>In a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#44; if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;4"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element must contain only <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>In a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#44; if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element must contain only text&#44; except that invoking the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[HTML fragment parsing algorithm](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm) with the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element as the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context"></a><var>[context](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#concept-frag-parse-context)</var> element and the text contents as the <var>input</var> must result in a list of nodes that consists only of <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> elements that would be conforming if they were children of the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#44; and no <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse errors](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#parse-errors)&#46;

<strong>Outside of <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> elements&#44; if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;5"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#39;s content model is <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;transparent&#45;2"></a>[transparent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#transparent)&#44; with the additional restriction that a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element must not have a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element as an ancestor &#40;that is&#44; <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> can&#39;t be nested&#41;&#46;

<strong>Outside of <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> elements&#44; if <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element must contain only text&#44; except that the text must be such that running the following algorithm results in a conforming document with no <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> elements and no <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> elements&#44; and such that no step in the algorithm throws an exception or causes an <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) to flag a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#parse-errors)&#58;

1.  Remove every <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](#the-script-element)</code> element from the document&#46;
2.  Make a list of every <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element in the document&#46; For every <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element in that list&#44; perform the following steps&#58;
    1.  Let <var>s</var> be the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) of the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#46;
    2.  Set the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;outerhtml"></a><code>[outerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-outerhtml)</code> attribute of the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element to the value of <var>s</var>&#46; &#40;This&#44; as a side&#45;effect&#44; causes the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element to be removed from the document&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

All these contortions are required because&#44; for historical reasons&#44; the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element is handled differently by the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) based on whether <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[scripting mode](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#scripting-mode) was <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a>[Disabled](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#scripting-mode-disabled) when the parser was invoked&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element must not be used in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;documents"></a>[XML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element is only effective in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;syntax"></a>[the HTML syntax](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax)&#44; it has no effect in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;xhtml&#45;syntax"></a>[the XML syntax](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#the-xhtml-syntax)&#46; This is because the way it works is by essentially &#34;turning off&#34; the parser when scripts are enabled&#44; so that the contents of the element are treated as pure text and not as real elements&#46; XML does not define a mechanism by which to do this&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element has no other requirements&#46; In particular&#44; children of the <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element are not exempt from <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>[form submission](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-submission-2)&#44; scripting&#44; and so forth&#44; even when <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script&#45;4"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the element&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; a <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element is used to provide fallback for a script&#46;

``` text
<form action="calcSquare.php">
 <p>
  <label for=x>Number</label>:
  <input id="x" name="x" type="number">
 </p>
 <script>
  var x = document.getElementById('x');
  var output = document.createElement('p');
  output.textContent = 'Type a number; it will be squared right then!';
  x.form.appendChild(output);
  x.form.onsubmit = function () { return false; }
  x.oninput = function () {
    var v = x.valueAsNumber;
    output.textContent = v + ' squared is ' + v * v;
  };
 </script>
 <noscript>
  <input type=submit value="Calculate Square">
 </noscript>
</form>
```

When script is disabled&#44; a button appears to do the calculation on the server side&#46; When script is enabled&#44; the value is computed on&#45;the&#45;fly instead&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> element is a blunt instrument&#46; Sometimes&#44; scripts might be enabled&#44; but for some reason the page&#39;s script might fail&#46; For this reason&#44; it&#39;s generally better to avoid using <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code>&#44; and to instead design the script to change the page from being a scriptless page to a scripted page on the fly&#44; as in the next example&#58;

``` text
<form action="calcSquare.php">
 <p>
  <label for=x>Number</label>:
  <input id="x" name="x" type="number">
 </p>
 <input id="submit" type=submit value="Calculate Square">
 <script>
  var x = document.getElementById('x');
  var output = document.createElement('p');
  output.textContent = 'Type a number; it will be squared right then!';
  x.form.appendChild(output);
  x.form.onsubmit = function () { return false; }
  x.oninput = function () {
    var v = x.valueAsNumber;
    output.textContent = v + ' squared is ' + v * v;
  };
  var submit = document.getElementById('submit');
  submit.parentNode.removeChild(submit);
 </script>
</form>
```

The above technique is also useful in <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;documents&#45;2"></a>[XML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document)&#44; since <a id="the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[noscript](#the-noscript-element)</code> is not allowed there&#46;

<a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment"></a><code>[shadowrootslotassignment](#attr-template-shadowrootslotassignment)</code> — Sets <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;slot&#45;assignment"></a>[slot assignment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-slot-assignment) on a declarative shadow root

<a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmltemplateelement"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;template&#45;content"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;template&#45;htmlfor"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootdelegatesfocus"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootserializable"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootclonable"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;7"></a><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;5"></a><a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootcustomelementregistry"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTemplateElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  readonly attribute DocumentFragment content;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="for"] attribute DOMString htmlFor;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString shadowRootMode;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean shadowRootDelegatesFocus;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean shadowRootSerializable;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString shadowRootSlotAssignment;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean shadowRootClonable;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString shadowRootCustomElementRegistry;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element is used to declare fragments of HTML that can be cloned and inserted in the document by script&#46;

In a rendering&#44; the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;for"></a><strong><code>for</code></strong> content attribute identifies the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;processinginstruction"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code> that marks the location at which to insert content &#40;<code>&#60;&#63;marker&#62;</code>&#41; or the start of the range to replace &#40;<code>&#60;&#63;start&#62;</code>&#41;&#46; If the attribute is specified&#44; the attribute&#39;s value must equal the value of the <code>name</code> attribute of a <code>&#60;&#63;marker&#62;</code> or <code>&#60;&#63;start&#62;</code> <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;processinginstruction&#45;2"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code> in the same <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) as the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode"></a><strong><code>shadowrootmode</code></strong> content attribute is an <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="template/shadowrootmode" id="attr-shadowrootmode-open" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>open</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-shadowrootmode-open-state">Open</dfn>      </td><td>The template element represents an open declarative shadow root&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="template/shadowrootmode" id="attr-shadowrootmode-closed" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>closed</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-shadowrootmode-closed-state">Closed</dfn>      </td><td>The template element represents a closed declarative shadow root&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowrootmode](#attr-template-shadowrootmode)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;none&#45;state"></a><strong>None</strong> state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootdelegatesfocus"></a><strong><code>shadowrootdelegatesfocus</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootserializable"></a><strong><code>shadowrootserializable</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment"></a><strong><code>shadowrootslotassignment</code></strong> content attribute is an <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="template/shadowrootslotassignment" id="attr-shadowrootslotassignment-named" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>named</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-shadowrootslotassignment-named-state">Named</dfn>      </td><td>The declarative shadow root uses named slot assignment&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="template/shadowrootslotassignment" id="attr-shadowrootslotassignment-manual" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>manual</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-shadowrootslotassignment-manual-state">Manual</dfn>      </td><td>The declarative shadow root uses manual slot assignment&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowrootslotassignment](#attr-template-shadowrootslotassignment)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;shadowrootslotassignment&#45;named&#45;state"></a>[Named](#attr-shadowrootslotassignment-named-state) state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootclonable"></a><strong><code>shadowrootclonable</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootcustomelementregistry"></a><strong><code>shadowrootcustomelementregistry</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) of a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element [are not children of the element itself](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#template-syntax)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is also possible&#44; as a result of DOM manipulation&#44; for a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element to contain <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes and element nodes&#59; however&#44; having any is a violation of the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s content model&#44; since its content model is defined as <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;content&#45;nothing&#45;2"></a>[nothing](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-content-nothing)&#46;

<a id="template&#45;example"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#template-example)

For example&#44; consider the following document&#58;

``` text
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Homework</title>
 <body>
  <template id="template"><p>Smile!</p></template>
  <script>
   let num = 3;
   const fragment = document.getElementById('template').content.cloneNode(true);
   while (num-- > 1) {
     fragment.firstChild.before(fragment.firstChild.cloneNode(true));
     fragment.firstChild.textContent += fragment.lastChild.textContent;
   }
   document.body.appendChild(fragment);
  </script>
</html>
```

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> is <em>not</em> a child of the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> in the DOM&#59; it is a child of the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;2"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> returned by the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;template&#45;content&#45;2"></a><code>[content](#dom-template-content)</code> IDL attribute&#46;

If the script were to call <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;node&#45;appendchild"></a><code>[appendChild&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-appendchild)</code> on the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; that would add a child to the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element &#40;as for any other element&#41;&#59; however&#44; doing so is a violation of the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s content model&#46;

<strong><code><var>template</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;template&#45;content&#45;dev"></a>[content](#dom-template-content)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLTemplateElement&#47;content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLTemplateElement/content)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox22&#43;Safari8&#43;Chrome26&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;13&#43;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Returns the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) &#40;a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;3"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code>&#41;&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element has an associated <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;4"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> object that is its <a id="template&#45;contents"></a><strong>template contents</strong>&#46; The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;3"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) have [no conformance requirements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#no-browsing-context)&#46; When a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element is created&#44; the user agent must run the following steps to establish the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;4"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;appropriate&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;owner&#45;document"></a>[appropriate template contents owner document](#appropriate-template-contents-owner-document)&#46;

2.  Create a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;5"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> object whose <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <var>document</var> and <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;documentfragment&#45;host"></a>[host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host) is the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;5"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) to the newly created <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;6"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> object&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="appropriate&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;owner&#45;document"></a><strong>appropriate template contents owner document</strong> is the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> returned by the following algorithm&#58;

1.  If <var>document</var> is not a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> created by this algorithm&#58;

    1.  If <var>document</var> does not yet have an <a id="associated&#45;inert&#45;template&#45;document"></a><strong>associated inert template document</strong>&#58;

        1.  Let <var>newDocument</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[creating a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-document) that implements <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; given <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;realm"></a>[relevant realm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-realm)&#59; its <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is null&#46; This is &#34;a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> created by this algorithm&#34; for the purposes of the step above&#46;

        2.  If <var>document</var> is an <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; then mark <var>newDocument</var> as an <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;html&#45;documents&#45;2"></a>[HTML document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document) also&#46;

        3.  Set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;associated&#45;inert&#45;template&#45;document"></a>[associated inert template document](#associated-inert-template-document) to <var>newDocument</var>&#46;

    2.  Set <var>document</var> to <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;associated&#45;inert&#45;template&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[associated inert template document](#associated-inert-template-document)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Each <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> not created by this algorithm thus gets a single <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> to act as its proxy for owning the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;6"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) of all its <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements&#44; so that they aren&#39;t in a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;browsing&#45;context"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#browsing-context) and thus remain inert &#40;e&#46;g&#46; scripts do not run&#41;&#46; Meanwhile&#44; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements inside <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> objects that <em>are</em> created by this algorithm just reuse the same <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> owner for their contents&#46;

2.  Return <var>document</var>&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element has an associated <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#45;or&#45;<a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;7"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <a id="insertion&#45;target"></a><strong>insertion target</strong>&#44; which is initially null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element has an associated <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;processinginstruction&#45;3"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <a id="insertion&#45;start&#45;marker"></a><strong>insertion start marker</strong> and <a id="insertion&#45;end&#45;marker"></a><strong>insertion end marker</strong>&#44; which are initially null&#46;

<a id="template&#45;adopting&#45;steps"></a>The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;adopt&#45;ext"></a>[adopting steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-adopt-ext) &#40;with <var>node</var> and <var>oldDocument</var> as parameters&#41; for <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements are the following&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;appropriate&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;owner&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[appropriate template contents owner document](#appropriate-template-contents-owner-document)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object that <var>node</var> was just adopted <em>into</em>&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;adopt"></a>[Adopt](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-adopt) <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;7"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) &#40;a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;8"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> object&#41; into <var>document</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;template&#45;content"></a><strong><code>content</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;8"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) is not a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;shadowroot"></a><code>[ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot)</code> node&#46;

2.  Return <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;9"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode"></a><strong><code>shadowRootMode</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;3"></a><code>[shadowrootmode](#attr-template-shadowrootmode)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment"></a><strong><code>shadowRootSlotAssignment</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;reflect&#45;2"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment&#45;3"></a><code>[shadowrootslotassignment](#attr-template-shadowrootslotassignment)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;template&#45;shadowrootcustomelementregistry"></a>[shadowRootCustomElementRegistry](#dom-template-shadowrootcustomelementregistry) IDL attribute intentionally does not have a boolean type so it can be extended&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;ext"></a>[cloning steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone-ext) for <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements given <var>node</var>&#44; <var>copy</var>&#44; and <var>subtree</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>subtree</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

2.  For each <var>child</var> of <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;10"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone"></a>[clone a node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone) given <var>child</var> with <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;document"></a>[<em>document</em>](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#clone-a-node-document) set to <var>copy</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;11"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;subtree"></a>[<em>subtree</em>](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#clone-a-node-subtree) set to true&#44; and <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;parent"></a>[<em>parent</em>](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#clone-a-node-parent) set to <var>copy</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;12"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#46;

To <a id="prepare&#45;content&#45;patching"></a><strong>prepare content patching</strong> given an <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;documentfragment&#45;9"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> <var>scope</var> and a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element <var>template</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;3"></a><code>[for](#attr-template-for)</code> attribute is specified&#46;

2.  Let <var>markerName</var> be <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;4"></a><code>[for](#attr-template-for)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#46;

3.  If <var>markerName</var> is the empty string&#44; then return false&#46;

4.  Let &#40;<var>start</var>&#44; <var>end</var>&#41; be the result of <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;find&#45;markers"></a>[find markers](#find-markers) given <var>scope</var> and <var>markerName</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>start</var> is null&#44; then return false&#46;

6.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;insertion&#45;target"></a>[insertion target](#insertion-target) to <var>start</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent)&#46;

7.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;insertion&#45;start&#45;marker"></a>[insertion start marker](#insertion-start-marker) to <var>start</var>&#46;

8.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;insertion&#45;end&#45;marker"></a>[insertion end marker](#insertion-end-marker) to <var>end</var>&#46;

9.  If <var>start</var> is <var>end</var>&#44; then return true&#46;

10. Let <var>removedNodes</var> be an empty <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

11. Let <var>currentNode</var> be <var>start</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;next&#45;sibling"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

12. While <var>currentNode</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  If <var>currentNode</var> is <var>end</var>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;break"></a>[break](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break)&#46;

    2.  Append <var>currentNode</var> to <var>removedNodes</var>&#46;

    3.  Set <var>currentNode</var> to <var>currentNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;next&#45;sibling&#45;2"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

13. For each <var>node</var> of <var>removedNodes</var>&#58;

    1.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;parent&#45;2"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is not null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) <var>node</var>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The parent might have changed because removing a node can fire events like the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;event&#45;pagehide"></a><code>[pagehide](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-pagehide)</code> event&#44; and an event handler can mutate the DOM&#46; The parent identity is not checked&#59; as long as the node still has a parent&#44; it is removed&#46;

14. Return true&#46;

To <a id="find&#45;markers"></a><strong>find markers</strong> given a node <var>scope</var> and a string <var>name</var>&#58;

1.  For each <var>descendant</var> of <var>scope</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;descendant"></a>[descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>descendant</var> is not a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;processinginstruction&#45;4"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code> node&#44; then <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  If the result of <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;get&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;attribute"></a>[getting a processing instruction attribute](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#get-a-processing-instruction-attribute) given <var>descendant</var> and &#34;<code>name</code>&#34; is not <var>name</var>&#44; then <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;continue&#45;2"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    3.  If <var>descendant</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;pi&#45;target"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-pi-target) is &#34;<code>marker</code>&#34;&#44; then return &#40;<var>descendant</var>&#44; <var>descendant</var>&#41;&#46;

    4.  If <var>descendant</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;pi&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-pi-target) is &#34;<code>start</code>&#34;&#58;

        1.  Let <var>start</var> be <var>descendant</var>&#46;

        2.  Let <var>nestingLevel</var> be 0&#46;

        3.  Let <var>sibling</var> be <var>start</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;next&#45;sibling&#45;3"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

        4.  While <var>sibling</var> is not null&#58;

            1.  If <var>sibling</var> is a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;processinginstruction&#45;5"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code> node&#58;

                1.  If <var>sibling</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;pi&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-pi-target) is &#34;<code>start</code>&#34;&#44; then increment <var>nestingLevel</var> by one&#46;

                2.  If <var>sibling</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;pi&#45;target&#45;4"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-pi-target) is &#34;<code>end</code>&#34;&#58;

                    1.  If <var>nestingLevel</var> is 0&#44; then return &#40;<var>start</var>&#44; <var>sibling</var>&#41;&#46;

                    2.  Decrement <var>nestingLevel</var> by one&#46;

            2.  Set <var>sibling</var> to <var>sibling</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;next&#45;sibling&#45;4"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

        5.  Return &#40;<var>start</var>&#44; null&#41;&#46;

            <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

            No matching <code>&#60;&#63;end&#62;</code> was found&#44; which is interpreted as a range from <var>start</var> to the end of its parent&#46;

2.  Return &#40;null&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a script populates a table four&#45;column with data from a data structure&#44; using a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> to provide the element structure instead of manually generating the structure from markup&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang='en'>
<title>Cat data</title>
<script>
 // Data is hard-coded here, but could come from the server
 var data = [
   { name: 'Pillar', color: 'Ticked Tabby', sex: 'Female (neutered)', legs: 3 },
   { name: 'Hedral', color: 'Tuxedo', sex: 'Male (neutered)', legs: 4 },
 ];
</script>
<table>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th>Name <th>Color <th>Sex <th>Legs
 <tbody>
  <template id="row">
   <tr><td><td><td><td>
  </template>
</table>
<script>
 var template = document.querySelector('#row');
 for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 1) {
   var cat = data[i];
   var clone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
   var cells = clone.querySelectorAll('td');
   cells[0].textContent = cat.name;
   cells[1].textContent = cat.color;
   cells[2].textContent = cat.sex;
   cells[3].textContent = cat.legs;
   template.parentNode.appendChild(clone);
 }
</script>
```

This example uses <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;node&#45;clonenode"></a><code>[cloneNode&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-clonenode)</code> on the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code>&#39;s contents&#59; it could equivalently have used <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;importnode"></a><code>[document&#46;importNode&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-importnode)</code>&#44; which does the same thing&#46; The only difference between these two APIs is when the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is updated&#58; with <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;node&#45;clonenode&#45;2"></a><code>[cloneNode&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-clonenode)</code> it is updated when the nodes are appended with <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;node&#45;appendchild&#45;2"></a><code>[appendChild&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-appendchild)</code>&#44; with <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;importnode&#45;2"></a><code>[document&#46;importNode&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-importnode)</code> it is updated when the nodes are cloned&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;5"></a><code>[for](#attr-template-for)</code> attribute is used to populate a list of countries in a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; after the main content of the page has been delivered&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Out-of-order countries</title>
  <style>
   #countries:empty {
    opacity: 0;
   }
  </style>
 </head>
 <body>
  <select id=countries><?marker name="country-options"?></select>
  ...
  <template for="country-options"><option>Antigua</option>...</template>
 </body>
</html>
```

The <code>&#60;&#63;marker&#63;&#62;</code> processing instruction is replaced with the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements from the later <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#46; The <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element is transparent until it is populated&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;6"></a><code>[for](#attr-template-for)</code> attribute is used to stream a document out&#45;of&#45;order&#44; sending fast static content first and recommendations computed asynchronously as they become available on the server&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Async recommendation engine</title>
  <style>
   aside {
    /* position the aside where it can grow without causing layout shift or obscuring other content */
   }
   aside:has(.placeholder) {
    /* style the placeholder content */
   }
  </style>
 </head>
 <body>
  <h1>How to train your cat</h1>
  <p>Set realistic goals and don't expect your cat to make a perfect cup of tea
  on the first try.</p>
  <aside>
    <p>Recommended reading:</p>
    <?start name="recommended">
    <ul class="placeholder">
      <li>...</li>
      <li>...</li>
      <li>...</li>
    </ul>
    <?end>
  </aside>
  <p>...</p>
  <p>Now sit back and enjoy your tea with your cat.</p>

  <!-- The server has a potentially long delay at this point. -->

  <template for="recommended">
    <ul>
      <li>Cat or butler, which is right for you?</li>
      <li>Rewarding good cat behavior</li>
      <li>Kettles considered harmful</li>
    </ul>
  </template>
 </body>
</html>
```

The content between <code>&#60;&#63;start name&#61;&#34;recommended&#34;&#62;</code> and <code>&#60;&#63;end&#62;</code> is replaced with the <a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> contents&#46; Since the new content does not use <code>class&#61;&#34;placeholder&#34;</code>&#44; the placeholder styling no longer applies&#46;

##### <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath"></a>4&#46;12&#46;3&#46;1 Interaction of <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements with XSLT and XPath[](#template-XSLT-XPath)

Avoid using client&#45;side XSLT in browsers&#46; The browser implementations of XSLT are highly susceptible to memory safety vulnerabilities&#44; and the web platform has evolved toward JavaScript as the safe replacement&#46; For these reasons&#44; this feature is in the process of being removed from the web platform&#46; &#40;This is a long process that takes many years&#46;&#41;

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

This specification does not define how XSLT and XPath interact with the <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element&#46; However&#44; in the absence of another specification actually defining this&#44; here are some guidelines for implementers&#44; which are intended to be consistent with other processing described in this specification&#58;

- An XSLT processor based on an XML parser that acts <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[as described in this specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser) needs to act as if <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> elements contain as descendants their <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](#template-contents) for the purposes of the transform&#46;

- An XSLT processor that outputs a DOM needs to ensure that nodes that would go into a <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[template](#the-template-element)</code> element are instead placed into the element&#39;s <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#46;

- XPath evaluation using the XPath DOM API when applied to a <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> parsed using the <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or the <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser) described in this specification needs to ignore <a id="template&#45;XSLT&#45;XPath&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;3"></a>[template contents](#template-contents)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlslotelement"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;slot&#45;name"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assignednodes"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assignednodesoptions"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assignedelements"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assignednodesoptions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assign"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;element"></a><a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;text"></a><a id="assignednodesoptions"></a><a id="dom&#45;assignednodesoptions&#45;flatten"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLSlotElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  sequence<Node> assignedNodes(optional AssignedNodesOptions options = {});
  sequence<Element> assignedElements(optional AssignedNodesOptions options = {});
  undefined assign((Element or Text)... nodes);
};

dictionary AssignedNodesOptions {
  boolean flatten = false;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element"></a><code>[slot](#the-slot-element)</code> element defines a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;slot"></a>[slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slot)&#46; It is typically used in a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree)&#46; A <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[slot](#the-slot-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assigned&#45;nodes"></a>[assigned nodes](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slot-assigned-nodes)&#44; if any&#44; and its contents otherwise&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;slot&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> content attribute may contain any string value&#46; It represents a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;slot&#45;2"></a>[slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slot)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;slot&#45;name"></a>[name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slot-name)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-slot-name)</code> attribute is used to <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assign&#45;a&#45;slot"></a>[assign slots](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#assign-a-slot) to other elements&#58; a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[slot](#the-slot-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-slot-name)</code> attribute creates a named <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;slot&#45;3"></a>[slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slot) to which any element is <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assign&#45;a&#45;slot&#45;2"></a>[assigned](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#assign-a-slot) if that element has a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;slot"></a><code>[slot](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-slot)</code> attribute whose value matches that <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](#attr-slot-name)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[slot](#the-slot-element)</code> element is a child of the <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree&#45;2"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree) whose <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;root"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;documentfragment&#45;host"></a>[host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host) has that corresponding <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;2"></a><code>[slot](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-slot)</code> attribute value&#46;

<strong><code><var>slot</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;slot&#45;name&#45;dev"></a>[name](#dom-slot-name)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

Support in all current engines&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>slot</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assignedelements&#45;2"></a>[assignedElements](#dom-slot-assignedelements)&#40;&#123; flatten&#58; true &#125;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns the same as <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assignednodes&#45;3"></a><code>[assignedNodes&#40;&#123; flatten&#58; true &#125;&#41;](#dom-slot-assignednodes)</code>&#44; limited to elements&#46;

<strong><code><var>slot</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assign&#45;2"></a>[assign](#dom-slot-assign)&#40;&#46;&#46;&#46;<var>nodes</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Sets <var>slot</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes"></a>[manually assigned nodes](#manually-assigned-nodes) to the given <var>nodes</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[slot](#the-slot-element)</code> element has <a id="manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes"></a><strong>manually assigned nodes</strong>&#44; which is an <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;set"></a>[ordered set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;slottable"></a>[slottables](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slotable) set by <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;slot&#45;assign&#45;3"></a><code>[assign&#40;&#41;](#dom-slot-assign)</code>&#46; This set is initially empty&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;2"></a>[manually assigned nodes](#manually-assigned-nodes) set can be implemented using weak references to the <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;slottable&#45;2"></a>[slottables](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slotable)&#44; because this set is not directly accessible from script&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;slot&#45;assignednodes"></a><strong><code>assignedNodes&#40;<var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>options</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;assignednodesoptions&#45;flatten"></a><code>[flatten](#dom-assignednodesoptions-flatten)</code>&#34;&#93; is false&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;5"></a>[assigned nodes](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slot-assigned-nodes)&#46;

2.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;finding&#45;flattened&#45;slottables"></a>[finding flattened slottables](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#find-flattened-slotables) with <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;slot&#45;assignedelements"></a><strong><code>assignedElements&#40;<var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>options</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;assignednodesoptions&#45;flatten&#45;2"></a><code>[flatten](#dom-assignednodesoptions-flatten)</code>&#34;&#93; is false&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;6"></a>[assigned nodes](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slot-assigned-nodes)&#44; filtered to contain only <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> nodes&#46;

2.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;finding&#45;flattened&#45;slottables&#45;2"></a>[finding flattened slottables](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#find-flattened-slotables) with <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; filtered to contain only <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;element&#45;3"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> nodes&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;slot&#45;assign"></a><strong><code>assign&#40;&#46;&#46;&#46;<var>nodes</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>node</var> of <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;3"></a>[manually assigned nodes](#manually-assigned-nodes)&#44; set <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manual&#45;slot&#45;assignment"></a>[manual slot assignment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slottable-manual-slot-assignment) to null&#46;

2.  Let <var>nodesSet</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;set&#45;2"></a>[ordered set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set)&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;2"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>node</var> of <var>nodes</var>&#58;

    1.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manual&#45;slot&#45;assignment&#45;2"></a>[manual slot assignment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slottable-manual-slot-assignment) refers to a <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[slot](#the-slot-element)&#44; then remove <var>node</var> from that <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[slot](#the-slot-element)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;4"></a>[manually assigned nodes](#manually-assigned-nodes)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manual&#45;slot&#45;assignment&#45;3"></a>[manual slot assignment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slottable-manual-slot-assignment) to <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

    3.  <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;set&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append) <var>node</var> to <var>nodesSet</var>&#46;

4.  Set <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;manually&#45;assigned&#45;nodes&#45;5"></a>[manually assigned nodes](#manually-assigned-nodes) to <var>nodesSet</var>&#46;

5.  Run <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;assign&#45;slottables&#45;for&#45;a&#45;tree"></a>[assign slottables for a tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) for <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;slot&#45;element&#58;root&#45;2"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#46;
