``` text
typedef (CanvasRenderingContext2D or ImageBitmapRenderingContext or WebGLRenderingContext or WebGL2RenderingContext or GPUCanvasContext) RenderingContext;

[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLCanvasElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions] attribute unsigned long width;
  [CEReactions] attribute unsigned long height;

  RenderingContext? getContext(DOMString contextId, optional any options = null);

  USVString toDataURL(optional DOMString type = "image/png", optional any quality);
  undefined toBlob(BlobCallback _callback, optional DOMString type = "image/png", optional any quality);
  OffscreenCanvas transferControlToOffscreen();
};

callback BlobCallback = undefined (Blob? blob);
```

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element provides scripts with a resolution&#45;dependent bitmap canvas&#44; which can be used for rendering graphs&#44; game graphics&#44; art&#44; or other visual images on the fly&#46;

Authors should not use the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element in a document when a more suitable element is available&#46; For example&#44; it is inappropriate to use a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to render a page heading&#58; if the desired presentation of the heading is graphically intense&#44; it should be marked up using appropriate elements &#40;typically <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements"></a><code>[h1](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#41; and then styled using CSS and supporting technologies such as <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow trees](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree)&#46;

When authors use the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; they must also provide content that&#44; when presented to the user&#44; conveys essentially the same function or purpose as the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code>&#39;s bitmap&#46; This content may be placed as content of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46; The contents of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; if any&#44; are the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

In interactive visual media&#44; if <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; and if support for <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements has been enabled&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;3"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) consisting of a dynamically created image&#44; the element&#39;s bitmap&#46;

In non&#45;interactive&#44; static&#44; visual media&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has been previously associated with a rendering context &#40;e&#46;g&#46; if the page was viewed in an interactive visual medium and is now being printed&#44; or if some script that ran during the page layout process painted on the element&#41;&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;4"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) with the element&#39;s current bitmap and size&#46; Otherwise&#44; the element represents its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content) instead&#46;

In non&#45;visual media&#44; and in visual media if <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element or if support for <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements has been disabled&#44; the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content) instead&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;4"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;5"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category)&#44; the user can still focus descendants of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element &#40;in the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;4"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#41;&#46; When an element is <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused)&#44; it is the target of keyboard interaction events &#40;even though the element itself is not visible&#41;&#46; This allows authors to make an interactive canvas keyboard&#45;accessible&#58; authors should have a one&#45;to&#45;one mapping of interactive regions to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;focusable&#45;area"></a><em>[focusable areas](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusable-area)</em> in the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;5"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#46; &#40;Focus has no effect on mouse interaction events&#46;&#41; [&#91;UIEVENTS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsUIEVENTS)

An element whose nearest <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element ancestor is <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) and <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;5"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;6"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) is an element that is <a id="being&#45;used&#45;as&#45;relevant&#45;canvas&#45;fallback&#45;content"></a><strong>being used as relevant canvas fallback content</strong>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has two attributes to control the size of the element&#39;s bitmap&#58; <a id="attr&#45;canvas&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;canvas&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong>&#46; These attributes&#44; when specified&#44; must have values that are <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) must be used to <a id="obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values"></a><strong>obtain their numeric values</strong>&#46; If an attribute is missing&#44; or if parsing its value returns an error&#44; then the default value must be used instead&#46; The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> attribute defaults to 300&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> attribute defaults to 150&#46;

When setting the value of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;3"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> or <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;3"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> attribute&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode"></a>[context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element is set to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;placeholder"></a>[placeholder](#concept-canvas-placeholder)&#44; the user agent must throw an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> and leave the attribute&#39;s value unchanged&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural dimensions](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions) of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element when it <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;6"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;7"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) are equal to the dimensions of the element&#39;s bitmap&#46;

The user agent must use a square pixel density consisting of one pixel of image data per coordinate space unit for the bitmaps of a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> and its rendering contexts&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element can be sized arbitrarily by a style sheet&#44; its bitmap is then subject to the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;&#39;object&#45;fit&#39;"></a>[&#39;object&#45;fit&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#the-object-fit) CSS property&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The bitmaps of <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements&#44; the bitmaps of <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;imagebitmap"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> objects&#44; as well as some of the bitmaps of rendering contexts&#44; such as those described in the sections on the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> objects below&#44; have an <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a><strong>origin&#45;clean</strong> flag&#44; which can be set to true or false&#46; Initially&#44; when the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element or <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;imagebitmap&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> object is created&#44; its bitmap&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag must be set to true&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element can have a rendering context bound to it&#46; Initially&#44; it does not have a bound rendering context&#46; To keep track of whether it has a rendering context or not&#44; and what kind of rendering context it is&#44; a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> also has a <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode"></a><strong>canvas context mode</strong>&#44; which is initially <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;none"></a><strong>none</strong> but can be changed to either <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;placeholder"></a><strong>placeholder</strong>&#44; <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;2d"></a><strong>2d</strong>&#44; <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;bitmaprenderer"></a><strong>bitmaprenderer</strong>&#44; <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;webgl"></a><strong>webgl</strong>&#44; <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;webgl2"></a><strong>webgl2</strong>&#44; or <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;webgpu"></a><strong>webgpu</strong> by algorithms defined in this specification&#46;

When its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[canvas context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) is <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;none"></a>[none](#concept-canvas-none)&#44; a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has no rendering context&#44; and its bitmap must be <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) with a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) equal to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;4"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> attribute and a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) equal to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;4"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> attribute&#44; those values being interpreted in <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#44; and being updated as the attributes are set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#46;

When its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[canvas context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) is <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;placeholder&#45;2"></a>[placeholder](#concept-canvas-placeholder)&#44; a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has no rendering context&#46; It serves as a placeholder for an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#44; and the content of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element is updated by the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s rendering context&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element represents <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;8"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category)&#44; it provides a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;paint&#45;source"></a>[paint source](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images-4/#paint-source) whose width is the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;width&#45;2"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width)&#44; whose height is the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;height&#45;2"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height)&#44; and whose appearance is the element&#39;s bitmap&#46;

Whenever the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;5"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;5"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attributes are set&#44; removed&#44; changed&#44; or redundantly set to the value they already have&#44; then the user agent must perform the action from the row of the following table that corresponds to the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode)&#46;

<table><thead><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-context-mode" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-context-mode-5">Context Mode</a></p>      </th><th>       <p>Action</p>     </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-2d" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-2d">2d</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>Follow the steps to <a href="#concept-canvas-set-bitmap-dimensions" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-set-bitmap-dimensions">set bitmap       dimensions</a> to <a href="#obtain-numeric-values" id="the-canvas-element:obtain-numeric-values-3">the numeric values</a>       of the <code id="the-canvas-element:attr-canvas-width-6"><a href="#attr-canvas-width">width</a></code> and <code id="the-canvas-element:attr-canvas-height-6"><a href="#attr-canvas-height">height</a></code> content attributes&#46;</p>      </td></tr><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-webgl" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-webgl">webgl</a> or <a href="#concept-canvas-webgl2" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-webgl2">webgl2</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>Follow the behavior defined in the WebGL specifications&#46; <a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL">&#91;WEBGL&#93;</a></p>      </td></tr><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-webgpu" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-webgpu">webgpu</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>Follow the behavior defined in <cite>WebGPU</cite>&#46; <a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGPU">&#91;WEBGPU&#93;</a></p>      </td></tr><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-bitmaprenderer" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-bitmaprenderer">bitmaprenderer</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>If the context&#39;s <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode" id="the-canvas-element:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode">bitmap       mode</a> is set to <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank" id="the-canvas-element:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank">blank</a>&#44;       run the steps to <a href="#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap" id="the-canvas-element:set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap">set an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>&#39;s output bitmap</a>&#44;       passing the <code id="the-canvas-element:the-canvas-element-33"><a href="#the-canvas-element">canvas</a></code> element&#39;s rendering context&#46;</p>      </td></tr><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-placeholder" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-placeholder-3">placeholder</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>Do nothing&#46;</p>      </td></tr><tr><th>       <p><a href="#concept-canvas-none" id="the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-none-2">none</a></p>      </th><td>       <p>Do nothing&#46;</p>   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong> IDL attributes must <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the respective content attributes of the same name&#44; with the same defaults&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>context</var> &#61; <var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;getcontext&#45;dev"></a>[getContext](#dom-canvas-getcontext)&#40;<var>contextId</var> &#91;&#44; <var>options</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLCanvasElement&#47;getContext](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLCanvasElement/getContext)

Support in all current engines&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera9&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns an object that exposes an API for drawing on the canvas&#46; <var>contextId</var> specifies the desired API&#58; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;2d"></a><code>[2d](#canvas-context-2d)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;bitmaprenderer"></a><code>[bitmaprenderer](#canvas-context-bitmaprenderer)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgl"></a><code>[webgl](#canvas-context-webgl)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgl2"></a><code>[webgl2](#canvas-context-webgl2)</code>&#34;&#44; or &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgpu"></a><code>[webgpu](#canvas-context-webgpu)</code>&#34;&#46; <var>options</var> is handled by that API&#46;

This specification defines the &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;2"></a><code>[2d](#canvas-context-2d)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;bitmaprenderer&#45;2"></a><code>[bitmaprenderer](#canvas-context-bitmaprenderer)</code>&#34; contexts below&#46; The WebGL specifications define the &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgl&#45;2"></a><code>[webgl](#canvas-context-webgl)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgl2&#45;2"></a><code>[webgl2](#canvas-context-webgl2)</code>&#34; contexts&#46; WebGPU defines the &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgpu&#45;2"></a><code>[webgpu](#canvas-context-webgpu)</code>&#34; context&#46; [&#91;WEBGL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL) [&#91;WEBGPU&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGPU)

Returns null if <var>contextId</var> is not supported&#44; or if the canvas has already been initialized with another context type &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; trying to get a &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;3"></a><code>[2d](#canvas-context-2d)</code>&#34; context after getting a &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;webgl&#45;3"></a><code>[webgl](#canvas-context-webgl)</code>&#34; context&#41;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;getcontext"></a><strong><code>getContext&#40;<var>contextId</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>options</var> is not an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;idl&#45;object"></a>[object](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-object)&#44; then set <var>options</var> to null&#46;

2.  Set <var>options</var> to the result of <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>options</var> to a JavaScript value&#46;

3.  Run the steps in the cell of the following table whose column header matches this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;35"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[canvas context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) and whose row header matches <var>contextId</var>&#58;

<strong><code><var>url</var> &#61; <var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl&#45;dev"></a>[toDataURL](#dom-canvas-todataurl)&#40;&#91; <var>type</var> &#91;&#44; <var>quality</var> &#93; &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLCanvasElement&#47;toDataURL](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLCanvasElement/toDataURL)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox2&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome2&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera9&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;data&#45;protocol"></a>[<code>data&#58;</code> URL](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2397#section-2) for the image in the canvas&#46;

The first argument&#44; if provided&#44; controls the type of the image to be returned &#40;e&#46;g&#46; PNG or JPEG&#41;&#46; The default is &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;image&#47;png"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#59; that type is also used if the given type isn&#39;t supported&#46; The second argument applies if the type is an image format that supports variable quality &#40;such as &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;image&#47;jpeg"></a><code>[image&#47;jpeg](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/jpeg)</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; and is a number in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0 inclusive indicating the desired quality level for the resulting image&#46;

When trying to use types other than &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;image&#47;png&#45;2"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#44; authors can check if the image was really returned in the requested format by checking to see if the returned string starts with one of the exact strings &#34;<code>data&#58;image&#47;png&#44;</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>data&#58;image&#47;png&#59;</code>&#34;&#46; If it does&#44; the image is PNG&#44; and thus the requested type was not supported&#46; &#40;The one exception to this is if the canvas has either no height or no width&#44; in which case the result might simply be &#34;<code>data&#58;&#44;</code>&#34;&#46;&#41;

<strong><code><var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob&#45;dev"></a>[toBlob](#dom-canvas-toblob)&#40;<var>callback</var> &#91;&#44; <var>type</var> &#91;&#44; quality &#93; &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLCanvasElement&#47;toBlob](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLCanvasElement/toBlob)

Creates a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;blob&#45;2"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object representing a file containing the image in the canvas&#44; and invokes a callback with a handle to that object&#46;

The second argument&#44; if provided&#44; controls the type of the image to be returned &#40;e&#46;g&#46; PNG or JPEG&#41;&#46; The default is &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;image&#47;png&#45;3"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#59; that type is also used if the given type isn&#39;t supported&#46; The third argument applies if the type is an image format that supports variable quality &#40;such as &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;image&#47;jpeg&#45;2"></a><code>[image&#47;jpeg](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/jpeg)</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; and is a number in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0 inclusive indicating the desired quality level for the resulting image&#46;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Returns a newly created <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;4"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object that uses the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;36"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element as a placeholder&#46; Once the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has become a placeholder for an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;5"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#44; its natural size can no longer be changed&#44; and it cannot have a rendering context&#46; The content of the placeholder canvas is updated on the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;6"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;agent"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;agent&#45;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-agent-event-loop)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;update&#45;the&#45;rendering"></a>[update the rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#update-the-rendering) steps&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl"></a><strong><code>toDataURL&#40;<var>type</var>&#44; <var>quality</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is set to false&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap has no pixels &#40;i&#46;e&#46; either its horizontal dimension or its vertical dimension is zero&#41;&#44; then return the string &#34;<code>data&#58;&#44;</code>&#34;&#46; &#40;This is the shortest <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;data&#45;protocol&#45;2"></a>[<code>data&#58;</code> URL](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2397#section-2)&#59; it represents the empty string in a <code>text&#47;plain</code> resource&#46;&#41;

3.  Let <var>file</var> be <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;a&#45;serialisation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#45;as&#45;a&#45;file"></a>[a serialization of this <code>canvas</code> element&#39;s bitmap as a file](#a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file)&#44; passing <var>type</var> and <var>quality</var> if given&#46;

4.  If <var>file</var> is null&#44; then return &#34;<code>data&#58;&#44;</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  Return a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;data&#45;protocol&#45;3"></a>[<code>data&#58;</code> URL](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2397#section-2) representing <var>file</var>&#46; [&#91;RFC2397&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC2397)

The <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob"></a><strong><code>toBlob&#40;<var>callback</var>&#44; <var>type</var>&#44; <var>quality</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;40"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;3"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is set to false&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;securityerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>result</var> be null&#46;

3.  If this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;41"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap has pixels &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; neither its horizontal dimension nor its vertical dimension is zero&#41;&#44; then set <var>result</var> to a copy of this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;42"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap&#46;

4.  Run these steps <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#58;

    1.  If <var>result</var> is non&#45;null&#44; then set <var>result</var> to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;a&#45;serialisation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#45;as&#45;a&#45;file&#45;2"></a>[a serialization of <var>result</var> as a file](#a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file) with <var>type</var> and <var>quality</var> if given&#46;

    2.  <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="canvas&#45;blob&#45;serialisation&#45;task&#45;source"></a><strong>canvas blob serialization task source</strong> given the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;43"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to run these steps&#58;

        1.  If <var>result</var> is non&#45;null&#44; then set <var>result</var> to a new <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;blob&#45;3"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object&#44; created in the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;realm"></a>[relevant realm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-realm) of this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;44"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; representing <var>result</var>&#46; [&#91;FILEAPI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsFILEAPI)

        2.  <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;es&#45;invoking&#45;callback&#45;functions"></a>[Invoke](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function) <var>callback</var> with « <var>result</var> » and &#34;<code>report</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;canvas&#45;transfercontroltooffscreen"></a><strong><code>transferControlToOffscreen&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;45"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;11"></a>[context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) is not set to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;none&#45;4"></a>[none](#concept-canvas-none)&#44; throw an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;7"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;9"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>offscreenCanvas</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;7"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object with its width and height equal to the values of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;7"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;7"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attributes of this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;46"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

3.  Set the <var>offscreenCanvas</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder) to a weak reference to this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;47"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

4.  Set this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;48"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;12"></a>[context mode](#concept-canvas-context-mode) to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;placeholder&#45;5"></a>[placeholder](#concept-canvas-placeholder)&#46;

5.  Set the <var>offscreenCanvas</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang) to the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;language"></a>[language](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#language) of this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;49"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

6.  Set the <var>offscreenCanvas</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction) to the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) of this <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;50"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

7.  Return <var>offscreenCanvas</var>&#46;
