``` text
typedef (HTMLImageElement or
         SVGImageElement) HTMLOrSVGImageElement;

typedef (HTMLOrSVGImageElement or
         HTMLVideoElement or
         HTMLCanvasElement or
         ImageBitmap or
         OffscreenCanvas or
         VideoFrame) CanvasImageSource;

enum CanvasColorType { "unorm8", "float16" };

enum CanvasFillRule { "nonzero", "evenodd" };

dictionary CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings {
  boolean alpha = true;
  boolean desynchronized = false;
  PredefinedColorSpace colorSpace = "srgb";
  CanvasColorType colorType = "unorm8";
  boolean willReadFrequently = false;
};

enum ImageSmoothingQuality { "low", "medium", "high" };

[Exposed=Window]
interface CanvasRenderingContext2D {
  // back-reference to the canvas
  readonly attribute HTMLCanvasElement canvas;
};
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasSettings;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasState;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasTransform;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasCompositing;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasImageSmoothing;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasFillStrokeStyles;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasShadowStyles;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasFilters;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasRect;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasDrawPath;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasUserInterface;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasText;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasDrawImage;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasImageData;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasPathDrawingStyles;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasTextDrawingStyles;
CanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasPath;

interface mixin CanvasSettings {
  // settings
  CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings getContextAttributes();
};

interface mixin CanvasState {
  // state
  undefined save(); // push state on state stack
  undefined restore(); // pop state stack and restore state
  undefined reset(); // reset the rendering context to its default state
  boolean isContextLost(); // return whether context is lost
};

interface mixin CanvasTransform {
  // transformations (default transform is the identity matrix)
  undefined scale(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined rotate(unrestricted double angle);
  undefined translate(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined transform(unrestricted double a, unrestricted double b, unrestricted double c, unrestricted double d, unrestricted double e, unrestricted double f);

  [NewObject] DOMMatrix getTransform();
  undefined setTransform(unrestricted double a, unrestricted double b, unrestricted double c, unrestricted double d, unrestricted double e, unrestricted double f);
  undefined setTransform(optional DOMMatrix2DInit transform = {});
  undefined resetTransform();

};

interface mixin CanvasCompositing {
  // compositing
  attribute unrestricted double globalAlpha; // (default 1.0)
  attribute DOMString globalCompositeOperation; // (default "source-over")
};

interface mixin CanvasImageSmoothing {
  // image smoothing
  attribute boolean imageSmoothingEnabled; // (default true)
  attribute ImageSmoothingQuality imageSmoothingQuality; // (default low)

};

interface mixin CanvasFillStrokeStyles {
  // colors and styles (see also the CanvasPathDrawingStyles and CanvasTextDrawingStyles interfaces)
  attribute (DOMString or CanvasGradient or CanvasPattern) strokeStyle; // (default black)
  attribute (DOMString or CanvasGradient or CanvasPattern) fillStyle; // (default black)
  CanvasGradient createLinearGradient(double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1);
  CanvasGradient createRadialGradient(double x0, double y0, double r0, double x1, double y1, double r1);
  CanvasGradient createConicGradient(double startAngle, double x, double y);
  CanvasPattern? createPattern(CanvasImageSource image, [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString repetition);

};

interface mixin CanvasShadowStyles {
  // shadows
  attribute unrestricted double shadowOffsetX; // (default 0)
  attribute unrestricted double shadowOffsetY; // (default 0)
  attribute unrestricted double shadowBlur; // (default 0)
  attribute DOMString shadowColor; // (default transparent black)
};

interface mixin CanvasFilters {
  // filters
  attribute DOMString filter; // (default "none")
};

interface mixin CanvasRect {
  // rects
  undefined clearRect(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double w, unrestricted double h);
  undefined fillRect(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double w, unrestricted double h);
  undefined strokeRect(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double w, unrestricted double h);
};

interface mixin CanvasDrawPath {
  // path API (see also CanvasPath)
  undefined beginPath();
  undefined fill(optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  undefined fill(Path2D path, optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  undefined stroke();
  undefined stroke(Path2D path);
  undefined clip(optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  undefined clip(Path2D path, optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  boolean isPointInPath(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  boolean isPointInPath(Path2D path, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, optional CanvasFillRule fillRule = "nonzero");
  boolean isPointInStroke(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  boolean isPointInStroke(Path2D path, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
};

interface mixin CanvasUserInterface {
  undefined drawFocusIfNeeded(Element element);
  undefined drawFocusIfNeeded(Path2D path, Element element);
};

interface mixin CanvasText {
  // text (see also the CanvasPathDrawingStyles and CanvasTextDrawingStyles interfaces)
  undefined fillText(DOMString text, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, optional unrestricted double maxWidth);
  undefined strokeText(DOMString text, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, optional unrestricted double maxWidth);
  TextMetrics measureText(DOMString text);
};

interface mixin CanvasDrawImage {
  // drawing images
  undefined drawImage(CanvasImageSource image, unrestricted double dx, unrestricted double dy);
  undefined drawImage(CanvasImageSource image, unrestricted double dx, unrestricted double dy, unrestricted double dw, unrestricted double dh);
  undefined drawImage(CanvasImageSource image, unrestricted double sx, unrestricted double sy, unrestricted double sw, unrestricted double sh, unrestricted double dx, unrestricted double dy, unrestricted double dw, unrestricted double dh);
};

interface mixin CanvasImageData {
  // pixel manipulation
  ImageData createImageData([EnforceRange] long sw, [EnforceRange] long sh, optional ImageDataSettings settings = {});
  ImageData createImageData(ImageData imageData);
  ImageData getImageData([EnforceRange] long sx, [EnforceRange] long sy, [EnforceRange] long sw, [EnforceRange] long sh, optional ImageDataSettings settings = {});
  undefined putImageData(ImageData imageData, [EnforceRange] long dx, [EnforceRange] long dy);
  undefined putImageData(ImageData imageData, [EnforceRange] long dx, [EnforceRange] long dy, [EnforceRange] long dirtyX, [EnforceRange] long dirtyY, [EnforceRange] long dirtyWidth, [EnforceRange] long dirtyHeight);
};

enum CanvasLineCap { "butt", "round", "square" };
enum CanvasLineJoin { "round", "bevel", "miter" };
enum CanvasTextAlign { "start", "end", "left", "right", "center" };
enum CanvasTextBaseline { "top", "hanging", "middle", "alphabetic", "ideographic", "bottom" };
enum CanvasDirection { "ltr", "rtl", "inherit" };
enum CanvasFontKerning { "auto", "normal", "none" };
enum CanvasFontStretch { "ultra-condensed", "extra-condensed", "condensed", "semi-condensed", "normal", "semi-expanded", "expanded", "extra-expanded", "ultra-expanded" };
enum CanvasFontVariantCaps { "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "petite-caps", "all-petite-caps", "unicase", "titling-caps" };
enum CanvasTextRendering { "auto", "optimizeSpeed", "optimizeLegibility", "geometricPrecision" };

interface mixin CanvasPathDrawingStyles {
  // line caps/joins
  attribute unrestricted double lineWidth; // (default 1)
  attribute CanvasLineCap lineCap; // (default "butt")
  attribute CanvasLineJoin lineJoin; // (default "miter")
  attribute unrestricted double miterLimit; // (default 10)

  // dashed lines
  undefined setLineDash(sequence<unrestricted double> segments); // default empty
  sequence<unrestricted double> getLineDash();
  attribute unrestricted double lineDashOffset;
};

interface mixin CanvasTextDrawingStyles {
  // text
  attribute DOMString lang; // (default: "inherit")
  attribute DOMString font; // (default 10px sans-serif)
  attribute CanvasTextAlign textAlign; // (default: "start")
  attribute CanvasTextBaseline textBaseline; // (default: "alphabetic")
  attribute CanvasDirection direction; // (default: "inherit")
  attribute DOMString letterSpacing; // (default: "0px")
  attribute CanvasFontKerning fontKerning; // (default: "auto")
  attribute CanvasFontStretch fontStretch; // (default: "normal")
  attribute CanvasFontVariantCaps fontVariantCaps; // (default: "normal")
  attribute CanvasTextRendering textRendering; // (default: "auto")
  attribute DOMString wordSpacing; // (default: "0px")
};

interface mixin CanvasPath {
  // shared path API methods
  undefined closePath();
  undefined moveTo(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined lineTo(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined quadraticCurveTo(unrestricted double cpx, unrestricted double cpy, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined bezierCurveTo(unrestricted double cp1x, unrestricted double cp1y, unrestricted double cp2x, unrestricted double cp2y, unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y);
  undefined arcTo(unrestricted double x1, unrestricted double y1, unrestricted double x2, unrestricted double y2, unrestricted double radius); 
  undefined rect(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double w, unrestricted double h);
  undefined roundRect(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double w, unrestricted double h, optional (unrestricted double or DOMPointInit or sequence<(unrestricted double or DOMPointInit)>) radii = 0);
  undefined arc(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double radius, unrestricted double startAngle, unrestricted double endAngle, optional boolean counterclockwise = false); 
  undefined ellipse(unrestricted double x, unrestricted double y, unrestricted double radiusX, unrestricted double radiusY, unrestricted double rotation, unrestricted double startAngle, unrestricted double endAngle, optional boolean counterclockwise = false); 
};

[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface CanvasGradient {
  // opaque object
  undefined addColorStop(double offset, DOMString color);
};

[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface CanvasPattern {
  // opaque object
  undefined setTransform(optional DOMMatrix2DInit transform = {});
};

[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface TextMetrics {
  // x-direction
  readonly attribute double width; // advance width
  readonly attribute double actualBoundingBoxLeft;
  readonly attribute double actualBoundingBoxRight;

  // y-direction
  readonly attribute double fontBoundingBoxAscent;
  readonly attribute double fontBoundingBoxDescent;
  readonly attribute double actualBoundingBoxAscent;
  readonly attribute double actualBoundingBoxDescent;
  readonly attribute double emHeightAscent;
  readonly attribute double emHeightDescent;
  readonly attribute double hangingBaseline;
  readonly attribute double alphabeticBaseline;
  readonly attribute double ideographicBaseline;
};

[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface Path2D {
  constructor(optional (Path2D or DOMString) path);

  undefined addPath(Path2D path, optional DOMMatrix2DInit transform = {});
};
Path2D includes CanvasPath;
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

To maintain compatibility with existing web content&#44; user agents need to enumerate methods defined in <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasuserinterface&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasUserInterface](#canvasuserinterface)</code> immediately after the <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroke&#45;2"></a><code>[stroke&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-stroke)</code> method on <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;18"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> objects&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var> &#61; <var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;getcontext"></a>[getContext](#dom-canvas-getcontext)&#40;&#39;2d&#39; &#91;&#44; &#123; &#91; <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;alpha&#45;2"></a>[alpha](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-alpha)&#58; true &#93; &#91;&#44; <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;desynchronized&#45;2"></a>[desynchronized](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-desynchronized)&#58; false &#93; &#91;&#44; <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colorspace&#45;2"></a>[colorSpace](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colorspace)&#58; &#39;srgb&#39;&#93; &#91;&#44; <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;willreadfrequently&#45;2"></a>[willReadFrequently](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-willreadfrequently)&#58; false &#93;&#125; &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns a <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;19"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object that is permanently bound to a particular <a id="2dcontext&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

If the <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a><code>[alpha](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-alpha)</code> member is false&#44; then the context is forced to always be opaque&#46;

If the <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;desynchronized&#45;3"></a><code>[desynchronized](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-desynchronized)</code> member is true&#44; then the context might be <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized)&#46;

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colorspace&#45;3"></a><code>[colorSpace](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colorspace)</code> member specifies the <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) of the rendering context&#46;

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colortype&#45;2"></a><code>[colorType](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colortype)</code> member specifies the <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type) of the rendering context&#46;

If the <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;willreadfrequently&#45;3"></a><code>[willReadFrequently](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-willreadfrequently)</code> member is true&#44; then the context is marked for <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently"></a>[readback optimization](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently)&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;dev"></a>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;canvas](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/canvas)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the <a id="2dcontext&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><code><var>attributes</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;getcontextattributes&#45;2"></a>[getContextAttributes](#dom-context-2d-canvas-getcontextattributes)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns an object whose&#58;

- <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha)</code> member is true if the context has an alpha component that is not 1&#46;0&#59; otherwise false&#46;
- <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;desynchronized&#45;4"></a><code>[desynchronized](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-desynchronized)</code> member is true if the context can be <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized&#45;2"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized)&#46;
- <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colorspace&#45;4"></a><code>[colorSpace](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colorspace)</code> member is a string indicating the context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;2"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#46;
- <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colortype&#45;3"></a><code>[colorType](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colortype)</code> member is a string indicating the context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type)&#46;
- <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;willreadfrequently&#45;4"></a><code>[willReadFrequently](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-willreadfrequently)</code> member is true if the context is marked for <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently&#45;2"></a>[readback optimization](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;20"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> 2D rendering context represents a flat linear Cartesian surface whose origin &#40;0&#44;0&#41; is at the top left corner&#44; with the coordinate space having <var>x</var> values increasing when going right&#44; and <var>y</var> values increasing when going down&#46; The <var>x</var>&#45;coordinate of the right&#45;most edge is equal to the width of the rendering context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) in <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; similarly&#44; the <var>y</var>&#45;coordinate of the bottom&#45;most edge is equal to the height of the rendering context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) in <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

The size of the coordinate space does not necessarily represent the size of the actual bitmaps that the user agent will use internally or during rendering&#46; On high&#45;definition displays&#44; for instance&#44; the user agent may internally use bitmaps with four device pixels per unit in the coordinate space&#44; so that the rendering remains at high quality throughout&#46; Anti&#45;aliasing can similarly be implemented using oversampling with bitmaps of a higher resolution than the final image on the display&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Using <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) to describe the size of a rendering context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) does not mean that when rendered the canvas will cover an equivalent area in <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;5"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) are reused for ease of integration with CSS features&#44; such as text layout&#46;

In other words&#44; the <a id="2dcontext&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element below&#39;s rendering context has a 200x200 <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) &#40;which internally uses <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;6"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) as a unit for ease of integration with CSS&#41; and is rendered as 100x100 <a id="2dcontext&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;7"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#58;

``` text
<canvas width=200 height=200 style=width:100px;height:100px>
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="2d&#45;context&#45;creation&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>2D context creation algorithm</strong>&#44; which is passed a <var>target</var> &#40;a <a id="2dcontext&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#41; and <var>options</var>&#44; consists of running these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>settings</var> be the result of <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>options</var> to the dictionary type <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings](#canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings)</code>&#46; &#40;This can throw an exception&#46;&#41;

2.  Let <var>context</var> be a new <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;21"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object&#46;

3.  Initialize <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute to point to <var>target</var>&#46;

4.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) to the same bitmap as <var>target</var>&#39;s bitmap &#40;so that they are shared&#41;&#46;

5.  <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;set&#45;bitmap&#45;dimensions"></a>[Set bitmap dimensions](#concept-canvas-set-bitmap-dimensions) to <a id="2dcontext&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values"></a>[the numeric values](#obtain-numeric-values) of <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> and <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attributes&#46;

6.  Run the <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvas&#45;setting&#45;init&#45;bitmap"></a>[canvas settings output bitmap initialization algorithm](#canvas-setting-init-bitmap)&#44; given <var>context</var> and <var>settings</var>&#46;

7.  Return <var>context</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the user agent is to <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;set&#45;bitmap&#45;dimensions"></a><strong>set bitmap dimensions</strong> to <var>width</var> and <var>height</var>&#44; it must run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="2dcontext&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;rendering&#45;context&#45;to&#45;its&#45;default&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Reset the rendering context to its default state](#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state)&#46;

2.  Resize the <a id="2dcontext&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;6"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) to the new <var>width</var> and <var>height</var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>canvas</var> be the <a id="2dcontext&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which the rendering context&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute was initialized&#46;

4.  If <a id="2dcontext&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> content attribute differs from <var>width</var>&#44; then set <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;3"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> content attribute to the shortest possible string representing <var>width</var> as a <a id="2dcontext&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46;

5.  If <a id="2dcontext&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values&#45;3"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attribute differs from <var>height</var>&#44; then set <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="2dcontext&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;3"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attribute to the shortest possible string representing <var>height</var> as a <a id="2dcontext&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer&#45;2"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Only one square appears to be drawn in the following example&#58;

``` text
// canvas is a reference to a <canvas> element
var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
context.fillRect(0,0,50,50);
canvas.setAttribute('width', '300'); // clears the canvas
context.fillRect(0,100,50,50);
canvas.width = canvas.width; // clears the canvas
context.fillRect(100,0,50,50); // only this square remains
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas"></a><strong><code>canvas</code></strong> attribute must return the value it was initialized to when the object was created&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvascolortype&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasColorType](#canvascolortype)</code> enumeration is used to specify the <a id="2dcontext&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type) of the canvas&#39;s backing store&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvascolortype&#45;unorm8"></a><strong><code>unorm8</code></strong>&#34; value indicates that the type for all color components is 8&#45;bit unsigned normalized&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvascolortype&#45;float16"></a><strong><code>float16</code></strong>&#34; value indicates that the type for all color components is 16&#45;bit floating point&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;canvasfillrule&#45;7"></a><code>[CanvasFillRule](#canvasfillrule)</code> enumeration is used to select the <a id="fill&#45;rule"></a><strong>fill rule</strong> algorithm by which to determine if a point is inside or outside a path&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillrule&#45;nonzero"></a><strong><code>nonzero</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the nonzero winding rule&#44; wherein a point is considered to be outside a shape if the number of times a half&#45;infinite straight line drawn from that point crosses the shape&#39;s path going in one direction is equal to the number of times it crosses the path going in the other direction&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillrule&#45;evenodd"></a><strong><code>evenodd</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the even&#45;odd rule&#44; wherein a point is considered to be outside a shape if the number of times a half&#45;infinite straight line drawn from that point crosses the shape&#39;s path is even&#46;

If a point is not outside a shape&#44; it is inside the shape&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="2dcontext&#58;imagesmoothingquality&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageSmoothingQuality](#imagesmoothingquality)</code> enumeration is used to express a preference for the interpolation quality to use when smoothing images&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality&#45;low"></a><strong><code>low</code></strong>&#34; value indicates a preference for a low level of image interpolation quality&#46; Low&#45;quality image interpolation may be more computationally efficient than higher settings&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality&#45;medium"></a><strong><code>medium</code></strong>&#34; value indicates a preference for a medium level of image interpolation quality&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality&#45;high"></a><strong><code>high</code></strong>&#34; value indicates a preference for a high level of image interpolation quality&#46; High&#45;quality image interpolation may be more computationally expensive than lower settings&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Bilinear scaling is an example of a relatively fast&#44; lower&#45;quality image&#45;smoothing algorithm&#46; Bicubic or Lanczos scaling are examples of image&#45;smoothing algorithms that produce higher&#45;quality output&#46; This specification does not mandate that specific interpolation algorithms be used&#46;

###### <a id="implementation&#45;notes"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;1 Implementation notes[](#implementation-notes)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

The <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#44; when it is not directly displayed by the user agent&#44; implementations can&#44; instead of updating this bitmap&#44; merely remember the sequence of drawing operations that have been applied to it until such time as the bitmap&#39;s actual data is needed &#40;for example because of a call to <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><code>[drawImage&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code>&#44; or the <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;dom&#45;createimagebitmap"></a><code>[createImageBitmap&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-createimagebitmap)</code> factory method&#41;&#46; In many cases&#44; this will be more memory efficient&#46;

The bitmap of a <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element is the one bitmap that&#39;s pretty much always going to be needed in practice&#46; The <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) of a rendering context&#44; when it has one&#44; is always just an alias to a <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap&#46;

Additional bitmaps are sometimes needed&#44; e&#46;g&#46; to enable fast drawing when the canvas is being painted at a different size than its <a id="implementation&#45;notes&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions)&#44; or to enable double buffering so that graphics updates&#44; like page scrolling for example&#44; can be processed concurrently while canvas draw commands are being executed&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;2 The canvas settings[](#the-canvas-settings)

A <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object has an <a id="output&#45;bitmap"></a><strong>output bitmap</strong> that is initialized when the object is created&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) has an <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag&#44; which can be set to true or false&#46; Initially&#44; when one of these bitmaps is created&#44; its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag must be set to true&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object also has an <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha"></a><strong>alpha</strong> boolean&#46; When a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha) is false&#44; then its alpha component must be fixed to 1&#46;0 &#40;fully opaque&#41; for all pixels&#44; and attempts to change the alpha component of any pixel must be silently ignored&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; the bitmap of such a context starts off as <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) instead of <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#59; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clearrect"></a><code>[clearRect&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-clearrect)</code> always results in <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;opaque&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) pixels&#44; every fourth byte from <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code> is always 255&#44; the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata"></a><code>[putImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-putimagedata)</code> method effectively ignores every fourth byte in its input&#44; and so on&#46; However&#44; the alpha component of styles and images drawn onto the canvas are still honoured up to the point where they would impact the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#39;s alpha component&#59; for instance&#44; drawing a 50&#37; transparent white square on a freshly created <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) with its <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha&#45;2"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha) set to false will result in a fully&#45;opaque gray square&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object also has a <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized"></a><strong>desynchronized</strong> boolean&#46; When a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized) is true&#44; then the user agent may optimize the rendering of the canvas to reduce the latency&#44; as measured from input events to rasterization&#44; by desynchronizing the canvas paint cycle from the event loop&#44; bypassing the ordinary user agent rendering algorithm&#44; or both&#46; Insofar as this mode involves bypassing the usual paint mechanisms&#44; rasterization&#44; or both&#44; it might introduce visible tearing artifacts&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The user agent usually renders on a buffer which is not being displayed&#44; quickly swapping it and the one being scanned out for presentation&#59; the former buffer is called back buffer and the latter <em>front buffer</em>&#46; A popular technique for reducing latency is called front buffer rendering&#44; also known as <em>single buffer</em> rendering&#44; where rendering happens in parallel and racily with the scanning out process&#46; This technique reduces the latency at the price of potentially introducing tearing artifacts and can be used to implement in total or part of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized&#45;2"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized) boolean&#46; [&#91;MULTIPLEBUFFERING&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMULTIPLEBUFFERING)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized&#45;3"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized) boolean can be useful when implementing certain kinds of applications&#44; such as drawing applications&#44; where the latency between input and rasterization is critical&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object also has a <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently"></a><strong>will read frequently</strong> boolean&#46; When a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;7"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently"></a>[will read frequently](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently) is true&#44; the user agent may optimize the canvas for readback operations&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

On most devices the user agent needs to decide whether to store the canvas&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) on the GPU &#40;this is also called &#34;hardware accelerated&#34;&#41;&#44; or on the CPU &#40;also called &#34;software&#34;&#41;&#46; Most rendering operations are more performant for accelerated canvases&#44; with the major exception being readback with <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata&#45;2"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl"></a><code>[toDataURL&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-todataurl)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob"></a><code>[toBlob&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-toblob)</code>&#46; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> objects with <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently&#45;2"></a>[will read frequently](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently) equal to true tell the user agent that the webpage is likely to perform many readback operations and that it is advantageous to use a software canvas&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;9"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object also has a <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a><strong>color space</strong> setting of type <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;predefinedcolorspace"></a><code>[PredefinedColorSpace](#predefinedcolorspace)</code>&#46; The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;10"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) indicates the color space for the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;11"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object also has a <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type"></a><strong>color type</strong> setting of type <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvascolortype"></a><code>[CanvasColorType](#canvascolortype)</code>&#46; The <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;12"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type) indicates the data type of the color and alpha components of the pixels of the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;6"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#46;

To <a id="canvas&#45;setting&#45;init&#45;bitmap"></a><strong>initialize a <code>CanvasSettings</code> output bitmap</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvassettings&#45;13"></a><code>[CanvasSettings](#canvassettings)</code> <var>context</var> and a <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings](#canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings)</code> <var>settings</var>&#58;

1.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha) to <var>settings</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;alpha"></a><strong><code>alpha</code></strong>&#34;&#93;&#46;

2.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized&#45;4"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized) to <var>settings</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;desynchronized"></a><strong><code>desynchronized</code></strong>&#34;&#93;&#46;

3.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;2"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) to <var>settings</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colorspace"></a><strong><code>colorSpace</code></strong>&#34;&#93;&#46;

4.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type) to <var>settings</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colortype"></a><strong><code>colorType</code></strong>&#34;&#93;&#46;

5.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently&#45;3"></a>[will read frequently](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently) to <var>settings</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;willreadfrequently"></a><strong><code>willReadFrequently</code></strong>&#34;&#93;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;getcontextattributes"></a><strong><code>getContextAttributes&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return «&#91; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-alpha)</code>&#34; → <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha&#45;4"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha)&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;desynchronized"></a><code>[desynchronized](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-desynchronized)</code>&#34; → <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;desynchronized&#45;5"></a>[desynchronized](#concept-canvas-desynchronized)&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorSpace](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colorspace)</code>&#34; → <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;3"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;colortype"></a><code>[colorType](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-colortype)</code>&#34; → <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type)&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;dom&#45;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings&#45;willreadfrequently"></a><code>[willReadFrequently](#dom-canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings-willreadfrequently)</code>&#34; → <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;settings&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;will&#45;read&#45;frequently&#45;4"></a>[will read frequently](#concept-canvas-will-read-frequently) &#93;»&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;3 The canvas state[](#the-canvas-state)

Objects that implement the <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;canvasstate"></a><code>[CanvasState](#canvasstate)</code> interface maintain a stack of drawing states&#46; <a id="drawing&#45;state"></a><strong>Drawing states</strong> consist of&#58;

- The current <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;transformations"></a>[transformation matrix](#transformations)&#46;

- The current <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#46;

- The current <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;letter&#45;spacing"></a>[letter spacing](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-letter-spacing)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;word&#45;spacing"></a>[word spacing](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-word-spacing)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter"></a>[filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color)&#46;

- The current values of the following attributes&#58; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linecap"></a><code>[lineCap](#dom-context-2d-linecap)</code>&#44; Resets the rendering context&#44; which includes the backing buffer&#44; the drawing state stack&#44; path&#44; and styles&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;iscontextlost&#45;dev"></a>[isContextLost](#dom-context-2d-iscontextlost)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns true if the rendering context was lost&#46; Context loss can occur due to driver crashes&#44; running out of memory&#44; etc&#46; In these cases&#44; the canvas loses its backing storage and takes steps to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;rendering&#45;context&#45;to&#45;its&#45;default&#45;state"></a>[reset the rendering context to its default state](#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;save"></a><strong><code>save&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to push a copy of the current drawing state onto the drawing state stack&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;restore"></a><strong><code>restore&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to pop the top entry in the drawing state stack&#44; and reset the drawing state it describes&#46; If there is no saved state&#44; then the method must do nothing&#46;

To <a id="reset&#45;the&#45;rendering&#45;context&#45;to&#45;its&#45;default&#45;state"></a><strong>reset the rendering context to its default state</strong>&#58;

1.  Clear canvas&#39;s bitmap to <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

2.  Empty the list of subpaths in the context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#46;

3.  Clear the context&#39;s drawing state stack&#46;

4.  Reset everything that <a id="the&#45;canvas&#45;state&#58;drawing&#45;state"></a>[drawing state](#drawing-state) consists of to their initial values&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface have attributes and methods &#40;defined in this section&#41; that control how lines are treated by the object&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth"></a><strong><code>lineWidth</code></strong> attribute gives the width of lines&#44; in coordinate space units&#46; On getting&#44; it must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; zero&#44; negative&#44; infinite&#44; and NaN values must be ignored&#44; leaving the value unchanged&#59; other values must change the current value to the new value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth&#45;2"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code> attribute must initially have the value 1&#46;0&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linecap"></a><strong><code>lineCap</code></strong> attribute defines the type of endings that UAs will place on the end of lines&#46; The three valid values are &#34;<code>butt</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>round</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>square</code>&#34;&#46;

On getting&#44; it must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linecap&#45;2"></a><code>[lineCap](#dom-context-2d-linecap)</code> attribute must initially have the value &#34;<code>butt</code>&#34;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linejoin"></a><strong><code>lineJoin</code></strong> attribute defines the type of corners that UAs will place where two lines meet&#46; The three valid values are &#34;<code>bevel</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>round</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>miter</code>&#34;&#46;

On getting&#44; it must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linejoin&#45;2"></a><code>[lineJoin](#dom-context-2d-linejoin)</code> attribute must initially have the value &#34;<code>miter</code>&#34;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linejoin&#45;3"></a><code>[lineJoin](#dom-context-2d-linejoin)</code> attribute has the value &#34;<code>miter</code>&#34;&#44; strokes use the miter limit ratio to decide how to render joins&#46; The miter limit ratio can be explicitly set using the <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;miterlimit"></a><strong><code>miterLimit</code></strong> attribute&#46; On getting&#44; it must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; zero&#44; negative&#44; infinite&#44; and NaN values must be ignored&#44; leaving the value unchanged&#59; other values must change the current value to the new value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;miterlimit&#45;2"></a><code>[miterLimit](#dom-context-2d-miterlimit)</code> attribute must initially have the value 10&#46;0&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> object has a <a id="dash&#45;list"></a><strong>dash list</strong>&#44; which is either empty or consists of an even number of non&#45;negative numbers&#46; Initially&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list"></a>[dash list](#dash-list) must be empty&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;setlinedash"></a><strong><code>setLineDash&#40;<var>segments</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any value in <var>segments</var> is not finite &#40;e&#46;g&#46; an Infinity or a NaN value&#41;&#44; or if any value is negative &#40;less than zero&#41;&#44; then return &#40;without throwing an exception&#59; user agents could show a message on a developer console&#44; though&#44; as that would be helpful for debugging&#41;&#46;

2.  If the number of elements in <var>segments</var> is odd&#44; then let <var>segments</var> be the concatenation of two copies of <var>segments</var>&#46;

3.  Set the object&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[dash list](#dash-list) to <var>segments</var>&#46;

When the <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getlinedash"></a><strong><code>getLineDash&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method is invoked&#44; it must return a sequence whose values are the values of the object&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[dash list](#dash-list)&#44; in the same order&#46;

It is sometimes useful to change the &#34;phase&#34; of the dash pattern&#44; e&#46;g&#46; to achieve a &#34;marching ants&#34; effect&#46; The phase can be set using the <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linedashoffset"></a><strong><code>lineDashOffset</code></strong> attribute&#46; On getting&#44; it must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; infinite and NaN values must be ignored&#44; leaving the value unchanged&#59; other values must change the current value to the new value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;7"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linedashoffset&#45;2"></a><code>[lineDashOffset](#dom-context-2d-linedashoffset)</code> attribute must initially have the value 0&#46;0&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a user agent is to <a id="trace&#45;a&#45;path"></a><strong>trace a path</strong>&#44; given an object <var>style</var> that implements the <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface&#44; it must run the following algorithm&#46; This algorithm returns a new <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;path"></a>[path](#concept-path)&#46;

1.  Let <var>path</var> be a copy of the path being traced&#46;

2.  Prune all zero&#45;length <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;line&#45;segments"></a>[line segments](#line-segments) from <var>path</var>&#46;

3.  Remove from <var>path</var> any subpaths containing no lines &#40;i&#46;e&#46; subpaths with just one point&#41;&#46;

4.  Replace each point in each subpath of <var>path</var> other than the first point and the last point of each subpath by a <em>join</em> that joins the line leading to that point to the line leading out of that point&#44; such that the subpaths all consist of two points &#40;a starting point with a line leading out of it&#44; and an ending point with a line leading into it&#41;&#44; one or more lines &#40;connecting the points and the joins&#41;&#44; and zero or more joins &#40;each connecting one line to another&#41;&#44; connected together such that each subpath is a series of one or more lines with a join between each one and a point on each end&#46;

5.  Add a straight closing line to each closed subpath in <var>path</var> connecting the last point and the first point of that subpath&#59; change the last point to a join &#40;from the previously last line to the newly added closing line&#41;&#44; and change the first point to a join &#40;from the newly added closing line to the first line&#41;&#46;

6.  If <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;4"></a>[dash list](#dash-list) is empty&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>convert</em>&#46;

7.  Let <var>pattern width</var> be the concatenation of all the entries of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;5"></a>[dash list](#dash-list)&#44; in coordinate space units&#46;

8.  For each subpath <var>subpath</var> in <var>path</var>&#44; run the following substeps&#46; These substeps mutate the subpaths in <var>path</var> <em>in vivo</em>&#46;

    1.  Let <var>subpath width</var> be the length of all the lines of <var>subpath</var>&#44; in coordinate space units&#46;

    2.  Let <var>offset</var> be the value of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linedashoffset&#45;3"></a><code>[lineDashOffset](#dom-context-2d-linedashoffset)</code>&#44; in coordinate space units&#46;

    3.  While <var>offset</var> is greater than <var>pattern width</var>&#44; decrement it by <var>pattern width</var>&#46;

        While <var>offset</var> is less than zero&#44; increment it by <var>pattern width</var>&#46;

    4.  Define <var>L</var> to be a linear coordinate line defined along all lines in <var>subpath</var>&#44; such that the start of the first line in the subpath is defined as coordinate 0&#44; and the end of the last line in the subpath is defined as coordinate <var>subpath width</var>&#46;

    5.  Let <var>position</var> be 0 minus <var>offset</var>&#46;

    6.  Let <var>index</var> be 0&#46;

    7.  Let <var>current state</var> be <em>off</em> &#40;the other states being <em>on</em> and <em>zero&#45;on</em>&#41;&#46;

    8.  <em>Dash on</em>&#58; Let <var>segment length</var> be the value of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;6"></a>[dash list](#dash-list)&#39;s <var>index</var>th entry&#46;

    9.  Increment <var>position</var> by <var>segment length</var>&#46;

    10. If <var>position</var> is greater than <var>subpath width</var>&#44; then end these substeps for this subpath and start them again for the next subpath&#59; if there are no more subpaths&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>convert</em> instead&#46;

    11. If <var>segment length</var> is nonzero&#44; then let <var>current state</var> be <em>on</em>&#46;

    12. Increment <var>index</var> by one&#46;

    13. <em>Dash off</em>&#58; Let <var>segment length</var> be the value of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;7"></a>[dash list](#dash-list)&#39;s <var>index</var>th entry&#46;

    14. Let <var>start</var> be the offset <var>position</var> on <var>L</var>&#46;

    15. Increment <var>position</var> by <var>segment length</var>&#46;

    16. If <var>position</var> is less than zero&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>post&#45;cut</em>&#46;

    17. If <var>start</var> is less than zero&#44; then let <var>start</var> be zero&#46;

    18. If <var>position</var> is greater than <var>subpath width</var>&#44; then let <var>end</var> be the offset <var>subpath width</var> on <var>L</var>&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>end</var> be the offset <var>position</var> on <var>L</var>&#46;

    19. Jump to the first appropriate step&#58;

        <strong>If <var>segment length</var> is zero and <var>current state</var> is <em>off</em></strong>

        Do nothing&#44; just continue to the next step&#46;

        <strong>If <var>current state</var> is <em>off</em></strong>

        Cut the line on which <var>end</var> finds itself short at <var>end</var> and place a point there&#44; cutting in two the subpath that it was in&#59; remove all line segments&#44; joins&#44; points&#44; and subpaths that are between <var>start</var> and <var>end</var>&#59; and finally place a single point at <var>start</var> with no lines connecting to it&#46;

        The point has a <em>directionality</em> for the purposes of drawing line caps &#40;see below&#41;&#46; The directionality is the direction that the original line had at that point &#40;i&#46;e&#46; when <var>L</var> was defined above&#41;&#46;

        <strong>Otherwise</strong>

        Cut the line on which <var>start</var> finds itself into two at <var>start</var> and place a point there&#44; cutting in two the subpath that it was in&#44; and similarly cut the line on which <var>end</var> finds itself short at <var>end</var> and place a point there&#44; cutting in two the subpath that <em>it</em> was in&#44; and then remove all line segments&#44; joins&#44; points&#44; and subpaths that are between <var>start</var> and <var>end</var>&#46;

        If <var>start</var> and <var>end</var> are the same point&#44; then this results in just the line being cut in two and two points being inserted there&#44; with nothing being removed&#44; unless a join also happens to be at that point&#44; in which case the join must be removed&#46;

    20. <em>Post&#45;cut</em>&#58; If <var>position</var> is greater than <var>subpath width</var>&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>convert</em>&#46;

    21. Increment <var>index</var> by one&#46; If it is equal to the number of entries in <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dash&#45;list&#45;8"></a>[dash list](#dash-list)&#44; then let <var>index</var> be 0&#46;

    22. Return to the step labeled <em>dash on</em>&#46;

9.  <em>Convert</em>&#58; This is the step that converts the path to a new path that represents its stroke&#46;

    Create a new <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[path](#concept-path) that describes the edge of the areas that would be covered if a straight line of length equal to <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth&#45;3"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code> was swept along each subpath in <var>path</var> while being kept at an angle such that the line is orthogonal to the path being swept&#44; replacing each point with the end cap necessary to satisfy <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linecap&#45;3"></a><code>[lineCap](#dom-context-2d-linecap)</code> attribute as described previously and elaborated below&#44; and replacing each join with the join necessary to satisfy <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linejoin&#45;4"></a><code>[lineJoin](#dom-context-2d-linejoin)</code> type&#44; as defined below&#46;

    <strong>Caps</strong>&#58; Each point has a flat edge perpendicular to the direction of the line coming out of it&#46; This is then augmented according to the value of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linecap&#45;4"></a><code>[lineCap](#dom-context-2d-linecap)</code>&#46; The &#34;<code>butt</code>&#34; value means that no additional line cap is added&#46; The &#34;<code>round</code>&#34; value means that a semi&#45;circle with the diameter equal to <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth&#45;4"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code> width must additionally be placed on to the line coming out of each point&#46; The &#34;<code>square</code>&#34; value means that a rectangle with the length of <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth&#45;5"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code> width and the width of half <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linewidth&#45;6"></a><code>[lineWidth](#dom-context-2d-linewidth)</code> width&#44; placed flat against the edge perpendicular to the direction of the line coming out of the point&#44; must be added at each point&#46;

    Points with no lines coming out of them must have two caps placed back&#45;to&#45;back as if it was really two points connected to each other by an infinitesimally short straight line in the direction of the point&#39;s <em>directionality</em> &#40;as defined above&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Joins</strong>&#58; In addition to the point where a join occurs&#44; two additional points are relevant to each join&#44; one for each line&#58; the two corners found half the line width away from the join point&#44; one perpendicular to each line&#44; each on the side furthest from the other line&#46;

    A triangle connecting these two opposite corners with a straight line&#44; with the third point of the triangle being the join point&#44; must be added at all joins&#46; The <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;linejoin&#45;5"></a><code>[lineJoin](#dom-context-2d-linejoin)</code> attribute controls whether anything else is rendered&#46; The three aforementioned values have the following meanings&#58;

    The &#34;<code>bevel</code>&#34; value means that this is all that is rendered at joins&#46;

    The &#34;<code>round</code>&#34; value means that an arc connecting the two aforementioned corners of the join&#44; abutting &#40;and not overlapping&#41; the aforementioned triangle&#44; with the diameter equal to the line width and the origin at the point of the join&#44; must be added at joins&#46;

    The &#34;<code>miter</code>&#34; value means that a second triangle must &#40;if it can given the miter length&#41; be added at the join&#44; with one line being the line between the two aforementioned corners&#44; abutting the first triangle&#44; and the other two being continuations of the outside edges of the two joining lines&#44; as long as required to intersect without going over the miter length&#46;

    The miter length is the distance from the point where the join occurs to the intersection of the line edges on the outside of the join&#46; The miter limit ratio is the maximum allowed ratio of the miter length to half the line width&#46; If the miter length would cause the miter limit ratio &#40;as set by <var>style</var>&#39;s <a id="line&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;miterlimit&#45;3"></a><code>[miterLimit](#dom-context-2d-miterlimit)</code> attribute&#41; to be exceeded&#44; then this second triangle must not be added&#46;

    The subpaths in the newly created path must be oriented such that for any point&#44; the number of times a half&#45;infinite straight line drawn from that point crosses a subpath is even if and only if the number of times a half&#45;infinite straight line drawn from that same point crosses a subpath going in one direction is equal to the number of times it crosses a subpath going in the other direction&#46;

10. Return the newly created path&#46;

###### <a id="text&#45;styles"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;5 Text styles[](#text-styles)

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;dev"></a>[lang](#dom-context-2d-lang) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>styles</var>&#46;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang"></a>[lang](#dom-context-2d-lang) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the current language setting&#46;

Can be set to a BCP 47 language tag&#44; the empty string&#44; or &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-lang-inherit)</code>&#34;&#44; to change the language used when resolving fonts&#46; &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit&#45;2"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-lang-inherit)</code>&#34; takes the language from the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s language&#44; or the associated <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) when there is no <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

The default is &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit&#45;3"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-lang-inherit)</code>&#34;&#46;
