<strong><code><var>styles</var>&#46;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering"></a>[textRendering](#dom-context-2d-textrendering) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the current text rendering settings&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the text rendering&#46; The possible values and their meanings are given below&#46; Other values are ignored&#46; The default is &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](#dom-context-2d-textrendering-auto)</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;wordspacing&#45;dev"></a>[wordSpacing](#dom-context-2d-wordspacing) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>styles</var>&#46;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;wordspacing"></a>[wordSpacing](#dom-context-2d-wordspacing) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the current spacing between words in the text&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change spacing between words&#46; Values that cannot be parsed as a CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;length&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[&#60;length&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#lengths) are ignored&#46; The default is &#34;<code>0px</code>&#34;&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface have attributes &#40;defined in this section&#41; that control how text is laid out &#40;rasterized or outlined&#41; by the object&#46; Such objects can also have a <a id="font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object"></a><strong>font style source object</strong>&#46; For <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> objects&#44; this is the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element given by the value of the context&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute&#46; For <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> objects&#44; this is the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;associated&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;object"></a>[associated <code>OffscreenCanvas</code> object](#associated-offscreencanvas-object)&#46;

Font resolution for the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) requires a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;source"></a>[font source](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-source)&#46; This is determined for a given <var>object</var> implementing <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> by the following steps&#58; [&#91;CSSFONTLOAD&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSFONTLOAD)

1.  If <var>object</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) is a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; return the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; <var>object</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) is an <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#58;

    1.  Let <var>global</var> be <var>object</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    2.  If <var>global</var> is a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object&#44; then return <var>global</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#46;

    3.  <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>global</var> implements <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;workerglobalscope"></a><code>[WorkerGlobalScope](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#workerglobalscope)</code>&#46;

    4.  Return <var>global</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This is an example of font resolution with a regular <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element with ID <code>c1</code>&#46;

``` text
const font = new FontFace("MyCanvasFont", "url(mycanvasfont.ttf)");
documents.fonts.add(font);

const context = document.getElementById("c1").getContext("2d");
document.fonts.ready.then(function() {
  context.font = "64px MyCanvasFont";
  context.fillText("hello", 0, 0);
});
```

In this example&#44; the canvas will display text using <code>mycanvasfont&#46;ttf</code> as its font&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This is an example of how font resolution can happen using <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>&#46; Assuming a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element with ID <code>c2</code> which is transferred to a worker like so&#58;

``` text
const offscreenCanvas = document.getElementById("c2").transferControlToOffscreen();
worker.postMessage(offscreenCanvas, [offscreenCanvas]);
```

Then&#44; in the worker&#58;

``` text
self.onmessage = function(ev) {
  const transferredCanvas = ev.data;
  const context = transferredCanvas.getContext("2d");
  const font = new FontFace("MyFont", "url(myfont.ttf)");
  self.fonts.add(font);
  self.fonts.ready.then(function() {
    context.font = "64px MyFont";
    context.fillText("hello", 0, 0);
  });
};
```

In this example&#44; the canvas will display a text using <code>myfont&#46;ttf</code>&#46; Notice that the font is only loaded inside the worker&#44; and not in the document context&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;font"></a><strong><code>font</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on setting&#44; must be <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;parse&#45;something&#45;according&#45;to&#45;a&#45;css&#45;grammar"></a>[parsed as a CSS &#60;&#39;font&#39;&#62; value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-syntax/#parse-grammar) &#40;but without supporting property&#45;independent style sheet syntax like &#39;inherit&#39;&#41;&#44; and the resulting font must be assigned to the context&#44; with the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;line&#45;height&#39;"></a>[&#39;line&#45;height&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#propdef-line-height) component forced to &#39;normal&#39;&#44; with the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;size&#39;"></a>[&#39;font&#45;size&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-size-prop) component converted to <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#44; and with system fonts being computed to explicit values&#46; If the new value is syntactically incorrect &#40;including using property&#45;independent style sheet syntax like &#39;inherit&#39; or &#39;initial&#39;&#41;&#44; then it must be ignored&#44; without assigning a new font value&#46; [&#91;CSS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSS)

Font family names must be interpreted in the context of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;4"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) when the font is to be used&#59; any fonts embedded using <code>&#64;font&#45;face</code> or loaded using <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;fontface"></a><code>[FontFace](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fontface)</code> objects that are visible to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;5"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) must therefore be available once they are loaded&#46; &#40;Each <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;6"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) has a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[font source](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-font-loading/#font-source)&#44; which determines what fonts are available&#46;&#41; If a font is used before it is fully loaded&#44; or if the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;7"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) does not have that font in scope at the time the font is to be used&#44; then it must be treated as if it was an unknown font&#44; falling back to another as described by the relevant CSS specifications&#46; [&#91;CSSFONTS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSFONTS) [&#91;CSSFONTLOAD&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSFONTLOAD)

On getting&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;font&#45;2"></a><code>[font](#dom-context-2d-font)</code> attribute must return the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;serializing&#45;a&#45;css&#45;value"></a>[serialized form](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#serialize-a-css-value) of the current font of the context &#40;with no <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;line&#45;height&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;line&#45;height&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#propdef-line-height) component&#41;&#46; [&#91;CSSOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSOM)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; after the following statement&#58;

``` text
context.font = 'italic 400 12px/2 Unknown Font, sans-serif';
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;the expression <code>context&#46;font</code> would evaluate to the string &#34;<code>italic 12px &#34;Unknown Font&#34;&#44; sans&#45;serif</code>&#34;&#46; The &#34;400&#34; font&#45;weight doesn&#39;t appear because that is the default value&#46; The line&#45;height doesn&#39;t appear because it is forced to &#34;normal&#34;&#44; the default value&#46;

When the object implementing the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the font of the context must be set to 10px sans&#45;serif&#46; When the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;size&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;font&#45;size&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-size-prop) component is set to lengths using percentages&#44; <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;em&#39;"></a>[&#39;em&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#em) or <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;ex&#39;"></a>[&#39;ex&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#ex) units&#44; or the &#39;larger&#39; or &#39;smaller&#39; keywords&#44; these must be interpreted relative to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;computed&#45;value"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;size&#39;&#45;3"></a>[&#39;font&#45;size&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-size-prop) property of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;8"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) at the time that the attribute is set&#44; if it is an element&#46; When the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;weight&#39;"></a>[&#39;font&#45;weight&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-weight-prop) component is set to the relative values &#39;bolder&#39; and &#39;lighter&#39;&#44; these must be interpreted relative to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;weight&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;font&#45;weight&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-weight-prop) property of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;9"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) at the time that the attribute is set&#44; if it is an element&#46; If the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[computed values](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) are undefined for a particular case &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;10"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) is not an element or is not <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#41;&#44; then the relative keywords must be interpreted relative to the normal&#45;weight 10px sans&#45;serif default&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign"></a><strong><code>textAlign</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46; When the object implementing the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;2"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> attribute must initially have the value <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;start"></a><code>[start](#dom-context-2d-textalign-start)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline"></a><strong><code>textBaseline</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46; When the object implementing the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;2"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute must initially have the value <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;alphabetic&#45;2"></a><code>[alphabetic](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-alphabetic)</code>&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface have an associated <a id="concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;language"></a><strong>language</strong> value used to localize font rendering&#46; Valid values are a BCP 47 language tag&#44; the empty string&#44; or &#34;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit"></a><strong>inherit</strong>&#34; where the language comes from the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s language&#44; or the associated <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;document&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) when there is no <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46; Initially&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;language"></a>[language](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-language) must be &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit&#45;4"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-lang-inherit)</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang"></a><strong><code>lang</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;language&#45;2"></a>[language](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-language)&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;2"></a><code>[lang](#dom-context-2d-lang)</code> setter steps are to set <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;language&#45;3"></a>[language](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-language) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction"></a><strong><code>direction</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46; When the object implementing the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;7"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;2"></a><code>[direction](#dom-context-2d-direction)</code> attribute must initially have the value &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;inherit&#45;2"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-direction-inherit)</code>&#34;&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface have attributes that control the spacing between letters and words&#46; Such objects have associated <a id="concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;letter&#45;spacing"></a><strong>letter spacing</strong> and <a id="concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;word&#45;spacing"></a><strong>word spacing</strong> values&#44; which are CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;length&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[&#60;length&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#lengths) values&#46; Initially&#44; both must be the result of <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;parse&#45;something&#45;according&#45;to&#45;a&#45;css&#45;grammar&#45;2"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-syntax/#parse-grammar) &#34;<code>0px</code>&#34; as a CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;length&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[&#60;length&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#lengths)&#46;

Let <var>parsed</var> be the result of <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;parse&#45;something&#45;according&#45;to&#45;a&#45;css&#45;grammar&#45;3"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-syntax/#parse-grammar) the given value as a CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;length&#45;2&#45;5"></a>[&#60;length&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#lengths)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering"></a><strong><code>textRendering</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the current value&#46; On setting&#44; the current value must be changed to the new value&#46; When the object implementing the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;12"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interface is created&#44; the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;2"></a><code>[textRendering](#dom-context-2d-textrendering)</code> attribute must initially have the value &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;auto&#45;2"></a><code>[auto](#dom-context-2d-textrendering-auto)</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;3"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;start"></a><strong><code>start</code></strong></strong>

Align to the start edge of the text &#40;left side in left&#45;to&#45;right text&#44; right side in right&#45;to&#45;left text&#41;&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;end"></a><strong><code>end</code></strong></strong>

Align to the end edge of the text &#40;right side in left&#45;to&#45;right text&#44; left side in right&#45;to&#45;left text&#41;&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;left"></a><strong><code>left</code></strong></strong>

Align to the left&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;right"></a><strong><code>right</code></strong></strong>

Align to the right&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;center"></a><strong><code>center</code></strong></strong>

Align to the center&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;3"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords correspond to alignment points in the font&#58;

![The em&#45;over baseline is roughly at the top of the glyphs in a font&#44; the hanging baseline is where some glyphs like आ are anchored&#44; the middle is half&#45;way between the em&#45;over and em&#45;under baselines&#44; the alphabetic baseline is where characters like Á&#44; ÿ&#44; f&#44; and Ω are anchored&#44; the ideographic&#45;under baseline is where glyphs like 私 and 達 are anchored&#44; and the em&#45;under baseline is roughly at the bottom of the glyphs in a font&#46; The top and bottom of the bounding box can be far from these baselines&#44; due to glyphs extending far outside em&#45;over and em&#45;under baselines&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/baselines.png)

The keywords map to these alignment points as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;top"></a><strong><code>top</code></strong></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;hanging"></a><strong><code>hanging</code></strong></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;hanging&#45;baseline"></a>[hanging baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#hanging-baseline)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;middle"></a><strong><code>middle</code></strong></strong>

Halfway between the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline) and the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;alphabetic"></a><strong><code>alphabetic</code></strong></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;ideographic"></a><strong><code>ideographic</code></strong></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;ideographic&#45;under&#45;baseline"></a>[ideographic&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;bottom"></a><strong><code>bottom</code></strong></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline)

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;3"></a><code>[direction](#dom-context-2d-direction)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;ltr"></a><strong><code>ltr</code></strong></strong>

Treat input to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm"></a>[text preparation algorithm](#text-preparation-algorithm) as left&#45;to&#45;right text&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;rtl"></a><strong><code>rtl</code></strong></strong>

Treat input to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[text preparation algorithm](#text-preparation-algorithm) as right&#45;to&#45;left text&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;inherit"></a><strong><code>inherit</code></strong></strong>

Use the process in the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[text preparation algorithm](#text-preparation-algorithm) to obtain the text direction from the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#44; or <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;document&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontkerning&#45;3"></a><code>[fontKerning](#dom-context-2d-fontkerning)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontkerning&#45;auto"></a><strong><code>auto</code></strong></strong>

Kerning is applied at the discretion of the user agent&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontkerning&#45;normal"></a><strong><code>normal</code></strong></strong>

Kerning is applied&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontkerning&#45;none"></a><strong><code>none</code></strong></strong>

Kerning is not applied&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;3"></a><code>[fontStretch](#dom-context-2d-fontstretch)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;ultra&#45;condensed"></a><strong><code>ultra&#45;condensed</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;ultra&#45;condensed&#39;"></a>[&#39;ultra&#45;condensed&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-ultra-condensed) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;condensed"></a><strong><code>condensed</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;&#45;3"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;condensed&#39;"></a>[&#39;condensed&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-condensed) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;semi&#45;condensed"></a><strong><code>semi&#45;condensed</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;&#45;4"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;semi&#45;condensed&#39;"></a>[&#39;semi&#45;condensed&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-semi-condensed) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;semi&#45;expanded"></a><strong><code>semi&#45;expanded</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;&#45;5"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;semi&#45;expanded&#39;"></a>[&#39;semi&#45;expanded&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-semi-expanded) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;expanded"></a><strong><code>expanded</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;&#45;6"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;expanded&#39;"></a>[&#39;expanded&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-expanded) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;extra&#45;expanded"></a><strong><code>extra&#45;expanded</code></strong></strong>

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontstretch&#45;ultra&#45;expanded"></a><strong><code>ultra&#45;expanded</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;&#45;8"></a>[&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;ultra&#45;expanded&#39;"></a>[&#39;ultra&#45;expanded&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-stretch-ultra-expanded) setting&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;3"></a><code>[fontVariantCaps](#dom-context-2d-fontvariantcaps)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;normal"></a><strong><code>normal</code></strong></strong>

None of the features listed below are enabled&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;small&#45;caps"></a><strong><code>small&#45;caps</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;small&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;small&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-small-caps) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;all&#45;small&#45;caps"></a><strong><code>all&#45;small&#45;caps</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;all&#45;small&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;all&#45;small&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-all-small-caps) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;petite&#45;caps"></a><strong><code>petite&#45;caps</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;&#45;3"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;petite&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;petite&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-petite-caps) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;all&#45;petite&#45;caps"></a><strong><code>all&#45;petite&#45;caps</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;&#45;4"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;all&#45;petite&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;all&#45;petite&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-all-petite-caps) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;unicase"></a><strong><code>unicase</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;&#45;5"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;unicase&#39;"></a>[&#39;unicase&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-unicase) setting&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fontvariantcaps&#45;titling&#45;caps"></a><strong><code>titling&#45;caps</code></strong></strong>

Same as CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;&#45;6"></a>[&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps) <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;titling&#45;caps&#39;"></a>[&#39;titling&#45;caps&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#valdef-font-variant-caps-titling-caps) setting&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;3"></a><code>[textRendering](#dom-context-2d-textrendering)</code> attribute&#39;s allowed keywords are as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;auto"></a><strong><code>auto</code></strong></strong>

Same as &#39;auto&#39; in <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;svg&#45;text&#45;rendering"></a>[SVG text&#45;rendering](https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#TextRendering) property&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;optimizespeed"></a><strong><code>optimizeSpeed</code></strong></strong>

Same as &#39;optimizeSpeed&#39; in <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;svg&#45;text&#45;rendering&#45;2"></a>[SVG text&#45;rendering](https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#TextRendering) property&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;optimizelegibility"></a><strong><code>optimizeLegibility</code></strong></strong>

Same as &#39;optimizeLegibility&#39; in <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;svg&#45;text&#45;rendering&#45;3"></a>[SVG text&#45;rendering](https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#TextRendering) property&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textrendering&#45;geometricprecision"></a><strong><code>geometricPrecision</code></strong></strong>

Same as &#39;geometricPrecision&#39; in <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;svg&#45;text&#45;rendering&#45;4"></a>[SVG text&#45;rendering](https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#TextRendering) property&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>text preparation algorithm</strong> is as follows&#46; It takes as input a string <var>text</var>&#44; a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;13"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> object <var>target</var>&#44; and an optional length <var>maxWidth</var>&#46; It returns an array of glyph shapes&#44; each positioned on a common coordinate space&#44; a <var>physical alignment</var> whose value is one of <em>left</em>&#44; <em>right</em>&#44; and <em>center</em>&#44; and an <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46; &#40;Most callers of this algorithm ignore the <var>physical alignment</var> and the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;2"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;&#41;

1.  If <var>maxWidth</var> was provided but is less than or equal to zero or equal to NaN&#44; then return an empty array&#46;

2.  Replace all <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) in <var>text</var> with U&#43;0020 SPACE characters&#46;

3.  Let <var>font</var> be the current font of <var>target</var>&#44; as given by that object&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;font&#45;3"></a><code>[font](#dom-context-2d-font)</code> attribute&#46;

4.  Let <var>language</var> be the <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvastextdrawingstyles&#45;language&#45;4"></a>[language](#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-language)&#46;

5.  If <var>language</var> is &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lang&#45;inherit&#45;5"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-lang-inherit)</code>&#34;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>sourceObject</var> be <var>object</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;11"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object)&#46;

    2.  If <var>sourceObject</var> is a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; then set <var>language</var> to the <var>sourceObject</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;language"></a>[language](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#language)&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#58;

        1.  <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>sourceObject</var> is an <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46;

        2.  Set <var>language</var> to the <var>sourceObject</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang)&#46;

6.  If <var>language</var> is the empty string&#44; then set <var>language</var> to <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;explicitly&#45;unknown"></a>[explicitly unknown](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-explicitly-unknown)&#46;

7.  Apply the appropriate step from the following list to determine the value of <var>direction</var>&#58;

    <strong>If the <var>target</var> object&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;4"></a><code>[direction](#dom-context-2d-direction)</code> attribute has the value &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;ltr"></a><code>[ltr](#dom-context-2d-direction-ltr)</code>&#34;</strong>

    Let <var>direction</var> be &#39;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;ltr"></a>[ltr](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-ltr)&#39;&#46;
    <strong>If the <var>target</var> object&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;5"></a><code>[direction](#dom-context-2d-direction)</code> attribute has the value &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;rtl"></a><code>[rtl](#dom-context-2d-direction-rtl)</code>&#34;</strong>

    Let <var>direction</var> be &#39;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;rtl"></a>[rtl](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-rtl)&#39;&#46;
    <strong>If the <var>target</var> object&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;6"></a><code>[direction](#dom-context-2d-direction)</code> attribute has the value &#34;<a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;direction&#45;inherit&#45;3"></a><code>[inherit](#dom-context-2d-direction-inherit)</code>&#34;</strong>

    1.  Let <var>sourceObject</var> be <var>object</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;12"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object)&#46;

    2.  If <var>sourceObject</var> is a <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; then let <var>direction</var> be <var>sourceObject</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality)&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#58;

        1.  <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;assert&#45;3"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>sourceObject</var> is an <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;4"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46;

        2.  Let <var>direction</var> be <var>sourceObject</var>&#39;s <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction)&#46;

8.  Form a hypothetical infinitely&#45;wide CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;line&#45;box"></a>[line box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#line-box) containing a single <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;3"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box) containing the text <var>text</var>&#44; with the CSS <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;content&#45;language"></a>[content language](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text-4/#content-language) set to <var>language</var>&#44; and with its CSS properties set as follows&#58;

    <table><thead><tr><th>Property</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'direction'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes/#direction" data-x-internal="'direction'">&#39;direction&#39;</a></td><td><var>direction</var></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'font'-2" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-prop" data-x-internal="'font'">&#39;font&#39;</a></td><td><var>font</var></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'font-kerning'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-kerning" data-x-internal="'font-kerning'">&#39;font&#45;kerning&#39;</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <code id="text-styles:dom-context-2d-fontkerning-4"><a href="#dom-context-2d-fontkerning">fontKerning</a></code></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'font-stretch'-9" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-stretch" data-x-internal="'font-stretch'">&#39;font&#45;stretch&#39;</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <code id="text-styles:dom-context-2d-fontstretch-4"><a href="#dom-context-2d-fontstretch">fontStretch</a></code></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'font-variant-caps'-7" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#propdef-font-variant-caps" data-x-internal="'font-variant-caps'">&#39;font&#45;variant&#45;caps&#39;</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <code id="text-styles:dom-context-2d-fontvariantcaps-4"><a href="#dom-context-2d-fontvariantcaps">fontVariantCaps</a></code></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'letter-spacing'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#letter-spacing-property" data-x-internal="'letter-spacing'">&#39;letter&#45;spacing&#39;</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <a href="#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-letter-spacing" id="text-styles:concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-letter-spacing-3">letter spacing</a></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:svg-text-rendering-5" href="https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/painting.html#TextRendering" data-x-internal="svg-text-rendering">SVG text&#45;rendering</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <code id="text-styles:dom-context-2d-textrendering-4"><a href="#dom-context-2d-textrendering">textRendering</a></code></td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'white-space'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#white-space-property" data-x-internal="'white-space'">&#39;white&#45;space&#39;</a></td><td>&#39;pre&#39;</td></tr><tr><td><a id="text-styles:'word-spacing'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#propdef-word-spacing" data-x-internal="'word-spacing'">&#39;word&#45;spacing&#39;</a></td><td><var>target</var>&#39;s <a href="#concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-word-spacing" id="text-styles:concept-canvastextdrawingstyles-word-spacing-3">word spacing</a></td></tr></tbody></table>

    and with all other properties set to their initial values&#46;

9.  If <var>maxWidth</var> was provided and the hypothetical width of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;4"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box) in the hypothetical <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;line&#45;box&#45;2"></a>[line box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#line-box) is greater than <var>maxWidth</var> <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#44; then change <var>font</var> to have a more condensed font &#40;if one is available or if a reasonably readable one can be synthesized by applying a horizontal scale factor to the font&#41; or a smaller font&#44; and return to the previous step&#46;

10. The <var>anchor point</var> is a point on the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;5"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; and the <var>physical alignment</var> is one of the values <em>left</em>&#44; <em>right</em>&#44; and <em>center</em>&#46; These variables are determined by the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;4"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> and <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;4"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> values as follows&#58;

    Horizontal position&#58;

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;5"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;left"></a><code>[left](#dom-context-2d-textalign-left)</code></strong>

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;6"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;start&#45;2"></a><code>[start](#dom-context-2d-textalign-start)</code> and <var>direction</var> is &#39;ltr&#39;</strong>

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;7"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;end"></a><code>[end](#dom-context-2d-textalign-end)</code> and <var>direction</var> is &#39;rtl&#39;</strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s horizontal position to the left edge of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;6"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; and let <var>physical alignment</var> be <em>left</em>&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;8"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;right"></a><code>[right](#dom-context-2d-textalign-right)</code></strong>

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;9"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;end&#45;2"></a><code>[end](#dom-context-2d-textalign-end)</code> and <var>direction</var> is &#39;ltr&#39;</strong>

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;10"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;start&#45;3"></a><code>[start](#dom-context-2d-textalign-start)</code> and <var>direction</var> is &#39;rtl&#39;</strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s horizontal position to the right edge of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;7"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; and let <var>physical alignment</var> be <em>right</em>&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;11"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;center"></a><code>[center](#dom-context-2d-textalign-center)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s horizontal position to half way between the left and right edges of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;8"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; and let <var>physical alignment</var> be <em>center</em>&#46;
    Vertical position&#58;

    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;5"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;top"></a><code>[top](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-top)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to the top of the em box of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;9"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;6"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;hanging"></a><code>[hanging](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-hanging)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;hanging&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[hanging baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#hanging-baseline) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;2"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;10"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;7"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;middle"></a><code>[middle](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-middle)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to half way between the bottom and the top of the em box of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;3"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;11"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;8"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;alphabetic&#45;3"></a><code>[alphabetic](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-alphabetic)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;4"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;12"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;9"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;ideographic"></a><code>[ideographic](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-ideographic)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;ideographic&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[ideographic&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;5"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;13"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;
    <strong>If <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;10"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> is <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;bottom"></a><code>[bottom](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-bottom)</code></strong>

    Set the <var>anchor point</var>&#39;s vertical position to the bottom of the em box of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;6"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font) of the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;14"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#46;

11. Let <var>result</var> be an array constructed by iterating over each glyph in the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;15"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box) from left to right &#40;if any&#41;&#44; adding to the array&#44; for each glyph&#44; the shape of the glyph as it is in the <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;16"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; positioned on a coordinate space using <a id="text&#45;styles&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) with its origin at the <var>anchor point</var>&#46;

12. Return <var>result</var>&#44; <var>physical alignment</var>&#44; and the inline box&#46;

###### <a id="building&#45;paths"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;6 Building paths[](#building-paths)

Objects that implement the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;canvaspath"></a><code>[CanvasPath](#canvaspath)</code> interface have a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path"></a>[path](#concept-path)&#46; A <a id="concept&#45;path"></a><strong>path</strong> has a list of zero or more subpaths&#46; Each subpath consists of a list of one or more points&#44; connected by straight or curved <a id="line&#45;segments"></a><strong>line segments</strong>&#44; and a flag indicating whether the subpath is closed or not&#46; A closed subpath is one where the last point of the subpath is connected to the first point of the subpath by a straight line&#46; Subpaths with only one point are ignored when painting the path&#46;

<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[Paths](#concept-path) have a <a id="need&#45;new&#45;subpath"></a><strong>need new subpath</strong> flag&#46; When this flag is set&#44; certain APIs create a new subpath rather than extending the previous one&#46; When a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;3"></a>[path](#concept-path) is created&#44; its <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;need&#45;new&#45;subpath"></a>[need new subpath](#need-new-subpath) flag must be set&#46;

When an object implementing the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;canvaspath&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasPath](#canvaspath)</code> interface is created&#44; its <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;4"></a>[path](#concept-path) must be initialized to zero subpaths&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;moveto&#45;dev"></a>[moveTo](#dom-context-2d-moveto)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;moveTo](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/moveTo)

Support in all current engines&#46;

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;moveto"></a>[moveTo](#dom-context-2d-moveto)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Creates a new subpath with the given point&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;closepath&#45;dev"></a>[closePath](#dom-context-2d-closepath)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Marks the current subpath as closed&#44; and starts a new subpath with a point the same as the start and end of the newly closed subpath&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lineto&#45;dev"></a>[lineTo](#dom-context-2d-lineto)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lineto"></a>[lineTo](#dom-context-2d-lineto)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;beziercurveto"></a>[bezierCurveTo](#dom-context-2d-beziercurveto)&#40;<var>cp1x</var>&#44; <var>cp1y</var>&#44; <var>cp2x</var>&#44; <var>cp2y</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Adds the given point to the current subpath&#44; connected to the previous one by a cubic Bézier curve with the given control points&#46;

Adds points to the subpath such that the arc described by the circumference of the ellipse described by the arguments&#44; starting at the given start angle and ending at the given end angle&#44; going in the given direction &#40;defaulting to clockwise&#41;&#44; is added to the path&#44; connected to the previous point by a straight line&#46;

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;rect"></a>[rect](#dom-context-2d-rect)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Adds a new closed subpath to the path&#44; representing the given rectangle&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;roundrect&#45;dev"></a>[roundRect](#dom-context-2d-roundrect)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#44; <var>radii</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;roundrect"></a>[roundRect](#dom-context-2d-roundrect)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#44; <var>radii</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Adds a new closed subpath to the path representing the given rounded rectangle&#46; <var>radii</var> is either a list of radii or a single radius representing the corners of the rectangle in pixels&#46; If a list is provided&#44; the number and order of these radii function in the same way as the CSS <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;&#39;border&#45;radius&#39;"></a>[&#39;border&#45;radius&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds/#propdef-border-radius) property&#46; A single radius behaves the same way as a list with a single element&#46;

If <var>w</var> and <var>h</var> are both greater than or equal to 0&#44; or if both are smaller than 0&#44; then the path is drawn clockwise&#46; Otherwise&#44; it is drawn counterclockwise&#46;

When <var>w</var> is negative&#44; the rounded rectangle is flipped horizontally&#44; which means that the radius values that normally apply to the left corners are used on the right and vice versa&#46; Similarly&#44; when <var>h</var> is negative&#44; the rounded rect is flipped vertically&#46;

When a value <var>r</var> in <var>radii</var> is a number&#44; the corresponding corner&#40;s&#41; are drawn as circular arcs of radius <var>r</var>&#46;

When a value <var>r</var> in <var>radii</var> is an object with <code>&#123; x&#44; y &#125;</code> properties&#44; the corresponding corner&#40;s&#41; are drawn as elliptical arcs whose <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> radii are equal to <var>r&#46;x</var> and <var>r&#46;y</var>&#44; respectively&#46;

When the sum of the <var>radii</var> of two corners of the same edge is greater than the length of the edge&#44; all the <var>radii</var> of the rounded rectangle are scaled by a factor of length &#47; &#40;<var>r1</var> &#43; <var>r2</var>&#41;&#46; If multiple edges have this property&#44; the scale factor of the edge with the smallest scale factor is used&#46; This is consistent with CSS behavior&#46;

Throws a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;js&#45;rangeerror"></a><code>[RangeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror)</code> if <var>radii</var> is a list whose size is not one&#44; two&#44; three&#44; or four&#46;

Throws a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;js&#45;rangeerror&#45;2"></a><code>[RangeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror)</code> if a value in <var>radii</var> is a negative number&#44; or is an <code>&#123; x&#44; y &#125;</code> object whose <code>x</code> or <code>y</code> properties are negative numbers&#46;

The following methods allow authors to manipulate the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;5"></a>[paths](#concept-path) of objects implementing the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;canvaspath&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasPath](#canvaspath)</code> interface&#46;

For objects implementing the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;canvasdrawpath"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> and <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;canvastransform"></a><code>[CanvasTransform](#canvastransform)</code> interfaces&#44; the points passed to the methods&#44; and the resulting lines added to <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) by these methods&#44; must be transformed according to the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) before being added to the path&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;moveto"></a><strong><code>moveTo&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If either of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Create a new subpath with the specified point as its first &#40;and only&#41; point&#46;

When the user agent is to <a id="ensure&#45;there&#45;is&#45;a&#45;subpath"></a><strong>ensure there is a subpath</strong> for a coordinate &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; on a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;6"></a>[path](#concept-path)&#44; the user agent must check to see if the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;7"></a>[path](#concept-path) has its <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;need&#45;new&#45;subpath&#45;2"></a>[need new subpath](#need-new-subpath) flag set&#46; If it does&#44; then the user agent must create a new subpath with the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; as its first &#40;and only&#41; point&#44; as if the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;moveto&#45;2"></a><code>[moveTo&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-moveto)</code> method had been called&#44; and must then unset the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;concept&#45;path&#45;8"></a>[path](#concept-path)&#39;s <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;need&#45;new&#45;subpath&#45;3"></a>[need new subpath](#need-new-subpath) flag&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;closepath"></a><strong><code>closePath&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must do nothing if the object&#39;s path has no subpaths&#46; Otherwise&#44; it must mark the last subpath as closed&#44; create a new subpath whose first point is the same as the previous subpath&#39;s first point&#44; and finally add this new subpath to the path&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the last subpath had more than one point in its list of points&#44; then this is equivalent to adding a straight line connecting the last point back to the first point of the last subpath&#44; thus &#34;closing&#34; the subpath&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

New points and the lines connecting them are added to subpaths using the methods described below&#46; In all cases&#44; the methods only modify the last subpath in the object&#39;s path&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;lineto"></a><strong><code>lineTo&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If either of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If the object&#39;s path has no subpaths&#44; then <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ensure&#45;there&#45;is&#45;a&#45;subpath"></a>[ensure there is a subpath](#ensure-there-is-a-subpath) for &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; connect the last point in the subpath to the given point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; using a straight line&#44; and then add the given point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; to the subpath&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;quadraticcurveto"></a><strong><code>quadraticCurveTo&#40;<var>cpx</var>&#44; <var>cpy</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ensure&#45;there&#45;is&#45;a&#45;subpath&#45;2"></a>[Ensure there is a subpath](#ensure-there-is-a-subpath) for &#40;<var>cpx</var>&#44; <var>cpy</var>&#41;&#46;

3.  Connect the last point in the subpath to the given point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; using a quadratic Bézier curve with control point &#40;<var>cpx</var>&#44; <var>cpy</var>&#41;&#46; [&#91;BEZIER&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBEZIER)

4.  Add the given point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; to the subpath&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;beziercurveto"></a><strong><code>bezierCurveTo&#40;<var>cp1x</var>&#44; <var>cp1y</var>&#44; <var>cp2x</var>&#44; <var>cp2y</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ensure&#45;there&#45;is&#45;a&#45;subpath&#45;3"></a>[Ensure there is a subpath](#ensure-there-is-a-subpath) for &#40;<var>cp1x</var>&#44; <var>cp1y</var>&#41;&#46;

3.  Connect the last point in the subpath to the given point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; using a cubic Bézier curve with control points &#40;<var>cp1x</var>&#44; <var>cp1y</var>&#41; and &#40;<var>cp2x</var>&#44; <var>cp2y</var>&#41;&#46; [&#91;BEZIER&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBEZIER)

4.  Add the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; to the subpath&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;arcto"></a><strong><code>arcTo&#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#44; <var>x2</var>&#44; <var>y2</var>&#44; <var>radius</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ensure&#45;there&#45;is&#45;a&#45;subpath&#45;4"></a>[Ensure there is a subpath](#ensure-there-is-a-subpath) for &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41;&#46;

3.  If <var>radius</var> is negative&#44; then throw an <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  Let the point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; be the last point in the subpath&#44; transformed by the inverse of the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;transformations&#45;2"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) &#40;so that it is in the same coordinate system as the points passed to the method&#41;&#46;

5.  If the point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; is equal to the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41;&#44; or if the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; is equal to the point &#40;<var>x2</var>&#44; <var>y2</var>&#41;&#44; or if <var>radius</var> is zero&#44; then add the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; to the subpath&#44; and connect that point to the previous point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; by a straight line&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; if the points &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41;&#44; and &#40;<var>x2</var>&#44; <var>y2</var>&#41; all lie on a single straight line&#44; then add the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; to the subpath&#44; and connect that point to the previous point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; by a straight line&#46;

7.  Otherwise&#44; let <var>The Arc</var> be the shortest arc given by circumference of the circle that has radius <var>radius</var>&#44; and that has one point tangent to the half&#45;infinite line that crosses the point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; and ends at the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41;&#44; and that has a different point tangent to the half&#45;infinite line that ends at the point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; and crosses the point &#40;<var>x2</var>&#44; <var>y2</var>&#41;&#46; The points at which this circle touches these two lines are called the start and end tangent points respectively&#46; Connect the point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; to the start tangent point by a straight line&#44; adding the start tangent point to the subpath&#44; and then connect the start tangent point to the end tangent point by <var>The Arc</var>&#44; adding the end tangent point to the subpath&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;arc"></a><strong><code>arc&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>radius</var>&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>endAngle</var>&#44; <var>counterclockwise</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ellipse&#45;method&#45;steps"></a>[ellipse method steps](#ellipse-method-steps) with <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>radius</var>&#44; <var>radius</var>&#44; 0&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>endAngle</var>&#44; and <var>counterclockwise</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This makes it equivalent to <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ellipse&#45;2"></a><code>[ellipse&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-ellipse)</code> except that both radii are equal and <var>rotation</var> is 0&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ellipse"></a><strong><code>ellipse&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>radiusX</var>&#44; <var>radiusY</var>&#44; <var>rotation</var>&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>endAngle</var>&#44; <var>counterclockwise</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;ellipse&#45;method&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[ellipse method steps](#ellipse-method-steps) with <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>radiusX</var>&#44; <var>radiusY</var>&#44; <var>rotation</var>&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>endAngle</var>&#44; and <var>counterclockwise</var>&#46;

The <a id="determine&#45;the&#45;point&#45;on&#45;an&#45;ellipse&#45;steps"></a><strong>determine the point on an ellipse steps</strong>&#44; given <var>ellipse</var>&#44; and <var>angle</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Let <var>eccentricCircle</var> be the circle that shares its origin with <var>ellipse</var>&#44; with a radius equal to the semi&#45;major axis of <var>ellipse</var>&#46;

2.  Let <var>outerPoint</var> be the point on <var>eccentricCircle</var>&#39;s circumference at <var>angle</var> measured in radians clockwise from <var>ellipse</var>&#39;s semi&#45;major axis&#46;

3.  Let <var>chord</var> be the line perpendicular to <var>ellipse</var>&#39;s major axis between this axis and <var>outerPoint</var>&#46;

4.  Return the point on <var>chord</var> that crosses <var>ellipse</var>&#39;s circumference&#46;

The <a id="ellipse&#45;method&#45;steps"></a><strong>ellipse method steps</strong>&#44; given <var>canvasPath</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>radiusX</var>&#44; <var>radiusY</var>&#44; <var>rotation</var>&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>endAngle</var>&#44; and <var>counterclockwise</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If either <var>radiusX</var> or <var>radiusY</var> are negative&#44; then throw an <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>canvasPath</var>&#39;s path has any subpaths&#44; then add a straight line from the last point in the subpath to the start point of the arc&#46;

4.  Add the start and end points of the arc to the subpath&#44; and connect them with an arc&#46; The arc and its start and end points are defined as follows&#58;

    Consider an ellipse that has its origin at &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; that has a major&#45;axis radius <var>radiusX</var> and a minor&#45;axis radius <var>radiusY</var>&#44; and that is rotated about its origin such that its semi&#45;major axis is inclined <var>rotation</var> radians clockwise from the x&#45;axis&#46;

    If <var>counterclockwise</var> is false and <var>endAngle</var> − <var>startAngle</var> is greater than or equal to 2π&#44; or&#44; if <var>counterclockwise</var> is <em>true</em> and <var>startAngle</var> − <var>endAngle</var> is greater than or equal to 2π&#44; then the arc is the whole circumference of this ellipse&#44; and both the start point and the end point are the result of running the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;point&#45;on&#45;an&#45;ellipse&#45;steps"></a>[determine the point on an ellipse steps](#determine-the-point-on-an-ellipse-steps) given this ellipse and <var>startAngle</var>&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; the start point is the result of running the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;point&#45;on&#45;an&#45;ellipse&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[determine the point on an ellipse steps](#determine-the-point-on-an-ellipse-steps) given this ellipse and <var>startAngle</var>&#44; the end point is the result of running the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;point&#45;on&#45;an&#45;ellipse&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[determine the point on an ellipse steps](#determine-the-point-on-an-ellipse-steps) given this ellipse and <var>endAngle</var>&#44; and the arc is the path along the circumference of this ellipse from the start point to the end point&#44; going counterclockwise if <var>counterclockwise</var> is true&#44; and clockwise otherwise&#46; Since the points are on the ellipse&#44; as opposed to being simply angles from zero&#44; the arc can never cover an angle greater than 2π radians&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Even if the arc covers the entire circumference of the ellipse and there are no other points in the subpath&#44; the path is not closed unless the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;closepath&#45;2"></a><code>[closePath&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-closepath)</code> method is appropriately invoked&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;rect"></a><strong><code>rect&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Create a new subpath containing just the four points &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; in that order&#44; with those four points connected by straight lines&#46;

3.  Mark the subpath as closed&#46;

4.  Create a new subpath with the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; as the only point in the subpath&#46;
