The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;roundrect"></a><strong><code>roundRect&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#44; <var>radii</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If any of <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; or <var>h</var> are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>radii</var> is an <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;idl&#45;unrestricted&#45;double"></a><code>[unrestricted double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unrestricted-double)</code> or <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit"></a><code>[DOMPointInit](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dictdef-dompointinit)</code>&#44; then set <var>radii</var> to « <var>radii</var> »&#46;

3.  If <var>radii</var> is not a list of size one&#44; two&#44; three&#44; or four&#44; then throw a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;js&#45;rangeerror&#45;3"></a><code>[RangeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror)</code>&#46;

4.  Let <var>normalizedRadii</var> be an empty list&#46;

5.  For each <var>radius</var> of <var>radii</var>&#58;

    1.  If <var>radius</var> is a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMPointInit](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dictdef-dompointinit)</code>&#58;

        1.  If <var>radius</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93; or <var>radius</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93; is infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

        2.  If <var>radius</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;2"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93; or <var>radius</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;2"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93; is negative&#44; then throw a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;js&#45;rangeerror&#45;4"></a><code>[RangeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror)</code>&#46;

        3.  Otherwise&#44; append <var>radius</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#46;

    2.  If <var>radius</var> is a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;idl&#45;unrestricted&#45;double&#45;2"></a><code>[unrestricted double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unrestricted-double)</code>&#58;

        1.  If <var>radius</var> is infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

        2.  If <var>radius</var> is negative&#44; then throw a <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;js&#45;rangeerror&#45;5"></a><code>[RangeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror)</code>&#46;

        3.  Otherwise&#44; append «&#91; &#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;3"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34; → <var>radius</var>&#44; &#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;4"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34; → <var>radius</var> &#93;» to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#46;

6.  Let <var>upperLeft</var>&#44; <var>upperRight</var>&#44; <var>lowerRight</var>&#44; and <var>lowerLeft</var> be null&#46;

7.  If <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#39;s size is 4&#44; then set <var>upperLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;0&#93;&#44; set <var>upperRight</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;1&#93;&#44; set <var>lowerRight</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;2&#93;&#44; and set <var>lowerLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;3&#93;&#46;

8.  If <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#39;s size is 3&#44; then set <var>upperLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;0&#93;&#44; set <var>upperRight</var> and <var>lowerLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;1&#93;&#44; and set <var>lowerRight</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;2&#93;&#46;

9.  If <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#39;s size is 2&#44; then set <var>upperLeft</var> and <var>lowerRight</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;0&#93; and set <var>upperRight</var> and <var>lowerLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;1&#93;&#46;

10. If <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#39;s size is 1&#44; then set <var>upperLeft</var>&#44; <var>upperRight</var>&#44; <var>lowerRight</var>&#44; and <var>lowerLeft</var> to <var>normalizedRadii</var>&#91;0&#93;&#46;

11. Corner curves must not overlap&#46; Scale all radii to prevent this&#58;

    1.  Let <var>top</var> be <var>upperLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;5"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93; &#43; <var>upperRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;6"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#46;

    2.  Let <var>right</var> be <var>upperRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;3"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93; &#43; <var>lowerRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;4"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#46;

    3.  Let <var>bottom</var> be <var>lowerRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;7"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93; &#43; <var>lowerLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;8"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#46;

    4.  Let <var>left</var> be <var>upperLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;5"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93; &#43; <var>lowerLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;6"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#46;

    5.  Let <var>scale</var> be the minimum value of the ratios <var>w</var> &#47; <var>top</var>&#44; <var>h</var> &#47; <var>right</var>&#44; <var>w</var> &#47; <var>bottom</var>&#44; <var>h</var> &#47; <var>left</var>&#46;

    6.  If <var>scale</var> is less than 1&#44; then set the <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;9"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code> and <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;7"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code> members of <var>upperLeft</var>&#44; <var>upperRight</var>&#44; <var>lowerLeft</var>&#44; and <var>lowerRight</var> to their current values multiplied by <var>scale</var>&#46;

12. Create a new subpath&#58;

    1.  Move to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>upperLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;10"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46;

    2.  Draw a straight line to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>w</var> − <var>upperRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;11"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46;

    3.  Draw an arc to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>upperRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;8"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#41;&#46;

    4.  Draw a straight line to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>h</var> − <var>lowerRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;9"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#41;&#46;

    5.  Draw an arc to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>w</var> − <var>lowerRight</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;12"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>h</var>&#41;&#46;

    6.  Draw a straight line to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>lowerLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;13"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>h</var>&#41;&#46;

    7.  Draw an arc to the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>h</var> − <var>lowerLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;10"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#41;&#46;

    8.  Draw a straight line to the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var> &#43; <var>upperLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;y&#45;11"></a><code>[y](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-y)</code>&#34;&#93;&#41;&#46;

    9.  Draw an arc to the point &#40;<var>x</var> &#43; <var>upperLeft</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="building&#45;paths&#58;dompointinit&#45;x&#45;14"></a><code>[x](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dom-dompointinit-x)</code>&#34;&#93;&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46;

13. Mark the subpath as closed&#46;

14. Create a new subpath with the point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; as the only point in the subpath&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is designed to behave similarly to the CSS <a id="building&#45;paths&#58;&#39;border&#45;radius&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;border&#45;radius&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds/#propdef-border-radius) property&#46;

When <var>path</var> is a <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;path2d&#45;5"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object&#44; returns a copy&#46;

When <var>path</var> is a string&#44; creates the path described by the argument&#44; interpreted as SVG path data&#46; [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG)

<strong><code><var>path</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;path2d&#45;addpath&#45;dev"></a>[addPath](#dom-path2d-addpath)&#40;<var>path</var> &#91;&#44; <var>transform</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Adds to the path the path given by the argument&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;path2d"></a><strong><code>Path2D&#40;<var>path</var>&#41;</code></strong> constructor&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>output</var> be a new <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;path2d&#45;6"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object&#46;

2.  If <var>path</var> is not given&#44; then return <var>output</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>path</var> is a <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;path2d&#45;7"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object&#44; then add all subpaths of <var>path</var> to <var>output</var> and return <var>output</var>&#46; &#40;In other words&#44; it returns a copy of the argument&#46;&#41;

4.  Let <var>svgPath</var> be the result of parsing and interpreting <var>path</var> according to SVG 2&#39;s rules for path data&#46; [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG)

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The resulting path could be empty&#46; SVG defines error handling rules for parsing and applying path data&#46;

5.  Let &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; be the last point in <var>svgPath</var>&#46;

6.  Add all the subpaths&#44; if any&#44; from <var>svgPath</var> to <var>output</var>&#46;

7.  Create a new subpath in <var>output</var> with &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; as the only point in the subpath&#46;

8.  Return <var>output</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;path2d&#45;addpath"></a><strong><code>addPath&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>transform</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked on a <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;path2d&#45;8"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object <var>a</var>&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;path2d&#45;9"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object <var>path</var> has no subpaths&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>matrix</var> be the result of <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;create&#45;a&#45;dommatrix&#45;from&#45;a&#45;2d&#45;dictionary"></a>[creating a <code>DOMMatrix</code> from the 2D dictionary](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#create-a-dommatrix-from-the-2d-dictionary) <var>transform</var>&#46;

3.  If one or more of <var>matrix</var>&#39;s <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m11&#45;element"></a>[m11 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m11-element)&#44; <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m12&#45;element"></a>[m12 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m12-element)&#44; <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m21&#45;element"></a>[m21 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m21-element)&#44; <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m22&#45;element"></a>[m22 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m22-element)&#44; <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m41&#45;element"></a>[m41 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m41-element)&#44; or <a id="path2d&#45;objects&#58;m42&#45;element"></a>[m42 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m42-element) are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Create a copy of all the subpaths in <var>path</var>&#46; Let <var>c</var> be this copy&#46;

5.  Transform all the coordinates and lines in <var>c</var> by the transform matrix <var>matrix</var>&#46;

6.  Let &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; be the last point in the last subpath of <var>c</var>&#46;

7.  Add all the subpaths in <var>c</var> to <var>a</var>&#46;

8.  Create a new subpath in <var>a</var> with &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; as the only point in the subpath&#46;

###### <a id="transformations"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;8 <strong>Transformations</strong>[](#transformations)

Objects that implement the <a id="transformations&#58;canvastransform"></a><code>[CanvasTransform](#canvastransform)</code> interface have a <a id="current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix"></a><strong>current transformation matrix</strong>&#44; as well as methods &#40;described in this section&#41; to manipulate it&#46; When an object implementing the <a id="transformations&#58;canvastransform&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasTransform](#canvastransform)</code> interface is created&#44; its transformation matrix must be initialized to the identity matrix&#46;

The <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) is applied to coordinates when creating the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#44; and when painting text&#44; shapes&#44; and <a id="transformations&#58;path2d"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> objects&#44; on objects implementing the <a id="transformations&#58;canvastransform&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasTransform](#canvastransform)</code> interface&#46;

The transformations must be performed in reverse order&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; if a scale transformation that doubles the width is applied to the canvas&#44; followed by a rotation transformation that rotates drawing operations by a quarter turn&#44; and a rectangle twice as wide as it is tall is then drawn on the canvas&#44; the actual result will be a square&#46;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Changes the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;9"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) to the identity matrix&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;scale"></a><strong><code>scale&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If either of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Add the scaling transformation described by the arguments to the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;10"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix)&#46; The <var>x</var> argument represents the scale factor in the horizontal direction and the <var>y</var> argument represents the scale factor in the vertical direction&#46; The factors are multiples&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;rotate"></a><strong><code>rotate&#40;<var>angle</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>angle</var> is infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Add the rotation transformation described by the argument to the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;11"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix)&#46; The <var>angle</var> argument represents a clockwise rotation angle expressed in radians&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;translate"></a><strong><code>translate&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If either of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Add the translation transformation described by the arguments to the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;12"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix)&#46; The <var>x</var> argument represents the translation distance in the horizontal direction and the <var>y</var> argument represents the translation distance in the vertical direction&#46; The arguments are in coordinate space units&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;transform"></a><strong><code>transform&#40;<var>a</var>&#44; <var>b</var>&#44; <var>c</var>&#44; <var>d</var>&#44; <var>e</var>&#44; <var>f</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Replace the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;13"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) with the result of <a id="transformations&#58;matrix&#45;multiplication"></a>[multiplying](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-multiply) the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;14"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) with the matrix described by&#58;

    <table class="matrix"><tr><td><var>a</var></td><td><var>c</var></td><td><var>e</var></td></tr><tr><td><var>b</var></td><td><var>d</var></td><td><var>f</var></td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>1</td></tr></table>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The arguments <var>a</var>&#44; <var>b</var>&#44; <var>c</var>&#44; <var>d</var>&#44; <var>e</var>&#44; and <var>f</var> are sometimes called <var>m11</var>&#44; <var>m12</var>&#44; <var>m21</var>&#44; <var>m22</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; and <var>dy</var> or <var>m11</var>&#44; <var>m21</var>&#44; <var>m12</var>&#44; <var>m22</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; and <var>dy</var>&#46; Care ought to be taken in particular with the order of the second and third arguments &#40;<var>b</var> and <var>c</var>&#41; as their order varies from API to API and APIs sometimes use the notation <var>m12</var>&#47;<var>m21</var> and sometimes <var>m21</var>&#47;<var>m12</var> for those positions&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;gettransform"></a><strong><code>getTransform&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must return a newly created <a id="transformations&#58;dommatrix&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMMatrix](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dommatrix)</code> representing a copy of the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;15"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) matrix of the context&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This returned object is not live&#44; so updating it will not affect the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;16"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix)&#44; and updating the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;17"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) will not affect an already returned <a id="transformations&#58;dommatrix&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMMatrix](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#dommatrix)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;settransform"></a><strong><code>setTransform&#40;<var>a</var>&#44; <var>b</var>&#44; <var>c</var>&#44; <var>d</var>&#44; <var>e</var>&#44; <var>f</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Reset the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;18"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) to the matrix described by&#58;

    <table class="matrix"><tr><td><var>a</var></td><td><var>c</var></td><td><var>e</var></td></tr><tr><td><var>b</var></td><td><var>d</var></td><td><var>f</var></td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>1</td></tr></table>

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;settransform&#45;matrix"></a><strong><code>setTransform&#40;<var>transform</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>matrix</var> be the result of <a id="transformations&#58;create&#45;a&#45;dommatrix&#45;from&#45;a&#45;2d&#45;dictionary"></a>[creating a <code>DOMMatrix</code> from the 2D dictionary](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#create-a-dommatrix-from-the-2d-dictionary) <var>transform</var>&#46;

2.  If one or more of <var>matrix</var>&#39;s <a id="transformations&#58;m11&#45;element"></a>[m11 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m11-element)&#44; <a id="transformations&#58;m12&#45;element"></a>[m12 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m12-element)&#44; <a id="transformations&#58;m21&#45;element"></a>[m21 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m21-element)&#44; <a id="transformations&#58;m22&#45;element"></a>[m22 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m22-element)&#44; <a id="transformations&#58;m41&#45;element"></a>[m41 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m41-element)&#44; or <a id="transformations&#58;m42&#45;element"></a>[m42 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m42-element) are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Reset the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;19"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) to <var>matrix</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;resettransform"></a><strong><code>resetTransform&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must reset the <a id="transformations&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix&#45;20"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) to the identity matrix&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Given a matrix of the form created by the <a id="transformations&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;transform"></a><code>[transform&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-transform)</code> and <a id="transformations&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;settransform"></a><code>[setTransform&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-settransform)</code> methods&#44; i&#46;e&#46;&#44;

<table class="matrix"><tr><td><var>a</var></td><td><var>c</var></td><td><var>e</var></td></tr><tr><td><var>b</var></td><td><var>d</var></td><td><var>f</var></td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>1</td></tr></table>

the resulting transformed coordinates after transform matrix multiplication will be

<var>x</var><sub>new</sub> &#61; <var>a</var> <var>x</var> &#43; <var>c</var> <var>y</var> &#43; <var>e</var><br><var>y</var><sub>new</sub> &#61; <var>b</var> <var>x</var> &#43; <var>d</var> <var>y</var> &#43; <var>f</var>

###### <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;9 Image sources for 2D rendering contexts[](#image-sources-for-2d-rendering-contexts)

Some methods on the <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasdrawimage"></a><code>[CanvasDrawImage](#canvasdrawimage)</code> and <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasfillstrokestyles"></a><code>[CanvasFillStrokeStyles](#canvasfillstrokestyles)</code> interfaces take the union type <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> as an argument&#46;

This union type allows objects implementing any of the following interfaces to be used as image sources&#58;

- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlorsvgimageelement"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGImageElement](#htmlorsvgimageelement)</code> &#40;<a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> or <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;svg&#45;image"></a>[SVG <code>image</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-image) elements&#41;
- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlvideoelement"></a><code>[HTMLVideoElement](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#htmlvideoelement)</code> &#40;<a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code> elements&#41;
- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlcanvaselement"></a><code>[HTMLCanvasElement](#htmlcanvaselement)</code> &#40;<a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements&#41;
- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;offscreencanvas"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>
- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagebitmap"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code>
- <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;videoframe"></a><code>[VideoFrame](https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#videoframe-interface)</code>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Although not formally specified as such&#44; <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;svg&#45;image&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>image</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-image) elements are expected to be implemented nearly identical to <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> elements&#46; That is&#44; <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;svg&#45;image&#45;3"></a>[SVG <code>image</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-image) elements share the fundamental concepts and features of <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagebitmap&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> interface can be created from a number of other image&#45;representing types&#44; including <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagedata"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code>&#46;

To <a id="check&#45;the&#45;usability&#45;of&#45;the&#45;image&#45;argument"></a><strong>check the usability of the <var>image</var> argument</strong>&#44; where <var>image</var> is a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  Switch on <var>image</var>&#58;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlorsvgimageelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGImageElement](#htmlorsvgimageelement)</code></strong>

    If <var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;current&#45;request"></a>[current request](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#current-request)&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state"></a>[state](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#img-req-state) is <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;img&#45;error"></a>[broken](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#img-error)&#44; then throw an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    If <var>image</var> is not <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;img&#45;good"></a>[fully decodable](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#img-good)&#44; then return <em>bad</em>&#46;

    If <var>image</var> has a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) or <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) &#40;or both&#41; equal to zero&#44; then return <em>bad</em>&#46;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlvideoelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLVideoElement](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#htmlvideoelement)</code></strong>

    If <var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is either <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#dom-media-have_nothing)</code> or <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#dom-media-have_metadata)</code>&#44; then return <em>bad</em>&#46;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlcanvaselement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCanvasElement](#htmlcanvaselement)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code></strong>

    If <var>image</var> has either a horizontal dimension or a vertical dimension equal to zero&#44; then throw an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagebitmap&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;videoframe&#45;2"></a><code>[VideoFrame](https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#videoframe-interface)</code></strong>

    If <var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;detached"></a>[&#91;&#91;Detached&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#detached) internal slot value is set to true&#44; then throw an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Return <em>good</em>&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlorsvgimageelement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGImageElement](#htmlorsvgimageelement)</code>&#44; the element&#39;s image must be used as the source image&#46;

Specifically&#44; when a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an animated image in an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlorsvgimageelement&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGImageElement](#htmlorsvgimageelement)</code>&#44; the user agent must use the default image of the animation &#40;the one that the format defines is to be used when animation is not supported or is disabled&#41;&#44; or&#44; if there is no such image&#44; the first frame of the animation&#44; when rendering the image for <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> APIs&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlvideoelement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLVideoElement](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#htmlvideoelement)</code>&#44; then the frame at the <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#current-playback-position) when the method with the argument is invoked must be used as the source image when rendering the image for <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> APIs&#44; and the source image&#39;s dimensions must be the <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width"></a>[natural width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#concept-video-intrinsic-width) and <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height"></a>[natural height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#concept-video-intrinsic-height) of the <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#media-resource) &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; after any aspect&#45;ratio correction has been applied&#41;&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlcanvaselement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCanvasElement](#htmlcanvaselement)</code>&#44; the element&#39;s bitmap must be used as the source image&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;7"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an element that is <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) and that element has been resized&#44; the original image data of the source image must be used&#44; not the image as it is rendered &#40;e&#46;g&#46; <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes on the source element have no effect on how the object is interpreted when rendering the image for <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> APIs&#41;&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagebitmap&#45;4"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code>&#44; the object&#39;s bitmap image data must be used as the source image&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;9"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents an <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>&#44; the object&#39;s bitmap must be used as the source image&#46;

When a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;canvasimagesource&#45;10"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code> object represents a <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;videoframe&#45;3"></a><code>[VideoFrame](https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#videoframe-interface)</code>&#44; the object&#39;s pixel data must be used as the source image&#44; and the source image&#39;s dimensions must be the object&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;display&#45;width"></a>[&#91;&#91;display width&#93;&#93;](https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#dom-videoframe-display-width-slot) and <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;display&#45;height"></a>[&#91;&#91;display height&#93;&#93;](https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#dom-videoframe-display-height-slot)&#46;

An object <var>image</var> <a id="the&#45;image&#45;argument&#45;is&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a><strong>is not origin&#45;clean</strong> if&#44; switching on <var>image</var>&#39;s type&#58;

<strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlorsvgimageelement&#45;5"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGImageElement](#htmlorsvgimageelement)</code></strong>

<var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;current&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[current request](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#current-request)&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data"></a>[image data](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#img-req-data) is <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#46;

<strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlvideoelement&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLVideoElement](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#htmlvideoelement)</code></strong>

<var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#media-data) is <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#46;

<strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;htmlcanvaselement&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLCanvasElement](#htmlcanvaselement)</code></strong>

<strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;imagebitmap&#45;5"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code></strong>

<strong><a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;4"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code></strong>

<var>image</var>&#39;s bitmap&#39;s <a id="image&#45;sources&#45;for&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;contexts&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is false&#46;

###### <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;10 Fill and stroke styles[](#fill-and-stroke-styles)

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillstyle&#45;dev"></a>[fillStyle](#dom-context-2d-fillstyle) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;fillStyle](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/fillStyle)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#46;5&#43;Safari2&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the current style used for filling shapes&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#46;

The style can be either a string containing a CSS color&#44; or a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> or <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object&#46; Invalid values are ignored&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;strokestyle&#45;dev"></a>[strokeStyle](#dom-context-2d-strokestyle) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;strokeStyle](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/strokeStyle)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#46;5&#43;Safari2&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the current style used for stroking shapes&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style&#46;](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)

The style can be either a string containing a CSS color&#44; or a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> or <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object&#46; Invalid values are ignored&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasfillstrokestyles"></a><code>[CanvasFillStrokeStyles](#canvasfillstrokestyles)</code> interface have attributes and methods &#40;defined in this section&#41; that control how shapes are treated by the object&#46;

Such objects have associated <a id="concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a><strong>fill style</strong> and <a id="concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a><strong>stroke style</strong> values&#44; which are either CSS colors&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code>s&#44; or <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code>s&#46; Initially&#44; both must be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) the string &#34;<code>&#35;000000</code>&#34;&#46;

When the value is a CSS color&#44; it must not be affected by the transformation matrix when used to draw on bitmaps&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

When set to a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> or <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> object&#44; changes made to the object after the assignment do affect subsequent stroking or filling of shapes&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillstyle"></a><strong><code>fillStyle</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style&#45;2"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style) is a CSS color&#44; then return the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;serialisation&#45;of&#45;a&#45;color"></a>[serialization](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#serializing-color-values) of that color with <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;html&#45;compatible&#45;serialization&#45;is&#45;requested"></a>[HTML&#45;compatible serialization requested](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-serialization-html-compatible-serialization-is-requested)&#46;

2.  Return <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style&#45;3"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#46;

The <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillstyle"></a><code>[fillStyle](#dom-context-2d-fillstyle)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is a string&#58;

    1.  Let <var>context</var> be <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; if that is an element&#59; otherwise null&#46;

    2.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) the given value with <var>context</var> if non&#45;null&#46;

    3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

    4.  Set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style&#45;4"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style) to <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

    5.  Return&#46;

2.  If the given value is a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object that is marked as <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;pattern&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[not origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-pattern-not-origin-clean)&#44; then set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag to false&#46;

3.  Set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style&#45;5"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;strokestyle"></a><strong><code>strokeStyle</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style&#45;2"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style) is a CSS color&#44; then return the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;serialisation&#45;of&#45;a&#45;color&#45;2"></a>[serialization](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#serializing-color-values) of that color with <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;html&#45;compatible&#45;serialization&#45;is&#45;requested&#45;2"></a>[HTML&#45;compatible serialization requested](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-serialization-html-compatible-serialization-is-requested)&#46;

2.  Return <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style&#45;3"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)&#46;

The <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;strokestyle"></a><code>[strokeStyle](#dom-context-2d-strokestyle)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is a string&#58;

    1.  Let <var>context</var> be <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; if that is an element&#59; otherwise null&#46;

    2.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) the given value with <var>context</var> if non&#45;null&#46;

    3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

    4.  Set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style&#45;4"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style) to <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

    5.  Return&#46;

2.  If the given value is a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object that is marked as <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;pattern&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[not origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-pattern-not-origin-clean)&#44; then set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag to false&#46;

3.  Set <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style&#45;5"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style) to the given value&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are three types of gradients&#44; linear gradients&#44; radial gradients&#44; and conic gradients&#44; represented by objects implementing the opaque <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> interface&#46;

<a id="interpolation"></a>Once a gradient has been created &#40;see below&#41;&#44; stops are placed along it to define how the colors are distributed along the gradient&#46; The color of the gradient at each stop is the color specified for that stop&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;converting&#45;colors"></a>[converted](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) to the context&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#46; Between each such stop&#44; the colors and the alpha component must be linearly interpolated in the context&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;2"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) without premultiplying the alpha value to find the color to use at that offset&#46; Before the first stop&#44; the color must be the color of the first stop&#46; After the last stop&#44; the color must be the color of the last stop&#46; When there are no stops&#44; the gradient is <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

<strong><code><var>gradient</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;canvasgradient&#45;addcolorstop&#45;dev"></a>[addColorStop](#dom-canvasgradient-addcolorstop)&#40;<var>offset</var>&#44; <var>color</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

Throws an <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the offset is out of range&#46; Throws a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;syntaxerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the color cannot be parsed&#46;

<strong><code><var>gradient</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createradialgradient&#45;dev"></a>[createRadialGradient](#dom-context-2d-createradialgradient)&#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#44; <var>r0</var>&#44; <var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#44; <var>r1</var>&#41;</code></strong>

If either of the radii are negative&#44; throws an <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<strong><code><var>gradient</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createconicgradient&#45;dev"></a>[createConicGradient](#dom-context-2d-createconicgradient)&#40;<var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Returns a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> object that represents a conic gradient that paints clockwise along the rotation around the center represented by the arguments&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;canvasgradient&#45;addcolorstop"></a><strong><code>addColorStop&#40;<var>offset</var>&#44; <var>color</var>&#41;</code></strong> method on the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;9"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code>&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If the <var>offset</var> is less than 0 or greater than 1&#44; then throw an <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>parsed color</var> be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) <var>color</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    No element is passed to the parser because <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;10"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> objects are <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code>&#45;neutral — a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;11"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> object created by one <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> can be used by another&#44; and there is therefore no way to know which is the &#34;element in question&#34; at the time that the color is specified&#46;

3.  If <var>parsed color</var> is failure&#44; throw a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;syntaxerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  Place a new stop on the gradient&#44; at offset <var>offset</var> relative to the whole gradient&#44; and with the color <var>parsed color</var>&#46;

    If multiple stops are added at the same offset on a gradient&#44; then they must be placed in the order added&#44; with the first one closest to the start of the gradient&#44; and each subsequent one infinitesimally further along towards the end point &#40;in effect causing all but the first and last stop added at each point to be ignored&#41;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createlineargradient"></a><strong><code>createLinearGradient&#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#44; <var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41;</code></strong> method takes four arguments that represent the start point &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; and end point &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; of the gradient&#46; The method&#44; when invoked&#44; must return a linear <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;12"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> initialized with the specified line&#46;

Linear gradients must be rendered such that all points on a line perpendicular to the line that crosses the start and end points have the color at the point where those two lines cross &#40;with the colors coming from the [interpolation and extrapolation](#interpolation) described above&#41;&#46; The points in the linear gradient must be transformed as described by the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) when rendering&#46;

If <var>x0</var> &#61; <var>x1</var> and <var>y0</var> &#61; <var>y1</var>&#44; then the linear gradient must paint nothing&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createradialgradient"></a><strong><code>createRadialGradient&#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#44; <var>r0</var>&#44; <var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#44; <var>r1</var>&#41;</code></strong> method takes six arguments&#44; the first three representing the start circle with origin &#40;<var>x0</var>&#44; <var>y0</var>&#41; and radius <var>r0</var>&#44; and the last three representing the end circle with origin &#40;<var>x1</var>&#44; <var>y1</var>&#41; and radius <var>r1</var>&#46; The values are in coordinate space units&#46; If either of <var>r0</var> or <var>r1</var> are negative&#44; then an <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> must be thrown&#46; Otherwise&#44; the method&#44; when invoked&#44; must return a radial <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;13"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> initialized with the two specified circles&#46;

Radial gradients must be rendered by following these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>x<sub>0</sub></var> &#61; <var>x<sub>1</sub></var> and <var>y<sub>0</sub></var> &#61; <var>y<sub>1</sub></var> and <var>r<sub>0</sub></var> &#61; <var>r<sub>1</sub></var>&#44; then the radial gradient must paint nothing&#46; Return&#46;

2.  Let x&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41; &#61; &#40;<var>x<sub>1</sub></var>&#45;<var>x<sub>0</sub></var>&#41;<var>ω</var> &#43; <var>x<sub>0</sub></var>&#46;

    Let y&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41; &#61; &#40;<var>y<sub>1</sub></var>&#45;<var>y<sub>0</sub></var>&#41;<var>ω</var> &#43; <var>y<sub>0</sub></var>&#46;

    Let r&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41; &#61; &#40;<var>r<sub>1</sub></var>&#45;<var>r<sub>0</sub></var>&#41;<var>ω</var> &#43; <var>r<sub>0</sub></var>&#46;

    Let the color at <var>ω</var> be the color at that position on the gradient &#40;with the colors coming from the [interpolation and extrapolation](#interpolation) described above&#41;&#46;

3.  For all values of <var>ω</var> where r&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41; &#62; 0&#44; starting with the value of <var>ω</var> nearest to positive infinity and ending with the value of <var>ω</var> nearest to negative infinity&#44; draw the circumference of the circle with radius r&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41; at position &#40;x&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41;&#44; y&#40;<var>ω</var>&#41;&#41;&#44; with the color at <var>ω</var>&#44; but only painting on the parts of the bitmap that have not yet been painted on by earlier circles in this step for this rendering of the gradient&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This effectively creates a cone&#44; touched by the two circles defined in the creation of the gradient&#44; with the part of the cone before the start circle &#40;0&#46;0&#41; using the color of the first offset&#44; the part of the cone after the end circle &#40;1&#46;0&#41; using the color of the last offset&#44; and areas outside the cone untouched by the gradient &#40;<a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#41;&#46;

The resulting radial gradient must then be transformed as described by the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transformations&#45;2"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) when rendering&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createconicgradient"></a><strong><code>createConicGradient&#40;<var>startAngle</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method takes three arguments&#44; the first argument&#44; <var>startAngle</var>&#44; represents the angle in radians at which the gradient begins&#44; and the last two arguments&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; represent the center of the gradient in <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; The method&#44; when invoked&#44; must return a conic <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;14"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> initialized with the specified center and angle&#46;

It follows the same rendering rule as CSS <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;&#39;conic&#45;gradient&#39;"></a>[&#39;conic&#45;gradient&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images-4/#funcdef-conic-gradient) and it is equivalent to CSS &#39;conic&#45;gradient&#40;from <var>adjustedStartAngle</var>rad at <var>x</var>px <var>y</var>px&#44; <var>angularColorStopList</var>&#41;&#39;&#46; Here&#58;

- <var>adjustedStartAngle</var> is given by <var>startAngle</var> &#43; π&#47;2&#59;

- <var>angularColorStopList</var> is given by the color stops that have been added to the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvasgradient&#45;15"></a><code>[CanvasGradient](#canvasgradient)</code> using <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;canvasgradient&#45;addcolorstop"></a><code>[addColorStop&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvasgradient-addcolorstop)</code>&#44; with the color stop offsets interpreted as percentages&#46;

Gradients must be painted only where the relevant stroking or filling effects requires that they be drawn&#46;

<strong><code><var>pattern</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createpattern&#45;dev"></a>[createPattern](#dom-context-2d-createpattern)&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>repetition</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;8"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object that uses the given image and repeats in the direction&#40;s&#41; given by the <var>repetition</var> argument&#46;

The allowed values for <var>repetition</var> are <code>repeat</code> &#40;both directions&#41;&#44; <code>repeat&#45;x</code> &#40;horizontal only&#41;&#44; <code>repeat&#45;y</code> &#40;vertical only&#41;&#44; and <code>no&#45;repeat</code> &#40;neither&#41;&#46; If the <var>repetition</var> argument is empty&#44; the value <code>repeat</code> is used&#46;

If the image isn&#39;t yet fully decoded&#44; then nothing is drawn&#46; If the image is a canvas with no data&#44; throws an <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<strong><code><var>pattern</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;canvaspattern&#45;settransform&#45;dev"></a>[setTransform](#dom-canvaspattern-settransform)&#40;<var>transform</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasPattern&#47;setTransform](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasPattern/setTransform)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox33&#43;Safari11&#46;1&#43;Chrome68&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Sets the transformation matrix that will be used when rendering the pattern during a fill or stroke painting operation&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createpattern"></a><strong><code>createPattern&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>repetition</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>usability</var> be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;check&#45;the&#45;usability&#45;of&#45;the&#45;image&#45;argument"></a>[checking the usability of](#check-the-usability-of-the-image-argument) <var>image</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>usability</var> is <em>bad</em>&#44; then return null&#46;

3.  <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>usability</var> is <em>good</em>&#46;

4.  If <var>repetition</var> is the empty string&#44; then set it to &#34;<code>repeat</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  If <var>repetition</var> is not <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) one of &#34;<code>repeat</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>repeat&#45;x</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>repeat&#45;y</code>&#34;&#44; or &#34;<code>no&#45;repeat</code>&#34;&#44; then throw a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;syntaxerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

6.  Let <var>pattern</var> be a new <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;9"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object with the image <var>image</var> and the repetition behavior given by <var>repetition</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>image</var> <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;the&#45;image&#45;argument&#45;is&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[is not origin&#45;clean](#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean)&#44; then mark <var>pattern</var> as <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;pattern&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a><strong>not origin&#45;clean</strong>&#46;

8.  Return <var>pattern</var>&#46;

Modifying the <var>image</var> used when creating a <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;10"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object after calling the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createpattern"></a><code>[createPattern&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-createpattern)</code> method must not affect the pattern&#40;s&#41; rendered by the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;canvaspattern&#45;11"></a><code>[CanvasPattern](#canvaspattern)</code> object&#46;

Patterns have a transformation matrix&#44; which controls how the pattern is used when it is painted&#46; Initially&#44; a pattern&#39;s transformation matrix must be the identity matrix&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;canvaspattern&#45;settransform"></a><strong><code>setTransform&#40;<var>transform</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>matrix</var> be the result of <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;create&#45;a&#45;dommatrix&#45;from&#45;a&#45;2d&#45;dictionary"></a>[creating a <code>DOMMatrix</code> from the 2D dictionary](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#create-a-dommatrix-from-the-2d-dictionary) <var>transform</var>&#46;

2.  If one or more of <var>matrix</var>&#39;s <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m11&#45;element"></a>[m11 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m11-element)&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m12&#45;element"></a>[m12 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m12-element)&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m21&#45;element"></a>[m21 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m21-element)&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m22&#45;element"></a>[m22 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m22-element)&#44; <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m41&#45;element"></a>[m41 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m41-element)&#44; or <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;m42&#45;element"></a>[m42 element](https://drafts.csswg.org/geometry/#matrix-m42-element) are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Reset the pattern&#39;s transformation matrix to <var>matrix</var>&#46;

When a pattern is to be rendered within an area&#44; the user agent must run the following steps to determine what is rendered&#58;

1.  Create an infinite <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;3"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap&#46;

2.  Place a copy of the image on the bitmap&#44; anchored such that its top left corner is at the origin of the coordinate space&#44; with one coordinate space unit per <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixel](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) of the image&#44; then place repeated copies of this image horizontally to the left and right&#44; if the repetition behavior is &#34;<code>repeat&#45;x</code>&#34;&#44; or vertically up and down&#44; if the repetition behavior is &#34;<code>repeat&#45;y</code>&#34;&#44; or in all four directions all over the bitmap&#44; if the repetition behavior is &#34;<code>repeat</code>&#34;&#46;

    If the original image data is a bitmap image&#44; then the value painted at a point in the area of the repetitions is computed by filtering the original image data&#46; When scaling up&#44; if the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingenabled"></a><code>[imageSmoothingEnabled](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingenabled)</code> attribute is set to false&#44; then the image must be rendered using nearest&#45;neighbor interpolation&#46; Otherwise&#44; the user agent may use any filtering algorithm &#40;for example bilinear interpolation or nearest&#45;neighbor&#41;&#46; User agents which support multiple filtering algorithms may use the value of the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality"></a><code>[imageSmoothingQuality](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingquality)</code> attribute to guide the choice of filtering algorithm&#46; When such a filtering algorithm requires a pixel value from outside the original image data&#44; it must instead use the value from wrapping the pixel&#39;s coordinates to the original image&#39;s dimensions&#46; &#40;That is&#44; the filter uses &#39;repeat&#39; behavior&#44; regardless of the value of the pattern&#39;s repetition behavior&#46;&#41;

3.  Transform the resulting bitmap according to the pattern&#39;s transformation matrix&#46;

4.  Transform the resulting bitmap again&#44; this time according to the <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transformations&#45;3"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations)&#46;

5.  Replace any part of the image outside the area in which the pattern is to be rendered with <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;4"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

6.  The resulting bitmap is what is to be rendered&#44; with the same origin and same scale&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a radial gradient or repeated pattern is used when the transformation matrix is singular&#44; then the resulting style must be <a id="fill&#45;and&#45;stroke&#45;styles&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;5"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) &#40;otherwise the gradient or pattern would be collapsed to a point or line&#44; leaving the other pixels undefined&#41;&#46; Linear gradients and solid colors always define all points even with singular transformation matrices&#46;

###### <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;11 Drawing rectangles to the bitmap[](#drawing-rectangles-to-the-bitmap)

Objects that implement the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvasrect"></a><code>[CanvasRect](#canvasrect)</code> interface provide the following methods for immediately drawing rectangles to the bitmap&#46; The methods each take four arguments&#59; the first two give the <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> coordinates of the top left of the rectangle&#44; and the second two give the width <var>w</var> and height <var>h</var> of the rectangle&#44; respectively&#46;

The <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) must be applied to the following four coordinates&#44; which form the path that must then be closed to get the specified rectangle&#58; &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#46;

Shapes are painted without affecting the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#44; and are subject to the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#44; and&#44; with the exception of <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clearrect"></a><code>[clearRect&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-clearrect)</code>&#44; also <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow effects](#shadows)&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; and the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clearrect&#45;dev"></a>[clearRect](#dom-context-2d-clearrect)&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong>
