Paints the box that outlines the given rectangle onto the bitmap&#44; using the current stroke style&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clearrect"></a><strong><code>clearRect&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>pixels</var> be the set of pixels in the specified rectangle that also intersect the current <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;clipping&#45;region&#45;2"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#46;

3.  Clear the pixels in <var>pixels</var> to a <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#44; erasing any previous image&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If either height or width are zero&#44; this method has no effect&#44; since the set of pixels would be empty&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillrect"></a><strong><code>fillRect&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If either <var>w</var> or <var>h</var> are zero&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Paint the specified rectangular area using <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;strokerect"></a><strong><code>strokeRect&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>w</var>&#44; <var>h</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Take the result of <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path"></a>[tracing the path](#trace-a-path) described below&#44; using the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> interface&#39;s line styles&#44; and fill it with <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)&#46;

If both <var>w</var> and <var>h</var> are zero&#44; the path has a single subpath with just one point &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; and no lines&#44; and this method thus has no effect &#40;the <a id="drawing&#45;rectangles&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[trace a path](#trace-a-path) algorithm returns an empty path in that case&#41;&#46;

If just one of either <var>w</var> or <var>h</var> is zero&#44; then the path has a single subpath consisting of two points&#44; with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; and &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; in that order&#44; connected by a single straight line&#46;

Otherwise&#44; the path has a single subpath consisting of four points&#44; with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>x</var>&#43;<var>w</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; and &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>h</var>&#41;&#44; connected to each other in that order by straight lines&#46;

Returns the measurement described below&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvastext"></a><code>[CanvasText](#canvastext)</code> interface provide the following methods for rendering text&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filltext"></a><strong><code>fillText&#40;<var>text</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>maxWidth</var>&#41;</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroketext"></a><strong><code>strokeText&#40;<var>text</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>maxWidth</var>&#41;</code></strong> methods render the given <var>text</var> at the given &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; coordinates ensuring that the text isn&#39;t wider than <var>maxWidth</var> if specified&#44; using the current <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;font"></a><code>[font](#dom-context-2d-font)</code>&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code>&#44; and <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> values&#46; Specifically&#44; when the methods are invoked&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Run the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm"></a>[text preparation algorithm](#text-preparation-algorithm)&#44; passing it <var>text</var>&#44; the object implementing the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvastext&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasText](#canvastext)</code> interface&#44; and&#44; if the <var>maxWidth</var> argument was provided&#44; that argument&#46; Let <var>glyphs</var> be the result&#46;

3.  Move all the shapes in <var>glyphs</var> to the right by <var>x</var> <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) and down by <var>y</var> <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

4.  Paint the shapes given in <var>glyphs</var>&#44; as transformed by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations)&#44; with each <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixel](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) in the coordinate space of <var>glyphs</var> mapped to one coordinate space unit&#46;

    For <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filltext"></a><code>[fillText&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-filltext)</code>&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style) must be applied to the shapes and <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style) must be ignored&#46; For <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroketext"></a><code>[strokeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-stroketext)</code>&#44; the reverse holds&#58; <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style&#45;2"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style) must be applied to the result of <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path"></a>[tracing](#trace-a-path) the shapes using the object implementing the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvastext&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasText](#canvastext)</code> interface for the line styles&#44; and <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style&#45;2"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style) must be ignored&#46;

    These shapes are painted without affecting the current path&#44; and are subject to <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow effects](#shadows)&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#44; and the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

<a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;tracking&#45;vector"></a>[![&#40;This is a tracking vector&#46;&#41;](https://resources.whatwg.org/tracking-vector.svg)](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tracking-vector) The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;measuretext"></a><strong><code>measureText&#40;<var>text</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;text&#45;preparation&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[text preparation algorithm](#text-preparation-algorithm)&#44; passing it <var>text</var> and the object implementing the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;canvastext&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasText](#canvastext)</code> interface&#44; and then using the returned <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box) return a new <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;textmetrics&#45;2"></a><code>[TextMetrics](#textmetrics)</code> object with members behaving as described in the following list&#58; [&#91;CSS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSS)

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The width of that <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;2"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; &#40;The text&#39;s advance width&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxleft"></a><strong><code>actualBoundingBoxLeft</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance parallel to the baseline from the alignment point given by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;2"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> attribute to the left side of the bounding rectangle of the given text&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;5"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going left from the given alignment point&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The sum of this value and the next &#40;<a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxright"></a><code>[actualBoundingBoxRight](#dom-textmetrics-actualboundingboxright)</code>&#41; can be wider than the width of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;3"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box) &#40;<a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#dom-textmetrics-width)</code>&#41;&#44; in particular with slanted fonts where characters overhang their advance width&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxright"></a><strong><code>actualBoundingBoxRight</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance parallel to the baseline from the alignment point given by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textalign&#45;3"></a><code>[textAlign](#dom-context-2d-textalign)</code> attribute to the right side of the bounding rectangle of the given text&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;6"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going right from the given alignment point&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;fontboundingboxascent"></a><strong><code>fontBoundingBoxAscent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;2"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;ascent&#45;metric"></a>[ascent metric](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ascent-metric) of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;7"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going up from the given baseline&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This value and the next are useful when rendering a background that have to have a consistent height even if the exact text being rendered changes&#46; The <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxascent"></a><code>[actualBoundingBoxAscent](#dom-textmetrics-actualboundingboxascent)</code> attribute &#40;and its corresponding attribute for the descent&#41; are useful when drawing a bounding box around specific text&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;fontboundingboxdescent"></a><strong><code>fontBoundingBoxDescent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;3"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;descent&#45;metric"></a>[descent metric](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#descent-metric) of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;first&#45;available&#45;font&#45;2"></a>[first available font](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#first-available-font)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;8"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going down from the given baseline&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxascent"></a><strong><code>actualBoundingBoxAscent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;4"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the top of the bounding rectangle of the given text&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;9"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going up from the given baseline&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This number can vary greatly based on the input text&#44; even if the first font specified covers all the characters in the input&#46; For example&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxascent&#45;2"></a><code>[actualBoundingBoxAscent](#dom-textmetrics-actualboundingboxascent)</code> of a lowercase &#34;o&#34; from an <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline) would be less than that of an uppercase &#34;F&#34;&#46; The value can easily be negative&#59; for example&#44; the distance from the top of the em box &#40;<a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;5"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> value &#34;<a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;top"></a><code>[top](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-top)</code>&#34;&#41; to the top of the bounding rectangle when the given text is just a single comma &#34;<code>&#44;</code>&#34; would likely &#40;unless the font is quite unusual&#41; be negative&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;actualboundingboxdescent"></a><strong><code>actualBoundingBoxDescent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;6"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the bottom of the bounding rectangle of the given text&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;10"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating a distance going down from the given baseline&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;emheightascent"></a><strong><code>emHeightAscent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;7"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline) in the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;4"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;11"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating that the given baseline is below the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline) &#40;so this value will usually be positive&#41;&#46; Zero if the given baseline is the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline&#45;3"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline)&#59; half the font size if the given baseline is halfway between the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;over&#45;baseline&#45;4"></a>[em&#45;over baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-over-baseline) and the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline)&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;emheightdescent"></a><strong><code>emHeightDescent</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;8"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline) in the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;5"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;12"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating that the given baseline is above the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;3"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline)&#46; &#40;Zero if the given baseline is the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;em&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;4"></a>[em&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#em-under-baseline)&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;hangingbaseline"></a><strong><code>hangingBaseline</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;9"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;hanging&#45;baseline"></a>[hanging baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#hanging-baseline) of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;6"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;13"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating that the given baseline is below the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;hanging&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[hanging baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#hanging-baseline)&#46; &#40;Zero if the given baseline is the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;hanging&#45;baseline&#45;3"></a>[hanging baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#hanging-baseline)&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;alphabeticbaseline"></a><strong><code>alphabeticBaseline</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;10"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline) of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;7"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;14"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating that the given baseline is below the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline&#45;3"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline)&#46; &#40;Zero if the given baseline is the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;alphabetic&#45;baseline&#45;4"></a>[alphabetic baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#alphabetic-baseline)&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;textmetrics&#45;ideographicbaseline"></a><strong><code>ideographicBaseline</code></strong> attribute</strong>

The distance from the horizontal line indicated by the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;textbaseline&#45;11"></a><code>[textBaseline](#dom-context-2d-textbaseline)</code> attribute to the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;ideographic&#45;under&#45;baseline"></a>[ideographic&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline) of the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;inline&#45;box&#45;8"></a>[inline box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#inline-box)&#44; in <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;15"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#59; positive numbers indicating that the given baseline is below the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;ideographic&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;2"></a>[ideographic&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline)&#46; &#40;Zero if the given baseline is the <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;ideographic&#45;under&#45;baseline&#45;3"></a>[ideographic&#45;under baseline](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline)&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Glyphs rendered using <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filltext&#45;2"></a><code>[fillText&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-filltext)</code> and <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroketext&#45;2"></a><code>[strokeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-stroketext)</code> can spill out of the box given by the font size and the width returned by <a id="drawing&#45;text&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;measuretext"></a><code>[measureText&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-measuretext)</code> &#40;the text width&#41;&#46; Authors are encouraged to use the bounding box values described above if this is an issue&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

A future version of the 2D context API might provide a way to render fragments of documents&#44; rendered using CSS&#44; straight to the canvas&#46; This would be provided in preference to a dedicated way of doing multiline layout&#46;

###### <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;13 Drawing paths to the canvas[](#drawing-paths-to-the-canvas)

Objects that implement the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> interface have a <a id="current&#45;default&#45;path"></a><strong>current default path</strong>&#46; There is only one <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#44; it is not part of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;drawing&#45;state"></a>[drawing state](#drawing-state)&#46; The <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) is a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;concept&#45;path"></a>[path](#concept-path)&#44; as described above&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;beginpath&#45;dev"></a>[beginPath](#dom-context-2d-beginpath)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ispointinstroke"></a>[isPointInStroke](#dom-context-2d-ispointinstroke)&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns true if the given point would be in the region covered by the stroke of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;8"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) or the given path&#44; given the current stroke style&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;beginpath"></a><strong><code>beginPath&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to empty the list of subpaths in <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;9"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) so that it once again has zero subpaths&#46;

Where the following method definitions use the term <a id="intended&#45;path"></a><strong>intended path</strong> for a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; it means <var>path</var> itself if it is a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;2"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object&#44; or the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;10"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) otherwise&#46;

When the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) is a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;3"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object&#44; the coordinates and lines of its subpaths must be transformed according to the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;transformations"></a> [current transformation matrix](#transformations) on the object implementing the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvastransform"></a><code>[CanvasTransform](#canvastransform)</code> interface when used by these methods &#40;without affecting the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;4"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> object itself&#41;&#46; When the intended path is the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;11"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#44; it is not affected by the transform&#46; &#40;This is because transformations already affect the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;12"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) when it is constructed&#44; so applying it when it is painted as well would result in a double transformation&#46;&#41;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fill"></a><strong><code>fill&#40;<var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;steps"></a>[fill steps](#fill-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; null&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fill&#45;path"></a><strong><code>fill&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[fill steps](#fill-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>path</var>&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="fill&#45;steps"></a><strong>fill steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> <var>context</var>&#44; a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;5"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; and a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) <var>fillRule</var>&#44; are to fill all the subpaths of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) for <var>path</var>&#44; using <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#44; and using the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule&#45;2"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) indicated by <var>fillRule</var>&#46; Open subpaths must be implicitly closed when being filled &#40;without affecting the actual subpaths&#41;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroke"></a><strong><code>stroke&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;stroke&#45;steps"></a>[stroke steps](#stroke-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and null&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;stroke&#45;path"></a><strong><code>stroke&#40;<var>path</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;stroke&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[stroke steps](#stroke-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and <var>path</var>&#46;

The <a id="stroke&#45;steps"></a><strong>stroke steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> <var>context</var> and a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;6"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; are to <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path"></a>[trace](#trace-a-path) the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path&#45;3"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) for <var>path</var>&#44; using <var>context</var>&#39;s line styles as set by its <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> mixin&#44; and then fill the resulting path using <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)&#44; using the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillrule&#45;nonzero"></a>[nonzero winding rule](#dom-context-2d-fillrule-nonzero)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

As a result of how the algorithm to <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[trace a path](#trace-a-path) is defined&#44; overlapping parts of the paths in one stroke operation are treated as if their union was what was painted&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The stroke <em>style</em> is affected by the transformation during painting&#44; even if the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;13"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) is used&#46;

Paths&#44; when filled or stroked&#44; must be painted without affecting the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;14"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path) or any <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;7"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code> objects&#44; and must be subject to <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow effects](#shadows)&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#44; and the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46; &#40;The effect of transformations is described above and varies based on which path is being used&#46;&#41;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clip"></a><strong><code>clip&#40;<var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;clip&#45;steps"></a>[clip steps](#clip-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; null&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;clip&#45;path"></a><strong><code>clip&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to run the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;clip&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[clip steps](#clip-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>path</var>&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="clip&#45;steps"></a><strong>clip steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath&#45;4"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> <var>context</var>&#44; a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;8"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; and a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule&#45;3"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) <var>fillRule</var>&#44; are to create a new <a id="clipping&#45;region"></a><strong>clipping region</strong> by calculating the intersection of <var>context</var>&#39;s current clipping region and the area described by the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path&#45;4"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) for <var>path</var>&#44; using the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule&#45;4"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) indicated by <var>fillRule</var>&#46; Open subpaths must be implicitly closed when computing the clipping region&#44; without affecting the actual subpaths&#46; The new clipping region replaces the current clipping region&#46;

When the context is initialized&#44; its current clipping region must be set to the largest infinite surface &#40;i&#46;e&#46; by default&#44; no clipping occurs&#41;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ispointinpath"></a><strong><code>isPointInPath&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return the result of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;path&#45;steps"></a>[is point in path steps](#is-point-in-path-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; null&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ispointinpath&#45;path"></a><strong><code>isPointInPath&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; <var>fillRule</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return the result of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;path&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[is point in path steps](#is-point-in-path-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>path</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#44; and <var>fillRule</var>&#46;

The <a id="is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;path&#45;steps"></a><strong>is point in path steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath&#45;5"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> <var>context</var>&#44; a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;9"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; two numbers <var>x</var> and <var>y</var>&#44; and a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule&#45;5"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) <var>fillRule</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>x</var> or <var>y</var> are infinite or NaN&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  If the point given by the <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> coordinates&#44; when treated as coordinates in the canvas coordinate space unaffected by the current transformation&#44; is inside the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path&#45;5"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) for <var>path</var> as determined by the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;fill&#45;rule&#45;6"></a>[fill rule](#fill-rule) indicated by <var>fillRule</var>&#44; then return true&#46; Open subpaths must be implicitly closed when computing the area inside the path&#44; without affecting the actual subpaths&#46; Points on the path itself must be considered to be inside the path&#46;

3.  Return false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ispointinstroke"></a><strong><code>isPointInStroke&#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return the result of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;stroke&#45;steps"></a>[is point in stroke steps](#is-point-in-stroke-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; null&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; and <var>y</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;ispointinstroke&#45;path"></a><strong><code>isPointInStroke&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return the result of the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;stroke&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[is point in stroke steps](#is-point-in-stroke-steps) given <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>path</var>&#44; <var>x</var>&#44; and <var>y</var>&#46;

The <a id="is&#45;point&#45;in&#45;stroke&#45;steps"></a><strong>is point in stroke steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvasdrawpath&#45;6"></a><code>[CanvasDrawPath](#canvasdrawpath)</code> <var>context</var>&#44; a <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;path2d&#45;10"></a><code>[Path2D](#path2d)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <var>path</var>&#44; and two numbers <var>x</var> and <var>y</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>x</var> or <var>y</var> are infinite or NaN&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  If the point given by the <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> coordinates&#44; when treated as coordinates in the canvas coordinate space unaffected by the current transformation&#44; is inside the path that results from <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;trace&#45;a&#45;path&#45;3"></a>[tracing](#trace-a-path) the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;intended&#45;path&#45;6"></a>[intended path](#intended-path) for <var>path</var>&#44; using the <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;fillrule&#45;nonzero&#45;2"></a>[nonzero winding rule](#dom-context-2d-fillrule-nonzero)&#44; and using <var>context</var>&#39;s line styles as set by its <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code> mixin&#44; then return true&#46; Points on the resulting path must be considered to be inside the path&#46;

3.  Return false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a id="drawCustomFocusRingExample"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#drawCustomFocusRingExample)

This <a id="drawing&#45;paths&#45;to&#45;the&#45;canvas&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element has a couple of checkboxes&#46; The path&#45;related commands are highlighted&#58;

``` text
<canvas height=400 width=750>
 <label><input type=checkbox id=showA> Show As</label>
 <label><input type=checkbox id=showB> Show Bs</label>
 <!-- ... -->
</canvas>
<script>
 function drawCheckbox(context, element, x, y, paint) {
   context.save();
   context.font = '10px sans-serif';
   context.textAlign = 'left';
   context.textBaseline = 'middle';
   var metrics = context.measureText(element.labels[0].textContent);
   if (paint) {
     context.beginPath();
     context.strokeStyle = 'black';
     context.rect(x-5, y-5, 10, 10);
     context.stroke();
     if (element.checked) {
       context.fillStyle = 'black';
       context.fill();
     }
     context.fillText(element.labels[0].textContent, x+5, y);
   }
   context.beginPath();
   context.rect(x-7, y-7, 12 + metrics.width+2, 14);

   context.drawFocusIfNeeded(element);
   context.restore();
 }
 function drawBase() { /* ... */ }
 function drawAs() { /* ... */ }
 function drawBs() { /* ... */ }
 function redraw() {
   var canvas = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
   var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   drawCheckbox(context, document.getElementById('showA'), 20, 40, true);
   drawCheckbox(context, document.getElementById('showB'), 20, 60, true);
   drawBase();
   if (document.getElementById('showA').checked)
     drawAs();
   if (document.getElementById('showB').checked)
     drawBs();
 }
 function processClick(event) {
   var canvas = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
   var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   var x = event.clientX;
   var y = event.clientY;
   var node = event.target;
   while (node) {
     x -= node.offsetLeft - node.scrollLeft;
     y -= node.offsetTop - node.scrollTop;
     node = node.offsetParent;
   }
   drawCheckbox(context, document.getElementById('showA'), 20, 40, false);
   if (context.isPointInPath(x, y))
     document.getElementById('showA').checked = !(document.getElementById('showA').checked);
   drawCheckbox(context, document.getElementById('showB'), 20, 60, false);
   if (context.isPointInPath(x, y))
     document.getElementById('showB').checked = !(document.getElementById('showB').checked);
   redraw();
 }
 document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].addEventListener('focus', redraw, true);
 document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].addEventListener('blur', redraw, true);
 document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].addEventListener('change', redraw, true);
 document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].addEventListener('click', processClick, false);
 redraw();
</script>
```

###### <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;14 Drawing focus rings[](#drawing-focus-rings-and-scrolling-paths-into-view)

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawfocusifneeded&#45;dev"></a>[drawFocusIfNeeded](#dom-context-2d-drawfocusifneeded)&#40;<var>element</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;drawFocusIfNeeded](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/drawFocusIfNeeded)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox32&#43;Safari8&#43;Chrome37&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;14&#43;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

If <var>element</var> is <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused)&#44; draws a focus ring around the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#44; following the platform conventions for focus rings&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawfocusifneeded&#45;path&#45;element&#45;dev"></a>[drawFocusIfNeeded](#dom-context-2d-drawfocusifneeded-path-element)&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>element</var>&#41;</code></strong>

If <var>element</var> is <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;focused&#45;2"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused)&#44; draws a focus ring around <var>path</var>&#44; following the platform conventions for focus rings&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;canvasuserinterface"></a><code>[CanvasUserInterface](#canvasuserinterface)</code> interface provide the following methods to draw focus rings&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawosfocusring"></a>The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawfocusifneeded"></a><strong><code>drawFocusIfNeeded&#40;<var>element</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;draw&#45;focus&#45;if&#45;needed"></a>[draw focus if needed](#draw-focus-if-needed) given <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>element</var>&#44; and <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;current&#45;default&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[current default path](#current-default-path)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawfocusifneeded&#45;path&#45;element"></a><strong><code>drawFocusIfNeeded&#40;<var>path</var>&#44; <var>element</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;draw&#45;focus&#45;if&#45;needed&#45;2"></a>[draw focus if needed](#draw-focus-if-needed) given <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>element</var>&#44; and <var>path</var>&#46;

To <a id="draw&#45;focus&#45;if&#45;needed"></a><strong>draw focus if needed</strong>&#44; given an object implementing <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;canvasuserinterface&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasUserInterface](#canvasuserinterface)</code> <var>context</var>&#44; an element <var>element</var>&#44; and a <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;concept&#45;path"></a>[path](#concept-path) <var>path</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;focused&#45;3"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) or is not a descendant of <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Draw a focus ring of the appropriate style along <var>path</var>&#44; following platform conventions&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Some platforms only draw focus rings around elements that have been focused from the keyboard&#44; and not those focused from the mouse&#46; Other platforms simply don&#39;t draw focus rings around some elements at all unless relevant accessibility features are enabled&#46; This API is intended to follow these conventions&#46; User agents that implement distinctions based on the manner in which the element was focused are encouraged to classify focus driven by the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;dom&#45;focus"></a><code>[focus&#40;&#41;](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#dom-focus)</code> method based on the kind of user interaction event from which the call was triggered &#40;if any&#41;&#46;

    The focus ring should not be subject to the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow effects](#shadows)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;fill&#45;style"></a>[fill style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-fill-style)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;concept&#45;canvasfillstrokestyles&#45;stroke&#45;style"></a>[stroke style](#concept-canvasfillstrokestyles-stroke-style)&#44; or any of the members in the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;canvaspathdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasPathDrawingStyles](#canvaspathdrawingstyles)</code>&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;canvastextdrawingstyles"></a><code>[CanvasTextDrawingStyles](#canvastextdrawingstyles)</code> interfaces&#44; but <em>should</em> be subject to the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#46; &#40;The effect of transformations is described above and varies based on which path is being used&#46;&#41;

3.  [Inform the user](#inform) that the focus is at the location given by the intended path&#46; User agents may wait until the next time the <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reaches its <a id="drawing&#45;focus&#45;rings&#45;and&#45;scrolling&#45;paths&#45;into&#45;view&#58;update&#45;the&#45;rendering"></a>[update the rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#update-the-rendering) step to optionally inform the user&#46;

User agents should not implicitly close open subpaths in the intended path when drawing the focus ring&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This might be a moot point&#44; however&#46; For example&#44; if the focus ring is drawn as an axis&#45;aligned bounding rectangle around the points in the intended path&#44; then whether the subpaths are closed or not has no effect&#46; This specification intentionally does not specify precisely how focus rings are to be drawn&#58; user agents are expected to honor their platform&#39;s native conventions&#46;

<a id="inform"></a>&#34;Inform the user&#34;&#44; as used in this section&#44; does not imply any persistent state change&#46; It could mean&#44; for instance&#44; calling a system accessibility API to notify assistive technologies such as magnification tools so that the user&#39;s magnifier moves to the given area of the canvas&#46; However&#44; it does not associate the path with the element&#44; or provide a region for tactile feedback&#44; etc&#46;

###### <a id="drawing&#45;images"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;15 Drawing images[](#drawing-images)

Objects that implement the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;canvasdrawimage"></a><code>[CanvasDrawImage](#canvasdrawimage)</code> interface have the <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><strong><code>drawImage&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method to draw images&#46;

This method can be invoked with three different sets of arguments&#58;

- <code>drawImage&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#41;</code>
- <code>drawImage&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dh</var>&#41;</code>
- <code>drawImage&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#44; <var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dh</var>&#41;</code>

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage&#45;dev"></a>[drawImage](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;drawImage](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/drawImage)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#46;5&#43;Safari2&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera9&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a>[drawImage](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dh</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage&#45;2"></a>[drawImage](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)&#40;<var>image</var>&#44; <var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#44; <var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dh</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Draws the given image onto the canvas&#46; The arguments are interpreted as follows&#58;

![The sx and sy parameters give the x and y coordinates of the source rectangle&#59; the sw and sh arguments give the width and height of the source rectangle&#59; the dx and dy give the x and y coordinates of the destination rectangle&#59; and the dw and dh arguments give the width and height of the destination rectangle&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/drawImage.png)

If the image isn&#39;t yet fully decoded&#44; then nothing is drawn&#46; If the image is a canvas with no data&#44; throws an <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

When the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage&#45;3"></a><code>[drawImage&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code> method is invoked&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

1.  If any of the arguments are infinite or NaN&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Let <var>usability</var> be the result of <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;check&#45;the&#45;usability&#45;of&#45;the&#45;image&#45;argument"></a>[checking the usability of <var>image</var>](#check-the-usability-of-the-image-argument)&#46;

3.  If <var>usability</var> is <em>bad</em>&#44; then return &#40;without drawing anything&#41;&#46;

4.  Establish the source and destination rectangles as follows&#58;

    If not specified&#44; the <var>dw</var> and <var>dh</var> arguments must default to the values of <var>sw</var> and <var>sh</var>&#44; interpreted such that one <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixel](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) in the image is treated as one unit in the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#39;s coordinate space&#46; If the <var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#44; <var>sw</var>&#44; and <var>sh</var> arguments are omitted&#44; then they must default to 0&#44; 0&#44; the image&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) in image pixels&#44; and the image&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) in image pixels&#44; respectively&#46; If the image has no <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural dimensions](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions)&#44; then the <em>concrete object size</em> must be used instead&#44; as determined using the CSS &#34;[Concrete Object Size Resolution](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#default-sizing)&#34; algorithm&#44; with the <em>specified size</em> having neither a definite width nor height&#44; nor any additional constraints&#44; the object&#39;s natural properties being those of the <var>image</var> argument&#44; and the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;default&#45;object&#45;size"></a>[default object size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#default-object-size) being the size of the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#46; [&#91;CSSIMAGES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSIMAGES)

    The source rectangle is the rectangle whose corners are the four points &#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#43;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#43;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#43;<var>sh</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#43;<var>sh</var>&#41;&#46;

    The destination rectangle is the rectangle whose corners are the four points &#40;<var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>dx</var>&#43;<var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>dx</var>&#43;<var>dw</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#43;<var>dh</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#43;<var>dh</var>&#41;&#46;

    When the source rectangle is outside the source image&#44; the source rectangle must be clipped to the source image and the destination rectangle must be clipped in the same proportion&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    When the destination rectangle is outside the destination image &#40;the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#41;&#44; the pixels that land outside the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) are discarded&#44; as if the destination was an infinite canvas whose rendering was clipped to the dimensions of the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#46;

5.  If one of the <var>sw</var> or <var>sh</var> arguments is zero&#44; then return&#46; Nothing is painted&#46;

6.  Paint the region of the <var>image</var> argument specified by the source rectangle on the region of the rendering context&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;6"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) specified by the destination rectangle&#44; after applying the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations) to the destination rectangle&#46;

    The image data must be processed in the original direction&#44; even if the dimensions given are negative&#46;

    When scaling up&#44; if the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingenabled"></a><code>[imageSmoothingEnabled](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingenabled)</code> attribute is set to true&#44; the user agent should attempt to apply a smoothing algorithm to the image data when it is scaled&#46; User agents which support multiple filtering algorithms may use the value of the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality"></a><code>[imageSmoothingQuality](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingquality)</code> attribute to guide the choice of filtering algorithm when the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingenabled&#45;2"></a><code>[imageSmoothingEnabled](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingenabled)</code> attribute is set to true&#46; Otherwise&#44; the image must be rendered using nearest&#45;neighbor interpolation&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This specification does not define the precise algorithm to use when scaling an image down&#44; or when scaling an image up when the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingenabled&#45;3"></a><code>[imageSmoothingEnabled](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingenabled)</code> attribute is set to true&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    When a <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element is drawn onto itself&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;drawing&#45;model"></a>[drawing model](#drawing-model) requires the source to be copied before the image is drawn&#44; so it is possible to copy parts of a <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element onto overlapping parts of itself&#46;

    If the original image data is a bitmap image&#44; then the value painted at a point in the destination rectangle is computed by filtering the original image data&#46; The user agent may use any filtering algorithm &#40;for example bilinear interpolation or nearest&#45;neighbor&#41;&#46; When the filtering algorithm requires a pixel value from outside the original image data&#44; it must instead use the value from the nearest edge pixel&#46; &#40;That is&#44; the filter uses &#39;clamp&#45;to&#45;edge&#39; behavior&#46;&#41; When the filtering algorithm requires a pixel value from outside the source rectangle but inside the original image data&#44; then the value from the original image data must be used&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Thus&#44; scaling an image in parts or in whole will have the same effect&#46; This does mean that when sprites coming from a single sprite sheet are to be scaled&#44; adjacent images in the sprite sheet can interfere&#46; This can be avoided by ensuring each sprite in the sheet is surrounded by a border of <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#44; or by copying sprites to be scaled into temporary <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements and drawing the scaled sprites from there&#46;

    Images are painted without affecting the current path&#44; and are subject to <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow effects](#shadows)&#44; <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#44; and the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

7.  If <var>image</var> <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;the&#45;image&#45;argument&#45;is&#45;not&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[is not origin&#45;clean](#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean)&#44; then set the <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;images&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag to false&#46;

###### <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;16 <strong>Pixel manipulation</strong>[](#pixel-manipulation)

<strong><code><var>imageData</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createimagedata&#45;imagedata&#45;dev"></a>[createImageData](#dom-context-2d-createimagedata-imagedata)&#40;<var>imageData</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object with the same dimensions and color space as the argument&#46; All the pixels in the returned object are <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

<strong><code><var>imageData</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createimagedata&#45;dev"></a>[createImageData](#dom-context-2d-createimagedata)&#40;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var> &#91;&#44; <var>settings</var>&#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

Returns an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object with the given dimensions&#46; The color space of the returned object is the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) of <var>context</var> unless overridden by <var>settings</var>&#46; All the pixels in the returned object are <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

Throws an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if either of the width or height arguments are zero&#46;

<strong><code><var>imageData</var> &#61; <var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata&#45;dev"></a>[getImageData](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)&#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#44; <var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var> &#91;&#44; <var>settings</var>&#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object containing the image data for the given rectangle of the bitmap&#46; The color space of the returned object is the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;2"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) of <var>context</var> unless overridden by <var>settings</var>&#46;

Throws an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the either of the width or height arguments are zero&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;dev"></a>[putImageData](#dom-context-2d-putimagedata)&#40;<var>imageData</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var> &#91;&#44; <var>dirtyX</var>&#44; <var>dirtyY</var>&#44; <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#44; <var>dirtyHeight</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>
