Paints the data from the given <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;4"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object onto the bitmap&#46; If a dirty rectangle is provided&#44; only the pixels from that rectangle are painted&#46;

The <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalalpha"></a><code>[globalAlpha](#dom-context-2d-globalalpha)</code> and <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalcompositeoperation"></a><code>[globalCompositeOperation](#dom-context-2d-globalcompositeoperation)</code> properties&#44; as well as the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;shadows"></a>[shadow attributes](#shadows)&#44; are ignored for the purposes of this method call&#59; pixels in the canvas are replaced wholesale&#44; with no composition&#44; alpha blending&#44; no shadows&#44; etc&#46;

Throws an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the <var>imageData</var> object&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;data"></a><code>[data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-data)</code> attribute value&#39;s &#91;&#91;ViewedArrayBuffer&#93;&#93; internal slot is detached&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;canvasimagedata"></a><code>[CanvasImageData](#canvasimagedata)</code> interface provide the following methods for reading and writing pixel data to the bitmap&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createimagedata"></a><strong><code>createImageData&#40;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>settings</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If one or both of <var>sw</var> and <var>sh</var> are zero&#44; then throw an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>newImageData</var> be a <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;new"></a>[new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;5"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object&#46;

3.  <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;initialize&#45;an&#45;imagedata&#45;object"></a>[Initialize](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialize-an-imagedata-object) <var>newImageData</var> given the absolute magnitude of <var>sw</var>&#44; the absolute magnitude of <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>settings</var>&#44; and <em><a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;initialize&#45;imagedata&#45;defaultcolorspace"></a>[defaultColorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialize-imagedata-defaultcolorspace)</em> set to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;3"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#46;

4.  Initialize the image data of <var>newImageData</var> to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;3"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

5.  Return <var>newImageData</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;createimagedata&#45;imagedata"></a><strong><code>createImageData&#40;<var>imageData</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>newImageData</var> be a <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;new&#45;2"></a>[new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;6"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object&#46;

2.  Let <var>settings</var> be the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedatasettings"></a><code>[ImageDataSettings](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedatasettings)</code> object «&#91; &#34;<a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedatasettings&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedatasettings-colorspace)</code>&#34; → <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;colorspace"></a>[colorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-colorspace)&#44; &#34;<a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedatasettings&#45;pixelformat"></a><code>[pixelFormat](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedatasettings-pixelformat)</code>&#34; → <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;pixelformat"></a>[pixelFormat](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-pixelformat) &#93;»&#46;

3.  <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;initialize&#45;an&#45;imagedata&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[Initialize](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialize-an-imagedata-object) <var>newImageData</var> given the value of <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;width"></a><code>[width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-width)</code> attribute&#44; the value of <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;height"></a><code>[height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-height)</code> attribute&#44; and <var>settings</var>&#46;

4.  Initialize the image data of <var>newImageData</var> to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;4"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

5.  Return <var>newImageData</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata"></a><strong><code>getImageData&#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#44; <var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>settings</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If either the <var>sw</var> or <var>sh</var> arguments are zero&#44; then throw an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is set to false&#44; then throw a <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  Let <var>imageData</var> be a <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;new&#45;3"></a>[new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;7"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object&#46;

4.  <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;initialize&#45;an&#45;imagedata&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[Initialize](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialize-an-imagedata-object) <var>imageData</var> given <var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sh</var>&#44; <var>settings</var>&#44; and <em><a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;initialize&#45;imagedata&#45;defaultcolorspace&#45;2"></a>[defaultColorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialize-imagedata-defaultcolorspace)</em> set to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;4"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#46;

5.  Let the source rectangle be the rectangle whose corners are the four points &#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#43;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#43;<var>sw</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#43;<var>sh</var>&#41;&#44; &#40;<var>sx</var>&#44; <var>sy</var>&#43;<var>sh</var>&#41;&#46;

6.  Set the pixel values of <var>imageData</var> to be the pixels of <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) in the area specified by the source rectangle in the bitmap&#39;s coordinate space units&#44; converted from <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;5"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) to <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;colorspace&#45;2"></a><code>[colorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-colorspace)</code> using <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;"></a>[&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/#valdef-color-profile-rendering-intent-relative-colorimetric) rendering intent&#46;

7.  Set the pixels values of <var>imageData</var> for areas of the source rectangle that are outside of the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;5"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

8.  Return <var>imageData</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;short"></a><strong><code>putImageData&#40;<var>imageData</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;common"></a>[put pixels from an <code>ImageData</code> onto a bitmap](#dom-context2d-putimagedata-common)&#44; given <var>imageData</var>&#44; <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; 0&#44; 0&#44; <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-width)</code>&#44; and <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-height)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata"></a><strong><code>putImageData&#40;<var>imageData</var>&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dirtyX</var>&#44; <var>dirtyY</var>&#44; <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#44; <var>dirtyHeight</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;common&#45;2"></a>[put pixels from an <code>ImageData</code> onto a bitmap](#dom-context2d-putimagedata-common)&#44; given <var>imageData</var>&#44; <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#44; <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dirtyX</var>&#44; <var>dirtyY</var>&#44; <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#44; and <var>dirtyHeight</var>&#46;

To <a id="dom&#45;context2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;common"></a><strong>put pixels from an <code>ImageData</code> onto a bitmap</strong>&#44; given an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;8"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> <var>imageData</var>&#44; an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) <var>bitmap</var>&#44; and numbers <var>dx</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#44; <var>dirtyX</var>&#44; <var>dirtyY</var>&#44; <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#44; and <var>dirtyHeight</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>buffer</var> be <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;data&#45;2"></a><code>[data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-data)</code> attribute value&#39;s &#91;&#91;ViewedArrayBuffer&#93;&#93; internal slot&#46;

2.  If <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;isdetachedbuffer"></a>[IsDetachedBuffer](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isdetachedbuffer)&#40;<var>buffer</var>&#41; is true&#44; then throw an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>dirtyWidth</var> is negative&#44; then let <var>dirtyX</var> be <var>dirtyX</var>&#43;<var>dirtyWidth</var>&#44; and let <var>dirtyWidth</var> be equal to the absolute magnitude of <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#46;

    If <var>dirtyHeight</var> is negative&#44; then let <var>dirtyY</var> be <var>dirtyY</var>&#43;<var>dirtyHeight</var>&#44; and let <var>dirtyHeight</var> be equal to the absolute magnitude of <var>dirtyHeight</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>dirtyX</var> is negative&#44; then let <var>dirtyWidth</var> be <var>dirtyWidth</var>&#43;<var>dirtyX</var>&#44; and let <var>dirtyX</var> be 0&#46;

    If <var>dirtyY</var> is negative&#44; then let <var>dirtyHeight</var> be <var>dirtyHeight</var>&#43;<var>dirtyY</var>&#44; and let <var>dirtyY</var> be 0&#46;

5.  If <var>dirtyX</var>&#43;<var>dirtyWidth</var> is greater than the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;width&#45;3"></a><code>[width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-width)</code> attribute of the <var>imageData</var> argument&#44; then let <var>dirtyWidth</var> be the value of that <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;width&#45;4"></a><code>[width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-width)</code> attribute&#44; minus the value of <var>dirtyX</var>&#46;

    If <var>dirtyY</var>&#43;<var>dirtyHeight</var> is greater than the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;height&#45;3"></a><code>[height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-height)</code> attribute of the <var>imageData</var> argument&#44; then let <var>dirtyHeight</var> be the value of that <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;height&#45;4"></a><code>[height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-height)</code> attribute&#44; minus the value of <var>dirtyY</var>&#46;

6.  If&#44; after those changes&#44; either <var>dirtyWidth</var> or <var>dirtyHeight</var> are negative or zero&#44; then return without affecting any bitmaps&#46;

7.  For all integer values of <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> where <var>dirtyX</var> ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>dirtyX</var>&#43;<var>dirtyWidth</var> and <var>dirtyY</var> ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>dirtyY</var>&#43;<var>dirtyHeight</var>&#44; set the pixel with coordinate &#40;<var>dx</var>&#43;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>dy</var>&#43;<var>y</var>&#41; in <var>bitmap</var> to the color of the pixel at coordinate &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; in the <var>imageData</var> data structure&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;imagedata&#45;bitmap&#45;representation"></a>[bitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagedata-bitmap-representation)&#44; converted from <var>imageData</var>&#39;s <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;imagedata&#45;colorspace&#45;3"></a><code>[colorSpace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-imagedata-colorspace)</code> to the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;6"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) of <var>bitmap</var> using <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/#valdef-color-profile-rendering-intent-relative-colorimetric) rendering intent&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Due to the lossy nature of converting between color spaces and converting to and from <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;premultiplied&#45;alpha"></a>[premultiplied alpha](#concept-premultiplied-alpha) color values&#44; pixels that have just been set using <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata"></a><code>[putImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-putimagedata)</code>&#44; and are not completely opaque&#44; might be returned to an equivalent <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code> as different values&#46;

The current path&#44; <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;transformations"></a>[transformation matrix](#transformations)&#44; <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;shadows&#45;2"></a>[shadow attributes](#shadows)&#44; <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#44; the <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region)&#44; and <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator) must not affect the methods described in this section&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the script generates an <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;imagedata&#45;9"></a><code>[ImageData](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagedata)</code> object so that it can draw onto it&#46;

``` text
// canvas is a reference to a <canvas> element
var context = canvas.getContext('2d');

// create a blank slate
var data = context.createImageData(canvas.width, canvas.height);

// create some plasma
FillPlasma(data, 'green'); // green plasma

// add a cloud to the plasma
AddCloud(data, data.width/2, data.height/2); // put a cloud in the middle

// paint the plasma+cloud on the canvas
context.putImageData(data, 0, 0);

// support methods
function FillPlasma(data, color) { ... }
function AddCloud(data, x, y) { ... }
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of using <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata&#45;2"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code> and <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;putimagedata&#45;2"></a><code>[putImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-putimagedata)</code> to implement an edge detection filter&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Edge detection demo</title>
  <script>
   var image = new Image();
   function init() {
     image.onload = demo;
     image.src = "image.jpeg";
   }
   function demo() {
     var canvas = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
     var context = canvas.getContext('2d');

     // draw the image onto the canvas
     context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);

     // get the image data to manipulate
     var input = context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

     // get an empty slate to put the data into
     var output = context.createImageData(canvas.width, canvas.height);

     // alias some variables for convenience
     // In this case input.width and input.height
     // match canvas.width and canvas.height
     // but we'll use the former to keep the code generic.
     var w = input.width, h = input.height;
     var inputData = input.data;
     var outputData = output.data;

     // edge detection
     for (var y = 1; y < h-1; y += 1) {
       for (var x = 1; x < w-1; x += 1) {
         for (var c = 0; c < 3; c += 1) {
           var i = (y*w + x)*4 + c;
           outputData[i] = 127 + -inputData[i - w*4 - 4] -   inputData[i - w*4] - inputData[i - w*4 + 4] +
                                 -inputData[i - 4]       + 8*inputData[i]       - inputData[i + 4] +
                                 -inputData[i + w*4 - 4] -   inputData[i + w*4] - inputData[i + w*4 + 4];
         }
         outputData[(y*w + x)*4 + 3] = 255; // alpha
       }
     }

     // put the image data back after manipulation
     context.putImageData(output, 0, 0);
   }
  </script>
 </head>
 <body onload="init()">
  <canvas></canvas>
 </body>
</html>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of color space conversion applied when drawing a solid color and reading the result back using and <a id="pixel&#45;manipulation&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata&#45;3"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code>&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang="en">
<title>Color space image data demo</title>

<canvas></canvas>

<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
const context = canvas.getContext('2d', {colorSpace:'display-p3'});

// Draw a red rectangle. Note that the hex color notation
// specifies sRGB colors.
context.fillStyle = "#FF0000";
context.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);

// Get the image data.
const pixels = context.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1);

// This will print 'display-p3', reflecting the default behavior
// of returning image data in the canvas's color space.
console.log(pixels.colorSpace);

// This will print the values 234, 51, and 35, reflecting the
// red fill color, converted to 'display-p3'.
console.log(pixels.data[0]);
console.log(pixels.data[1]);
console.log(pixels.data[2]);
</script>
```

Returns the <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#44; from the values defined in Compositing and Blending&#46; [&#91;COMPOSITE&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOMPOSITE)

Can be set&#44; to change the <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator&#45;2"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46; Unknown values are ignored&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="compositing&#58;canvascompositing"></a><code>[CanvasCompositing](#canvascompositing)</code> interface have a <a id="compositing&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha) value and a <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator&#45;3"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator) value that both affect all the drawing operations on this object&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a><strong>global alpha</strong> value gives an alpha value that is applied to shapes and images before they are composited onto the <a id="compositing&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#46; The value ranges from 0&#46;0 &#40;fully transparent&#41; to 1&#46;0 &#40;no additional transparency&#41;&#46; It must initially have the value 1&#46;0&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalalpha"></a><strong><code>globalAlpha</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="compositing&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="compositing&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha&#45;4"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)&#46;

The <a id="compositing&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalalpha"></a><code>[globalAlpha](#dom-context-2d-globalalpha)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is either infinite&#44; NaN&#44; or not in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; set <a id="compositing&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="compositing&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha&#45;5"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a><strong>current compositing and blending operator</strong> value controls how shapes and images are drawn onto the <a id="compositing&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#44; once they have had the <a id="compositing&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha&#45;6"></a>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha) and the <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;transformation&#45;matrix"></a>[current transformation matrix](#current-transformation-matrix) applied&#46; Initially&#44; it must be set to &#34;<a id="compositing&#58;gcop&#45;source&#45;over"></a><code>[source&#45;over](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_srcover)</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalcompositeoperation"></a><strong><code>globalCompositeOperation</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="compositing&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator&#45;4"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

The <a id="compositing&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;globalcompositeoperation"></a><code>[globalCompositeOperation](#dom-context-2d-globalcompositeoperation)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is not <a id="compositing&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) any of the values that the <a id="compositing&#58;blend&#45;mode"></a>[&#60;blend&#45;mode&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#ltblendmodegt) or the <a id="compositing&#58;composite&#45;mode"></a>[&#60;composite&#45;mode&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#compositemode) properties are defined to take&#44; then return&#46; [&#91;COMPOSITE&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOMPOSITE)

2.  Otherwise&#44; set <a id="compositing&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="compositing&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator&#45;5"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality"></a><strong><code>imageSmoothingQuality</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the last value it was set to&#46; On setting&#44; it must be set to the new value&#46; When the object implementing the <a id="image&#45;smoothing&#58;canvasimagesmoothing&#45;3"></a><code>[CanvasImageSmoothing](#canvasimagesmoothing)</code> interface is created&#44; the attribute must be set to &#34;<a id="image&#45;smoothing&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;imagesmoothingquality&#45;low&#45;2"></a><code>[low](#dom-context-2d-imagesmoothingquality-low)</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur&#45;dev"></a>[shadowBlur](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the current level of blur applied to shadows&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the blur level&#46; Values that are not finite numbers greater than or equal to zero are ignored&#46;

Objects which implement the <a id="shadows&#58;canvasshadowstyles&#45;2"></a><code>[CanvasShadowStyles](#canvasshadowstyles)</code> interface have an associated <a id="concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color"></a><strong>shadow color</strong>&#44; which is a CSS color&#46; Initially&#44; it must be <a id="shadows&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowcolor"></a><strong><code>shadowColor</code></strong> getter steps are to return the <a id="shadows&#58;serialisation&#45;of&#45;a&#45;color"></a>[serialization](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#serializing-color-values) of <a id="shadows&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="shadows&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color) with <a id="shadows&#58;html&#45;compatible&#45;serialization&#45;is&#45;requested"></a>[HTML&#45;compatible serialization requested](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-serialization-html-compatible-serialization-is-requested)&#46;

The <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowcolor"></a><code>[shadowColor](#dom-context-2d-shadowcolor)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>context</var> be <a id="shadows&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; if that is an element&#59; otherwise null&#46;

2.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="shadows&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) the given value with <var>context</var> if non&#45;null&#46;

3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Set <a id="shadows&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="shadows&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color&#45;2"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color) to <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsetx"></a><strong><code>shadowOffsetX</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsety"></a><strong><code>shadowOffsetY</code></strong> attributes specify the distance that the shadow will be offset in the positive horizontal and positive vertical distance respectively&#46; Their values are in coordinate space units&#46; They are not affected by the current transformation matrix&#46;

When the context is created&#44; the shadow offset attributes must initially have the value 0&#46;

On getting&#44; they must return their current value&#46; On setting&#44; the attribute being set must be set to the new value&#44; except if the value is infinite or NaN&#44; in which case the new value must be ignored&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur"></a><strong><code>shadowBlur</code></strong> attribute specifies the level of the blurring effect&#46; &#40;The units do not map to coordinate space units&#44; and are not affected by the current transformation matrix&#46;&#41;

When the context is created&#44; the <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur"></a><code>[shadowBlur](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur)</code> attribute must initially have the value 0&#46;

On getting&#44; the attribute must return its current value&#46; On setting&#44; the attribute must be set to the new value&#44; except if the value is negative&#44; infinite or NaN&#44; in which case the new value must be ignored&#46;

<a id="when&#45;shadows&#45;are&#45;drawn"></a><strong>Shadows are only drawn if</strong> the opacity component of the alpha component of the <a id="shadows&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color&#45;3"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color) is nonzero and either the <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowBlur](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur)</code> is nonzero&#44; or the <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsetx"></a><code>[shadowOffsetX](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx)</code> is nonzero&#44; or the <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsety"></a><code>[shadowOffsetY](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety)</code> is nonzero&#46;

<a id="shadows&#58;when&#45;shadows&#45;are&#45;drawn"></a>[When shadows are drawn](#when-shadows-are-drawn)&#44; they must be rendered as follows&#58;

1.  Let <var>A</var> be an infinite <a id="shadows&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap on which the source image for which a shadow is being created has been rendered&#46;

2.  Let <var>B</var> be an infinite <a id="shadows&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;3"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap&#44; with a coordinate space and an origin identical to <var>A</var>&#46;

3.  Copy the alpha component of <var>A</var> to <var>B</var>&#44; offset by <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsetx&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowOffsetX](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx)</code> in the positive <var>x</var> direction&#44; and <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowoffsety&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowOffsetY](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety)</code> in the positive <var>y</var> direction&#46;

4.  If <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur&#45;3"></a><code>[shadowBlur](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur)</code> is greater than 0&#58;

    1.  Let <var>σ</var> be half the value of <a id="shadows&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;shadowblur&#45;4"></a><code>[shadowBlur](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur)</code>&#46;

    2.  Perform a 2D Gaussian Blur on <var>B</var>&#44; using <var>σ</var> as the standard deviation&#46;

    User agents may limit values of <var>σ</var> to an implementation&#45;specific maximum value to avoid exceeding hardware limitations during the Gaussian blur operation&#46;

5.  Set the red&#44; green&#44; and blue components of every pixel in <var>B</var> to the red&#44; green&#44; and blue components &#40;respectively&#41; of the <a id="shadows&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color&#45;4"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color)&#46;

6.  Multiply the alpha component of every pixel in <var>B</var> by the alpha component of the <a id="shadows&#58;concept&#45;canvasshadowstyles&#45;shadow&#45;color&#45;5"></a>[shadow color](#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color)&#46;

7.  The shadow is in the bitmap <var>B</var>&#44; and is rendered as part of the <a id="shadows&#58;drawing&#45;model"></a>[drawing model](#drawing-model) described below&#46;

If the <a id="shadows&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator) is &#34;<a id="shadows&#58;gcop&#45;copy"></a><code>[copy](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_src)</code>&#34;&#44; then shadows effectively won&#39;t render &#40;since the shape will overwrite the shadow&#41;&#46;

###### <a id="filters"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;20 Filters[](#filters)

All drawing operations on an object which implements the <a id="filters&#58;canvasfilters"></a><code>[CanvasFilters](#canvasfilters)</code> interface are affected by the global <a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter"></a><strong><code>filter</code></strong> attribute&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;dev"></a>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

MDN

[CanvasRenderingContext2D&#47;filter](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/filter)

Firefox49&#43;SafariNoChrome52&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Returns the current filter&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the filter&#46; Values can either be the string &#34;<code>none</code>&#34; or a string parseable as a <a id="filters&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list)&#46; Other values are ignored&#46;

Such objects have an associated <a id="concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter"></a><strong>current filter</strong>&#44; which is a string&#46; Initially the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is set to the string &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46; Whenever the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;2"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is the string &#34;<code>none</code>&#34; filters will be disabled for the context&#46;

The <a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> getter steps are to return <a id="filters&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;3"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter)&#46;

The <a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;2"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#44; then set <a id="filters&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;4"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34; and return&#46;

2.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="filters&#58;parse&#45;something&#45;according&#45;to&#45;a&#45;css&#45;grammar"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-syntax/#parse-grammar) the given values as a <a id="filters&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list)&#46; If any property&#45;independent style sheet syntax like &#39;inherit&#39; or &#39;initial&#39; is present&#44; then this parsing must return failure&#46;

3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Set <a id="filters&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;5"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) to the given value&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Though <code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;3"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> &#61; &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;</code> will disable filters for the context&#44; <code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;4"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> &#61; &#34;&#34;</code>&#44; <code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;5"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> &#61; null</code>&#44; and <code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;filter&#45;6"></a><code>[filter](#dom-context-2d-filter)</code> &#61; undefined</code> are all treated as unparseable inputs and the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;6"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is left unchanged&#46;

Coordinates used in the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;7"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) are interpreted such that one pixel is equivalent to one SVG user space unit and to one canvas coordinate space unit&#46; Filter coordinates are not affected by the <a id="filters&#58;transformations"></a>[current transformation matrix](#transformations)&#46; The current transformation matrix affects only the input to the filter&#46; Filters are applied in the <a id="filters&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#39;s coordinate space&#46;

When the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;8"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is a string parsable as a <a id="filters&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list) which defines lengths using percentages or using <a id="filters&#58;&#39;em&#39;"></a>[&#39;em&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#em) or <a id="filters&#58;&#39;ex&#39;"></a>[&#39;ex&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#ex) units&#44; these must be interpreted relative to the <a id="filters&#58;computed&#45;value"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of the <a id="filters&#58;&#39;font&#45;size&#39;"></a>[&#39;font&#45;size&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-size-prop) property of the <a id="filters&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) at the time that the attribute is set&#46; If the <a id="filters&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[computed values](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) are undefined for a particular case &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the <a id="filters&#58;font&#45;style&#45;source&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[font style source object](#font-style-source-object) is not an element or is not <a id="filters&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#41;&#44; then the relative keywords must be interpreted relative to the default value of the <a id="filters&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;font"></a><code>[font](#dom-context-2d-font)</code> attribute&#46; The &#39;larger&#39; and &#39;smaller&#39; keywords are not supported&#46;

If the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;9"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is a string parseable as a <a id="filters&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#45;4"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list) with a reference to an SVG filter in the same document&#44; and this SVG filter changes&#44; then the changed filter is used for the next draw operation&#46;

If the value of the <a id="filters&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;10"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is a string parseable as a <a id="filters&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#45;5"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list) with a reference to an SVG filter in an external resource document and that document is not loaded when a drawing operation is invoked&#44; then the drawing operation must proceed with no filtering&#46;

###### <a id="working&#45;with&#45;externally&#45;defined&#45;svg&#45;filters"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;21 Working with externally&#45;defined SVG filters[](#working-with-externally-defined-svg-filters)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Since drawing is performed using filter value &#34;<code>none</code>&#34; until an externally&#45;defined filter has finished loading&#44; authors might wish to determine whether such a filter has finished loading before proceeding with a drawing operation&#46; One way to accomplish this is to load the externally&#45;defined filter elsewhere within the same page in some element that sends a <code>load</code> event &#40;for example&#44; an <a id="working&#45;with&#45;externally&#45;defined&#45;svg&#45;filters&#58;svg&#45;use"></a>[SVG <code>use</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-use) element&#41;&#44; and wait for the <code>load</code> event to be dispatched&#46;

###### <a id="drawing&#45;model"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;22 <strong>Drawing model</strong>[](#drawing-model)

When a shape or image is painted&#44; user agents must follow these steps&#44; in the order given &#40;or act as if they do&#41;&#58;

1.  Render the shape or image onto an infinite <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap&#44; creating image <var>A</var>&#44; as described in the previous sections&#46; For shapes&#44; the current fill&#44; stroke&#44; and line styles must be honored&#44; and the stroke must itself also be subjected to the current transformation matrix&#46;

2.  Convert the image <var>A</var> to the context&#39;s <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    There do not exist any inputs to a 2D context for which the color space is undefined&#46; The color space for CSS colors is defined in CSS Color&#46; The color space for images that specify no color profile information is <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;&#39;srgb&#39;"></a>[&#39;srgb&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb)&#44; as specified in the [Color Spaces of Untagged Colors](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#untagged) section of CSS Color&#46; [&#91;CSSCOLOR&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSCOLOR)

3.  Multiply the alpha component of every pixel in <var>A</var> by <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;global&#45;alpha"></a><code>[global alpha](#concept-canvas-global-alpha)</code>&#46;

4.  When the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is set to a value other than &#34;<code>none</code>&#34; and all the externally&#45;defined filters it references&#44; if any&#44; are in documents that are currently loaded&#44; then use image <var>A</var> as the input to the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;2"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter)&#44; creating image <var>B</var>&#46; If the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;3"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) is a string parseable as a <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;filter&#45;value&#45;list"></a>[&#60;filter&#45;value&#45;list&#62;](https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list)&#44; then draw using the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;current&#45;filter&#45;4"></a>[current filter](#concept-canvas-current-filter) in the same manner as SVG&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; let <var>B</var> be an alias for <var>A</var>&#46;

5.  <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;when&#45;shadows&#45;are&#45;drawn"></a>[When shadows are drawn](#when-shadows-are-drawn)&#44; render the shadow from image <var>B</var>&#44; using the current shadow styles&#44; creating image <var>C</var>&#46;

6.  <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;when&#45;shadows&#45;are&#45;drawn&#45;2"></a>[When shadows are drawn](#when-shadows-are-drawn)&#44; composite <var>C</var> within the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;clipping&#45;region"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region) over the current <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) using the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

7.  Composite <var>B</var> within the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;clipping&#45;region&#45;2"></a>[clipping region](#clipping-region) over the current <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) using the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;current&#45;compositing&#45;and&#45;blending&#45;operator&#45;2"></a>[current compositing and blending operator](#current-compositing-and-blending-operator)&#46;

When compositing onto the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#44; pixels that would fall outside of the <a id="drawing&#45;model&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) must be discarded&#46;

###### <a id="best&#45;practices"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;23 Best practices[](#best-practices)

When a canvas is interactive&#44; authors should include <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;focusable"></a>[focusable](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusable) elements in the element&#39;s fallback content corresponding to each <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;focusable&#45;2"></a>[focusable](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusable) part of the canvas&#44; as in the [example above](#drawCustomFocusRingExample)&#46;

When rendering focus rings&#44; to ensure that focus rings have the appearance of native focus rings&#44; authors should use the <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawfocusifneeded"></a><code>[drawFocusIfNeeded&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawfocusifneeded)</code> method&#44; passing it the element for which a ring is being drawn&#46; This method only draws the focus ring if the element is <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused)&#44; so that it can simply be called whenever drawing the element&#44; without checking whether the element is focused or not first&#46;

<a id="no&#45;text&#45;editing&#45;in&#45;canvas&#45;please"></a>Authors should avoid implementing text editing controls using the <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46; Doing so has a large number of disadvantages&#58;

- Mouse placement of the caret has to be reimplemented&#46;
- Keyboard movement of the caret has to be reimplemented &#40;possibly across lines&#44; for multiline text input&#41;&#46;
- Scrolling of the text control has to be implemented &#40;horizontally for long lines&#44; vertically for multiline input&#41;&#46;
- Native features such as copy&#45;and&#45;paste have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Native features such as spell&#45;checking have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Native features such as drag&#45;and&#45;drop have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Native features such as page&#45;wide text search have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Native features specific to the user&#44; for example custom text services&#44; have to be reimplemented&#46; This is close to impossible since each user might have different services installed&#44; and there is an unbounded set of possible such services&#46;
- Bidirectional text editing has to be reimplemented&#46;
- For multiline text editing&#44; line wrapping has to be implemented for all relevant languages&#46;
- Text selection has to be reimplemented&#46;
- Dragging of bidirectional text selections has to be reimplemented&#46;
- Platform&#45;native keyboard shortcuts have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Platform&#45;native input method editors &#40;IMEs&#41; have to be reimplemented&#46;
- Undo and redo functionality has to be reimplemented&#46;
- Accessibility features such as magnification following the caret or selection have to be reimplemented&#46;

This is a huge amount of work&#44; and authors are most strongly encouraged to avoid doing any of it by instead using the <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#44; or the <a id="best&#45;practices&#58;attr&#45;contenteditable"></a><code>[contenteditable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-contenteditable)</code> attribute&#46;

###### <a id="examples"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;1&#46;24 Examples[](#examples)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of a script that uses canvas to draw [pretty glowing lines](data:text/html;charset=utf-8;base64,PCFET0NUWVBFIEhUTUw%2BDQo8aHRtbCBsYW5nPSJlbiI%2BDQogPGhlYWQ%2BDQogIDx0aXRsZT5QcmV0dHkgR2xvd2luZyBMaW5lczwvdGl0bGU%2BDQogPC9oZWFkPg0KIDxib2R5Pg0KPGNhbnZhcyB3aWR0aD0iODAwIiBoZWlnaHQ9IjQ1MCI%2BPC9jYW52YXM%%2BDQogPC9ib2R5Pg0KPC9odG1sPg0K)&#46;

``` text
<canvas width="800" height="450"></canvas>
<script>

 var context = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].getContext('2d');

 var lastX = context.canvas.width * Math.random();
 var lastY = context.canvas.height * Math.random();
 var hue = 0;
 function line() {
   context.save();
   context.translate(context.canvas.width/2, context.canvas.height/2);
   context.scale(0.9, 0.9);
   context.translate(-context.canvas.width/2, -context.canvas.height/2);
   context.beginPath();
   context.lineWidth = 5 + Math.random() * 10;
   context.moveTo(lastX, lastY);
   lastX = context.canvas.width * Math.random();
   lastY = context.canvas.height * Math.random();
   context.bezierCurveTo(context.canvas.width * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.height * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.width * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.height * Math.random(),
                         lastX, lastY);

   hue = hue + 10 * Math.random();
   context.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ', 50%, 50%)';
   context.shadowColor = 'white';
   context.shadowBlur = 10;
   context.stroke();
   context.restore();
 }
 setInterval(line, 50);

 function blank() {
   context.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
   context.fillRect(0, 0, context.canvas.width, context.canvas.height);
 }
 setInterval(blank, 40);

</script>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The 2D rendering context for <a id="examples&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> is often used for sprite&#45;based games&#46; The following example demonstrates this&#58;



Here is the source for this example&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Blue Robot Demo</title>
<style>
  html { overflow: hidden; min-height: 200px; min-width: 380px; }
  body { height: 200px; position: relative; margin: 8px; }
  .buttons { position: absolute; bottom: 0px; left: 0px; margin: 4px; }
</style>
<canvas width="380" height="200"></canvas>
<script>
 var Landscape = function (context, width, height) {
   this.offset = 0;
   this.width = width;
   this.advance = function (dx) {
     this.offset += dx;
   };
   this.horizon = height * 0.7;
   // This creates the sky gradient (from a darker blue to white at the bottom)
   this.sky = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, this.horizon);
   this.sky.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgb(55,121,179)');
   this.sky.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgb(121,194,245)');
   this.sky.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgb(164,200,214)');
   // this creates the grass gradient (from a darker green to a lighter green)
   this.earth = context.createLinearGradient(0, this.horizon, 0, height);
   this.earth.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgb(81,140,20)');
   this.earth.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgb(123,177,57)');
   this.paintBackground = function (context, width, height) {
     // first, paint the sky and grass rectangles
     context.fillStyle = this.sky;
     context.fillRect(0, 0, width, this.horizon);
     context.fillStyle = this.earth;
     context.fillRect(0, this.horizon, width, height-this.horizon);
     // then, draw the cloudy banner
     // we make it cloudy by having the draw text off the top of the
     // canvas, and just having the blurred shadow shown on the canvas
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*3.2)) % (this.width*4.0))+0, 0);
     context.shadowColor = 'white';
     context.shadowOffsetY = 30+this.horizon/3; // offset down on canvas
     context.shadowBlur = '5';
     context.fillStyle = 'white';
     context.textAlign = 'left';
     context.textBaseline = 'top';
     context.font = '20px sans-serif';
     context.fillText('WHATWG ROCKS', 10, -30); // text up above canvas
     context.restore();
     // then, draw the background tree
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*0.2)) % (this.width*1.5))+30, 0);
     context.beginPath();
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(143,89,2)';
     context.lineStyle = 'rgb(10,10,10)';
     context.lineWidth = 2;
     context.rect(0, this.horizon+5, 10, -50); // trunk
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.beginPath();
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(78,154,6)';
     context.arc(5, this.horizon-60, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); // leaves
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.restore();
   };
   this.paintForeground = function (context, width, height) {
     // draw the box that goes in front
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*0.7)) % (this.width*1.1))+0, 0);
     context.beginPath();
     context.rect(0, this.horizon - 5, 25, 25);
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(220,154,94)';
     context.lineStyle = 'rgb(10,10,10)';
     context.lineWidth = 2;
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.restore();
   };
 };
</script>
<script>
 var BlueRobot = function () {
   this.sprites = new Image();
   this.sprites.src = 'blue-robot.png'; // this sprite sheet has 8 cells
   this.targetMode = 'idle';
   this.walk = function () {
     this.targetMode = 'walk';
   };
   this.stop = function () {
     this.targetMode = 'idle';
   };
   this.frameIndex = {
     'idle': [0], // first cell is the idle frame
     'walk': [1,2,3,4,5,6], // the walking animation is cells 1-6
     'stop': [7], // last cell is the stopping animation
   };
   this.mode = 'idle';
   this.frame = 0; // index into frameIndex
   this.tick = function () {
     // this advances the frame and the robot
     // the return value is how many pixels the robot has moved
     this.frame += 1;
     if (this.frame >= this.frameIndex[this.mode].length) {
       // we've reached the end of this animation cycle
       this.frame = 0;
       if (this.mode != this.targetMode) {
         // switch to next cycle
         if (this.mode == 'walk') {
           // we need to stop walking before we decide what to do next
           this.mode = 'stop';
         } else if (this.mode == 'stop') {
           if (this.targetMode == 'walk')
             this.mode = 'walk';
           else
             this.mode = 'idle';
         } else if (this.mode == 'idle') {
           if (this.targetMode == 'walk')
             this.mode = 'walk';
         }
       }
     }
     if (this.mode == 'walk')
       return 8;
     return 0;
   },
   this.paint = function (context, x, y) {
     if (!this.sprites.complete) return;
     // draw the right frame out of the sprite sheet onto the canvas
     // we assume each frame is as high as the sprite sheet
     // the x,y coordinates give the position of the bottom center of the sprite
     context.drawImage(this.sprites,
                       this.frameIndex[this.mode][this.frame] * this.sprites.height, 0, this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height,
                       x-this.sprites.height/2, y-this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height);
   };
 };
</script>
<script>
 var canvas = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
 var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
 var landscape = new Landscape(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 var blueRobot = new BlueRobot();
 // paint when the browser wants us to, using requestAnimationFrame()
 function paint() {
   context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   landscape.paintBackground(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   blueRobot.paint(context, canvas.width/2, landscape.horizon*1.1);
   landscape.paintForeground(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   requestAnimationFrame(paint);
 }
 paint();
 // but tick every 100ms, so that we don't slow down when we don't paint
 setInterval(function () {
   var dx = blueRobot.tick();
   landscape.advance(dx);
 }, 100);
</script>
<p class="buttons">
 <input type=button value="Walk" onclick="blueRobot.walk()">
 <input type=button value="Stop" onclick="blueRobot.stop()">
<footer>
 <small> Blue Robot Player Sprite by <a href="https://johncolburn.deviantart.com/">JohnColburn</a>.
 Licensed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 3.0 Unported license.</small>
 <small> This work is itself licensed under a <a rel="license" href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/">Creative
 Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License</a>.</small>
</footer>
```

##### <a id="the&#45;imagebitmap&#45;rendering&#45;context"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;2 The <a id="the&#45;imagebitmap&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;imagebitmap"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> rendering context[](#the-imagebitmap-rendering-context)

###### <a id="introduction&#45;6"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;2&#46;1 Introduction[](#introduction-6)

<a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> is a performance&#45;oriented interface that provides a low overhead method for displaying the contents of <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;imagebitmap"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> objects&#46; It uses transfer semantics to reduce overall memory consumption&#46; It also streamlines performance by avoiding intermediate compositing&#44; unlike the <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><code>[drawImage&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code> method of <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#46;

Using an <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element as an intermediate for getting an image resource into a canvas&#44; for example&#44; would result in two copies of the decoded image existing in memory at the same time&#58; the <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s copy&#44; and the one in the canvas&#39;s backing store&#46; This memory cost can be prohibitive when dealing with extremely large images&#46; This can be avoided by using <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Using <a id="introduction&#45;6&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code>&#44; here is how to transcode an image to the JPEG format in a memory&#45; and CPU&#45;efficient way&#58;

``` text
createImageBitmap(inputImageBlob).then(image => {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const context = canvas.getContext('bitmaprenderer');
  context.transferFromImageBitmap(image);

  canvas.toBlob(outputJPEGBlob => {
    // Do something with outputJPEGBlob.
  }, 'image/jpeg');
});
```

###### <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;2&#46;2 The <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> interface[](#the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ImageBitmapRenderingContext)

Support in all current engines&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------
