<a id="imagebitmaprenderingcontext"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;htmlcanvaselement"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;canvas"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmap"></a><a id="imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings"></a><a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings&#45;alpha"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface ImageBitmapRenderingContext {
  readonly attribute (HTMLCanvasElement or OffscreenCanvas) canvas;
  undefined transferFromImageBitmap(ImageBitmap? bitmap);
};

dictionary ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings {
  boolean alpha = true;
};
```

<strong><code><var>context</var> &#61; <var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;getcontext"></a>[getContext](#dom-canvas-getcontext)&#40;&#39;bitmaprenderer&#39; &#91;&#44; &#123; &#91; <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings&#45;alpha&#45;2"></a>[alpha](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha)&#58; false &#93; &#125; &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object that is permanently bound to a particular <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a><code>[alpha](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha)</code> setting is provided and set to false&#44; then the canvas is forced to always be opaque&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;canvas&#45;dev"></a>[canvas](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-canvas)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element that the context is bound to&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap&#45;dev"></a>[transferFromImageBitmap](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)&#40;imageBitmap&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[ImageBitmapRenderingContext&#47;transferFromImageBitmap](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ImageBitmapRenderingContext/transferFromImageBitmap)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox50&#43;Safari11&#46;1&#43;Chrome66&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Transfers the underlying <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data) from <var>imageBitmap</var> to <var>context</var>&#44; and the bitmap becomes the contents of the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which <var>context</var> is bound&#46;

<strong><code><var>context</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap&#45;2"></a>[transferFromImageBitmap](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)&#40;null&#41;</code></strong>

Replaces contents of the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which <var>context</var> is bound with a <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap whose size corresponds to the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attributes of the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;canvas"></a><strong><code>canvas</code></strong> attribute must return the value it was initialized to when the object was created&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object has an <a id="concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap"></a><strong>output bitmap</strong>&#44; which is a reference to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data)&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;4"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object has a <a id="concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;bitmap&#45;mode"></a><strong>bitmap mode</strong>&#44; which can be set to <a id="concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;valid"></a><strong>valid</strong> or <a id="concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;blank"></a><strong>blank</strong>&#46; A value of <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;valid"></a>[valid](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid) indicates that the context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) refers to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data) that was acquired via <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap&#45;3"></a><code>[transferFromImageBitmap&#40;&#41;](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)</code>&#46; A value <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;blank"></a>[blank](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank) indicates that the context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) is a default transparent bitmap&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;5"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object also has an <a id="concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;alpha"></a><strong>alpha</strong> flag&#44; which can be set to true or false&#46; When an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;6"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object has its <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;alpha"></a>[alpha](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha) flag set to false&#44; the contents of the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which the context is bound are obtained by compositing the context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) onto an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) bitmap of the same size using the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;gcop&#45;source&#45;over"></a>[source&#45;over](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_srcover) compositing operator&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;alpha&#45;2"></a>[alpha](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha) flag is set to true&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) is used as the contents of the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which the context is bound&#46; [&#91;COMPOSITE&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOMPOSITE)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The step of compositing over an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;opaque&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) bitmap ought to be elided whenever equivalent results can be obtained more efficiently by other means&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a user agent is required to <a id="set&#45;an&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s&#45;output&#45;bitmap"></a><strong>set an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>&#39;s output bitmap</strong>&#44; with a <var>context</var> argument that is an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;7"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object and an optional argument <var>bitmap</var> that refers to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data&#45;4"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data)&#44; it must run these steps&#58;

1.  If a <var>bitmap</var> argument was not provided&#58;

    1.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;bitmap&#45;mode"></a>[bitmap mode](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode) to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;blank&#45;2"></a>[blank](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank)&#46;

    2.  Let <var>canvas</var> be the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which <var>context</var> is bound&#46;

    3.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) to be <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) with a <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) equal to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> attribute and a <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) equal to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;obtain&#45;numeric&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[the numeric value](#obtain-numeric-values) of <var>canvas</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> attribute&#44; those values being interpreted in <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

    4.  Set the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;6"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag to true&#46;

2.  If a <var>bitmap</var> argument was provided&#58;

    1.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;bitmap&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[bitmap mode](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode) to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;valid&#45;2"></a>[valid](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;7"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) to refer to the same underlying bitmap data as <var>bitmap</var>&#44; without making a copy&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag of <var>bitmap</var> is included in the bitmap data to be referenced by <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;8"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;creation&#45;algorithm"></a><strong><code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code> creation algorithm</strong>&#44; which is passed a <var>target</var> and <var>options</var>&#44; consists of running these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>settings</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>options</var> to the dictionary type <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings](#imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings)</code>&#46; &#40;This can throw an exception&#46;&#41;

2.  Let <var>context</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;8"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object&#46;

3.  Initialize <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;canvas"></a><code>[canvas](#dom-context-2d-canvas)</code> attribute to point to <var>target</var>&#46;

4.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;9"></a>[output bitmap](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap) to the same bitmap as <var>target</var>&#39;s bitmap &#40;so that they are shared&#41;&#46;

5.  Run the steps to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;an&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s&#45;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[set an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>&#39;s output bitmap](#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap) with <var>context</var>&#46;

6.  Initialize <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a>[alpha](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha) flag to true&#46;

7.  Process each of the members of <var>settings</var> as follows&#58;

    <strong><a id="dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings&#45;alpha"></a><strong><code>alpha</code></strong></strong>

    If false&#44; then set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;alpha&#45;4"></a>[alpha](#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha) flag to false&#46;

8.  Return <var>context</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap"></a><strong><code>transferFromImageBitmap&#40;<var>bitmap</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>bitmapContext</var> be the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;9"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code> object on which the <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap&#45;4"></a><code>[transferFromImageBitmap&#40;&#41;](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)</code> method was called&#46;

2.  If <var>bitmap</var> is null&#44; then run the steps to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;an&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[set an ImageBitmapRenderingContext&#39;s output bitmap](#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap)&#44; with <var>bitmapContext</var> as the <em>context</em> argument and no <em>bitmap</em> argument&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If the value of <var>bitmap</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;detached"></a>[&#91;&#91;Detached&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#detached) internal slot is set to true&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  Run the steps to <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;an&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s&#45;output&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[set an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>&#39;s output bitmap](#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap)&#44; with the <em>context</em> argument equal to <var>bitmapContext</var>&#44; and the <em>bitmap</em> argument referring to <var>bitmap</var>&#39;s underlying <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data&#45;5"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data)&#46;

5.  Set the value of <var>bitmap</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;detached&#45;2"></a>[&#91;&#91;Detached&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#detached) internal slot to true&#46;

6.  Unset <var>bitmap</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;imagebitmap&#45;bitmap&#45;data&#45;6"></a>[bitmap data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data)&#46;

id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;eventhandler"></a><a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;handler&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;oncontextlost"></a><a
``` text
typedef (OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D or ImageBitmapRenderingContext or WebGLRenderingContext or WebGL2RenderingContext or GPUCanvasContext) OffscreenRenderingContext;

dictionary ImageEncodeOptions {
  DOMString type = "image/png";
  unrestricted double quality;
};

enum OffscreenRenderingContextId { "2d", "bitmaprenderer", "webgl", "webgl2", "webgpu" };

[Exposed=(Window,Worker), Transferable]
interface OffscreenCanvas : EventTarget {
  constructor([EnforceRange] unsigned long long width, [EnforceRange] unsigned long long height);

  attribute [EnforceRange] unsigned long long width;
  attribute [EnforceRange] unsigned long long height;

  OffscreenRenderingContext? getContext(OffscreenRenderingContextId contextId, optional any options = null);
  ImageBitmap transferToImageBitmap();
  Promise<Blob> convertToBlob(optional ImageEncodeOptions options = {});

  attribute EventHandler oncontextlost;
  attribute EventHandler oncontextrestored;
};
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> is an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;eventtarget&#45;2"></a><code>[EventTarget](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-eventtarget)</code>&#44; so both <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> and WebGL can fire events at it&#46; <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> can fire <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;contextlost"></a><code>[contextlost](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-contextlost)</code> and <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;contextrestored"></a><code>[contextrestored](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-contextrestored)</code>&#44; and WebGL can fire <code>webglcontextlost</code> and <code>webglcontextrestored</code>&#46; [&#91;WEBGL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL)

<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> objects are used to create rendering contexts&#44; much like an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;htmlcanvaselement"></a><code>[HTMLCanvasElement](#htmlcanvaselement)</code>&#44; but with no connection to the DOM&#46; This makes it possible to use canvas rendering contexts in [workers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#workers)&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;4"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object may hold a weak reference to a <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder"></a><strong>placeholder <code>canvas</code> element</strong>&#44; which is typically in the DOM&#44; whose embedded content is provided by the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;5"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46; The bitmap of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;6"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object is pushed to the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder) as part of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;7"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;relevant&#45;agent"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;agent&#45;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-agent-event-loop)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;update&#45;the&#45;rendering"></a>[update the rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#update-the-rendering) steps&#46;

<strong><code><var>offscreenCanvas</var> &#61; new <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;dev"></a>[OffscreenCanvas](#dom-offscreencanvas)&#40;<var>width</var>&#44; <var>height</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns an object that exposes an API for drawing on the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;9"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46; <var>contextId</var> specifies the desired API&#58; &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;2d&#45;2"></a><code>[2d](#offscreen-context-type-2d)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;bitmaprenderer&#45;2"></a><code>[bitmaprenderer](#offscreen-context-type-bitmaprenderer)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl&#45;2"></a><code>[webgl](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl2&#45;2"></a><code>[webgl2](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)</code>&#34;&#44; or &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgpu&#45;2"></a><code>[webgpu](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)</code>&#34;&#46; <var>options</var> is handled by that API&#46;

This specification defines the &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;canvas&#45;context&#45;2d"></a><code>[2d](#canvas-context-2d)</code>&#34; context below&#44; which is similar but distinct from the &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;2d&#45;3"></a><code>[2d](#offscreen-context-type-2d)</code>&#34; context that is created from a <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#46; The WebGL specifications define the &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl&#45;3"></a><code>[webgl](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl2&#45;3"></a><code>[webgl2](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)</code>&#34; contexts&#46; WebGPU defines the &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgpu&#45;3"></a><code>[webgpu](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)</code>&#34; context&#46; [&#91;WEBGL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL) [&#91;WEBGPU&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGPU)

Returns null if the canvas has already been initialized with another context type &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; trying to get a &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;2d&#45;4"></a><code>[2d](#offscreen-context-type-2d)</code>&#34; context after getting a &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl&#45;4"></a><code>[webgl](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)</code>&#34; context&#41;&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;10"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object has an internal <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap"></a><strong>bitmap</strong> that is initialized when the object is created&#46; The width and height of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) are equal to the values of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#dom-offscreencanvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#dom-offscreencanvas-height)</code> attributes of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;11"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46; Initially&#44; all the bitmap&#39;s pixels are <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;12"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object has an internal <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang"></a><strong>inherited language</strong> and <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction"></a><strong>inherited direction</strong> set when the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;13"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> is created&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;14"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object can have a rendering context bound to it&#46; Initially&#44; it does not have a bound rendering context&#46; To keep track of whether it has a rendering context or not&#44; and what kind of rendering context it is&#44; an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;15"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object also has a <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode"></a><strong>context mode</strong>&#44; which is initially <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;none"></a><strong>none</strong> but can be changed to either <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;2d"></a><strong>2d</strong>&#44; <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;bitmaprenderer"></a><strong>bitmaprenderer</strong>&#44; <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;webgl"></a><strong>webgl</strong>&#44; <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;webgl2"></a><strong>webgl2</strong>&#44; <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;webgpu"></a><strong>webgpu</strong>&#44; or <a id="offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;detached"></a><strong>detached</strong> by algorithms defined in this specification&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas"></a><strong><code>new OffscreenCanvas&#40;<var>width</var>&#44; <var>height</var>&#41;</code></strong> constructor steps are&#58;

1.  Initialize the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to a rectangular array of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;2"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) pixels of the dimensions specified by <var>width</var> and <var>height</var>&#46;

2.  Initialize the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;width&#45;3"></a><code>[width](#dom-offscreencanvas-width)</code> of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to <var>width</var>&#46;

3.  Initialize the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;height&#45;3"></a><code>[height](#dom-offscreencanvas-height)</code> of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to <var>height</var>&#46;

4.  Set <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang) to <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;explicitly&#45;unknown"></a>[explicitly unknown](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-explicitly-unknown)&#46;

5.  Set <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction) to &#34;<code>ltr</code>&#34;&#46;

6.  Let <var>global</var> be the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

7.  If <var>global</var> is a <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) of <var>global</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#46;

    2.  If <var>element</var> is not null&#58;

        1.  Set the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang&#45;2"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang) of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;language"></a>[language](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#language)&#46;

        2.  Set the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction&#45;2"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction) of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;16"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> objects are <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transferable&#45;objects"></a>[transferable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#transferable-objects)&#46; Their <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transfer&#45;steps"></a>[transfer steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#transfer-steps)&#44; given <var>value</var> and <var>dataHolder</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) is not equal to <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;none"></a>[none](#offscreencanvas-context-none)&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Set <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) to <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;detached"></a>[detached](#offscreencanvas-context-detached)&#46;

3.  Let <var>width</var> and <var>height</var> be the dimensions of <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;3"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap)&#46;

4.  Let <var>language</var> and <var>direction</var> be the values of <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang&#45;3"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang) and <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction&#45;3"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction)&#46;

5.  Unset <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;4"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap)&#46;

6.  Set <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Width&#93;&#93; to <var>width</var> and <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Height&#93;&#93; to <var>height</var>&#46;

7.  Set <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Language&#93;&#93; to <var>language</var> and <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Direction&#93;&#93; to <var>direction</var>&#46;

8.  Set <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;PlaceholderCanvas&#93;&#93; to be a weak reference to <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;3"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#44; if <var>value</var> has one&#44; or null if it does not&#46;

Their <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transfer&#45;receiving&#45;steps"></a>[transfer&#45;receiving steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#transfer-receiving-steps)&#44; given <var>dataHolder</var> and <var>value</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Initialize <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;5"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) to a rectangular array of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;3"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) pixels with width given by <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Width&#93;&#93; and height given by <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Height&#93;&#93;&#46;

2.  Set <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;lang&#45;4"></a>[inherited language](#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang) to <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Language&#93;&#93; and its <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;inherited&#45;direction&#45;4"></a>[inherited direction](#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction) to <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;Direction&#93;&#93;&#46;

3.  If <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;PlaceholderCanvas&#93;&#93; is not null&#44; set <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;4"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder) to <var>dataHolder</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;PlaceholderCanvas&#93;&#93; &#40;while maintaining the weak reference semantics&#41;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;getcontext"></a><strong><code>getContext&#40;<var>contextId</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method of an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;17"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#44; when invoked&#44; must run these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>options</var> is not an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;idl&#45;object"></a>[object](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-object)&#44; then set <var>options</var> to null&#46;

2.  Set <var>options</var> to the result of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>options</var> to a JavaScript value&#46;

3.  Run the steps in the cell of the following table whose column header matches this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;18"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) and whose row header matches <var>contextId</var>&#58;

       </th><td>         <ol><li><p>Let <var>context</var> be the result of running the          <a href="#offscreen-2d-context-creation-algorithm" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreen-2d-context-creation-algorithm">offscreen 2D context creation algorithm</a> given          <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-9" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" data-x-internal="this">this</a> and <var>options</var>&#46;</p></li><li><p>Set <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-10" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>&#39;s <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-4">context          mode</a> to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-2d" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-2d-2">2d</a>&#46;</p></li><li><p>Return <var>context</var>&#46;</p></li></ol>        </td><td>         Return the same object as was returned the last time the method was invoked with this same         first argument&#46;       </td></tr><tr><th>&#34;<dfn id="offscreen-context-type-bitmaprenderer"><code>bitmaprenderer</code></dfn>&#34;        </th><td>         <ol><li><p>Let <var>context</var> be the result of running the          <a href="#imagebitmaprenderingcontext-creation-algorithm" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:imagebitmaprenderingcontext-creation-algorithm"><code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code> creation          algorithm</a> given <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-11" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" data-x-internal="this">this</a> and <var>options</var>&#46;</p></li><li><p>Set <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-12" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>&#39;s <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-5">context          mode</a> to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-bitmaprenderer" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-bitmaprenderer-2">bitmaprenderer</a>&#46;</p></li><li><p>Return <var>context</var>&#46;</p></li></ol>        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return the same object as was returned the last time the method was invoked with this same         first argument&#46;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Throw an <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-3" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror" data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;</a> <code id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-3"><a data-x-internal="domexception" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException">DOMException</a></code>&#46;       </td></tr><tr><th>&#34;<dfn id="offscreen-context-type-webgl"><code>webgl</code></dfn>&#34; or &#34;<dfn id="offscreen-context-type-webgl2"><code>webgl2</code></dfn>&#34;        </th><td>         <ol><li><p>Let <var>context</var> be the result of following the instructions given in the          WebGL specifications&#39; <i>Context Creation</i> sections&#46; <a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL">&#91;WEBGL&#93;</a></p></li><li><p>If <var>context</var> is null&#44;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return the same value as was returned the last time the method was invoked with this same         first argument&#46;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Throw an <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-4" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror" data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;</a> <code id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-4"><a data-x-internal="domexception" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException">DOMException</a></code>&#46;       </td></tr><tr><th>&#34;<dfn id="offscreen-context-type-webgpu"><code>webgpu</code></dfn>&#34;        </th><td>         <ol><li><p>Let <var>context</var> be the result of following the instructions given in          <cite>WebGPU</cite>&#39;s <a href="https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#canvas-rendering">Canvas Rendering</a> section&#46; otherwise set <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-14" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>&#39;s          <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-7">context mode</a> to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-webgpu" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-webgpu-2">webgpu</a>&#46;</p></li><li><p>Return <var>context</var>&#46;</p></li></ol>        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return null&#46;        </td><td>         Return the same value as was returned the last time the method was invoked with this same         first argument&#46;        </td><td>         Throw an <a id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-5" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror" data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;</a> <code id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-5"><a data-x-internal="domexception" href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException">DOMException</a></code>&#46;     </td></tr></tbody></table>

These attributes return the dimensions of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;19"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;6"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap)&#46;

They can be set&#44; to replace the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;7"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) with a new&#44; <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;4"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) bitmap of the specified dimensions &#40;effectively resizing it&#41;&#46;

If either the <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> or <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong> attributes of an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;20"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object are set &#40;to a new value or to the same value as before&#41; and the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;21"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) is <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;3"></a>[2d](#offscreencanvas-context-2d)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;rendering&#45;context&#45;to&#45;its&#45;default&#45;state"></a>[reset the rendering context to its default state](#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state) and resize the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;22"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;8"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) to the new values of the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;width&#45;4"></a><code>[width](#dom-offscreencanvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;height&#45;4"></a><code>[height](#dom-offscreencanvas-height)</code> attributes&#46;

The resizing behavior for &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl&#45;5"></a><code>[webgl](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgl2&#45;4"></a><code>[webgl2](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)</code>&#34; contexts is defined in the WebGL specifications&#46; [&#91;WEBGL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL)

The resizing behavior for &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreen&#45;context&#45;type&#45;webgpu&#45;4"></a><code>[webgpu](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)</code>&#34; context is defined in WebGPU&#46; [&#91;WEBGPU&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGPU)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;23"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object whose dimensions were changed has a <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;5"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;6"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions) will only be updated during the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;24"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;agent&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-agent-event-loop)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;update&#45;the&#45;rendering&#45;2"></a>[update the rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#update-the-rendering) steps&#46;

Returns a promise that will fulfill with a new <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;blob&#45;2"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object representing a file containing the image in the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;25"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46;

The argument&#44; if provided&#44; is a dictionary that controls the encoding options of the image file to be created&#46; The <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;image&#45;encode&#45;options&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#image-encode-options-type)</code> field specifies the file format and has a default value of &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;image&#47;png"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#59; that type is also used if the requested type isn&#39;t supported&#46; If the image format supports variable quality &#40;such as &#34;<a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;image&#47;jpeg"></a><code>[image&#47;jpeg](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/jpeg)</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;image&#45;encode&#45;options&#45;quality&#45;2"></a><code>[quality](#image-encode-options-quality)</code> field is a number in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0 inclusive indicating the desired quality level for the resulting image&#46;

<strong><code><var>canvas</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;transfertoimagebitmap&#45;dev"></a>[transferToImageBitmap](#dom-offscreencanvas-transfertoimagebitmap)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns a newly created <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmap&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> object with the image in the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;26"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46; The image in the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;27"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object is replaced with a new blank image&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;converttoblob"></a><strong><code>convertToBlob&#40;<var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If the value of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;15"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;detached"></a>[&#91;&#91;Detached&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#detached) internal slot is true&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;6"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;16"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) is <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;4"></a>[2d](#offscreencanvas-context-2d) and the rendering context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is set to false&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with&#45;2"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) a <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;17"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;9"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) has no pixels &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; either its horizontal dimension or its vertical dimension is zero&#41;&#44; then return <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with&#45;3"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  Let <var>bitmap</var> be a copy of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;18"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;10"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap)&#46;

5.  Let <var>result</var> be a new promise object&#46;

6.  Let <var>global</var> be <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;19"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

7.  Run these steps <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>file</var> be <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;a&#45;serialisation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#45;as&#45;a&#45;file"></a>[a serialization of <var>bitmap</var> as a file](#a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file)&#44; with <var>options</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;encode&#45;options&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> and <a id="image&#45;encode&#45;options&#45;quality"></a><strong><code>quality</code></strong> if present&#46;

    2.  <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task"></a>[Queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;canvas&#45;blob&#45;serialisation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[canvas blob serialization task source](#canvas-blob-serialisation-task-source) given <var>global</var> to run these steps&#58;

        1.  If <var>file</var> is null&#44; then reject <var>result</var> with an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;encodingerror"></a>[&#34;<code>EncodingError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#encodingerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;9"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

        2.  Otherwise&#44; resolve <var>result</var> with a new <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;blob&#45;3"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object&#44; created in <var>global</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;realm"></a>[relevant realm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-realm)&#44; representing <var>file</var>&#46; [&#91;FILEAPI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsFILEAPI)

8.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;transfertoimagebitmap"></a><strong><code>transferToImageBitmap&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the value of this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;28"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;detached&#45;2"></a>[&#91;&#91;Detached&#93;&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#detached) internal slot is set to true&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;7"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;10"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;29"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;mode&#45;10"></a>[context mode](#offscreencanvas-context-mode) is set to <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;context&#45;none&#45;3"></a>[none](#offscreencanvas-context-none)&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;8"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;11"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  Let <var>image</var> be a newly created <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;imagebitmap&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> object that references the same underlying bitmap data as this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;30"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;11"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap)&#46;

4.  Set this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;31"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap&#45;12"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) to reference a newly created bitmap of the same dimensions and color space as the previous bitmap&#44; and with its pixels initialized to <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;transparent&#45;black&#45;5"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#44; or <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) if the rendering context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha) is false&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This means that if the rendering context of this <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;32"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> is a <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;webglrenderingcontext&#45;2"></a><code>[WebGLRenderingContext](https://www.khronos.org/registry/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#WebGLRenderingContext)</code>&#44; the value of <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;webglcontextattributes"></a><code>[preserveDrawingBuffer](https://www.khronos.org/registry/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#WebGLContextAttributes)</code> will have no effect&#46; [&#91;WEBGL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBGL)

5.  Return <var>image</var>&#46;

The following are the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;handlers"></a>[event handlers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handlers) &#40;and their corresponding <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;handler&#45;event&#45;type"></a>[event handler event types](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handler-event-type)&#41; that must be supported&#44; as <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;handler&#45;idl&#45;attributes"></a>[event handler IDL attributes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handler-idl-attributes)&#44; by all objects implementing the <a id="the&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;interface&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;33"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> interface&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handlers" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:event-handlers-2">Event handler</a> </th><th><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handler-event-type" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:event-handler-event-type-2">Event handler event type</a>    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas" id="handler-offscreencanvas-oncontextlost" data-dfn-type="attribute"><code>oncontextlost</code></dfn> </td><td> <code id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:event-contextlost-2"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-contextlost">contextlost</a></code>     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas" id="handler-offscreencanvas-oncontextrestored" data-dfn-type="attribute"><code>oncontextrestored</code></dfn> </td><td> <code id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:event-contextrestored-2"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-contextrestored">contextrestored</a></code>   </td></tr></tbody></table>
