id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvaspath"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D {
  readonly attribute OffscreenCanvas canvas;
};

OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasSettings;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasState;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasTransform;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasCompositing;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasImageSmoothing;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasFillStrokeStyles;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasShadowStyles;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasFilters;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasRect;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasDrawPath;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasText;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasDrawImage;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasImageData;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasPathDrawingStyles;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasTextDrawingStyles;
OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D includes CanvasPath;
```

The <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;17"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object is a rendering context for drawing to the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;bitmap"></a>[bitmap](#offscreencanvas-bitmap) of an <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;2"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#46; It is similar to the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object&#44; with the following differences&#58;

- there is no support for <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvasuserinterface"></a>[user interface](#canvasuserinterface) features&#59;

- its <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencontext2d&#45;canvas&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#offscreencontext2d-canvas)</code> attribute refers to an <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;3"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object rather than a <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#59;

An <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;18"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object has an <a id="associated&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;object"></a><strong>associated <code>OffscreenCanvas</code> object</strong>&#44; which is the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;4"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object from which the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;19"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object was created&#46;

<strong><code><var>offscreenCanvas</var> &#61; <var>offscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D</var>&#46;<a id="offscreencontext2d&#45;canvas&#45;dev"></a>[canvas](#offscreencontext2d-canvas)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;associated&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;object"></a>[associated <code>OffscreenCanvas</code> object](#associated-offscreencanvas-object)&#46;

The <a id="offscreen&#45;2d&#45;context&#45;creation&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>offscreen 2D context creation algorithm</strong>&#44; which is passed a <var>target</var> &#40;an <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;5"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> object&#41; and optionally some arguments&#44; consists of running the following steps&#58;

1.  If the algorithm was passed some arguments&#44; let <var>arg</var> be the first such argument&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>arg</var> be undefined&#46;

2.  Let <var>settings</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>arg</var> to the dictionary type <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings](#canvasrenderingcontext2dsettings)</code>&#46; &#40;This can throw an exception&#46;&#41;

3.  Let <var>context</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;20"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> object&#46;

4.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;associated&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[associated <code>OffscreenCanvas</code> object](#associated-offscreencanvas-object) to <var>target</var>&#46;

5.  Run the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvas&#45;setting&#45;init&#45;bitmap"></a>[canvas settings output bitmap initialization algorithm](#canvas-setting-init-bitmap)&#44; given <var>context</var> and <var>settings</var>&#46;

6.  Set <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) to a newly created bitmap with the dimensions specified by the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#dom-offscreencanvas-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;dom&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#dom-offscreencanvas-height)</code> attributes of <var>target</var>&#44; and set <var>target</var>&#39;s bitmap to the same bitmap &#40;so that they are shared&#41;&#46;

7.  If <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;alpha"></a>[alpha](#concept-canvas-alpha) flag is set to true&#44; initialize all the pixels of <var>context</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) to <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black)&#46; Otherwise&#44; initialize the pixels to <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black)&#46;

8.  Return <var>context</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Implementations are encouraged to short&#45;circuit the graphics update steps of the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;window&#45;event&#45;loop"></a>[window event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window-event-loop) for the purposes of updating the contents of a <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder) to the display&#46; This could mean&#44; for example&#44; that the bitmap contents are copied directly to a graphics buffer that is mapped to the physical display location of the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;2"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#46; This or similar short&#45;circuiting approaches can significantly reduce display latency&#44; especially in cases where the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;6"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> is updated from a <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;worker&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[worker event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#worker-event-loop-2) and the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;window&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[window event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window-event-loop) of the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;3"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder) is busy&#46; However&#44; such shortcuts cannot have any script&#45;observable side&#45;effects&#46; This means that the committed bitmap still needs to be sent to the <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvas&#45;placeholder&#45;4"></a>[placeholder <code>canvas</code> element](#offscreencanvas-placeholder)&#44; in case the element is used as a <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvasimagesource"></a><code>[CanvasImageSource](#canvasimagesource)</code>&#44; as an <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;imagebitmapsource"></a><code>[ImageBitmapSource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmapsource)</code>&#44; or in case <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl"></a><code>[toDataURL&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-todataurl)</code> or <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob"></a><code>[toBlob&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-toblob)</code> are called on it&#46;

The <a id="offscreencontext2d&#45;canvas"></a><strong><code>canvas</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return this <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d&#45;21"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;offscreen&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;associated&#45;offscreencanvas&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[associated <code>OffscreenCanvas</code> object](#associated-offscreencanvas-object)&#46;

##### <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;4 Color spaces and color space conversion[](#colour-spaces-and-colour-correction)

<a id="predefinedcolorspace"></a><a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;srgb"></a><a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;srgb&#45;linear"></a><a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;display&#45;p3"></a><a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;display&#45;p3&#45;linear"></a>

``` text
enum PredefinedColorSpace { "srgb", "srgb-linear", "display-p3", "display-p3-linear" };
```

The <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;predefinedcolorspace"></a><code>[PredefinedColorSpace](#predefinedcolorspace)</code> enumeration is used to specify the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) of the canvas&#39;s backing store&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;srgb"></a><strong><code>srgb</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;&#39;srgb&#39;"></a>[&#39;srgb&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb) color space&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;srgb&#45;linear"></a><strong><code>srgb&#45;linear</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;&#39;srgb&#45;linear&#39;"></a>[&#39;srgb&#45;linear&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb-linear) color space&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;display&#45;p3"></a><strong><code>display&#45;p3</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;&#39;display&#45;p3&#39;"></a>[&#39;display&#45;p3&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-display-p3) color space&#46;

The &#34;<a id="dom&#45;predefinedcolorspace&#45;display&#45;p3&#45;linear"></a><strong><code>display&#45;p3&#45;linear</code></strong>&#34; value indicates the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;&#39;display&#45;p3&#45;linear&#39;"></a>[&#39;display&#45;p3&#45;linear&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#display-p3-linear-space) color space&#46;

<a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;converting&#45;colors"></a>[Color space conversion](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) must be applied to the canvas&#39;s backing store when rendering the canvas to the output device&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The algorithm for converting between color spaces can be found in the <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;converting&#45;colors&#45;2"></a>[Converting Colors](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) section of CSS Color&#46; This color space conversion is identical to the color space conversion that would be applied to an <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element with a color profile that specifies the same <a id="colour&#45;spaces&#45;and&#45;colour&#45;correction&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;space&#45;2"></a>[color space](#concept-canvas-color-space) as the canvas&#39;s backing store&#46; [&#91;CSSCOLOR&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSCOLOR)

##### <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;5 Serializing bitmaps to a file[](#serialising-bitmaps-to-a-file)

When a user agent is to create <a id="a&#45;serialisation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;bitmap&#45;as&#45;a&#45;file"></a><strong>a serialization of the bitmap as a file</strong>&#44; given a <var>type</var> and an optional <var>quality</var>&#44; it must create an image file in the format given by <var>type</var>&#46; If an error occurs during the creation of the image file &#40;e&#46;g&#46; an internal encoder error&#41;&#44; then the result of the serialization is null&#46; [&#91;PNG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPNG)

The image file&#39;s pixel data must be the bitmap&#39;s pixel data scaled to one image pixel per coordinate space unit&#44; and if the file format used supports encoding resolution metadata&#44; the resolution must be given as 96dpi &#40;one image pixel per <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixel](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#41;&#46;

If <var>type</var> is supplied&#44; then it must be interpreted as a <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;mime&#45;type"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) giving the format to use&#46; If the type has any parameters&#44; then it must be treated as not supported&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; the value &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;png"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34; would mean to generate a PNG image&#44; the value &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;jpeg"></a><code>[image&#47;jpeg](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/jpeg)</code>&#34; would mean to generate a JPEG image&#44; and the value &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;svg&#43;xml"></a><code>[image&#47;svg&#43;xml](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/svg+xml)</code>&#34; would mean to generate an SVG image &#40;which would require that the user agent track how the bitmap was generated&#44; an unlikely&#44; though potentially awesome&#44; feature&#41;&#46;

User agents must support PNG &#40;&#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;png&#45;2"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#41;&#46; User agents may support other types&#46; If the user agent does not support the requested type&#44; then it must create the file using the PNG format&#46; [&#91;PNG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPNG)

User agents must <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase"></a>[convert the provided type to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase) before establishing if they support that type&#46;

For image types that do not support an alpha component&#44; the serialized image must be the bitmap image composited onto an <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black) background using the <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;gcop&#45;source&#45;over"></a>[source&#45;over](https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_srcover) compositing operator&#46;

For image types that support color profiles&#44; the serialized image must include a color profile indicating the color space of the underlying bitmap&#46; For image types that do not support color profiles&#44; the serialized image must be <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;converting&#45;colors"></a>[converted](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) to the <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;&#39;srgb&#39;"></a>[&#39;srgb&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb) color space using <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;"></a>[&#39;relative&#45;colorimetric&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/#valdef-color-profile-rendering-intent-relative-colorimetric) rendering intent&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; in the 2D context&#44; calling the <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><code>[drawImage&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code> method to render the output of the <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl"></a><code>[toDataURL&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-todataurl)</code> or <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob"></a><code>[toBlob&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-toblob)</code> method to the canvas&#44; given the appropriate dimensions&#44; has no visible effect beyond&#44; at most&#44; clipping colors of the canvas to a more narrow gamut&#46;

For image types that support multiple bit depths&#44; the serialized image must use the bit depth that best preserves content of the underlying bitmap&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; when serializing a 2D context that has <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;color&#45;type"></a>[color type](#concept-canvas-color-type) of <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;dom&#45;canvascolortype&#45;float16"></a>[float16](#dom-canvascolortype-float16) to <var>type</var> &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;png&#45;3"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#44; the resulting image would have 16 bits per sample&#46; This serialization will still lose significant detail &#40;all values less than 0&#46;5&#47;65535 would be clamped to 0&#44; and all values greater than 1 would be clamped to 1&#41;&#46;

If <var>type</var> is an image format that supports variable quality &#40;such as &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;jpeg&#45;2"></a><code>[image&#47;jpeg](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/jpeg)</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; <var>quality</var> is given&#44; and <var>type</var> is not &#34;<a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;image&#47;png&#45;4"></a><code>[image&#47;png](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/png)</code>&#34;&#44; then&#44; if <var>quality</var> <a id="serialising&#45;bitmaps&#45;to&#45;a&#45;file&#58;js&#45;number"></a>[is a Number](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ecmascript-language-types-number-type) in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0 inclusive&#44; the user agent must treat <var>quality</var> as the desired quality level&#46; Otherwise&#44; the user agent must use its default quality value&#44; as if the <var>quality</var> argument had not been given&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The use of type&#45;testing here&#44; instead of simply declaring <var>quality</var> as a Web IDL <code>double</code>&#44; is a historical artifact&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Different implementations can have slightly different interpretations of &#34;quality&#34;&#46; When the quality is not specified&#44; an implementation&#45;specific default is used that represents a reasonable compromise between compression ratio&#44; image quality&#44; and encoding time&#46;

##### <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;6 Security with <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements[](#security-with-canvas-elements)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

<strong>Information leakage</strong> can occur if scripts from one <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin) can access information &#40;e&#46;g&#46; read pixels&#41; from images from another origin &#40;one that isn&#39;t the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin)&#41;&#46;

To mitigate this&#44; bitmaps used with <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> elements&#44; <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;offscreencanvas"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvas](#offscreencanvas)</code> objects&#44; and <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;imagebitmap"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> objects are defined to have a flag indicating whether they are <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean)&#46; All bitmaps start with their <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;2"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) set to true&#46; The flag is set to false when cross&#45;origin images are used&#46;

The <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;todataurl"></a><code>[toDataURL&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-todataurl)</code>&#44; <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;canvas&#45;toblob"></a><code>[toBlob&#40;&#41;](#dom-canvas-toblob)</code>&#44; and <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;getimagedata"></a><code>[getImageData&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-getimagedata)</code> methods check the flag and will throw a <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> rather than leak cross&#45;origin data&#46;

The value of the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;3"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is propagated from a source&#39;s bitmap to a new <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;imagebitmap&#45;2"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> object by <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;createimagebitmap"></a><code>[createImageBitmap&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-createimagebitmap)</code>&#46; Conversely&#44; a destination <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element&#39;s bitmap will have its <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;4"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flags set to false by <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><code>[drawImage](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code> if the source image is an <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;imagebitmap&#45;3"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> object whose bitmap has its <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;5"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag set to false&#46;

The flag can be reset in certain situations&#59; for example&#44; when changing the value of the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-canvas-width)</code> or the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;canvas&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-canvas-height)</code> content attribute of the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> element to which a <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code> is bound&#44; the bitmap is cleared and its <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;6"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is reset&#46;

When using an <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;imagebitmaprenderingcontext"></a><code>[ImageBitmapRenderingContext](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)</code>&#44; the value of the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;canvas&#45;origin&#45;clean&#45;7"></a>[origin&#45;clean](#concept-canvas-origin-clean) flag is propagated from <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;imagebitmap&#45;4"></a><code>[ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#imagebitmap)</code> objects when they are transferred to the <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[canvas](#the-canvas-element)</code> via <a id="security&#45;with&#45;canvas&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#45;transferfromimagebitmap"></a>[transferFromImageBitmap&#40;&#41;](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)&#46;

##### <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context"></a>4&#46;12&#46;5&#46;7 Premultiplied alpha and the 2D rendering context[](#premultiplied-alpha-and-the-2d-rendering-context)

<a id="concept&#45;premultiplied&#45;alpha"></a><strong>Premultiplied alpha</strong> refers to one way of representing transparency in an image&#44; the other being non&#45;premultiplied alpha&#46;

Under non&#45;premultiplied alpha&#44; the red&#44; green&#44; and blue components of a pixel represent that pixel&#39;s color&#44; and its alpha component represents that pixel&#39;s opacity&#46;

Under premultiplied alpha&#44; however&#44; the red&#44; green&#44; and blue components of a pixel represent the amounts of color that the pixel adds to the image&#44; and its alpha component represents the amount that the pixel obscures whatever is behind it&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; assuming the color components range from 0 &#40;off&#41; to 255 &#40;full intensity&#41;&#44; these example colors are represented in the following ways&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>CSS color representation       </th><th>Premultiplied representation       </th><th>Non&#45;premultiplied representation       </th><th>Description of color       </th><th>Image of color blended above other content     </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>rgba&#40;255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 1&#41;       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 255       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 255       </td><td>Completely&#45;opaque orange       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="An opaque orange circle sits atop a background" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-1.png" height="96">      </td></tr><tr><td>rgba&#40;255&#44; 255&#44; 0&#44; 0&#46;5&#41;       </td><td>127&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 127       </td><td>255&#44; 255&#44; 0&#44; 127       </td><td>Halfway&#45;opaque yellow       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="A yellow circle, halfway transparent, sits atop a background" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-2.png" height="96">      </td></tr><tr><td>Unrepresentable       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 127       </td><td>Unrepresentable       </td><td>Additive halfway&#45;opaque orange       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="An orange circle somewhat brightens the background that it sits atop" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-3.png" height="96">      </td></tr><tr><td>Unrepresentable       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 0       </td><td>Unrepresentable       </td><td>Additive fully&#45;transparent orange       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="An orange circle completely brightens the background that it sits atop" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-4.png" height="96">      </td></tr><tr><td>rgba&#40;255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 0&#41;       </td><td>0&#44; 0&#44; 0&#44; 0       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 0       </td><td>Fully&#45;transparent &#40;&#34;invisible&#34;&#41; orange       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="An empty background with nothing atop it" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-5.png" height="96">      </td></tr><tr><td>rgba&#40;0&#44; 127&#44; 255&#44; 0&#41;       </td><td>0&#44; 0&#44; 0&#44; 0       </td><td>255&#44; 127&#44; 0&#44; 0       </td><td>Fully&#45;transparent &#40;&#34;invisible&#34;&#41; turquoise       </td><td><img loading="lazy" width="96" alt="An empty background with nothing atop it" src="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/premultiplied-example-5.png" height="96">    </td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="convert&#45;to&#45;premultiplied"></a><strong>Converting a color value from a non&#45;premultiplied representation to a premultiplied one</strong> involves multiplying the color&#39;s red&#44; green&#44; and blue components by its alpha component &#40;remapping the range of the alpha component such that &#34;fully transparent&#34; is 0&#44; and &#34;fully opaque&#34; is 1&#41;&#46;

<a id="convert&#45;from&#45;premultiplied"></a><strong>Converting a color value from a premultiplied representation to a non&#45;premultiplied one</strong> involves the inverse&#58; dividing the color&#39;s red&#44; green&#44; and blue components by its alpha component&#46;

As certain colors can only be represented under premultiplied alpha &#40;for instance&#44; additive colors&#41;&#44; and others can only be represented under non&#45;premultiplied alpha &#40;for instance&#44; &#34;invisible&#34; colors which hold certain red&#44; green&#44; and blue values even with no opacity&#41;&#59; and division and multiplication using finite precision entails a loss of accuracy&#44; converting between premultiplied and non&#45;premultiplied alpha is a lossy operation on colors that are not fully opaque&#46;

A <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;canvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[CanvasRenderingContext2D](#canvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#39;s <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;output&#45;bitmap"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) and an <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d"></a><code>[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)</code>&#39;s <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;output&#45;bitmap&#45;2"></a>[output bitmap](#output-bitmap) must use premultiplied alpha to represent transparent colors&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is important for canvas bitmaps to represent colors using premultiplied alpha because it affects the range of representable colors&#46; While additive colors cannot currently be drawn onto canvases directly because CSS colors are non&#45;premultiplied and cannot represent them&#44; it is still possible to&#44; for instance&#44; draw additive colors onto a WebGL canvas and then draw that WebGL canvas onto a 2D canvas via <a id="premultiplied&#45;alpha&#45;and&#45;the&#45;2d&#45;rendering&#45;context&#58;dom&#45;context&#45;2d&#45;drawimage"></a><code>[drawImage&#40;&#41;](#dom-context-2d-drawimage)</code>&#46;

### <a id="custom&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;13 Custom elements[](#custom-elements)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Using&#95;custom&#95;elements](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Web_Components/Using_custom_elements)

Support in all current engines&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
