Each <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;similar&#45;origin&#45;window&#45;agent"></a>[similar&#45;origin window agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#similar-origin-window-agent) has an associated <a id="active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map"></a><strong>active custom element constructor map</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;ordered&#45;map"></a>[map](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map) of constructors to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;2"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> objects&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Window&#47;customElements](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/customElements)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox63&#43;Safari10&#46;1&#43;Chrome54&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> <a id="dom&#45;window&#45;customelements"></a><strong><code>customElements</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry) is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;3"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    A <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;window&#45;2"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window&#45;2"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window) is always created with a new <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;4"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#46;

2.  Return <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window&#45;3"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;2"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry)&#46;

<a id="customelementregistry"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;define"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementconstructor"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;elementdefinitionoptions"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementconstructor&#45;2"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;get"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;getname"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;idl&#45;promise"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementconstructor&#45;3"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;whendefined"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;upgrade"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;initialize"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node&#45;2"></a><a id="customelementconstructor"></a><a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="elementdefinitionoptions"></a><a id="dom&#45;elementdefinitionoptions&#45;extends"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface CustomElementRegistry {
  constructor();

  [CEReactions] undefined define(DOMString name, CustomElementConstructor constructor, optional ElementDefinitionOptions options = {});
  (CustomElementConstructor or undefined) get(DOMString name);
  DOMString? getName(CustomElementConstructor constructor);
  Promise<CustomElementConstructor> whenDefined(DOMString name);
  [CEReactions] undefined upgrade(Node root);
  [CEReactions] undefined initialize(Node root);
};

callback CustomElementConstructor = HTMLElement ();

dictionary ElementDefinitionOptions {
  DOMString extends;
};
```

Every <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;5"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> has an <a id="is&#45;scoped"></a><strong>is scoped</strong>&#44; a boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

Every <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;6"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> has a <a id="scoped&#45;document&#45;set"></a><strong>scoped document set</strong>&#44; a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;set"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> objects&#44; initially « »&#46;

Every <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;7"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> has a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set"></a><strong>custom element definition set</strong>&#44; a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;set&#45;2"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definitions](#custom-element-definition)&#44; initially « »&#46; Lookup of items in this <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;set&#45;3"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) uses their <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name)&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name)&#44; or <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor)&#46;

Every <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;8"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> also has an <a id="element&#45;definition&#45;is&#45;running"></a><strong>element definition is running</strong> boolean which is used to prevent reentrant invocations of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;definition"></a>[element definition](#element-definition)&#46; It is initially false&#46;

Every <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;9"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> also has a <a id="when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map"></a><strong>when&#45;defined promise map</strong>&#44; a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;ordered&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[map](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map) of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name"></a>[valid custom element names](#valid-custom-element-name) to promises&#46; It is used to implement the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;whendefined&#45;2"></a><code>[whenDefined&#40;&#41;](#dom-customelementregistry-whendefined)</code> method&#46;

To <a id="look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a><strong>look up a custom element registry</strong>&#44; given a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node&#45;3"></a><code>[Node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node)</code> object <var>node</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>node</var> is an <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> object&#44; then return <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry)&#46;

2.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadowroot"></a><code>[ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot)</code> object&#44; then return <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;root&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)&#46;

3.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; then return <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;3"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry)&#46;

4.  Return null&#46;

<strong><code><var>registry</var> &#61; <var>window</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;window&#45;customelements&#45;dev"></a>[customElements](#dom-window-customelements)</code></strong>

Returns the global&#39;s associated <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;10"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#46;

<strong><code><var>registry</var> &#61; new <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;dev"></a>[CustomElementRegistry](#dom-customelementregistry)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Constructs a new <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;11"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#44; for scoped usage&#46;

<strong><code><var>registry</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;initialize&#45;dev"></a>[initialize](#dom-customelementregistry-initialize)&#40;<var>root</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Each <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;inclusive&#45;descendant"></a>[inclusive descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) of <var>root</var> with a null registry will have it updated to this <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;13"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#46; A <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> will be thrown if this <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;14"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object is not for scoped usage and either <var>root</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node or <var>root</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;4"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry) is not this <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;15"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry"></a><strong><code>new CustomElementRegistry&#40;&#41;</code></strong> constructor steps are to set <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;is&#45;scoped"></a>[is scoped](#is-scoped) to true&#46;

<a id="element&#45;definition"></a><strong>Element definition</strong> is a process of adding a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;4"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) to the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;16"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code>&#46; This is accomplished by the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;define&#45;3"></a><code>[define&#40;&#41;](#dom-customelementregistry-define)</code> method&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;define"></a><strong><code>define&#40;<var>name</var>&#44; <var>constructor</var>&#44; <var>options</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;isconstructor"></a>[IsConstructor](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isconstructor)&#40;<var>constructor</var>&#41; is false&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>name</var> is not a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[valid custom element name](#valid-custom-element-name)&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;syntaxerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) an item with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name) <var>name</var>&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;2"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) an item with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;4"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor) <var>constructor</var>&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  Let <var>localName</var> be <var>name</var>&#46;

6.  Let <var>extends</var> be <var>options</var>&#91;&#34;<a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;elementdefinitionoptions&#45;extends"></a><code>[extends](#dom-elementdefinitionoptions-extends)</code>&#34;&#93; if it <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;exists"></a>[exists](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#59; otherwise null&#46;

7.  If <var>extends</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;is&#45;scoped&#45;2"></a>[is scoped](#is-scoped) is true&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    2.  If <var>extends</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[valid custom element name](#valid-custom-element-name)&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;6"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    3.  If the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;interface"></a>[element interface](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-interface) for <var>extends</var> and the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) is <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;htmlunknownelement"></a><code>[HTMLUnknownElement](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlunknownelement)</code> &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if <var>extends</var> does not indicate an element definition in this specification&#41;&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;7"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;9"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    4.  Set <var>localName</var> to <var>extends</var>&#46;

8.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;definition&#45;is&#45;running"></a>[element definition is running](#element-definition-is-running) is true&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;8"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;10"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

9.  Set <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;definition&#45;is&#45;running&#45;2"></a>[element definition is running](#element-definition-is-running) to true&#46;

10. Let <var>formAssociated</var> be false&#46;

11. Let <var>disableInternals</var> be false&#46;

12. Let <var>disableShadow</var> be false&#46;

13. Let <var>observedAttributes</var> be an empty <code>sequence&#60;DOMString&#62;</code>&#46;

14. Run the following steps while catching any exceptions&#58;

    1.  Let <var>prototype</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<var>constructor</var>&#44; &#34;prototype&#34;&#41;&#46;

    2.  If <var>prototype</var> <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;object"></a>[is not an Object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type)&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;typeerror&#45;2"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code> exception&#46;

    3.  Let <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var> be the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;ordered&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[ordered map](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map) «&#91; &#34;<code>connectedCallback</code>&#34; → null&#44; &#34;<code>disconnectedCallback</code>&#34; → null&#44; &#34;<code>connectedMoveCallback</code>&#34; → null&#44; &#34;<code>adoptedCallback</code>&#34; → null&#44; &#34;<code>attributeChangedCallback</code>&#34; → null &#93;»&#46;

    4.  For each <var>callbackName</var> of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;get&#45;the&#45;keys"></a>[the keys](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-getting-the-keys) of <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var>&#58;

        1.  Let <var>callbackValue</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get&#45;2"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<var>prototype</var>&#44; <var>callbackName</var>&#41;&#46;

        2.  If <var>callbackValue</var> is not undefined&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;set"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var>&#91;<var>callbackName</var>&#93; to the result of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>callbackValue</var> to the Web IDL <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;idl&#45;function"></a><code>[Function](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#common-Function)</code> callback type&#46;

    5.  If <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var>&#91;&#34;<code>attributeChangedCallback</code>&#34;&#93; is not null&#58;

        1.  Let <var>observedAttributesIterable</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get&#45;3"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<var>constructor</var>&#44; &#34;observedAttributes&#34;&#41;&#46;

        2.  If <var>observedAttributesIterable</var> is not undefined&#44; then set <var>observedAttributes</var> to the result of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert&#45;2"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>observedAttributesIterable</var> to a <code>sequence&#60;DOMString&#62;</code>&#46; Rethrow any exceptions from the conversion&#46;

    6.  Let <var>disabledFeatures</var> be an empty <code>sequence&#60;DOMString&#62;</code>&#46;

    7.  Let <var>disabledFeaturesIterable</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get&#45;4"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<var>constructor</var>&#44; &#34;disabledFeatures&#34;&#41;&#46;

    8.  If <var>disabledFeaturesIterable</var> is not undefined&#44; then set <var>disabledFeatures</var> to the result of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert&#45;3"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>disabledFeaturesIterable</var> to a <code>sequence&#60;DOMString&#62;</code>&#46; Rethrow any exceptions from the conversion&#46;

    9.  If <var>disabledFeatures</var> <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;3"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) &#34;<code>internals</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>disableInternals</var> to true&#46;

    10. If <var>disabledFeatures</var> <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;4"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) &#34;<code>shadow</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>disableShadow</var> to true&#46;

    11. Let <var>formAssociatedValue</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get&#45;5"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40; <var>constructor</var>&#44; &#34;formAssociated&#34;&#41;&#46;

    12. Set <var>formAssociated</var> to the result of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert&#45;4"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>formAssociatedValue</var> to a <code>boolean</code>&#46;

    13. If <var>formAssociated</var> is true&#44; then for each <var>callbackName</var> of « &#34;<code>formAssociatedCallback</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>formResetCallback</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>formDisabledCallback</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>formStateRestoreCallback</code>&#34; »&#58;

        1.  Let <var>callbackValue</var> be &#63; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;js&#45;get&#45;6"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<var>prototype</var>&#44; <var>callbackName</var>&#41;&#46;

        2.  If <var>callbackValue</var> is not undefined&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var>&#91;<var>callbackName</var>&#93; to the result of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert&#45;5"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>callbackValue</var> to the Web IDL <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;idl&#45;function&#45;2"></a><code>[Function](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#common-Function)</code> callback type&#46;

    Then&#44; regardless of whether the above steps threw an exception or not&#58; set <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;definition&#45;is&#45;running&#45;3"></a>[element definition is running](#element-definition-is-running) to false&#46;

    Finally&#44; if the steps threw an exception&#44; rethrow that exception&#46;

15. Let <var>definition</var> be a new <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;5"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;5"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name) <var>name</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[local name](#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name) <var>localName</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;5"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor) <var>constructor</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;observed&#45;attributes"></a>[observed attributes](#concept-custom-element-definition-observed-attributes) <var>observedAttributes</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;lifecycle&#45;callbacks"></a>[lifecycle callbacks](#concept-custom-element-definition-lifecycle-callbacks) <var>lifecycleCallbacks</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;form&#45;associated"></a>[form&#45;associated](#concept-custom-element-definition-form-associated) <var>formAssociated</var>&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;disable&#45;internals"></a>[disable internals](#concept-custom-element-definition-disable-internals) <var>disableInternals</var>&#44; and <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;disable&#45;shadow"></a>[disable shadow](#concept-custom-element-definition-disable-shadow) <var>disableShadow</var>&#46;

16. <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;set&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append) <var>definition</var> to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set)&#46;

17. If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;is&#45;scoped&#45;3"></a>[is scoped](#is-scoped) is true&#44; then for each <var>document</var> of <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;scoped&#45;document&#45;set"></a>[scoped document set](#scoped-document-set)&#58; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;upgrade&#45;particular&#45;elements&#45;within&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[upgrade particular elements within a document](#upgrade-particular-elements-within-a-document) given <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;13"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <var>document</var>&#44; <var>definition</var>&#44; and <var>localName</var>&#46;

18. Otherwise&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;upgrade&#45;particular&#45;elements&#45;within&#45;a&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[upgrade particular elements within a document](#upgrade-particular-elements-within-a-document) given <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;14"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;15"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window&#45;4"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#44; <var>definition</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; and <var>name</var>&#46;

19. If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;16"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;exists&#45;2"></a>[exists](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#58;

    1.  Resolve <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;17"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93; with <var>constructor</var>&#46;

    2.  <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;18"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93;&#46;

To <a id="upgrade&#45;particular&#45;elements&#45;within&#45;a&#45;document"></a><strong>upgrade particular elements within a document</strong> given a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;17"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object <var>registry</var>&#44; a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object <var>document</var>&#44; a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;6"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) <var>definition</var>&#44; a string <var>localName</var>&#44; and optionally a string <var>name</var> &#40;default <var>localName</var>&#41;&#58;

1.  Let <var>upgradeCandidates</var> be all elements that are <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;descendant"></a>[shadow&#45;including descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-descendant) of <var>document</var>&#44; whose <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;2"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) is <var>registry</var>&#44; whose namespace is the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; and whose local name is <var>localName</var>&#44; in <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;tree&#45;order"></a>[shadow&#45;including tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-tree-order)&#46; Additionally&#44; if <var>name</var> is not <var>localName</var>&#44; only include elements whose <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) is equal to <var>name</var>&#46;

2.  For each element <var>element</var> of <var>upgradeCandidates</var>&#58; <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;upgrade&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueue a custom element upgrade reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-upgrade-reaction) given <var>element</var> and <var>definition</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;get"></a><strong><code>get&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;19"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;4"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;5"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) an item with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;6"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name) <var>name</var>&#44; then return that item&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;6"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor)&#46;

2.  Return undefined&#46;
