The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;getname"></a><strong><code>getName&#40;<var>constructor</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;20"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;5"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;6"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) an item with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;7"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor) <var>constructor</var>&#44; then return that item&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;7"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name)&#46;

2.  Return null&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;whendefined"></a><strong><code>whenDefined&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>name</var> is not a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name&#45;5"></a>[valid custom element name](#valid-custom-element-name)&#44; then return <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;syntaxerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;11"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;21"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;6"></a>[custom element definition set](#custom-element-definition-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;list&#45;contains&#45;7"></a>[contains](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain) an item with <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;8"></a>[name](#concept-custom-element-definition-name) <var>name</var>&#44; then return <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;resolved&#45;with"></a>[a promise resolved with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-resolved-with) that item&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;8"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor)&#46;

3.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;22"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map&#45;4"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93; does not <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;exists&#45;3"></a>[exist](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;map&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;23"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map&#45;5"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93; to a new promise&#46;

4.  Return <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;24"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;when&#45;defined&#45;promise&#45;map&#45;6"></a>[when&#45;defined promise map](#when-defined-promise-map)&#91;<var>name</var>&#93;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;whendefined&#45;3"></a><code>[whenDefined&#40;&#41;](#dom-customelementregistry-whendefined)</code> method can be used to avoid performing an action until all appropriate <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[custom elements](#custom-element) are <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;defined"></a>[defined](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-defined)&#46; In this example&#44; we combine it with the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;selector&#45;defined"></a><code>[&#58;defined](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#selector-defined)</code> pseudo&#45;class to hide a dynamically&#45;loaded article&#39;s contents until we&#39;re sure that all of the <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;autonomous&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[autonomous custom elements](#autonomous-custom-element) it uses are defined&#46;

``` text
articleContainer.hidden = true;

fetch(articleURL)
  .then(response => response.text())
  .then(text => {
    articleContainer.innerHTML = text;

    return Promise.all(
      [...articleContainer.querySelectorAll(":not(:defined)")]
        .map(el => customElements.whenDefined(el.localName))
    );
  })
  .then(() => {
    articleContainer.hidden = false;
  });
```

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;upgrade"></a><strong><code>upgrade&#40;<var>root</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  For each <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;inclusive&#45;descendant&#45;2"></a>[shadow&#45;including inclusive descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) <var>candidate</var> of <var>root</var>&#44; in <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[shadow&#45;including tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>candidate</var> is not an <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> node&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  If <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;3"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) is not <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;25"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;continue&#45;2"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    3.  <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;try&#45;upgrade&#45;2"></a>[Try to upgrade](#concept-try-upgrade) <var>candidate</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;upgrade&#45;2"></a><code>[upgrade&#40;&#41;](#dom-customelementregistry-upgrade)</code> method allows upgrading of elements at will&#46; Normally elements are automatically upgraded when they become <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;connected&#45;2"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; but this method can be used if you need to upgrade before you&#39;re ready to connect the element&#46;

``` text
const el = document.createElement("spider-man");

class SpiderMan extends HTMLElement {}
customElements.define("spider-man", SpiderMan);

console.assert(!(el instanceof SpiderMan)); // not yet upgraded

customElements.upgrade(el);
console.assert(el instanceof SpiderMan);    // upgraded!
```

The <a id="dom&#45;customelementregistry&#45;initialize"></a><strong><code>initialize&#40;<var>root</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;26"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;is&#45;scoped&#45;4"></a>[is scoped](#is-scoped) is false and either <var>root</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node or <var>root</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;5"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry) is not <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;27"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; then throw a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;notsupportederror&#45;9"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;12"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>root</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node whose <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;6"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry) is null&#44; then set <var>root</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;7"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry) to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;28"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>root</var> is a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadowroot&#45;2"></a><code>[ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot)</code> node whose <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;root&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;2"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) is null&#44; then set <var>root</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;shadow&#45;root&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;3"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;29"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

4.  For each <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;inclusive&#45;descendant&#45;2"></a>[inclusive descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) <var>inclusiveDescendant</var> of <var>root</var>&#44; in <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>inclusiveDescendant</var> is not an <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;3"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> node&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;continue&#45;3"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  If <var>inclusiveDescendant</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;4"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) is null&#58;

        1.  Set <var>inclusiveDescendant</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;5"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;30"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

        2.  If <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;31"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;is&#45;scoped&#45;5"></a>[is scoped](#is-scoped) is true&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;set&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append) <var>inclusiveDescendant</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) to <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;32"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;scoped&#45;document&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[scoped document set](#scoped-document-set)&#46;

    3.  If <var>inclusiveDescendant</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;6"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) is not <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;this&#45;33"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; then <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;continue&#45;4"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    4.  <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;try&#45;upgrade&#45;3"></a>[Try to upgrade](#concept-try-upgrade) <var>inclusiveDescendant</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Once the custom element registry of a node is initialized to a <a id="custom&#45;elements&#45;api&#58;customelementregistry&#45;18"></a><code>[CustomElementRegistry](#customelementregistry)</code> object&#44; it intentionally cannot be changed any further&#46; This simplifies reasoning about code and allows implementations to optimize&#46;

#### <a id="upgrades"></a>4&#46;13&#46;5 <strong>Upgrades</strong>[](#upgrades)

To <a id="concept&#45;upgrade&#45;an&#45;element"></a><strong>upgrade an element</strong>&#44; given as input a <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) <var>definition</var> and an element <var>element</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="concept&#45;upgrade&#45;an&#45;element&#45;early&#45;exit"></a>

    If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) is not &#34;<code>undefined</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>uncustomized</code>&#34;&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    One scenario where this can occur due to reentrant invocation of this algorithm&#44; as in the following example&#58;

    ``` text
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <x-foo id="a"></x-foo>
    <x-foo id="b"></x-foo>

    <script>
    // Defining enqueues upgrade reactions for both "a" and "b"
    customElements.define("x-foo", class extends HTMLElement {
      constructor() {
        super();

        const b = document.querySelector("#b");
        b.remove();

        // While this constructor is running for "a", "b" is still
        // undefined, and so inserting it into the document will enqueue a
        // second upgrade reaction for "b" in addition to the one enqueued
        // by defining x-foo.
        document.body.appendChild(b);
      }
    })
    </script>
    ```

    This step will thus bail out the algorithm early when <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;upgrade&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[upgrade an element](#concept-upgrade-an-element) is invoked with &#34;<code>b</code>&#34; a second time&#46;

2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definition](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-definition) to <var>definition</var>&#46;

3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) to &#34;<code>failed</code>&#34;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    It will be set to &#34;<code>custom</code>&#34; [after the upgrade succeeds](#concept-upgrade-an-element-set-state-to-custom)&#46; For now&#44; we set it to &#34;<code>failed</code>&#34; so that any reentrant invocations will hit [the above early&#45;exit step](#concept-upgrade-an-element-early-exit)&#46;

4.  For each <var>attribute</var> in <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;attribute&#45;list"></a>[attribute list](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attribute)&#44; in order&#44; <a id="upgrades&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with <var>element</var>&#44; callback name &#34;<code>attributeChangedCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « <var>attribute</var>&#39;s local name&#44; null&#44; <var>attribute</var>&#39;s value&#44; <var>attribute</var>&#39;s namespace »&#46;

5.  If <var>element</var> is <a id="upgrades&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then <a id="upgrades&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction&#45;2"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with <var>element</var>&#44; callback name &#34;<code>connectedCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « »&#46;

6.  Add <var>element</var> to the end of <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;construction&#45;stack"></a>[construction stack](#concept-custom-element-definition-construction-stack)&#46;

7.  Let <var>C</var> be <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor)&#46;

8.  Let <var>previousRegistry</var> be the <a id="upgrades&#58;surrounding&#45;agent"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map"></a>[active custom element constructor map](#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<var>C</var>&#93; <a id="upgrades&#58;map&#45;with&#45;default"></a>[with default](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-with-default) null&#46;

9.  <a id="upgrades&#58;map&#45;set"></a>[Set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) the <a id="upgrades&#58;surrounding&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[active custom element constructor map](#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<var>C</var>&#93; to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry)&#46;

10. Run the following steps while catching any exceptions&#58;

    1.  If <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;disable&#45;shadow"></a>[disable shadow](#concept-custom-element-definition-disable-shadow) is true and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-shadow-root) is non&#45;null&#44; then throw a <a id="upgrades&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="upgrades&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This is needed as <a id="upgrades&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;attachshadow"></a><code>[attachShadow&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-element-attachshadow)</code> does not use <a id="upgrades&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[look up a custom element definition](#look-up-a-custom-element-definition) while <a id="upgrades&#58;dom&#45;attachinternals"></a><code>[attachInternals&#40;&#41;](#dom-attachinternals)</code> does&#46;

    2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) to &#34;<code>precustomized</code>&#34;&#46;

    3.  Let <var>constructResult</var> be the result of <a id="upgrades&#58;es&#45;constructing&#45;callback&#45;functions"></a>[constructing](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#construct-a-callback-function) <var>C</var>&#44; with no arguments&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        If <var>C</var> [non&#45;conformantly](#custom-element-conformance) uses an API decorated with the <a id="upgrades&#58;cereactions"></a><code>[&#91;CEReactions&#93;](#cereactions)</code> extended attribute&#44; then the reactions enqueued at the beginning of this algorithm will execute during this step&#44; before <var>C</var> finishes and control returns to this algorithm&#46; Otherwise&#44; they will execute after <var>C</var> and the rest of the upgrade process finishes&#46;

    4.  If <a id="upgrades&#58;samevalue"></a>[SameValue](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-samevalue)&#40;<var>constructResult</var>&#44; <var>element</var>&#41; is false&#44; then throw a <a id="upgrades&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This can occur if <var>C</var> constructs another instance of the same custom element before calling <code>super&#40;&#41;</code>&#44; or if <var>C</var> uses JavaScript&#39;s <code>return</code>&#45;override feature to return an arbitrary <a id="upgrades&#58;htmlelement"></a><code>[HTMLElement](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlelement)</code> object from the constructor&#46;

    Then&#44; perform the following steps&#44; regardless of whether the above steps threw an exception or not&#58;

    1.  If <var>previousRegistry</var> is null&#44; then <a id="upgrades&#58;map&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove) the <a id="upgrades&#58;surrounding&#45;agent&#45;3"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[active custom element constructor map](#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<var>C</var>&#93;&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="upgrades&#58;map&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) the <a id="upgrades&#58;surrounding&#45;agent&#45;4"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map&#45;4"></a>[active custom element constructor map](#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<var>C</var>&#93; to <var>previousRegistry</var>&#46;

    3.  Remove the last entry from the end of <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;construction&#45;stack&#45;2"></a>[construction stack](#concept-custom-element-definition-construction-stack)&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        Assuming <var>C</var> calls <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> &#40;as it will if it is [conformant](#custom-element-conformance)&#41;&#44; and that the call succeeds&#44; this will be the <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;already&#45;constructed&#45;marker"></a>[<em>already constructed</em> marker](#concept-already-constructed-marker) that replaced the <var>element</var> we pushed at the beginning of this algorithm&#46; &#40;The [HTML element constructor](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-constructors) carries out this replacement&#46;&#41;

        If <var>C</var> does not call <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> &#40;i&#46;e&#46; it is not [conformant](#custom-element-conformance)&#41;&#44; or if any step in the [HTML element constructor](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-constructors) throws&#44; then this entry will still be <var>element</var>&#46;

    Finally&#44; if the above steps threw an exception&#58;

    1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;2"></a>[custom element definition](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-definition) to null&#46;

    2.  Empty <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue"></a>[custom element reaction queue](#custom-element-reaction-queue)&#46;

    3.  Rethrow the exception &#40;thus terminating this algorithm&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If the above steps threw an exception&#44; then <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) will remain &#34;<code>failed</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>precustomized</code>&#34;&#46;

11. If <var>element</var> is a <a id="upgrades&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#58;

    1.  <a id="upgrades&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;form&#45;owner"></a>[Reset the form owner](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#reset-the-form-owner) of <var>element</var>&#46; If <var>element</var> is associated with a <a id="upgrades&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="upgrades&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction&#45;3"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with <var>element</var>&#44; callback name &#34;<code>formAssociatedCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « the associated <a id="upgrades&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> »&#46;

    2.  If <var>element</var> is <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; then <a id="upgrades&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction&#45;4"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with <var>element</var>&#44; callback name &#34;<code>formDisabledCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « true »&#46;

12. <a id="concept&#45;upgrade&#45;an&#45;element&#45;set&#45;state&#45;to&#45;custom"></a>

    Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state&#45;5"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) to &#34;<code>custom</code>&#34;&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;try&#45;upgrade"></a><strong>try to upgrade an element</strong> given an element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>definition</var> be the result of <a id="upgrades&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;2"></a>[looking up a custom element definition](#look-up-a-custom-element-definition) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;2"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry)&#44; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;namespace"></a>[namespace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-namespace)&#44; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#44; and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="upgrades&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value)&#46;

2.  If <var>definition</var> is not null&#44; then <a id="upgrades&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;upgrade&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueue a custom element upgrade reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-upgrade-reaction) given <var>element</var> and <var>definition</var>&#46;

#### <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions"></a>4&#46;13&#46;6 Custom element reactions[](#custom-element-reactions)

A <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](#custom-element) possesses the ability to respond to certain occurrences by running author code&#58;

- When <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;upgrades"></a>[upgraded](#upgrades)&#44; its <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](#custom-element-constructor) is run&#44; with no arguments&#46;

- When it <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;becomes&#45;connected"></a>[becomes connected](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#becomes-connected)&#44; its <code>connectedCallback</code> is called&#44; with no arguments&#46;

- When it <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;becomes&#45;disconnected"></a>[becomes disconnected](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#becomes-disconnected)&#44; its <code>disconnectedCallback</code> is called&#44; with no arguments&#46;

- When it is <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;move&#45;ext"></a>[moved](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-move-ext)&#44; its <code>connectedMoveCallback</code> is called&#44; with no arguments&#46;

- When it is <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;adopt"></a>[adopted](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-adopt) into a new document&#44; its <code>adoptedCallback</code> is called&#44; given the old document and new document as arguments&#46;

- When any of its attributes are <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change"></a>[changed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change)&#44; <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;append"></a>[appended](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-append)&#44; <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove"></a>[removed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove)&#44; or <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;replace"></a>[replaced](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-replace)&#44; its <code>attributeChangedCallback</code> is called&#44; given the attribute&#39;s local name&#44; old value&#44; new value&#44; and namespace as arguments&#46; &#40;An attribute&#39;s old or new value is considered to be null when the attribute is added or removed&#44; respectively&#46;&#41;

- When the user agent <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;form&#45;owner"></a>[resets the form owner](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#reset-the-form-owner) of a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) and doing so changes the form owner&#44; its <code>formAssociatedCallback</code> is called&#44; given the new form owner &#40;or null if no owner&#41; as an argument&#46;

- When the form owner of a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) is <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset"></a>[reset](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-form-reset)&#44; its <code>formResetCallback</code> is called&#46;

- When the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-disabled) state of a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) is changed&#44; its <code>formDisabledCallback</code> is called&#44; given the new state as an argument&#46;

- When the user agent updates a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#39;s value on behalf of a user or <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;restore&#45;persisted&#45;state"></a>[as part of navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#restore-persisted-state)&#44; its <code>formStateRestoreCallback</code> is called&#44; given the new state and a string indicating a reason&#44; &#34;<code>autocomplete</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>restore</code>&#34;&#44; as arguments&#46;

We call these reactions collectively <a id="concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction"></a><strong>custom element reactions</strong>&#46;

The way in which <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction) are invoked is done with special care&#44; to avoid running author code during the middle of delicate operations&#46; Effectively&#44; they are delayed until &#34;just before returning to user script&#34;&#46; This means that for most purposes they appear to execute synchronously&#44; but in the case of complicated composite operations &#40;like <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone"></a>[cloning](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone)&#44; or <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;range"></a>[range](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-range) manipulation&#41;&#44; they will instead be delayed until after all the relevant user agent processing steps have completed&#44; and then run together as a batch&#46;

Additionally&#44; the precise ordering of these reactions is managed via a somewhat&#45;complicated stack&#45;of&#45;queues system&#44; described below&#46; The intention behind this system is to guarantee that <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;2"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction) always are invoked in the same order as their triggering actions&#44; at least within the local context of a single <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[custom element](#custom-element)&#46; &#40;Because <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;3"></a>[custom element reaction](#concept-custom-element-reaction) code can perform its own mutations&#44; it is not possible to give a global ordering guarantee across multiple elements&#46;&#41;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;similar&#45;origin&#45;window&#45;agent"></a>[similar&#45;origin window agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#similar-origin-window-agent) has a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack"></a><strong>custom element reactions stack</strong>&#44; which is initially empty&#46; A <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;similar&#45;origin&#45;window&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[similar&#45;origin window agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#similar-origin-window-agent)&#39;s <a id="current&#45;element&#45;queue"></a><strong>current element queue</strong> is the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;element&#45;queue"></a>[element queue](#element-queue) at the top of its <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46; Each item in the stack is an <a id="element&#45;queue"></a><strong>element queue</strong>&#44; which is initially empty as well&#46; Each item in an <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[element queue](#element-queue) is an element&#46; &#40;The elements are not necessarily <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;custom"></a>[custom](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom) yet&#44; since this queue is used for <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;upgrades&#45;2"></a>[upgrades](#upgrades) as well&#46;&#41;

Each <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;2"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack) has an associated <a id="backup&#45;element&#45;queue"></a><strong>backup element queue</strong>&#44; which is an initially&#45;empty <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;3"></a>[element queue](#element-queue)&#46; Elements are pushed onto the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;backup&#45;element&#45;queue"></a>[backup element queue](#backup-element-queue) during operations that affect the DOM without going through an API decorated with <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;cereactions"></a><code>[&#91;CEReactions&#93;](#cereactions)</code>&#44; or through the parser&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[create an element for the token](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#create-an-element-for-the-token) algorithm&#46; An example of this is a user&#45;initiated editing operation which modifies the descendants or attributes of an <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;editable"></a>[editable](https://w3c.github.io/editing/docs/execCommand/#editable) element&#46; To prevent reentrancy when processing the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;backup&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[backup element queue](#backup-element-queue)&#44; each <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;3"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack) also has a <a id="processing&#45;the&#45;backup&#45;element&#45;queue"></a><strong>processing the backup element queue</strong> flag&#44; initially unset&#46;

All elements have an associated <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue"></a><strong>custom element reaction queue</strong>&#44; initially empty&#46; Each item in the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue"></a>[custom element reaction queue](#custom-element-reaction-queue) is of one of two types&#58;

- An <a id="upgrade&#45;reaction"></a><strong>upgrade reaction</strong>&#44; which will <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;upgrades&#45;3"></a>[upgrade](#upgrades) the custom element and contains a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition)&#59; or

- A <a id="callback&#45;reaction"></a><strong>callback reaction</strong>&#44; which will call a lifecycle callback&#44; and contains a callback function as well as a list of arguments&#46;

This is all summarized in the following schematic diagram&#58;

![A custom element reactions stack consists of a stack of element queues&#46; Zooming in on a particular queue&#44; we see that it contains a number of elements &#40;in our example&#44; &#60;x&#45;a&#62;&#44; then &#60;x&#45;b&#62;&#44; then &#60;x&#45;c&#62;&#41;&#46; Any particular element in the queue then has a custom element reaction queue&#46; Zooming in on the custom element reaction queue&#44; we see that it contains a variety of queued&#45;up reactions &#40;in our example&#44; upgrade&#44; then attribute changed&#44; then another attribute changed&#44; then connected&#41;&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/custom-element-reactions.svg)

To <a id="enqueue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;on&#45;the&#45;appropriate&#45;element&#45;queue"></a><strong>enqueue an element on the appropriate element queue</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>reactionsStack</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;relevant&#45;agent"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;4"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46;

2.  If <var>reactionsStack</var> is empty&#58;

    1.  Add <var>element</var> to <var>reactionsStack</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;backup&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;3"></a>[backup element queue](#backup-element-queue)&#46;

    2.  If <var>reactionsStack</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;processing&#45;the&#45;backup&#45;element&#45;queue"></a>[processing the backup element queue](#processing-the-backup-element-queue) flag is set&#44; then return&#46;

    3.  Set <var>reactionsStack</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;processing&#45;the&#45;backup&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[processing the backup element queue](#processing-the-backup-element-queue) flag&#46;

    4.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask"></a>[Queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to perform the following steps&#58;

        1.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;invoke&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions"></a>[Invoke custom element reactions](#invoke-custom-element-reactions) in <var>reactionsStack</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;backup&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;4"></a>[backup element queue](#backup-element-queue)&#46;

        2.  Unset <var>reactionsStack</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;processing&#45;the&#45;backup&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;3"></a>[processing the backup element queue](#processing-the-backup-element-queue) flag&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; add <var>element</var> to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;current&#45;element&#45;queue"></a>[current element queue](#current-element-queue)&#46;

To <a id="enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction"></a><strong>enqueue a custom element callback reaction</strong>&#44; given a <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[custom element](#custom-element) <var>element</var>&#44; a callback name <var>callbackName</var>&#44; and a list of arguments <var>args</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>definition</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definition](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-definition)&#46;

2.  Let <var>callback</var> be the value of the entry in <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;lifecycle&#45;callbacks"></a>[lifecycle callbacks](#concept-custom-element-definition-lifecycle-callbacks) with key <var>callbackName</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>callbackName</var> is &#34;<code>connectedMoveCallback</code>&#34; and <var>callback</var> is null&#58;

    1.  Let <var>disconnectedCallback</var> be the value of the entry in <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;lifecycle&#45;callbacks&#45;2"></a>[lifecycle callbacks](#concept-custom-element-definition-lifecycle-callbacks) with key &#34;<code>disconnectedCallback</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  Let <var>connectedCallback</var> be the value of the entry in <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;lifecycle&#45;callbacks&#45;3"></a>[lifecycle callbacks](#concept-custom-element-definition-lifecycle-callbacks) with key &#34;<code>connectedCallback</code>&#34;&#46;

    3.  If <var>connectedCallback</var> and <var>disconnectedCallback</var> are null&#44; then return&#46;

    4.  Set <var>callback</var> to the following steps&#58;

        1.  If <var>disconnectedCallback</var> is not null&#44; then call <var>disconnectedCallback</var> with no arguments&#46;

        2.  If <var>connectedCallback</var> is not null&#44; then call <var>connectedCallback</var> with no arguments&#46;

4.  If <var>callback</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If <var>callbackName</var> is &#34;<code>attributeChangedCallback</code>&#34;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>attributeName</var> be the first element of <var>args</var>&#46;

    2.  If <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;observed&#45;attributes"></a>[observed attributes](#concept-custom-element-definition-observed-attributes) does not contain <var>attributeName</var>&#44; then return&#46;

6.  Add a new <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;callback&#45;reaction"></a>[callback reaction](#callback-reaction) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[custom element reaction queue](#custom-element-reaction-queue)&#44; with callback function <var>callback</var> and arguments <var>args</var>&#46;

7.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;enqueue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;on&#45;the&#45;appropriate&#45;element&#45;queue"></a>[Enqueue an element on the appropriate element queue](#enqueue-an-element-on-the-appropriate-element-queue) given <var>element</var>&#46;

To <a id="enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;upgrade&#45;reaction"></a><strong>enqueue a custom element upgrade reaction</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var> and <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;2"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) <var>definition</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  Add a new <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;upgrade&#45;reaction"></a>[upgrade reaction](#upgrade-reaction) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue&#45;3"></a>[custom element reaction queue](#custom-element-reaction-queue)&#44; with <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;3"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition) <var>definition</var>&#46;

2.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;enqueue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;on&#45;the&#45;appropriate&#45;element&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[Enqueue an element on the appropriate element queue](#enqueue-an-element-on-the-appropriate-element-queue) given <var>element</var>&#46;

To <a id="invoke&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions"></a><strong>invoke custom element reactions</strong> in an <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;4"></a>[element queue](#element-queue) <var>queue</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  While <var>queue</var> is not <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;list&#45;is&#45;empty"></a>[empty](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;dequeue"></a>[dequeuing](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#queue-dequeue) from <var>queue</var>&#46;

    2.  Let <var>reactions</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;queue&#45;4"></a>[custom element reaction queue](#custom-element-reaction-queue)&#46;

    3.  Repeat until <var>reactions</var> is empty&#58;

        1.  Remove the first element of <var>reactions</var>&#44; and let <var>reaction</var> be that element&#46; Switch on <var>reaction</var>&#39;s type&#58;

            <strong><a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;upgrade&#45;reaction&#45;2"></a>[upgrade reaction](#upgrade-reaction)</strong>

            <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;upgrade&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[Upgrade](#concept-upgrade-an-element) <var>element</var> using <var>reaction</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;4"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition)&#46;

            If this throws an exception&#44; catch it&#44; and <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;report&#45;an&#45;exception"></a>[report](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#report-an-exception) it for <var>reaction</var>&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;5"></a>[custom element definition](#custom-element-definition)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor)&#39;s corresponding JavaScript object&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;associated&#45;realm"></a>[associated realm](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-associated-realm)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;realm&#45;global"></a>[global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-realm-global)&#46;

            <strong><a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;callback&#45;reaction&#45;2"></a>[callback reaction](#callback-reaction)</strong>

            <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;es&#45;invoking&#45;callback&#45;functions"></a>[Invoke](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function) <var>reaction</var>&#39;s callback function with <var>reaction</var>&#39;s arguments and &#34;<code>report</code>&#34;&#44; and <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;dfn&#45;callback&#45;this&#45;value"></a><em>[callback this value](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-callback-this-value)</em> set to <var>element</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To ensure <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;4"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction) are triggered appropriately&#44; we introduce the <a id="cereactions"></a><strong><code>&#91;CEReactions&#93;</code></strong> IDL <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;extended&#45;attribute"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute)&#46; It indicates that the relevant algorithm is to be supplemented with additional steps in order to appropriately track and invoke <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;5"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction)&#46;

The <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;CEReactions&#93;](#cereactions)</code> extended attribute must take no arguments&#44; and must not appear on anything other than an operation&#44; attribute&#44; setter&#44; or deleter&#46; Additionally&#44; it must not appear on readonly attributes&#46;

Operations&#44; attributes&#44; setters&#44; or deleters annotated with the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;CEReactions&#93;](#cereactions)</code> extended attribute must run the following steps in place of the ones specified in their description&#58;

1.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;stack&#45;push"></a>[Push](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack-push) a new <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;5"></a>[element queue](#element-queue) onto this object&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;3"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;5"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46;

2.  Run the originally&#45;specified steps for this construct&#44; catching any exceptions&#46; If the steps return a value&#44; let <var>value</var> be the returned value&#46; If they throw an exception&#44; let <var>exception</var> be the thrown exception&#46;

3.  Let <var>queue</var> be the result of <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;stack&#45;pop"></a>[popping](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#stack-pop) from this object&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;4"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;6"></a>[custom element reactions stack](#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46;

4.  <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;invoke&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;2"></a>[Invoke custom element reactions](#invoke-custom-element-reactions) in <var>queue</var>&#46;

5.  If an exception <var>exception</var> was thrown by the original steps&#44; rethrow <var>exception</var>&#46;

6.  If a value <var>value</var> was returned from the original steps&#44; return <var>value</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The intent behind this extended attribute is somewhat subtle&#46; One way of accomplishing its goals would be to say that every operation&#44; attribute&#44; setter&#44; and deleter on the platform must have these steps inserted&#44; and to allow implementers to optimize away unnecessary cases &#40;where no DOM mutation is possible that could cause <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;6"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction) to occur&#41;&#46;

However&#44; in practice this imprecision could lead to non&#45;interoperable implementations of <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reaction&#45;7"></a>[custom element reactions](#concept-custom-element-reaction)&#44; as some implementations might forget to invoke these steps in some cases&#46; Instead&#44; we settled on the approach of explicitly annotating all relevant IDL constructs&#44; as a way of ensuring interoperable behavior and helping implementations easily pinpoint all cases where these steps are necessary&#46;

Any nonstandard APIs introduced by the user agent that could modify the DOM in such a way as to cause <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueuing a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) or <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;upgrade&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueuing a custom element upgrade reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-upgrade-reaction)&#44; for example by modifying any attributes or child elements&#44; must also be decorated with the <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><code>[&#91;CEReactions&#93;](#cereactions)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

As of the time of this writing&#44; the following nonstandard or not&#45;yet&#45;standardized APIs are known to fall into this category&#58;

- <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;htmlinputelement"></a><code>[HTMLInputElement](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#htmlinputelement)</code>&#39;s <code>webkitdirectory</code> and <code>incremental</code> IDL attributes

- <a id="custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#58;htmllinkelement"></a><code>[HTMLLinkElement](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#htmllinkelement)</code>&#39;s <code>scope</code> IDL attribute

#### <a id="element&#45;internals"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7 Element internals[](#element-internals)

Certain capabilities are meant to be available to a custom element author&#44; but not to a custom element consumer&#46; These are provided by the <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;dom&#45;attachinternals"></a><code>[element&#46;attachInternals&#40;&#41;](#dom-attachinternals)</code> method&#44; which returns an instance of <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;elementinternals"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code>&#46; The properties and methods of <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;elementinternals&#45;2"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> allow control over internal features which the user agent provides to all elements&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;attachinternals&#45;dev"></a>[attachInternals&#40;&#41;](#dom-attachinternals)</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;elementinternals&#45;3"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> object targeting the <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](#custom-element) <var>element</var>&#46; Throws an exception if <var>element</var> is not a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[custom element](#custom-element)&#44; if the &#34;<code>internals</code>&#34; feature was disabled as part of the element definition&#44; or if it is called twice on the same element&#46;

Each <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;htmlelement"></a><code>[HTMLElement](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlelement)</code> has an <a id="attached&#45;internals"></a><strong>attached internals</strong> &#40;null or an <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;elementinternals&#45;4"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> object&#41;&#44; initially null&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLElement&#47;attachInternals](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/attachInternals)

Support in all current engines&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;attachinternals"></a><strong><code>attachInternals&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) is not null&#44; then throw a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>definition</var> be the result of <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[looking up a custom element definition](#look-up-a-custom-element-definition) given <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry)&#44; <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;namespace"></a>[namespace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-namespace)&#44; <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#44; and null&#46;

3.  If <var>definition</var> is null&#44; then throw a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;notsupportederror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  If <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;disable&#45;internals"></a>[disable internals](#concept-custom-element-definition-disable-internals) is true&#44; then throw a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;notsupportederror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  If <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;attached&#45;internals"></a>[attached internals](#attached-internals) is non&#45;null&#44; then throw a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;notsupportederror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

6.  If <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) is not &#34;<code>precustomized</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>custom</code>&#34;&#44; then throw a <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;notsupportederror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

7.  Set <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;attached&#45;internals&#45;2"></a>[attached internals](#attached-internals) to a new <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;elementinternals&#45;5"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> instance whose <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](#internals-target) is <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

8.  Return <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="element&#45;internals&#58;attached&#45;internals&#45;3"></a>[attached internals](#attached-internals)&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7&#46;1 The <a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;elementinternals"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> interface[](#the-elementinternals-interface)

<a id="elementinternals"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;shadowroot"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;shadowroot"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;form"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;validity"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;validationmessage"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;checkvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;reportvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;nodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;labels"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;customstateset"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;elementinternals&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;ariamixin"></a><a id="validitystateflags"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface ElementInternals {
  // Shadow root access
  readonly attribute ShadowRoot? shadowRoot;

  // Form-associated custom elements
  undefined setFormValue((File or USVString or FormData)? value,
                         optional (File or USVString or FormData)? state);

  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;

  undefined setValidity(optional ValidityStateFlags flags = {},
                        optional DOMString message,
                        optional HTMLElement anchor);
  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();

  readonly attribute NodeList labels;

  // Custom state pseudo-class
  [SameObject] readonly attribute CustomStateSet states;
};

// Accessibility semantics
ElementInternals includes ARIAMixin;

dictionary ValidityStateFlags {
  boolean valueMissing = false;
  boolean typeMismatch = false;
  boolean patternMismatch = false;
  boolean tooLong = false;
  boolean tooShort = false;
  boolean rangeUnderflow = false;
  boolean rangeOverflow = false;
  boolean stepMismatch = false;
  boolean badInput = false;
  boolean customError = false;
};
```

Each <a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;elementinternals&#45;4"></a><code>[ElementInternals](#elementinternals)</code> has a <a id="internals&#45;target"></a><strong>target element</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;elementinternals&#45;interface&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](#custom-element)&#46;

##### <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7&#46;2 Shadow root access[](#shadow-root-access)

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;shadowroot"></a>[shadowRoot](#dom-elementinternals-shadowroot)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;shadowroot"></a><code>[ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot)</code> for <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#44; if the <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target element](#internals-target) is a <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;shadow&#45;host"></a>[shadow host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-shadow-host)&#44; or null otherwise&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN
