The <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;shadowroot"></a><strong><code>shadowRoot</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>target</var> be <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

2.  If <var>target</var> is not a <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;shadow&#45;host&#45;2"></a>[shadow host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-shadow-host)&#44; then return null&#46;

3.  Let <var>shadow</var> be <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-shadow-root)&#46;

4.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="shadow&#45;root&#45;access&#58;available&#45;to&#45;element&#45;internals"></a>[available to element internals](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-available-to-element-internals) is false&#44; then return null&#46;

5.  Return <var>shadow</var>&#46;

##### <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7&#46;3 Form&#45;associated custom elements[](#form-associated-custom-elements)

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setformvalue"></a>[setFormValue](#dom-elementinternals-setformvalue)&#40;<var>value</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Sets both the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state"></a>[state](#face-state) and <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) of <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](#internals-target) to <var>value</var>&#46;

If <var>value</var> is null&#44; the element won&#39;t participate in form submission&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setformvalue&#45;2"></a>[setFormValue](#dom-elementinternals-setformvalue)&#40;<var>value</var>&#44; <var>state</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Sets the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) of <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target element](#internals-target) to <var>value</var>&#44; and its <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[state](#face-state) to <var>state</var>&#46;

If <var>value</var> is null&#44; the element won&#39;t participate in form submission&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;form"></a>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-form)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-owner) of <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity"></a>[setValidity](#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)&#40;<var>flags</var>&#44; <var>message</var> &#91;&#44; <var>anchor</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Marks <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;4"></a>[target element](#internals-target) as suffering from the constraints indicated by the <var>flags</var> argument&#44; and sets the element&#39;s validation message to <var>message</var>&#46; If <var>anchor</var> is specified&#44; the user agent might use it to indicate problems with the constraints of <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;5"></a>[target element](#internals-target) when the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-owner) is validated interactively or <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;reportvalidity"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-reportvalidity)</code> is called&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;2"></a>[setValidity](#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)&#40;&#123;&#125;&#41;</code></strong>

Marks <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;6"></a>[target element](#internals-target) as <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;fv&#45;valid"></a>[satisfying its constraints](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fv-valid)&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;willvalidate"></a>[willValidate](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-willvalidate)</code></strong>

Returns true if <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;7"></a>[target element](#internals-target) will be validated when the form is submitted&#59; false otherwise&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;validity"></a>[validity](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-validity)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;validitystate"></a><code>[ValidityState](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#validitystate)</code> object for <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;8"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;validationmessage"></a>[validationMessage](#dom-elementinternals-validationmessage)</code></strong>

Returns the error message that would be shown to the user if <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;9"></a>[target element](#internals-target) was to be checked for validity&#46;

<strong><code><var>valid</var> &#61; <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;checkvalidity"></a>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-checkvalidity)</code></strong>

Returns true if <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;10"></a>[target element](#internals-target) has no validity problems&#59; false otherwise&#46; Fires an <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;event&#45;invalid"></a><code>[invalid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-invalid)</code> event at the element in the latter case&#46;

<strong><code><var>valid</var> &#61; <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-reportvalidity)</code></strong>

Returns true if <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;11"></a>[target element](#internals-target) has no validity problems&#59; otherwise&#44; returns false&#44; fires an <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;event&#45;invalid&#45;2"></a><code>[invalid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-invalid)</code> event at the element&#44; and &#40;if the event isn&#39;t canceled&#41; reports the problem to the user&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;labels"></a>[labels](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-elementinternals-labels)</code></strong>

Returns a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;nodelist"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> of all the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-label-element)</code> elements that <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;12"></a>[target element](#internals-target) is associated with&#46;

Each <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) has <a id="face&#45;submission&#45;value"></a><strong>submission value</strong>&#46; It is used to provide one or more <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;entry"></a>[entries](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-entry) on form submission&#46; The initial value of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) is null&#44; and <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) can be null&#44; a string&#44; a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;file"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code>&#44; or a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;2"></a>[entries](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-entry)&#46;

Each <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) has <a id="face&#45;state"></a><strong>state</strong>&#46; It is information with which the user agent can restore a user&#39;s input for the element&#46; The initial value of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[state](#face-state) is null&#44; and <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[state](#face-state) can be null&#44; a string&#44; a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;file&#45;2"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code>&#44; or a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;2"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;3"></a>[entries](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-entry)&#46;

The <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setformvalue&#45;3"></a><code>[setFormValue&#40;&#41;](#dom-elementinternals-setformvalue)</code> method is used by the custom element author to set the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) and <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;5"></a>[state](#face-state)&#44; thus communicating these to the user agent&#46;

When the user agent believes it is a good idea to restore a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;6"></a>[state](#face-state)&#44; for example <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;restore&#45;persisted&#45;state"></a>[after navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#restore-persisted-state) or restarting the user agent&#44; they may <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with that element&#44; callback name &#34;<code>formStateRestoreCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « the state to be restored&#44; &#34;<code>restore</code>&#34; »&#46;

If the user agent has a form&#45;filling assist feature&#44; then when the feature is invoked&#44; it may <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction&#45;2"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; callback name &#34;<code>formStateRestoreCallback</code>&#34;&#44; and « the state value determined by history of state value and some heuristics&#44; &#34;<code>autocomplete</code>&#34; »&#46;

In general&#44; the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;7"></a>[state](#face-state) is information specified by a user&#44; and the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) is a value after canonicalization or sanitization&#44; suitable for submission to the server&#46; The following examples makes this concrete&#58;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Suppose that we have a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) which asks a user to specify a date&#46; The user specifies &#34;3&#47;15&#47;2019&#34;&#44; but the control wishes to submit <code>&#34;2019&#45;03&#45;15&#34;</code> to the server&#46; &#34;3&#47;15&#47;2019&#34; would be a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;8"></a>[state](#face-state) of the element&#44; and <code>&#34;2019&#45;03&#45;15&#34;</code> would be a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Suppose you develop a custom element emulating a the behavior of the existing <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>[checkbox](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> type&#46; Its <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) would be the value of its <code>value</code> content attribute&#44; or the string <code>&#34;on&#34;</code>&#46; Its <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;9"></a>[state](#face-state) would be one of <code>&#34;checked&#34;</code>&#44; <code>&#34;unchecked&#34;</code>&#44; <code>&#34;checked&#47;indeterminate&#34;</code>&#44; or <code>&#34;unchecked&#47;indeterminate&#34;</code>&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

The <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setformvalue"></a><strong><code>setFormValue&#40;<var>value</var>&#44; <var>state</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>element</var> be <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;13"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is not a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; then throw a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) to <var>value</var> if <var>value</var> is not a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;formdata"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object&#44; or to a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;clone"></a>[clone](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone) of <var>value</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;formdata&#45;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-formdata-entry-list) otherwise&#46;

4.  If the <var>state</var> argument of the function is omitted&#44; set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;10"></a>[state](#face-state) to its <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;10"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value)&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>state</var> is a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;formdata&#45;2"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object&#44; set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;11"></a>[state](#face-state) to a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;clone&#45;2"></a>[clone](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone) of <var>state</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;formdata&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[entry list](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-formdata-entry-list)&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;state&#45;12"></a>[state](#face-state) to <var>state</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) has validity flags named <code>valueMissing</code>&#44; <code>typeMismatch</code>&#44; <code>patternMismatch</code>&#44; <code>tooLong</code>&#44; <code>tooShort</code>&#44; <code>rangeUnderflow</code>&#44; <code>rangeOverflow</code>&#44; <code>stepMismatch</code>&#44; and <code>customError</code>&#46; They are false initially&#46;

Each <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) has a <a id="face&#45;validation&#45;message"></a><strong>validation message</strong> string&#46; It is the empty string initially&#46;

Each <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) has a <a id="face&#45;validation&#45;anchor"></a><strong>validation anchor</strong> element&#46; It is null initially&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity"></a><strong><code>setValidity&#40;<var>flags</var>&#44; <var>message</var>&#44; <var>anchor</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>element</var> be <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;14"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is not a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; then throw a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;notsupportederror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>message</var> is not given&#44; then set it to the empty string&#46;

4.  If <var>flags</var> contains one or more true values and <var>message</var> is the empty string&#44; then throw a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

5.  Set <var>message</var> to the result of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[normalizing newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines) given <var>message</var>&#46;

6.  For each entry <var>flag</var> → <var>value</var> of <var>flags</var>&#44; set <var>element</var>&#39;s validity flag with the name <var>flag</var> to <var>value</var>&#46;

7.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;validation&#45;message"></a>[validation message](#face-validation-message) to the empty string if all of <var>element</var>&#39;s validity flags are false&#59; otherwise to <var>message</var>&#46;

8.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <code>customError</code> validity flag is true&#44; then set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message"></a>[custom validity error message](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#custom-validity-error-message) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;validation&#45;message&#45;2"></a>[validation message](#face-validation-message)&#46; Otherwise&#44; set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message&#45;2"></a>[custom validity error message](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#custom-validity-error-message) to the empty string&#46;

9.  If <var>anchor</var> is not given&#44; then set it to <var>element</var>&#46;

10. Otherwise&#44; if <var>anchor</var> is not a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;inclusive&#45;descendant"></a>[shadow&#45;including inclusive descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) of <var>element</var>&#44; then throw a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;notfounderror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotFoundError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notfounderror) <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

11. Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;validation&#45;anchor"></a>[validation anchor](#face-validation-anchor) to <var>anchor</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;validationmessage"></a><strong><code>validationMessage</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>element</var> be <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;15"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is not a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; then throw a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;notsupportederror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  Return <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;validation&#45;message&#45;3"></a>[validation message](#face-validation-message)&#46;

The <a id="face&#45;entry&#45;construction"></a><strong>entry construction algorithm</strong> for a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; given an element <var>element</var> and an <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#entry-list) <var>entry list</var>&#44; consists of the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;11"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) is a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;3"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;4"></a>[entries](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-entry)&#44; then <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) each item of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;12"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) to <var>entry list</var>&#44; and return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    In this case&#44; user agent does not refer to the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> content attribute value&#46; An implementation of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](#form-associated-custom-element) is responsible to decide names of <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;5"></a>[entries](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-entry)&#46; They can be the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> content attribute value&#44; they can be strings based on the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> content attribute value&#44; or they can be unrelated to the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> content attribute&#46;

2.  If the element does not have a <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;5"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute specified&#44; or its <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;6"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;13"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value) is not null&#44; <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry"></a>[create an entry](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#create-an-entry) with the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;7"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute value and the <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;face&#45;submission&#45;value&#45;14"></a>[submission value](#face-submission-value)&#44; and <a id="form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

##### <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7&#46;4 Accessibility semantics[](#accessibility-semantics)

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;dom&#45;ariamixin&#45;role"></a>[role](https://w3c.github.io/aria/#idl-def-ariamixin-role) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Sets or retrieves the default ARIA role for <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#44; which will be used unless the page author overrides it using the <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;role"></a><code>[role](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-aria-role)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;dom&#45;ariamixin&#45;aria&#42;"></a>[aria&#42;](https://w3c.github.io/aria/#idl-def-ariamixin-ariaactivedescendantelement) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Sets or retrieves various default ARIA states or property values for <var>internals</var>&#39;s <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#44; which will be used unless the page author overrides them using the <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;&#42;"></a><code>[aria&#45;&#42;](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-aria-*)</code> attributes&#46;

Each <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](#custom-element) has an <a id="internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map"></a><strong>internal content attribute map</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="accessibility&#45;semantics&#58;ordered&#45;map"></a>[map](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map)&#44; initially empty&#46; See the [Requirements related to ARIA and to platform accessibility APIs](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#wai-aria) section for information on how this impacts platform accessibility APIs&#46;

##### <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class"></a>4&#46;13&#46;7&#46;5 Custom state pseudo&#45;class[](#custom-state-pseudo-class)

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;add&#40;<var>value</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Adds the string <var>value</var> to the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set"></a>[states set](#states-set) to be exposed as a pseudo&#45;class&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;2"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;has&#40;<var>value</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns true if <var>value</var> is in the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[states set](#states-set)&#44; otherwise false&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;3"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;delete&#40;<var>value</var>&#41;</code></strong>

If the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[states set](#states-set) has <var>value</var>&#44; then it will be removed and true will be returned&#46; Otherwise&#44; false will be returned&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;4"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;clear&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Removes all values from the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;4"></a>[states set](#states-set)&#46;

<strong><code>for &#40;const <var>stateName</var> of <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;5"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code>for &#40;const <var>stateName</var> of <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;6"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;entries&#40;&#41;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code>for &#40;const <var>stateName</var> of <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;7"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;keys&#40;&#41;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code>for &#40;const <var>stateName</var> of <var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;8"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;values&#40;&#41;&#41;</code></strong>

Iterates over all values in the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;5"></a>[states set](#states-set)&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;9"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;forEach&#40;<var>callback</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Iterates over all values in the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;6"></a>[states set](#states-set) by calling <var>callback</var> once for each value&#46;

<strong><code><var>internals</var>&#46;<a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states&#45;10"></a>[states](#dom-elementinternals-states)&#46;size</code></strong>

Returns the number of values in the element&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;7"></a>[states set](#states-set)&#46;

Each <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](#custom-element) has a <a id="states&#45;set"></a><strong>states set</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;customstateset"></a><code>[CustomStateSet](#customstateset)</code>&#44; initially empty&#46;

<a id="customstateset"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface CustomStateSet {
  setlike<DOMString>;
};
```

The <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;states"></a><strong><code>states</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;8"></a>[states set](#states-set)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The <a id="custom&#45;state&#45;pseudo&#45;class&#58;states&#45;set&#45;9"></a>[states set](#states-set) can expose boolean states represented by existence&#47;non&#45;existence of string values&#46; If an author wants to expose a state which can have three values&#44; it can be converted to three exclusive boolean states&#46; For example&#44; a state called <code>readyState</code> with <code>&#34;loading&#34;</code>&#44; <code>&#34;interactive&#34;</code>&#44; and <code>&#34;complete&#34;</code> values can be mapped to three exclusive boolean states&#44; <code>&#34;loading&#34;</code>&#44; <code>&#34;interactive&#34;</code>&#44; and <code>&#34;complete&#34;</code>&#58;

``` text
// Change the readyState from anything to "complete".
this._readyState = "complete";
this._internals.states.delete("loading");
this._internals.states.delete("interactive");
this._internals.states.add("complete");
```

### <a id="common&#45;idioms"></a>4&#46;14 Common idioms without dedicated elements[](#common-idioms)

#### <a id="rel&#45;up"></a>4&#46;14&#46;1 Breadcrumb navigation[](#rel-up)

This specification does not provide a machine&#45;readable way of describing breadcrumb navigation menus&#46; Authors are encouraged to just use a series of links in a paragraph&#46; The <a id="rel&#45;up&#58;the&#45;nav&#45;element"></a><code>[nav](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-nav-element)</code> element can be used to mark the section containing these paragraphs as being navigation blocks&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the current page can be reached via two paths&#46;

``` text
<nav>
 <p>
  <a href="/">Main</a> ▸
  <a href="/products/">Products</a> ▸
  <a href="/products/dishwashers/">Dishwashers</a> ▸
  <a>Second hand</a>
 </p>
 <p>
  <a href="/">Main</a> ▸
  <a href="/second-hand/">Second hand</a> ▸
  <a>Dishwashers</a>
 </p>
</nav>
```

#### <a id="tag&#45;clouds"></a>4&#46;14&#46;2 Tag clouds[](#tag-clouds)

<a id="tag&#45;cloud"></a>This specification does not define any markup specifically for marking up lists of keywords that apply to a group of pages &#40;also known as <em>tag clouds</em>&#41;&#46; In general&#44; authors are encouraged to either mark up such lists using <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> elements with explicit inline counts that are then hidden and turned into a presentational effect using a style sheet&#44; or to use SVG&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here&#44; three tags are included in a short tag cloud&#58;

``` text
<style>
.tag-cloud > li > span { display: none; }
.tag-cloud > li { display: inline; }
.tag-cloud-1 { font-size: 0.7em; }
.tag-cloud-2 { font-size: 0.9em; }
.tag-cloud-3 { font-size: 1.1em; }
.tag-cloud-4 { font-size: 1.3em; }
.tag-cloud-5 { font-size: 1.5em; }

@media speech {
  .tag-cloud > li > span { display:inline }
}
</style>
...
<ul class="tag-cloud">
 <li class="tag-cloud-4"><a title="28 instances" href="/t/apple">apple</a> <span>(popular)</span>
 <li class="tag-cloud-2"><a title="6 instances"  href="/t/kiwi">kiwi</a> <span>(rare)</span>
 <li class="tag-cloud-5"><a title="41 instances" href="/t/pear">pear</a> <span>(very popular)</span>
</ul>
```

The actual frequency of each tag is given using the <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#46; A CSS style sheet is provided to convert the markup into a cloud of differently&#45;sized words&#44; but for user agents that do not support CSS or are not visual&#44; the markup contains annotations like &#34;&#40;popular&#41;&#34; or &#34;&#40;rare&#41;&#34; to categorize the various tags by frequency&#44; thus enabling all users to benefit from the information&#46;

The <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> element is used &#40;rather than <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;the&#45;ol&#45;element"></a><code>[ol](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ol-element)</code>&#41; because the order is not particularly important&#58; while the list is in fact ordered alphabetically&#44; it would convey the same information if ordered by&#44; say&#44; the length of the tag&#46;

The <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;link&#45;type&#45;tag"></a><code>[tag](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#link-type-tag)</code> <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;rel"></a><code>[rel](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-rel)</code>&#45;keyword is <em>not</em> used on these <a id="tag&#45;clouds&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> elements because they do not represent tags that apply to the page itself&#59; they are just part of an index listing the tags themselves&#46;

#### <a id="conversations"></a>4&#46;14&#46;3 Conversations[](#conversations)

This specification does not define a specific element for marking up conversations&#44; meeting minutes&#44; chat transcripts&#44; dialogues in screenplays&#44; instant message logs&#44; and other situations where different players take turns in discourse&#46;

Instead&#44; authors are encouraged to mark up conversations using <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> elements and punctuation&#46; Authors who need to mark the speaker for styling purposes are encouraged to use <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;span&#45;element"></a><code>[span](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-span-element)</code> or <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#46; Paragraphs with their text wrapped in the <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code> element can be used for marking up stage directions&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This example demonstrates this using an extract from Abbot and Costello&#39;s famous sketch&#44; Who&#39;s on first&#58;

``` text
<p> Costello: Look, you gotta first baseman?
<p> Abbott: Certainly.
<p> Costello: Who's playing first?
<p> Abbott: That's right.
<p> Costello becomes exasperated.
<p> Costello: When you pay off the first baseman every month, who gets the money?
<p> Abbott: Every dollar of it.
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following extract shows how an IM conversation log could be marked up&#44; using the <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;data&#45;element"></a><code>[data](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-data-element)</code> element to provide Unix timestamps for each line&#46; Note that the timestamps are provided in a format that the <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;time&#45;element"></a><code>[time](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-time-element)</code> element does not support&#44; so the <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;data&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[data](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-data-element)</code> element is used instead &#40;namely&#44; Unix <code>time&#95;t</code> timestamps&#41;&#46; Had the author wished to mark up the data using one of the date and time formats supported by the <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;time&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[time](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-time-element)</code> element&#44; that element could have been used instead of <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;data&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[data](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-data-element)</code>&#46; This could be advantageous as it would allow data analysis tools to detect the timestamps unambiguously&#44; without coordination with the page author&#46;

``` text
<p> <data value="1319898155">14:22</data> <b>egof</b> I'm not that nerdy, I've only seen 30% of the star trek episodes
<p> <data value="1319898192">14:23</data> <b>kaj</b> if you know what percentage of the star trek episodes you have seen, you are inarguably nerdy
<p> <data value="1319898200">14:23</data> <b>egof</b> it's unarguably
<p> <data value="1319898228">14:23</data> <i>* kaj blinks</i>
<p> <data value="1319898260">14:24</data> <b>kaj</b> you are not helping your case
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

HTML does not have a good way to mark up graphs&#44; so descriptions of interactive conversations from games are more difficult to mark up&#46; This example shows one possible convention using <a id="conversations&#58;the&#45;dl&#45;element"></a><code>[dl](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dl-element)</code> elements to list the possible responses at each point in the conversation&#46; Another option to consider is describing the conversation in the form of a DOT file&#44; and outputting the result as an SVG image to place in the document&#46; [&#91;DOT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOT)

``` text
<p> Next, you meet a fisher. You can say one of several greetings:
<dl>
 <dt> "Hello there!"
 <dd>
  <p> She responds with "Hello, how may I help you?"; you can respond with:
  <dl>
   <dt> "I would like to buy a fish."
   <dd> <p> She sells you a fish and the conversation finishes.
   <dt> "Can I borrow your boat?"
   <dd>
    <p> She is surprised and asks "What are you offering in return?".
    <dl>
     <dt> "Five gold." (if you have enough)
     <dt> "Ten gold." (if you have enough)
     <dt> "Fifteen gold." (if you have enough)
     <dd> <p> She lends you her boat. The conversation ends.
     <dt> "A fish." (if you have one)
     <dt> "A newspaper." (if you have one)
     <dt> "A pebble." (if you have one)
     <dd> <p> "No thanks", she replies. Your conversation options
     at this point are the same as they were after asking to borrow
     her boat, minus any options you've suggested before.
    </dl>
   </dd>
  </dl>
 </dd>
 <dt> "Vote for me in the next election!"
 <dd> <p> She turns away. The conversation finishes.
 <dt> "Madam, are you aware that your fish are running away?"
 <dd>
  <p> She looks at you skeptically and says "Fish cannot run, miss".
  <dl>
   <dt> "You got me!"
   <dd> <p> The fisher sighs and the conversation ends.
   <dt> "Only kidding."
   <dd> <p> "Good one!" she retorts. Your conversation options at this
   point are the same as those following "Hello there!" above.
   <dt> "Oh, then what are they doing?"
   <dd> <p> She looks at her fish, giving you an opportunity to steal
   her boat, which you do. The conversation ends.
  </dl>
 </dd>
</dl>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In some games&#44; conversations are simpler&#58; each character merely has a fixed set of lines that they say&#46; In this example&#44; a game FAQ&#47;walkthrough lists some of the known possible responses for each character&#58;

``` text
<section>
 <h1>Dialogue</h1>
 <p><small>Some characters repeat their lines in order each time you interact
 with them, others randomly pick from amongst their lines. Those who respond in
 order have numbered entries in the lists below.</small>
 <h2>The Shopkeeper</h2>
 <ul>
  <li>How may I help you?
  <li>Fresh apples!
  <li>A loaf of bread for madam?
 </ul>
 <h2>The pilot</h2>
 <p>Before the accident:
 <ul>
  <li>I'm about to fly out, sorry!
  <li>Sorry, I'm just waiting for flight clearance and then I'll be off!
 </ul>
 <p>After the accident:
 <ol>
  <li>I'm about to fly out, sorry!
  <li>Ok, I'm not leaving right now, my plane is being cleaned.
  <li>Ok, it's not being cleaned, it needs a minor repair first.
  <li>Ok, ok, stop bothering me! Truth is, I had a crash.
 </ol>
 <h2>Clan Leader</h2>
 <p>During the first clan meeting:
 <ul>
  <li>Hey, have you seen my daughter? I bet she's up to something nefarious again...
  <li>Nice weather we're having today, eh?
  <li>The name is Bailey, Jeff Bailey. How can I help you today?
  <li>A glass of water? Fresh from the well!
 </ul>
 <p>After the earthquake:
 <ol>
  <li>Everyone is safe in the shelter, we just have to put out the fire!
  <li>I'll go and tell the fire brigade, you keep hosing it down!
 </ol>
</section>
```

#### <a id="footnotes"></a>4&#46;14&#46;4 Footnotes[](#footnotes)

HTML does not have a dedicated mechanism for marking up footnotes&#46; Here are the suggested alternatives&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For short inline annotations&#44; the <a id="footnotes&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute could be used&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; two parts of a dialogue are annotated with footnote&#45;like content using the <a id="footnotes&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;2"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#46;

``` text
<p> <b>Customer</b>: Hello! I wish to register a complaint. Hello. Miss?
<p> <b>Shopkeeper</b>: <span title="Colloquial pronunciation of 'What do you'"
>Watcha</span> mean, miss?
<p> <b>Customer</b>: Uh, I'm sorry, I have a cold. I wish to make a complaint.
<p> <b>Shopkeeper</b>: Sorry, <span title="This is, of course, a lie.">we're
closing for lunch</span>.
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Unfortunately&#44; relying on the <a id="footnotes&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;3"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is currently discouraged as many user agents do not expose the attribute in an accessible manner as required by this specification &#40;e&#46;g&#46; requiring a pointing device such as a mouse to cause a tooltip to appear&#44; which excludes keyboard&#45;only users and touch&#45;only users&#44; such as anyone with a modern phone or tablet&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the <a id="footnotes&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;4"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is used&#44; CSS can be used to draw the reader&#39;s attention to the elements with the attribute&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; the following CSS places a dashed line below elements that have a <a id="footnotes&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;5"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#46;

``` text
[title] { border-bottom: thin dashed; }
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For longer annotations&#44; the <a id="footnotes&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element should be used&#44; pointing to an element later in the document&#46; The convention is that the contents of the link be a number in square brackets&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a footnote in the dialogue links to a paragraph below the dialogue&#46; The paragraph then reciprocally links back to the dialogue&#44; allowing the user to return to the location of the footnote&#46;

``` text
<p> Announcer: Number 16: The <i>hand</i>.
<p> Interviewer: Good evening. I have with me in the studio tonight
Mr Norman St John Polevaulter, who for the past few years has been
contradicting people. Mr Polevaulter, why <em>do</em> you
contradict people?
<p> Norman: I don't. <sup><a href="#fn1" id="r1">[1]</a></sup>
<p> Interviewer: You told me you did!
...
<section>
 <p id="fn1"><a href="#r1">[1]</a> This is, naturally, a lie,
 but paradoxically if it were true he could not say so without
 contradicting the interviewer and thus making it false.</p>
</section>
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For side notes&#44; longer annotations that apply to entire sections of the text rather than just specific words or sentences&#44; the <a id="footnotes&#58;the&#45;aside&#45;element"></a><code>[aside](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-aside-element)</code> element should be used&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a sidebar is given after a dialogue&#44; giving it some context&#46;

``` text
<p> <span class="speaker">Customer</span>: I will not buy this record, it is scratched.
<p> <span class="speaker">Shopkeeper</span>: I'm sorry?
<p> <span class="speaker">Customer</span>: I will not buy this record, it is scratched.
<p> <span class="speaker">Shopkeeper</span>: No no no, this's'a tobacconist's.
<aside>
 <p>In 1970, the British Empire lay in ruins, and foreign
 nationalists frequented the streets — many of them Hungarians
 (not the streets — the foreign nationals). Sadly, Alexander
 Yalt has been publishing incompetently-written phrase books.
</aside>
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For figures or tables&#44; footnotes can be included in the relevant <a id="footnotes&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> or <a id="footnotes&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#44; or in surrounding prose&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a table has cells with footnotes that are given in prose&#46; A <a id="footnotes&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element is used to give a single legend to the combination of the table and its footnotes&#46;

``` text
<figure>
 <figcaption>Table 1. Alternative activities for knights.</figcaption>
 <table>
  <tr>
   <th> Activity
   <th> Location
   <th> Cost
  <tr>
   <td> Dance
   <td> Wherever possible
   <td> £0<sup><a href="#fn1">1</a></sup>
  <tr>
   <td> Routines, chorus scenes<sup><a href="#fn2">2</a></sup>
   <td> Undisclosed
   <td> Undisclosed
  <tr>
   <td> Dining<sup><a href="#fn3">3</a></sup>
   <td> Camelot
   <td> Cost of ham, jam, and spam<sup><a href="#fn4">4</a></sup>
 </table>
 <p id="fn1">1. Assumed.</p>
 <p id="fn2">2. Footwork impeccable.</p>
 <p id="fn3">3. Quality described as "well".</p>
 <p id="fn4">4. A lot.</p>
</figure>
```
